eeb22a243f238ba9.original: Element appears or disappears by changing opacity.
eeb22a243f238ba9.translationZh: 元素通过更改不透明度出现或消失。

8550decd0bc6af71.original: Element enters by sliding in from off-screen (left, right, top, or bottom).
8550decd0bc6af71.translationZh: 元素通过从屏幕外（左、右、上、下）滑入进入。

bb736c722e17ef98.original: Element grows from smaller to full size as it appears, often paired with a fade.
bb736c722e17ef98.translationZh: 元素从较小的尺寸逐渐变大，通常与淡入淡出相结合。

28e39c563b4d9010.original: Element appears with a slight overshoot, like it bounces into place.
28e39c563b4d9010.translationZh: 元素出现轻微超调，就像弹回到位一样。

77f2b48c9b055d4a.original: Content is uncovered gradually, often by animating a clip-path or mask.
77f2b48c9b055d4a.translationZh: 通常通过动画剪辑路径或蒙版来逐渐发现内容。

63fee9c53680d27d.original: The animation an element plays when it's added to or removed from the screen.
63fee9c53680d27d.translationZh: 元素在屏幕上添加或删除时播放的动画。

cd5ceb98fc2416e9.original: Defined points in an animation (0%, 50%, 100%) that the browser fills the gaps between.
cd5ceb98fc2416e9.translationZh: 浏览器填充动画中的定义点（0%、50%、100%）。

fa8dfad210275d83.original: Generating all the in-between frames between a start and end value, so motion is continuous.
fa8dfad210275d83.translationZh: 生成起始值和结束值之间的所有中间帧，因此运动是连续的。

b553039cf5cb76fd.original: Animate several items one after another with a small delay between each, creating a cascade.
b553039cf5cb76fd.translationZh: 依次对多个项目进行动画处理，每个项目之间有很小的延迟，从而创建级联。

efffa96ab171bd71.original: Deliberately timing multiple animations so they feel like one coordinated motion.
efffa96ab171bd71.translationZh: 故意安排多个动画的时间，使它们感觉像是一个协调的运动。

71e9fa5e07b9b7c0.original: Whether an element keeps its first or last frame's styles before the animation starts or after it ends (e.g. forwards).
71e9fa5e07b9b7c0.translationZh: 元素是否在动画开始之前或结束之后（例如向前）保留其第一帧或最后一帧的样式。

3d63388032d65e51.original: An animation that is divided into discrete steps, like a countdown timer.
3d63388032d65e51.translationZh: 分为离散步骤的动画，如倒计时器。

48e258e20d0746f7.original: Move an element along the X or Y axis.
48e258e20d0746f7.translationZh: 沿 X 或 Y 轴移动元素。

8ad69b0c06815493.original: Make an element bigger or smaller.

02aee19abbea929f.original: Spin an element around a point.

26ef78ad03e02d57.original: Slant an element along the X or Y axis, shearing it out of its rectangular shape.
26ef78ad03e02d57.translationZh: 沿 X 或 Y 轴倾斜元素，将其剪切出矩形形状。

f1ee683ebf4651f1.original: Rotate in 3D space (rotateX / rotateY) to add depth.
f1ee683ebf4651f1.translationZh: 在 3D 空间中旋转（rotateX/rotateY）以增加深度。

66460a2bcc599c70.original: How strong the 3D effect looks — a lower value exaggerates depth, like the viewer is closer.
66460a2bcc599c70.translationZh: 3D 效果看起来有多强 - 较低的值会夸大深度，就像观看者离得更近一样。

55ef1c386465db1b.original: The anchor point a scale or rotation grows or spins from.
55ef1c386465db1b.translationZh: 缩放或旋转生长或旋转的锚点。

fe80cb01aeab7526.original: An element animates out of its trigger, like a popover growing from the button that opened it instead of from its own center which is the default in CSS.
fe80cb01aeab7526.translationZh: 元素在其触发器之外进行动画处理，就像弹出窗口从打开它的按钮而不是从其自己的中心生长一样，这是 CSS 中的默认设置。

bd32dd14c2116030.original: One element fades out as another fades in, in the same spot.
bd32dd14c2116030.translationZh: 在同一位置，一个元素淡出，另一个元素淡入。

f323657be16cd5b6.original: A change that keeps the user oriented by visually connecting before and after. For example, making the same rectangle bigger and smaller.
f323657be16cd5b6.translationZh: 通过视觉上连接前后来保持用户导向的更改。例如，放大和缩小同一个矩形。

469e3c80e2d1fe4b.original: One shape smoothly turns into another shape, e.g. Dynamic Island.
469e3c80e2d1fe4b.translationZh: 一种形状平滑地变成另一种形状，例如动态岛。

23a97cfff85f81ae.original: An element travels and transforms from one position into another, like a thumbnail expanding into a card.
23a97cfff85f81ae.translationZh: 元素移动并从一个位置转换到另一个位置，就像缩略图扩展到卡片一样。

6bb0f2c8c2ceffcf.original: When an element's size or position changes, it animates to the new spot instead of snapping.
6bb0f2c8c2ceffcf.translationZh: 当元素的大小或位置发生变化时，它会以动画方式移动到新位置而不是捕捉。

22a9b63194dc7208.original: A section smoothly expands and collapses its height to show or hide content.
22a9b63194dc7208.translationZh: 部分平滑地扩展和折叠其高度以显示或隐藏内容。

0ce5e5305d1a8938.original: Content slides one way going forward and the opposite way going back, so navigation has a sense of direction.
0ce5e5305d1a8938.translationZh: 内容向前滑动，向后滑动，因此导航具有方向感。

9dd2e8d48d7655f4.original: Elements fade or slide into place as they enter the viewport.
9dd2e8d48d7655f4.translationZh: 元素进入视口时会淡出或滑入到位。

ce64ea53ac3e3cb3.original: An animation whose progress is tied directly to scroll position.
ce64ea53ac3e3cb3.translationZh: 进度直接与滚动位置相关的动画。

7ad27cc5adce20a9.original: Background and foreground move at different speeds while scrolling, creating depth.
7ad27cc5adce20a9.translationZh: 滚动时背景和前景以不同的速度移动，创造深度。

40a49d5a9a0f0c13.original: An animation that plays when navigating from one page or route to another.
40a49d5a9a0f0c13.translationZh: 从一个页面或路由导航到另一个页面时播放的动画。

1c5f77dc8684df81.original: The browser morphs between two states or pages, connecting shared elements.
1c5f77dc8684df81.translationZh: 浏览器在两个状态或页面之间变形，连接共享元素。

cf82b4a83361c7ee.original: Visual change when the cursor moves over an element.
cf82b4a83361c7ee.translationZh: 当光标移动到元素上时视觉发生变化。

e2e70b6c266e758a.original: A subtle scale-down when an element is clicked, so it feels physical.
e2e70b6c266e758a.translationZh: 单击元素时会微妙地缩小，因此感觉是物理的。

8e9f38ec0cd423f8.original: A progress effect that fills up while the user holds a button.
8e9f38ec0cd423f8.translationZh: 当用户按住按钮时会填充的进度效果。

4cc07ffe361c639e.original: Moving an element by grabbing it, often with momentum when released.
4cc07ffe361c639e.translationZh: 通过抓住元素来移动它，释放时通常具有动量。

8b85167e49547a1d.original: Dragging items in a list to rearrange them, while the others shift to make room.
8b85167e49547a1d.translationZh: 拖动列表中的项目以重新排列它们，而其他项目则移动以腾出空间。

f7618404ff377b6d.original: Dragging an element off-screen to close it, like a drawer or toast.
f7618404ff377b6d.translationZh: 将元素拖出屏幕以将其关闭，例如抽屉或吐司。

0d41095290d7dda0.original: Resistance and snap-back when you drag past a boundary (the iOS overscroll feel).
0d41095290d7dda0.translationZh: 拖动超过边界时的阻力和弹回（iOS 过度滚动的感觉）。

bd802779e03d0e83.original: A quick side-to-side jitter signaling an error or rejected input.
bd802779e03d0e83.translationZh: 快速的左右抖动表明存在错误或输入被拒绝。

9093dd69850ca5af.original: A circle expanding from the point of a tap, confirming the press.
9093dd69850ca5af.translationZh: 从点击点开始扩展的圆圈，确认按下。

eb0c7f7d187f7369.original: The rate at which an animation speeds up or slows down.
eb0c7f7d187f7369.translationZh: 动画加速或减慢的速率。

1dc83651d4277413.original: Starts fast, ends slow. The default for most UI and anything responding to the user.
1dc83651d4277413.translationZh: 开始快，结束慢。大多数 UI 和响应用户的任何内容的默认值。

606c87f248a85828.original: Starts slow, ends fast. Usually avoided; can feel sluggish.
606c87f248a85828.translationZh: 开始慢，结束快。通常会避免；会感到迟钝。

7fd95f15d375c71b.original: Slow, fast, slow. Good for elements already on screen moving from A to B.
7fd95f15d375c71b.translationZh: 慢，快，慢。适合屏幕上已有的元素从 A 移动到 B。

45a11fa7c76221ea.original: Constant speed. Avoid for UI; reserve for spinners or marquees.
45a11fa7c76221ea.translationZh: 恒速。避免用于 UI；为旋转器或帐篷预留。

e10038671b1f8038.original: A custom easing curve you define for precise control.
e10038671b1f8038.translationZh: 您为精确控制定义的自定义缓动曲线。

b3890e62e3391a8c.original: A curve that accelerates and decelerates at different rates. Feels more alive than a symmetric one.
b3890e62e3391a8c.translationZh: 以不同速率加速和减速的曲线。感觉比对称的更有活力。

e8fb3db48b22fe52.original: Motion driven by physics (tension, mass, damping) rather than a set duration.
e8fb3db48b22fe52.translationZh: 运动由物理（张力、质量、阻尼）驱动，而不是由设定的持续时间驱动。

be151d51a7a02c78.original: How strongly the spring pulls toward its target. Higher feels snappier.
be151d51a7a02c78.translationZh: 弹簧拉向目标的力度有多大。越高感觉越快。

da6a3c61288cb815.original: How quickly a spring settles. Lower damping means more bounce and oscillation.
da6a3c61288cb815.translationZh: 弹簧稳定的速度有多快。较低的阻尼意味着更多的弹跳和振动。

81cffc33cc92185d.original: How heavy the animated element feels. More mass makes it slower and more sluggish.
81cffc33cc92185d.translationZh: 动画元素感觉有多重。质量越大，速度就越慢。

16e5f96c40c02d5f.original: A spring that overshoots and settles, adding playfulness.
16e5f96c40c02d5f.translationZh: 弹簧过冲和稳定，增加了乐趣。

09a23f4e8acf9c6a.original: How long a spring feels finished, even though it keeps micro-settling underneath.
09a23f4e8acf9c6a.translationZh: 弹簧感觉完成的时间有多长，即使它在下面保持微沉降。

06885f76676c483f.original: Motion that carries velocity, especially after a drag or interruption.
06885f76676c483f.translationZh: 带有速度的运动，尤其是在拖动或中断之后。

20d91f08f3b6db7f.original: How fast and in which direction an element is moving. A spring carries it into the next animation when interrupted, so a flicked element keeps its speed.
20d91f08f3b6db7f.translationZh: 元素移动的速度和方向。当中断时，弹簧将其带入下一个动画，因此轻弹的元素保持其速度。

f33d5aae1e20436e.original: An animation that can be smoothly redirected mid-flight instead of finishing first.
f33d5aae1e20436e.translationZh: 可以在飞行中平滑重定向而不是首先完成的动画。

8e01d0e71485ab49.original: Text or content that scrolls continuously in a loop.
8e01d0e71485ab49.translationZh: 循环连续滚动的文本或内容。

2f947539e4d8cd54.original: An animation that repeats, a set number of times or infinitely.
2f947539e4d8cd54.translationZh: 重复一定次数或无限次的动画。

cd2b1e5afc40909c.original: A loop that plays forward then reverses each iteration, instead of jumping back to the start.
cd2b1e5afc40909c.translationZh: 每次迭代向前播放然后反转的循环，而不是跳回到开头。

bf852268e69bb909.original: An element circling around another in a continuous path.
bf852268e69bb909.translationZh: 一个元素在连续路径中围绕另一个元素旋转。

11134cbe285d9621.original: A gentle repeating scale or opacity change to draw attention.
11134cbe285d9621.translationZh: 温和的重复比例或不透明度变化以引起注意。

934ddf63a4037145.original: A gentle, continuous up-and-down drift that makes a static element feel alive and weightless.
934ddf63a4037145.translationZh: 柔和、连续的上下漂移，使静态元素感觉充满活力和失重。

9606f9603cb3bd5a.original: Subtle motion that plays while an element is just sitting there, waiting to be interacted with.
9606f9603cb3bd5a.translationZh: 当元素坐在那里等待交互时，会发生微妙的动作。

bf5d7a7e37706b23.original: A blur filter used to soften an element or mask tiny imperfections.
bf5d7a7e37706b23.translationZh: 用于柔化元素或掩盖微小缺陷的模糊滤镜。

df51d8e47125016e.original: Clipping an element to a shape, used for reveals, masks, and before/after sliders.
df51d8e47125016e.translationZh: 将元素剪切为形状，用于显示、蒙版以及滑块之前/之后。

a6390ecd52c9ec4b.original: Hiding or revealing parts of an element using a shape or gradient — like clip-path, but with soft, fadeable edges.
a6390ecd52c9ec4b.translationZh: 使用形状或渐变隐藏或显示元素的某些部分 - 类似于剪辑路径，但具有柔和、可褪色的边缘。

ce16729bdfda59d1.original: A draggable divider that wipes between two overlaid images to compare them.
ce16729bdfda59d1.translationZh: 可拖动的分隔线，可在两个重叠图像之间擦拭以进行比较。

66b821e1ad2edb32.original: An SVG path that draws itself in, like an invisible pen tracing it.
66b821e1ad2edb32.translationZh: 一条自行绘制的 SVG 路径，就像一支隐形笔在追踪它。

49974bf0d8f4eb2e.original: Text that animates character by character when it changes, drawing attention to the new value.
49974bf0d8f4eb2e.translationZh: 当文本发生变化时，逐个字符以动画形式显示的文本，以引起人们对新值的注意。

aa735c700a2bd6db.original: A placeholder with a moving sheen shown while content loads.
aa735c700a2bd6db.translationZh: 内容加载时显示的具有移动光泽的占位符。

d311327f47e50820.original: Digits rolling or counting up to a value.
d311327f47e50820.translationZh: 数字滚动或计数到某个值。

00d505dc1f455383.original: Fixed-width digits so numbers don't shift around as they change. Essential for tickers, timers, and counters.
00d505dc1f455383.translationZh: 固定宽度的数字，因此数字不会随着变化而移动。对于行情自动收录机、计时器和计数器来说必不可少。

5fd109aca22c7782.original: Text appearing one character at a time, as if being typed.
5fd109aca22c7782.translationZh: 文本一次出现一个字符，就像正在键入一样。

6a976cdb45da31f9.original: Frames drawn per second. 60fps is the baseline for smooth motion; 120fps on newer displays.
6a976cdb45da31f9.translationZh: 每秒绘制的帧数。 60fps是平滑运动的基线；在较新的显示器上为 120 fps。

b1f201d6fe8d7fe1.original: Visible stutter when the browser drops frames because it can't keep up with the animation.
b1f201d6fe8d7fe1.translationZh: 当浏览器因跟不上动画而丢帧时，会出现明显的卡顿。

c8827fecb7e8c67f.original: A frame the browser missed its deadline to draw, causing a tiny hitch in motion.
c8827fecb7e8c67f.translationZh: 浏览器错过了绘制的最后期限的框架，导致运动中出现微小的故障。

8522fa11b44bd39c.original: Letting the GPU move or fade an element on its own layer without redoing layout or paint.
8522fa11b44bd39c.translationZh: 让 GPU 在其自己的图层上移动或淡入淡出元素，而无需重新进行布局或绘制。

9fe27b384ae7209c.original: A CSS hint that an element is about to animate, so the browser can promote it to its own layer ahead of time.
9fe27b384ae7209c.translationZh: CSS 提示某个元素即将产生动画，因此浏览器可以提前将其提升到自己的层。

ac67c505e65d77c1.original: Animating properties like width, height, top, or left that force the browser to recalculate layout every frame, causing jank.
ac67c505e65d77c1.translationZh: 宽度、高度、顶部或左侧等动画属性强制浏览器每帧重新计算布局，从而导致卡顿。

aa05aac90976eb51.original: Motion should serve a function — orient, give feedback, show relationships — not just decorate.
aa05aac90976eb51.translationZh: 运动应该具有一种功能——定向、提供反馈、展示关系——而不仅仅是装饰。

85a5c0140d4aa99d.original: A small wind-up in the opposite direction before a move, hinting at what's about to happen.
85a5c0140d4aa99d.translationZh: 走势前相反方向的小幅结束，暗示即将发生的事情。

919ce4cf8643c06e.original: Parts of an element keep moving and settle slightly after the main motion stops, adding weight.
919ce4cf8643c06e.translationZh: 主运动停止后，元件的某些部分会继续移动并稍微沉降，从而增加重量。

5b3daf43de5ffa95.original: Deforming an element as it moves to convey weight, speed, and flexibility.
5b3daf43de5ffa95.translationZh: 在移动时使元素变形以传达重量、速度和灵活性。

6e8baa4911c5b104.original: The right animation makes an interface feel faster, even when it isn't.
6e8baa4911c5b104.translationZh: 正确的动画可以让界面感觉更快，即使事实并非如此。

cad0f67e93d55ba7.original: The more often a user sees an animation, the shorter and subtler it should be.
cad0f67e93d55ba7.translationZh: 用户看到动画的次数越多，它应该越短、越微妙。

7bc81df5a01c6f07.original: Animating so an element keeps its identity and position across states, so users never lose track of where things went.
7bc81df5a01c6f07.translationZh: 通过动画使元素在不同状态下保持其身份和位置，这样用户就永远不会忘记事物的去向。

4fc0ec79a91193c1.original: Animating transform and opacity lets the GPU keep motion smooth.
4fc0ec79a91193c1.translationZh: 动画变换和不透明度让 GPU 保持运动流畅。

cebee97589bb140c.original: Respecting the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting by toning down or removing motion.
cebee97589bb140c.translationZh: 通过减弱或消除运动来尊重用户偏好的减少运动设置。

2984569a7804fd0b.original: Locate and identify objects in image, video, audio, or other data.
2984569a7804fd0b.translationZh: 定位并识别图像、视频、音频或其他数据中的对象。

936bd653cbb813bd.original: Pull specific data fields from documents they already have.
936bd653cbb813bd.translationZh: 从他们已有的文档中提取特定的数据字段。

efd954d733beb913.original: Measure distances, depths, and dimensions from images or sensors.
efd954d733beb913.translationZh: 从图像或传感器测量距离、深度和尺寸。

97ba9f6f070a105b.original: Reveals the contributing factors behind a model's prediction.
97ba9f6f070a105b.translationZh: 揭示模型预测背后的影响因素。

975d4fc94e1bbe82.original: Predicts future values in a sequence based on historical trends.
975d4fc94e1bbe82.translationZh: 根据历史趋势预测序列中的未来值。

0bf6e39361f4258d.original: Identifies specific events or objects detected in continuous data streams.
0bf6e39361f4258d.translationZh: 识别在连续数据流中检测到的特定事件或对象。

b0c38b6e169c0650.original: Find relevant documents or items from large collections using semantic search.
b0c38b6e169c0650.translationZh: 使用语义搜索从大型集合中查找相关文档或项目。

6832aad4e0df3d20.original: Cut out and separate specific chunks of image or other data.
6832aad4e0df3d20.translationZh: 剪切并分离图像或其他数据的特定块。

c6716f652cd3bc16.translationZh: 将项目分类到预定义的组中。

abe55f3e15137f0e.original: Determine how similar two items are.
abe55f3e15137f0e.translationZh: 确定两个项目的相似程度。

443cebf82394e6d7.original: Sort items by relevance, quality, or importance.
443cebf82394e6d7.translationZh: 按相关性、质量或重要性对项目进行排序。

5124cfc2925907aa.original: Predict numerical values (price, score, rating) from structured data.
5124cfc2925907aa.translationZh: 根据结构化数据预测数值（价格、分数、评级）。

933eaaa63face484.original: Get the key points from multiple sources combined into one.
933eaaa63face484.translationZh: 将多个来源的要点合二为一。

9263033d28da7cc9.original: Evaluate content/claims against evidence to determine accuracy, consistency, or compliance.
9263033d28da7cc9.translationZh: 根据证据评估内容/声明，以确定准确性、一致性或合规性。

3be28f5049692200.original: Roll forward a world state under hypothetical conditions to predict outcomes and compare scenarios.
3be28f5049692200.translationZh: 在假设条件下前滚世界状态以预测结果并比较场景。

cefa58d8b2a8a088.translationZh: 控制在代理之间传递，并说明原因和发生的情况。

78b4d6920484ad88.original: A checklist the agent works through, with progress you can glance.
78b4d6920484ad88.translationZh: 代理工作的清单，进度一目了然。

54a0cc813058d061.original: One pill that always answers: what is it doing, and for how long.
54a0cc813058d061.translationZh: 一颗药丸总能回答：它在做什么，持续多长时间。

caac4d8cdd73db0c.original: Human in the loop: the agent asks before it runs anything with side effects.
caac4d8cdd73db0c.translationZh: 循环中的人：代理在运行任何有副作用的操作之前进行询问。

9aeb40eef93a1e52.original: A generated document as a tangible object, written live and versioned.
9aeb40eef93a1e52.translationZh: 生成的文档作为有形对象，实时编写并进行版本控制。

68956dcb9bd2cd40.original: A floating chat bubble for support widgets, help desks, and embedded assistants.
68956dcb9bd2cd40.translationZh: 用于支持小部件、帮助台和嵌入式助手的浮动聊天气泡。

6afcafcf77e9d1d6.original: A resizable side panel for copilot experiences and contextual assistance.
6afcafcf77e9d1d6.translationZh: 可调整大小的侧面板，用于副驾驶体验和上下文帮助。

928ddd5739ac5dd7.original: Runtime attachments for the composer and messages, with previews, progress, and removal.
928ddd5739ac5dd7.translationZh: 编写器和消息的运行时附件，包括预览、进度和删除。

cc0fe498f6f5899f.original: Work still going somewhere else, and the results waiting to be collected.
cc0fe498f6f5899f.translationZh: 工作仍在其他地方进行，结果等待收集。

3541be68f82d6671.original: The thread steps aside and the document takes the room, still being written as you read.
3541be68f82d6671.translationZh: 线程退到一边，文档占据了空间，在您阅读时仍在编写。

ab7b0406c303b28e.original: Area, line, and bars, with points landing one at a time as the series streams in.
ab7b0406c303b28e.translationZh: 区域、线条和条形，随着系列的涌入，点一次落地一个。

fe55763aa8d179fc.original: The whole family working together: a message, a pause, a streamed reply.
fe55763aa8d179fc.translationZh: 全家人一起工作：一条消息，一个暂停，一个流式回复。

66e34dd7c1d80aa8.original: Points you can fall back to, with what each one would give back.
66e34dd7c1d80aa8.translationZh: 您可以回溯到的点，以及每个点会回馈的内容。

8783404b97e69f03.original: A unified diff with tinted additions and removals, sized for chat.
8783404b97e69f03.translationZh: 带有着色添加和删除的统一差异，大小适合聊天。

235767fd0d1bb4ed.original: A snippet with a run button, and the output it produced attached below it.
235767fd0d1bb4ed.translationZh: 带有运行按钮的代码片段，其生成的输出附加在其下方。

ffdb30426c2047ac.original: Everything the app can do, one keystroke away and grouped by where it acts.
ffdb30426c2047ac.translationZh: 应用程序可以执行的所有操作，只需按一下键即可完成，并按其作用位置进行分组。

deef7c04ee06ae53.original: Two options weighed side by side, with the pick named and argued.
deef7c04ee06ae53.translationZh: 两个选项并列权衡，并命名并争论了选择。

da3be97974a618eb.original: Files stage inside the composer with per-file progress before the message sends.
da3be97974a618eb.translationZh: 在消息发送之前，文件在编辑器中暂存，并显示每个文件的进度。

8b4de0baea26f913.original: A token ring in the rail fills as the conversation grows, warning near the limit.
8b4de0baea26f913.translationZh: 随着对话的进行，轨道上的令牌环被填满，警告接近极限。

9f820273599494e0.original: Type @ to pull people and agents into the conversation, filtered as you go.
9f820273599494e0.translationZh: 输入 @ 将人员和代理拉入对话，并进行过滤。

e92b489b4bf264fb.original: The model lives in the composer rail, one tap away with context at a glance.
e92b489b4bf264fb.translationZh: 该模型位于作曲家导轨中，只需轻轻一按即可查看上下文。

5c11c6f8c8dea364.original: Type a slash and the command menu floats above the input, filtering as you continue.
5c11c6f8c8dea364.translationZh: 键入斜杠，命令菜单就会浮动在输入上方，并在您继续操作时进行过滤。

3ec1f2be3b927306.original: A character-triggered picker for mentions, slash commands, and nested composer actions.
3ec1f2be3b927306.translationZh: 字符触发的选择器，用于提及、斜线命令和嵌套的编辑器操作。

b68ace5dc4da6ab7.original: The mic morphs the input into a live waveform, then lands the transcript as text.
b68ace5dc4da6ab7.translationZh: 麦克风将输入转换为实时波形，然后将转录内容以文本形式呈现。

1d9017408543695f.original: The unified input: attachments, commands, mentions, models, voice, and context in one surface.
1d9017408543695f.translationZh: 统一输入：一个表面上的附件、命令、提及、模型、语音和上下文。

14e8963bf2519095.original: The screen the agent is driving, with a cursor trail and what it is doing right now.
14e8963bf2519095.translationZh: 代理正在驾驶的屏幕，带有光标轨迹以及它现在正在做什么。

e0a94979d62713cf.original: Which claims came from a source, which were inferred, and which are guesses.
e0a94979d62713cf.translationZh: 哪些说法来自来源，哪些是推断的，哪些是猜测。

21d5c9b4306ecae7.original: The socket drops, the run keeps going on the server, and the stream is picked back up.
21d5c9b4306ecae7.translationZh: 套接字断开，服务器上继续运行，并且重新拾取流。

59923f09695ddff5.original: Where the window actually went: prompt, tools, files, conversation, and what's left.
59923f09695ddff5.translationZh: 窗口实际去了哪里：提示符、工具、文件、对话以及剩下的内容。

9b1f343cd6baf0da.original: Model context usage as a ring, bar, or text value with a detailed hover view.
9b1f343cd6baf0da.translationZh: 将上下文使用建模为带有详细悬停视图的环、条或文本值。

6d177679fa4225cb.original: Find inside a long thread, with every hit marked down the scrollbar.
6d177679fa4225cb.translationZh: 在一个长线程中查找，每个点击都标记在滚动条上。

c9c49127f02c6157.original: What the run spent, split by model, against the session total.
c9c49127f02c6157.translationZh: 运行花费的金额（按模型划分）与会话总计。

47836263428c9f4d.original: A small comparison table the model can answer with directly.
47836263428c9f4d.translationZh: 模型可以直接回答的小比较表。

36b91690a7254406.original: Chronology in a long thread: days marked, times on hover.
36b91690a7254406.translationZh: 长串中的年表：标记日期，悬停时间。

5ae6cf1fa234f752.original: A drawn answer with zoom, reset, and a full-bleed view; you hand it the rendered graphic.
5ae6cf1fa234f752.translationZh: 带有缩放、重置和全屏视图的绘制答案；你把渲染的图形交给它。

99e914daa1cc115b.original: A message renderer that turns mention directives into inline, runtime-aware chips.
99e914daa1cc115b.translationZh: 消息渲染器，将提及指令转换为内联、运行时感知芯片。

049712e946725fc6.original: A document the answer leans on, with the quoted passage and the page to jump to.
049712e946725fc6.translationZh: 答案所依赖的文档，包含引用的段落和要跳转到的页面。

250553216a1a2629.original: Come back to a thread and the sentence you never sent is still waiting.
250553216a1a2629.translationZh: 回到一个线程，你从未发送过的句子仍在等待。

d921bcc25fc99724.original: Rewrite a turn in place, told up front how many replies the edit throws away.
d921bcc25fc99724.translationZh: 就地重写一个回合，预先告知编辑丢弃了多少回复。

4d85178e95ea416e.original: A server pausing mid-tool-call to ask you for the fields it still needs.
4d85178e95ea416e.translationZh: 服务器暂停中间工具调用，询问您它仍然需要的字段。

56f2c0a95ceb4647.original: The first screen: a greeting, three ways in, and the composer front and center.
56f2c0a95ceb4647.translationZh: 第一个屏幕：问候语，三路进入，作曲家在前面和中间。

89ddd434b6c2b2b9.original: A quiet failure banner with a retry path, not a modal in your face.
89ddd434b6c2b2b9.translationZh: 带有重试路径的安静失败横幅，而不是您脸上的模式。

53ee7177df1f634c.original: A thumbs-down that asks why, so the signal arrives with a reason attached.
53ee7177df1f634c.translationZh: 询问为什么的反对，因此信号到达时附有原因。

1f74df5dad49070d.original: Everything a run touched, as a tree, with the churn spelled out per file.
1f74df5dad49070d.translationZh: 运行所触及的所有内容，就像一棵树一样，每个文件都详细说明了流失情况。

fac125c100382ac0.original: File message parts with type-aware icons, filename, size, and download actions.
fac125c100382ac0.translationZh: 带有类型识别图标、文件名、大小和下载操作的文件消息部分。

8d21507c66c5a0d5.original: Work as a graph rather than a list: branches that fan out and rejoin.
8d21507c66c5a0d5.translationZh: 作为图表而不是列表工作：扇出并重新连接的分支。

317050cd13e87334.original: Prompt chips populated from the runtime's generated follow-up suggestions.
317050cd13e87334.translationZh: 根据运行时生成的后续建议填充的提示芯片。

4448b044966e751f.original: A styled component library for rendering structured generative UI output.
4448b044966e751f.translationZh: 用于渲染结构化生成 UI 输出的样式化组件库。

a667c17d4a127819.original: A refusal in its own shape, with the nearest thing it can do instead.
a667c17d4a127819.translationZh: 以它自己的形式拒绝，用它能做的最接近的事情来代替。

2e9234b0de43928d.original: An activity heat map with month labels, weekday labels, legend, and tooltip.
2e9234b0de43928d.translationZh: 带有月份标签、工作日标签、图例和工具提示的活动热图。

88cd75697af5a547.original: A dot grid holds the frame while the image resolves out of a blur.
88cd75697af5a547.translationZh: 点网格固定框架，同时图像不再模糊。

4f3bfeb071a24a8e.original: Image message parts with preview, loading states, actions, and a fullscreen view.
4f3bfeb071a24a8e.translationZh: 带有预览、加载状态、操作和全屏视图的图像消息部分。

f6368aa37b909f9b.original: Numbered references inside a sentence, each with a hover preview of its source.
f6368aa37b909f9b.translationZh: 句子内的编号参考文献，每个参考文献都有其来源的悬停预览。

4aa69cbf86859a9d.original: Work measured in minutes: weighted stages, an ETA, and a way out.
4aa69cbf86859a9d.translationZh: 以分钟为单位的工作量：加权阶段、预计到达时间和出路。

6a766e6174edc55d.original: The floating entry point, and the panel it opens into.
6a766e6174edc55d.translationZh: 浮动入口点及其打开的面板。

3febc8be7ca2c3a8.original: A pixel matrix that keeps time while the model has nothing to show yet.
3febc8be7ca2c3a8.translationZh: 当模型还没有任何东西可显示时，可以保持时间的像素矩阵。

d6336d50488a55f3.original: Inline SVG marks for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google model providers.
d6336d50488a55f3.translationZh: OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 模型提供商的内联 SVG 标记。

7bda381de76416d1.original: A location answer: pins, a route between them, and the list they came from.
7bda381de76416d1.translationZh: 位置答案：引脚、引脚之间的路线以及它们来自的列表。

195e91cc7fd92048.original: Assistant markdown with headings, lists, links, tables, and code blocks.
195e91cc7fd92048.translationZh: 带有标题、列表、链接、表格和代码块的辅助降价。

d07c8c68c2672a30.original: Rendered expressions with the working shown, one step at a time.
d07c8c68c2672a30.translationZh: 渲染表达式并显示工作原理，一次一步。

c21cf8d745b51c3c.original: A dialog for connectors and custom MCP servers, including authentication and connection state.
c21cf8d745b51c3c.translationZh: 连接器和自定义 MCP 服务器的对话框，包括身份验证和连接状态。

d801ca94dea6f91d.original: Which servers are connected, what each one brought, and which is still waiting on you.
d801ca94dea6f91d.translationZh: 连接了哪些服务器，每台服务器带来了什么，哪些还在等你。

afda5e014624f45a.original: What it now remembers about you, written during the turn and removable.
afda5e014624f45a.translationZh: 它现在记住的关于你的信息，在回合期间写入并且可移除。

abde420b97ad74b0.original: Mermaid diagrams rendered inside messages, including partial streaming input.
abde420b97ad74b0.translationZh: 消息内呈现的美人鱼图，包括部分流输入。

f1b37275babf12cd.original: Copy, rate, and regenerate. Each action confirms itself with a small state change.
f1b37275babf12cd.translationZh: 复制、评级和重新生成。每个动作都会通过一个小的状态变化来确认自己。

575ddc457aec68d1.original: Navigate between regenerated versions of the same answer without losing your place.
575ddc457aec68d1.translationZh: 在同一答案的重新生成版本之间导航，而不会丢失您的位置。

91d3a217e9040b8a.original: A user bubble and a streaming assistant reply, with actions that appear on hover.
91d3a217e9040b8a.translationZh: 用户气泡和流媒体助理回复，以及悬停时显示的操作。

b7804af5236be66b.original: Turns you typed while a run was in flight, stacked and cancelable until it finishes.
b7804af5236be66b.translationZh: 让您在运行过程中键入、堆叠并可取消，直到运行完成。

30f12ecd8c3bc8bb.original: Streaming statistics for the current message, including first token, total time, and speed.
30f12ecd8c3bc8bb.translationZh: 当前消息的流媒体统计信息，包括第一个令牌、总时间和速度。

6af513db368c71c2.original: The bottom sheet: keyboard-aware, quick actions above, thumb-sized targets.
6af513db368c71c2.translationZh: 底部表格：键盘感知，上方快速操作，拇指大小的目标。

e6b55fade3d20a20.original: A searchable runtime model picker with grouped providers and reasoning effort controls.
e6b55fade3d20a20.translationZh: 具有分组提供程序和推理工作控制的可搜索运行时模型选择器。

e2e9ec4591712742.original: Digits that roll into place as a count updates in real time.
e2e9ec4591712742.translationZh: 随着计数实时更新而滚动到位的数字。

386feeb27fab4b5a.original: First run: three moves that teach what this assistant is actually for.
386feeb27fab4b5a.translationZh: 第一次运行：三个动作，教导这个助手的实际用途。

5a78ea2ec1bcdbf7.original: The realtime voice orb, with connection, mute, and speaking state controls.
5a78ea2ec1bcdbf7.translationZh: 实时语音球，具有连接、静音和讲话状态控制。

b95824918d584e18.original: Granting a capability rather than approving one action, with the reach spelled out.
b95824918d584e18.translationZh: 授予一项能力而不是批准一项行动，并明确其范围。

8701a68a74ccd8dc.original: Prompts you saved, searchable, with their variables shown before you insert one.
8701a68a74ccd8dc.translationZh: 提示您已保存、可搜索，并在插入变量之前显示其变量。

610a2c84252955f5.original: How much is left, when it comes back, and the way to get more.
610a2c84252955f5.translationZh: 还剩下多少，什么时候回来，以及如何获得更多。

33760a7a1d34fc11.original: Select message text, quote it from a floating toolbar, and carry it into the composer.
33760a7a1d34fc11.translationZh: 选择消息文本，从浮动工具栏中引用它，并将其带入编辑器中。

a85a1aed1a93cb5f.original: An answer played back, the spoken word lit as it goes, speed under your thumb.
a85a1aed1a93cb5f.translationZh: 播放了一个答案，说出的单词随着播放而亮起，速度在您的拇指之下。

d965a5c89247ed93.original: How hard to think, and how much of that budget the run actually spent.
d965a5c89247ed93.translationZh: 想想有多难，运行实际花费了多少预算。

ae4db831d72d1ac2.original: A collapsible renderer for assistant reasoning that follows the active message part.
ae4db831d72d1ac2.translationZh: 用于辅助推理的可折叠渲染器，位于活动消息部分之后。

a5e7695beff2c55a.original: The agent proposes a change with its confidence, and waits for a yes.
a5e7695beff2c55a.translationZh: 代理充满信心地提出更改，并等待同意。

39333d07bd5c9e8b.original: Fork the same turn to a different model instead of rolling the same dice.
39333d07bd5c9e8b.translationZh: 将相同的回合分叉到不同的模型，而不是掷相同的骰子。

aa2cf06827f4393d.original: An outline that fills in section by section, each carrying the sources behind it.
aa2cf06827f4393d.translationZh: 逐节填写的大纲，每个部分都带有其背后的来源。

bcbf1fb32cce0289.original: The passages a retrieval answer stands on, scored, before the answer itself arrives.
bcbf1fb32cce0289.translationZh: 检索答案所在的段落，在答案本身到达之前进行评分。

97eb83aca138cdfc.original: The same diff, but each hunk is a decision: keep it, discard it, apply what survived.
97eb83aca138cdfc.translationZh: 相同的差异，但每个块都是一个决定：保留它，丢弃它，应用幸存的东西。

3fe2aeeb6a4b4b35.original: A run that repeats on its own, with its cadence and how it has been doing.
3fe2aeeb6a4b4b35.translationZh: 自行重复的跑步，有其节奏和表现。

590a5b8804371f22.original: A verdict with its arithmetic shown: criteria, weights, and what pulled it down.
590a5b8804371f22.translationZh: 显示了其算术的判决：标准、权重以及导致其下降的原因。

afbef00beeb696bb.original: Streaming never steals your scroll position; a pill offers the way back down.
afbef00beeb696bb.translationZh: 流媒体永远不会窃取您的滚动位置；一颗药丸提供了恢复的方法。

2b72495a8c423ea8.original: Model, system prompt, temperature, and what the assistant is allowed to do.
2b72495a8c423ea8.translationZh: 型号、系统提示、温度、助手可以执行的操作。

169e572fddc59779.original: A read-only transcript someone sent you, with a way to pick it up yourself.
169e572fddc59779.translationZh: 某人发送给您的只读成绩单，您可以自行获取。

e3ff19cfe6594b84.original: Shiki code highlighting that defers tokenization until a message part settles.
e3ff19cfe6594b84.translationZh: Shiki 代码突出显示，推迟标记化直到消息部分解决。

cc720fa4a269411f.original: Runtime URL sources with favicon, title, and an external link.
cc720fa4a269411f.translationZh: 带有网站图标、标题和外部链接的运行时 URL 源。

5e8c70b6c6d44d6d.original: Who is talking, once a thread holds more than a user and one model.
5e8c70b6c6d44d6d.translationZh: 谁在说话，一旦一个线程拥有多个用户和一个模型。

9bb842ece9e6f96e.original: The most common structured answer after a table: one object, labeled.
9bb842ece9e6f96e.translationZh: 表格之后最常见的结构化答案：一个对象，带标签。

cb005840f2bd518d.original: You pressed stop. The half-written answer stays, and continuing is one tap away.
cb005840f2bd518d.translationZh: 您按下了停止键。写了一半的答案会保留下来，只需轻轻一按即可继续。

7b3832c7dba463c5.original: Tokens arrive softly: the newest words land in blue and settle into ink.
7b3832c7dba463c5.translationZh: 令牌轻柔地到达：最新的单词以蓝色降落并融入墨水。

ed66fb7552321fcf.original: Parallel workers with their own progress, models, and completions.
ed66fb7552321fcf.translationZh: 具有自己的进度、模型和完成情况的并行工作人员。

b74bd4f7372bbd8c.original: Prism-based code highlighting for assistant markdown code blocks.
b74bd4f7372bbd8c.translationZh: 基于 Prism 的代码突出显示，用于辅助 Markdown 代码块。

88a8f014301ac0bb.original: Command output that streams line by line and ends with an exit status.
88a8f014301ac0bb.translationZh: 命令输出逐行流式传输并以退出状态结束。

12d32542e758b05d.original: A live status line that names what the agent is doing right now, with elapsed time.
12d32542e758b05d.translationZh: 实时状态行，列出代理现在正在执行的操作以及经过的时间。

0406dcff53afb1b9.original: A complete sidebar shell that places the runtime thread list beside the active conversation.

b891342a7e100b0e.original: An accordion is a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title, content snippet, or thumbnail representing a section of content. The headings function as controls that enable users to reveal or hide their associated sections of content. Accordions are commonly used to reduce the need to scroll when presenting multiple sections of content on a single page.
b891342a7e100b0e.translationZh: 手风琴是一组垂直堆叠的交互式标题，每个标题都包含代表内容部分的标题、内容片段或缩略图。标题充当控件，使用户能够显示或隐藏其相关的内容部分。手风琴通常用于减少在单个页面上呈现多个内容部分时滚动的需要。

196e9ceac2bcf9c6.original: An alert is an element that displays a brief, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting the user's task. Dynamically rendered alerts are automatically announced by most screen readers, and in some operating systems, they may trigger an alert sound. It is important to note that, at this time, screen readers do not inform users of alerts that are present on the page before page load completes.
196e9ceac2bcf9c6.translationZh: 警报是一种元素，它以吸引用户注意力而不中断用户任务的方式显示简短的重要消息。大多数屏幕阅读器会自动宣布动态呈现的警报，并且在某些操作系统中，它们可能会触发警报声音。请务必注意，此时，屏幕阅读器不会在页面加载完成之前通知用户页面上出现的警报。

d1d27c511d6e5f7f.original: An alert dialog is a modal dialog that interrupts the user's workflow to communicate an important message and acquire a response. Examples include action confirmation prompts and error message confirmations. The alertdialog role enables assistive technologies and browsers to distinguish alert dialogs from other dialogs so they have the option of giving alert dialogs special treatment, such as playing a system alert sound.
d1d27c511d6e5f7f.translationZh: 警报对话框是一种模式对话框，它会中断用户的工作流程以传达重要消息并获取响应。示例包括操作确认提示和错误消息确认。 Alertdialog 角色使辅助技术和浏览器能够将警报对话框与其他对话框区分开来，以便它们可以选择对警报对话框进行特殊处理，例如播放系统警报声音。

8fa76e7a3a98c5a2.original: A breadcrumb trail consists of a list of links to the parent pages of the current page in hierarchical order. It helps users find their place within a website or web application. Breadcrumbs are often placed horizontally before a page's main content.
8fa76e7a3a98c5a2.translationZh: 面包屑路径由一系列按层次结构顺序指向当前页面的父页面的链接组成。它可以帮助用户在网站或网络应用程序中找到自己的位置。面包屑通常水平放置在页面主要内容之前。

40e17630c49731e7.original: A button is a widget that enables users to trigger an action or event, such as submitting a form, opening a dialog, canceling an action, or performing a delete operation. A common convention for informing users that a button launches a dialog is to append "…" (ellipsis) to the button label, e.g., "Save as…".
40e17630c49731e7.translationZh: 按钮是一个小部件，使用户能够触发操作或事件，例如提交表单、打开对话框、取消操作或执行删除操作。通知用户按钮启动对话框的常见约定是将“...”（省略号）附加到按钮标签，例如“另存为...”。

9855fdb2dcdb7031.translationZh: 轮播（幻灯片放映或图像旋转器）

332d18c88898aa29.original: A carousel presents a set of items, referred to as slides, by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more slides. Typically, one slide is displayed at a time, and users can activate a next or previous slide control that hides the current slide and "rotates" the next or previous slide into view. In some implementations, rotation automatically starts when the page loads, and it may also automatically stop once all the slides have been displayed. While a slide may contain any type of content, image carousels where each slide contains nothing more than a single image are common.
332d18c88898aa29.translationZh: 轮播通过顺序显示一张或多张幻灯片的子集来呈现一组项目（称为幻灯片）。通常，一次显示一张幻灯片，用户可以激活下一张或上一张幻灯片控件，该控件隐藏当前幻灯片并将下一张或上一张幻灯片“旋转”到视图中。在一些实现中，旋转在页面加载时自动开始，并且也可以在所有幻灯片显示完毕后自动停止。虽然幻灯片可以包含任何类型的内容，但每张幻灯片仅包含单个图像的图像轮播很常见。

ba35974492984f00.original: WAI-ARIA supports two types of checkbox widgets: dual-state checkboxes toggle between two choices -- checked and not checked -- and tri-state checkboxes, which allow an additional third state known as partially checked.
ba35974492984f00.translationZh: WAI-ARIA 支持两种类型的复选框小部件：双状态复选框在两种选择（选中和未选中）之间切换，以及三态复选框，允许额外的第三种状态（称为部分选中）。

5865bfa47a2fd82f.original: A combobox is an input widget that has an associated popup. The popup enables users to choose a value for the input from a collection. The popup may be a listbox , grid , tree , or dialog.
5865bfa47a2fd82f.translationZh: 组合框是一个具有关联弹出窗口的输入小部件。弹出窗口使用户能够从集合中选择输入值。弹出窗口可以是列表框、网格、树或对话框。

0665bd5b86a5dd88.original: A dialog is a window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window. Windows under a modal dialog are inert. That is, users cannot interact with content outside an active dialog window. Inert content outside an active dialog is typically visually obscured or dimmed so it is difficult to discern, and in some implementations, attempts to interact with the inert content cause the dialog to close.
0665bd5b86a5dd88.translationZh: 对话框是覆盖在主窗口或另一个对话框窗口上的窗口。模式对话框下的窗口是惰性的。也就是说，用户无法与活动对话窗口之外的内容进行交互。活动对话框外部的惰性内容通常在视觉上模糊或变暗，因此难以辨别，并且在一些实现中，尝试与惰性内容交互会导致对话框关闭。

7d115da36f18ebad.original: A disclosure is a widget that enables content to be either collapsed (hidden) or expanded (visible). It has two elements: a disclosure button and a section of content whose visibility is controlled by the button. When the controlled content is hidden, the button is often styled as a typical push button with a right-pointing arrow or triangle to hint that activating the button will display additional content. When the content is visible, the arrow or triangle typically points down.
7d115da36f18ebad.translationZh: 披露是一个小部件，可以折叠（隐藏）或展开（可见）内容。它有两个元素：一个公开按钮和一个其可见性由按钮控制的内容部分。当受控内容被隐藏时，该按钮通常被设计为带有向右箭头或三角形的典型按钮，以暗示激活该按钮将显示其他内容。当内容可见时，箭头或三角形通常指向下方。

3ffa936273fd00a6.original: A feed is a section of a page that automatically loads new sections of content as the user scrolls. The sections of content in a feed are presented in article elements. So, a feed can be thought of as a dynamic list of articles that often appears to scroll infinitely.
3ffa936273fd00a6.translationZh: 提要是页面的一部分，当用户滚动时自动加载新的内容部分。提要中的内容部分以文章元素的形式呈现。因此，提要可以被认为是经常出现无限滚动的动态文章列表。

c81afbeacf8734c5.original: Grid (Interactive Tabular Data or Layout Container)
c81afbeacf8734c5.translationZh: 网格（交互式表格数据或布局容器）

3b2523e3b15e37c4.original: A grid widget is a container that enables users to navigate the information or interactive elements it contains using directional navigation keys, such as arrow keys, Home , and End . As a generic container widget that offers flexible keyboard navigation, it can serve a wide variety of needs. It can be used for purposes as simple as grouping a collection of checkboxes or navigation links or as complex as creating a full-featured spreadsheet application. While the words "row" and "column" are used in the names of WAI-ARIA attributes and by assistive technologies when describing and presenting the logical structure of elements with the grid role, using the grid role on an element does not necessarily imply that its visual presentation is tabular.
3b2523e3b15e37c4.translationZh: 网格小部件是一个容器，使用户能够使用方向导航键（例如箭头键、 Home 和 End ）来导航其包含的信息或交互元素。作为提供灵活键盘导航的通用容器小部件，它可以满足各种需求。它可以用于简单的用途，例如对复选框或导航链接的集合进行分组，也可以用于复杂的用途，例如创建功能齐全的电子表格应用程序。虽然在描述和呈现具有网格角色的元素的逻辑结构时，WAI-ARIA 属性的名称和辅助技术中使用了“行”和“列”这两个词，但在元素上使用网格角色并不一定意味着其视觉呈现是表格形式的。

a84fcc13c94d43fe.original: Landmarks are a set of eight roles that identify the major sections of a page. Each landmark role enables assistive technology users to perceive the start and end of a feature of the high-level page structure that is usually conveyed visually with placement, spacing, color, or borders. For example, the main landmark designates the section that contains the main content of the page. In addition to conveying structure, landmarks enable browsers and assistive technologies to facilitate efficient keyboard navigation among sections of a page.
a84fcc13c94d43fe.translationZh: 地标是一组八个角色，用于标识页面的主要部分。每个标志性角色都使辅助技术用户能够感知高级页面结构的功能的开始和结束，这些功能通常通过位置、间距、颜色或边框进行视觉传达。例如，主要地标指定包含页面主要内容的部分。除了传达结构之外，地标还使浏览器和辅助技术能够促进页面各部分之间的有效键盘导航。

aa51e0cc9f50e86e.original: A link widget provides an interactive reference to a resource. The target resource can be either external or local, i.e., either outside or within the current page or application.
aa51e0cc9f50e86e.translationZh: 链接小部件提供对资源的交互式引用。目标资源可以是外部的或本地的，即当前页面或应用程序外部或内部。

7e791b7d8cb010c1.original: A listbox widget presents a list of options and allows a user to select one or more of them. A listbox that allows a single option to be chosen is a single-select listbox; one that allows multiple options to be selected is a multi-select listbox.
7e791b7d8cb010c1.translationZh: 列表框小部件显示选项列表并允许用户选择其中一个或多个。允许选择单个选项的列表框是单选列表框；允许选择多个选项的一种是多选列表框。

fd0f945ab46febde.original: A menu button is a button that opens a menu as described in the Menu and Menubar Pattern . It is often styled as a typical push button with a downward pointing arrow or triangle to hint that activating the button will display a menu.
fd0f945ab46febde.translationZh: 菜单按钮是打开菜单的按钮，如菜单和菜单栏模式中所述。它通常被设计为带有向下箭头或三角形的典型按钮，以暗示激活该按钮将显示菜单。

e5f40ae6af6811d6.original: A menu is a widget that offers a list of choices to the user, such as a set of actions or functions. Menu widgets behave like native operating system menus, such as the menus that pull down from the menubars commonly found at the top of many desktop application windows. A menu is usually opened, or made visible, by activating a menu button , choosing an item in a menu that opens a sub menu, or by invoking a command, such as Shift + F10 in Windows, that opens a context specific menu. When a user activates a choice in a menu, the menu usually closes unless the choice opened a submenu.
e5f40ae6af6811d6.translationZh: 菜单是一个向用户提供选项列表的小部件，例如一组操作或功能。菜单小部件的行为类似于本机操作系统菜单，例如从许多桌面应用程序窗口顶部常见的菜单栏下拉的菜单。通常通过激活菜单按钮、选择打开子菜单的菜单中的项目或调用打开上下文特定菜单的命令（例如 Windows 中的 Shift + F10）来打开菜单或使其可见。当用户激活菜单中的选项时，菜单通常会关闭，除非该选项打开了子菜单。

0fa80cade8da9a17.original: A meter is a graphical display of a numeric value that varies within a defined range. For example, a meter could be used to depict a device's current battery percentage or a car's fuel level.
0fa80cade8da9a17.translationZh: 仪表是在定义范围内变化的数值的图形显示。例如，仪表可用于描述设备当前的电池百分比或汽车的燃油水平。

e6afaca7309715d1.original: A radio group is a set of checkable buttons, known as radio buttons, where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time. Some implementations may initialize the set with all buttons in the unchecked state in order to force the user to check one of the buttons before moving past a certain point in the workflow.
e6afaca7309715d1.translationZh: 单选组是一组可检查的按钮，称为单选按钮，一次只能检查一个按钮。一些实现可能会初始化所有按钮处于未选中状态的集合，以便强制用户在移动到工作流中的某一点之前检查其中一个按钮。

f75f124c0b7db212.original: A multi-thumb slider implements the Slider Pattern but includes two or more thumbs, often on a single rail. Each thumb sets one of the values in a group of related values. For example, in a product search, a two-thumb slider could be used to enable users to set the minimum and maximum price limits for the search. In many two-thumb sliders, the thumbs are not allowed to pass one another, such as when the slider sets the minimum and maximum values for a range. For example, in a price range selector, the maximum value of the thumb that sets the lower end of the range is limited by the current value of the thumb that sets the upper end of the range. Conversely, the minimum value of the upper end thumb is limited by the current value of the lower end thumb. However, in some multi-thumb sliders, each thumb sets a value that does not depend on the other thumb values.
f75f124c0b7db212.translationZh: 多拇指滑块实现滑块模式，但包含两个或更多拇指，通常位于单个导轨上。每个拇指设置一组相关值中的一个值。例如，在产品搜索中，可以使用两拇指滑块使用户能够设置搜索的最低和最高价格限制。在许多两拇指滑块中，不允许拇指相互经过，例如当滑块设置某一范围的最小值和最大值时。例如，在价格范围选择器中，设置范围下端的缩略图的最大值受到设置范围上端的缩略图的当前值的限制。相反，上端拇指的最小值受到下端拇指的当前值的限制。但是，在某些多拇指滑块中，每个拇指设置的值不依赖于其他拇指值。

26ee1f1e24f8a1e6.original: A slider is an input where the user selects a value from within a given range. Sliders typically have a slider thumb that can be moved along a bar, rail, or track to change the value of the slider.
26ee1f1e24f8a1e6.translationZh: 滑块是用户从给定范围内选择值的输入。滑块通常有一个滑块拇指，可以沿着条、导轨或轨道移动以更改滑块的值。

68936732bafa4565.original: A spinbutton is an input widget that restricts its value to a set or range of discrete values. For example, in a widget that enables users to set an alarm, a spinbutton could allow users to select a number from 0 to 59 for the minute of an hour.
68936732bafa4565.translationZh: 旋转按钮是一个输入小部件，它将其值限制为一组或一系列离散值。例如，在允许用户设置闹钟的小部件中，旋转按钮可以允许用户选择 0 到 59 之间的数字来表示一小时中的分钟。

efa0cf1217df0c30.original: A switch is an input widget that allows users to choose one of two values: on or off . Switches are similar to checkboxes and toggle buttons , which can also serve as binary inputs. One difference, however, is that switches can only be used for binary input while checkboxes and toggle buttons allow implementations the option of supporting a third middle state. Checkboxes can be checked or not checked and can optionally also allow for a partially checked state. Toggle buttons can be pressed or not pressed and can optionally allow for a partially pressed state.
efa0cf1217df0c30.translationZh: 开关是一个输入小部件，允许用户选择两个值之一： on 或 off 。开关类似于复选框和切换按钮，也可以用作二进制输入。然而，一个区别是开关只能用于二进制输入，而复选框和切换按钮允许实现支持第三种中间状态的选项。复选框可以被选中或不被选中，并且还可以选择允许部分选中状态。切换按钮可以按下或不按下，并且可以选择允许部分按下状态。

8ae4de90b2f5a131.original: Like an HTML table element, a WAI-ARIA table is a static tabular structure containing one or more rows that each contain one or more cells; it is not an interactive widget. Thus, its cells are not focusable or selectable. The grid pattern is used to make an interactive widget that has a tabular structure.
8ae4de90b2f5a131.translationZh: 与 HTML 表格元素一样，WAI-ARIA 表格是一种静态表格结构，包含一行或多行，每行包含一个或多个单元格；它不是一个交互式小部件。因此，它的单元格不可聚焦或可选择。网格图案用于制作具有表格结构的交互式小部件。

ac80e0292c25dcf8.original: Tabs are a set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that display one panel of content at a time. Each tab panel has an associated tab element, that when activated, displays the panel. The list of tab elements is arranged along one edge of the currently displayed panel, most commonly the top edge.
ac80e0292c25dcf8.translationZh: 选项卡是一组分层的内容部分，称为选项卡面板，一次显示一个内容面板。每个选项卡面板都有一个关联的选项卡元素，激活后会显示该面板。选项卡元素列表沿着当前显示的面板的一个边缘（最常见的是顶部边缘）排列。

ed0b4ed965601355.original: A toolbar is a container for grouping a set of controls, such as buttons, menubuttons, or checkboxes.
ed0b4ed965601355.translationZh: 工具栏是用于对一组控件（例如按钮、菜单按钮或复选框）进行分组的容器。

cb5e8aa9a2f597c5.original: NOTE: This design pattern is work in progress; it does not yet have task force consensus. Progress and discussions are captured in issue 128.
cb5e8aa9a2f597c5.translationZh: 注意：此设计模式正在开发中；工作组尚未达成共识。第 128 期记录了进展和讨论。

89ef150489d19b2f.original: A treegrid widget presents a hierarchical data grid consisting of tabular information that is editable or interactive. Any row in the hierarchy may have child rows, and rows with children may be expanded or collapsed to show or hide the children. For example, in a treegrid used to display messages and message responses for a e-mail discussion list, messages with responses would be in rows that can be expanded to reveal the response messages.
89ef150489d19b2f.translationZh: 树形网格小部件呈现由可编辑或交互的表格信息组成的分层数据网格。层次结构中的任何行都可以有子行，并且可以展开或折叠具有子行的行以显示或隐藏子行。例如，在用于显示电子邮件讨论列表的消息和消息响应的树形网格中，带有响应的消息将位于可以展开以显示响应消息的行中。

da4a37730345fc33.original: A tree view widget presents a hierarchical list. Any item in the hierarchy may have child items, and items that have children may be expanded or collapsed to show or hide the children. For example, in a file system navigator that uses a tree view to display folders and files, an item representing a folder can be expanded to reveal the contents of the folder, which may be files, folders, or both.
da4a37730345fc33.translationZh: 树视图小部件呈现分层列表。层次结构中的任何项目都可以具有子项目，并且具有子项目的项目可以展开或折叠以显示或隐藏子项目。例如，在使用树视图显示文件夹和文件的文件系统导航器中，可以展开表示文件夹的项目以显示文件夹的内容，该内容可以是文件、文件夹或两者。

e5a3a14187bd065e.original: NOTE: ARIA 1.1 introduced changes to the separator role so it behaves as a widget when focusable. While this pattern has been revised to match the ARIA 1.1 specification, the task force will not complete its review until a functional example that matches the ARIA 1.1 specification is complete. Progress on this pattern is tracked by issue 129.
e5a3a14187bd065e.translationZh: 注意：ARIA 1.1 引入了对分隔符角色的更改，因此它在可聚焦时表现为一个小部件。虽然此模式已经过修改以匹配 ARIA 1.1 规范，但工作组将在完成符合 ARIA 1.1 规范的功能示例之前完成审核。第 129 期跟踪了该模式的进展。

8531584e379fa5f5.original: An accordion is a sequence of disclosure widgets in a row.
8531584e379fa5f5.translationZh: 手风琴是一系列连续显示的小部件。

6bf67d8693c3c726.original: An alert is an element that displays a brief, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting the user's task. Alerts are typically intended by read out dynamically by a screen reader.
6bf67d8693c3c726.translationZh: 警报是一种元素，它以吸引用户注意力而不中断用户任务的方式显示简短的重要消息。警报通常是由屏幕阅读器动态读出的。

3fe471f02ef8aa88.translationZh: 打开 UI 研究主题：面包屑。

a9cb8820c5e85a2b.original: A checkbox is a control that allows the user to select a binary “checked” state, either checked or unchecked. They may also support a second binary “indeterminate” state.
a9cb8820c5e85a2b.translationZh: 复选框是一种控件，允许用户选择二进制“选中”状态（选中或未选中）。它们还可能支持第二个二元“不确定”状态。

06a58cc2eab9ef43.translationZh: 打开 UI 研究主题：Combobox。

9dcf049768d50b5e.original: Per the HTML Living Standard, "The dialog element represents a part of an application that a user interacts with to perform a task, for example a dialog box, inspector, or window."
9dcf049768d50b5e.translationZh: 根据 HTML Living 标准，“对话框元素表示用户与之交互以执行任务的应用程序的一部分，例如对话框、检查器或窗口。”

dd5040cbc13932e6.original: A disclosure widget is a widget containing a short summary or heading, plus a UI control to expand that heading to show more detail.
dd5040cbc13932e6.translationZh: 披露小部件是包含简短摘要或标题的小部件，以及用于扩展该标题以显示更多详细信息的 UI 控件。

fb8cd7c491fb619f.translationZh: 开放 UI 研究主题：Flex。

8d279fd1874be962.translationZh: 打开UI研究主题：数字（输入）。

71d5667332269bf4.translationZh: 打开UI研究主题：文本（输入）。

8514ff9c80f6835d.original: A list displays a group of sequential items. List items can be bulleted or ordered either through numbers or other seqeunce. List items can also be surfaces for compound content, which can include icons, images or different sections of text at the discretion of the UI feature. Lists can also support basic selection features similar to that of Listboxes.
8514ff9c80f6835d.translationZh: 列表显示一组连续的项目。列表项可以通过数字或其他顺序添加项目符号或排序。列表项也可以是复合内容的表面，其中可以包括图标、图像或不同的文本部分（由 UI 功能决定）。列表还可以支持类似于列表框的基本选择功能。

8df103a1949c05aa.original: NOTE: This Popover API explainer was mostly useful during the development of the feature. While it is roughly still in line with the actual feature, it might be more informative to look at either of these two sources of documentation:
8df103a1949c05aa.translationZh: 注意：此 Popover API 解释器在该功能的开发过程中非常有用。虽然它大致仍然符合实际功能，但查看这两个文档来源可能会提供更多信息：

9a9072d57528e263.original: A followup proposal to the original Popover proposal, which adds several features related to building hints/tooltips.
9a9072d57528e263.translationZh: 原始 Popover 提案的后续提案，添加了与构建提示/工具提示相关的多个功能。

122f43871d6531fb.original: A popup is a piece of transient UI that “pops up” over all other web app UI, i.e. “on the top layer”. A popup may be its own standalone element (such as a teaching bubble) or it may be part of a larger composited component (such as a combobox). Popups differ from other top-layer UI in that they are inherently transient: only one can be shown at a time unless chained by ancestry, and popups are dismissed upon “light dismiss” user interactions (e.g. sending focus out of the popup or hitting the ESC key). They can contain arbitrary content, including interactive descendents.
122f43871d6531fb.translationZh: 弹出窗口是一段短暂的 UI，它在所有其他 Web 应用程序 UI 上“弹出”，即“在顶层”。弹出窗口可以是它自己的独立元素（例如教学气泡），也可以是更大的复合组件（例如组合框）的一部分。弹出窗口与其他顶层 UI 的不同之处在于，它们本质上是瞬态的：一次只能显示一个，除非通过祖先链接，并且弹出窗口会在“轻微关闭”用户交互时关闭（例如，将焦点移出弹出窗口或按 ESC 键）。它们可以包含任意内容，包括交互式后代。

455f9dd1c9cb6a4f.translationZh: 为正在进行的操作提供视觉提示。

8bb13101e1ea578d.original: The Splitter component allows users to resize panels by dragging a handle between them. It supports horizontal, vertical, multi-panel, controlled, and store-driven configurations.

f60bfaba7e8857e4.original: Used to layout its children in a vertical or horizontal stack.
f60bfaba7e8857e4.translationZh: 将子元素按垂直或水平方向堆叠布局。

706cd45405aa43c1.original: Used to display a statistic with a title and value.
706cd45405aa43c1.translationZh: 用于展示带标题与数值的统计数据。

fee94e789113c884.original: Used to indicate the status of a process or state
fee94e789113c884.translationZh: 用于指示流程或状态的状态。

4d9532e23cb2a181.original: Used to indicate progress through a multi-step process
4d9532e23cb2a181.translationZh: 用于指示多步骤流程的进度。

4ccaa63b15873855.translationZh: 在标签页界面中展示内容。

31695ab8da73e96c.translationZh: 用于对内容进行分类或标注。

93ed857e6b3e5ef5.original: Used to enter multiple values as tags with features like tag creation, deletion, and keyboard navigation.

2da61554d88cf0cf.original: Used to render text and paragraphs within an interface.
2da61554d88cf0cf.translationZh: 在界面中渲染文本与段落。

0e456c1cf12e2a96.original: Used to display a list of events in chronological order
0e456c1cf12e2a96.translationZh: 按时间顺序展示事件列表。

f49770f87925464b.original: Used to display a temporary message to the user

5e3469262dace62e.original: Looks like a tooltip, but works like a popover.
5e3469262dace62e.translationZh: 外观像提示气泡，但行为如同弹出层。

07994fd85a91480f.original: Used to display additional information when a user hovers over an element.
07994fd85a91480f.translationZh: 在用户悬停元素时显示附加信息。

0411e5857ffc2d44.original: Used to display hierarchical data structures in an expandable tree format
0411e5857ffc2d44.translationZh: 以可展开的树形格式展示层级数据结构。

f29e754e4ec8ca1e.original: Used to add space between elements and wraps automatically if there isn't enough space.
f29e754e4ec8ca1e.translationZh: 为元素之间添加间距，空间不足时自动换行。

3ce98eb5f914c686.original: A collection of horizontally aligned IconButtons. The IconButtons can be split into groups by adding a divider. When there is not enough space, IconButtons that don't fit will be added to an overflow menu.
3ce98eb5f914c686.translationZh: 水平排列的图标按钮集合，可用分隔线分组；空间不足时放不下的按钮会收进溢出菜单。

ed10b7fc092c69ad.original: It's composed of items presented in a consistent, single-column format, with room for icons, descriptions, side information, and other rich visuals.
ed10b7fc092c69ad.translationZh: 由一致的单列格式条目组成，可容纳图标、描述、辅助信息及其他丰富视觉元素。

75c9d9828f58e6e0.original: ActionMenu is composed of ActionList and Overlay patterns used for quick actions and selections.
75c9d9828f58e6e0.translationZh: 操作菜单由操作列表与浮层模式组合而成，用于快速操作与选择。

36b87eb7927b9138.original: AnchoredOverlay opens an Overlay relative to the anchor position.
36b87eb7927b9138.translationZh: 锚定浮层相对于锚点位置打开浮层。

1cfb1197cbf06c15.original: Autocomplete allows users to quickly filter through a list of options and pick one or more values for a field.
1cfb1197cbf06c15.translationZh: 自动补全让用户快速筛选选项列表，为字段选择一个或多个值。

0461783923a12501.original: Avatar is an image that represents a user or organization.
0461783923a12501.translationZh: 头像（Avatar）是代表用户或组织的图像。

135a60c67268ccce.original: AvatarStack displays two or more Avatars in an inline stack.
135a60c67268ccce.translationZh: 头像堆叠以行内堆叠方式展示两个或更多头像。

22d4e1045f22435d.original: Banner is used to highlight important information.
22d4e1045f22435d.translationZh: 横幅用于突出重要信息。

e72750d4668975da.original: Blankslate is used as placeholder to tell users why content is missing.
e72750d4668975da.translationZh: 空白占位用于告知用户内容缺失的原因。

d341942cf9deca5f.original: BranchName is a label-type component rendered as an <a> tag by default that displays the name of a branch.
d341942cf9deca5f.translationZh: 分支名是默认渲染为 <a> 标签的标签类组件，显示分支名称。

c84d197a181c9c84.original: Breadcrumbs display the current page or context within the site, allowing them to navigate different levels of the hierarchy.
c84d197a181c9c84.translationZh: 面包屑显示当前页面在站点中的位置，支持在层级间导航。

6f98f508c95f3a1d.original: Button is used to initiate actions on a page or form.
6f98f508c95f3a1d.translationZh: 按钮用于在页面或表单上发起操作。

5ac1b8260a4a25bc.original: ButtonGroup renders a series of buttons.
5ac1b8260a4a25bc.translationZh: 按钮组渲染一系列按钮。

501f334462da2626.original: Card is a styled container component that groups related content. By default it renders a div element, which carries no implicit semantics. The right markup pattern depends on how the Card is used: as a standalone region, or as one item in a collection (list).
501f334462da2626.translationZh: 卡片是分组相关内容的样式化容器，默认渲染为 div；正确标记取决于其作为独立区域还是列表中的一项使用。

2900b282dfa818b3.original: Checkbox is a form control for single and multiple selections.
2900b282dfa818b3.translationZh: 复选框是支持单选与多选的表单控件。

c0fdf9616c4fb82c.original: CheckboxGroup renders a set of Checkboxes.
c0fdf9616c4fb82c.translationZh: 复选框组渲染一组复选框。

fdb1424cf123660b.original: CircleBadge visually connects logos of third-party services, eg. in the marketplace.
fdb1424cf123660b.translationZh: 圆形徽标在视觉上关联第三方服务的 Logo，例如市场中常见。

971911dd605ee474.original: ConfirmationDialog is a specialized dialog component used to confirm user actions. It provides a simple way to ask users to confirm or cancel potentially destructive or important actions.
971911dd605ee474.translationZh: 确认对话框是用于确认用户操作的专用对话框，用于请求用户确认或取消可能具有破坏性或重要的操作。

6f653bbff2444942.original: Adds a count to navigational elements and buttons.
6f653bbff2444942.translationZh: 为导航元素与按钮添加计数。

1519005a459ea4b4.original: DataTable is a 2-dimensional data structure where each row is an item, and each column is a data point about the item.
1519005a459ea4b4.translationZh: 数据表格是二维数据结构，每行为一个条目，每列为该条目的一个数据点。

376dfcb4e97e85ef.original: Details is a styled component to enhance the native behaviors of the <details> element.
376dfcb4e97e85ef.translationZh: 详情组件是增强原生 <details> 元素行为的样式化组件。

3bb8f59343f4192c.original: Dialog is a floating surface used to display transient content such as confirmation actions, selection options, and more.
3bb8f59343f4192c.translationZh: 对话框是用于显示确认操作、选择选项等临时内容的浮动表面。

2df390bb9b2eab17.original: FormControl displays a labelled input and, optionally, associated validation text and/or hint text.
2df390bb9b2eab17.translationZh: 表单控件容器展示带标签的输入框，并可附带校验文本或提示文本。

14b03ef626debda0.original: Heading defines the hierarchical structure and importance of the content they contain.
14b03ef626debda0.translationZh: 标题定义其所含内容的层级结构与重要性。

eb7128fa08c8badf.original: IconButton is used for buttons that show an icon in place of a text label.
eb7128fa08c8badf.translationZh: 图标按钮用于以图标代替文字标签的按钮。

00c71434b54e67b6.original: InlineMessage is used to inform the user about the result of an action within the content.
00c71434b54e67b6.translationZh: 行内消息用于在内容中告知用户操作结果。

833e2da08d4ce767.original: KeybindingHint indicates the presence of an available keyboard shortcut. It renders platform-appropriate key glyphs to help users discover and remember keybindings.
833e2da08d4ce767.translationZh: 快捷键提示标示可用的键盘快捷键，渲染平台对应的按键图形帮助用户发现与记忆。

f52dd06d74ea46c9.original: Use the label component to add contextual metadata to a design.
f52dd06d74ea46c9.translationZh: 使用标签组件为设计添加上下文元数据。

a3ea14c44919f019.original: Use LabelGroup to add commonly used margins and other layout constraints to groups of Labels
a3ea14c44919f019.translationZh: 使用标签组为标签集合添加常用边距与其他布局约束。

42e30d7065718946.original: Links are used to apply styles to hyperlink text.
42e30d7065718946.translationZh: 链接用于为超链接文本应用样式。

aad518800bb9159e.original: NavList renders a vertical list of navigation links.
aad518800bb9159e.translationZh: 导航列表渲染一组纵向的导航链接。

3c6a0ac64747d2dd.original: Overlay components codify design patterns related to floating surfaces such as Dialogs and menus.
3c6a0ac64747d2dd.translationZh: 浮层组件将对话框、菜单等浮动表面相关的设计模式规范化。

b84f93ec3dcf6244.original: PageHeader determines the top-level headings of a UI.
b84f93ec3dcf6244.translationZh: 页面标题区决定界面的顶级标题。

14eb19687801e23f.original: PageLayout defines the header, main, pane, and footer areas of a page.
14eb19687801e23f.translationZh: 页面布局定义页面的头部、主体、侧栏与页脚区域。

7e7581448a74433f.original: Pagination is a horizontal set of links to navigate paginated content.
7e7581448a74433f.translationZh: 分页是一组横向链接，用于浏览分页内容。

e8dad9f0b551f871.original: Popover is used to bring attention to specific user interface elements.
e8dad9f0b551f871.translationZh: 气泡用于引起对特定界面元素的注意。

d9f3a88f218c0849.original: A ProgressBar is a simple chart that can be used to show how complete something is, or visualize parts that make up a whole.
d9f3a88f218c0849.translationZh: 进度条是简单的图表，可显示完成度或可视化构成整体的各个部分。

c60bde770deb135e.original: Radio button is a form control for making a single selection from a short list of options.
c60bde770deb135e.translationZh: 单选按钮是用于从短选项列表中单选一项的表单控件。

460ca2e435521c0f.original: RadioGroup is used to render a short list of mutually exclusive options.
460ca2e435521c0f.translationZh: 单选组用于渲染互斥的短选项列表。

bdcc592141c4b78a.original: RelativeTime displays time in a way that is clear, concise, and accessible.
bdcc592141c4b78a.translationZh: 相对时间以清晰、简洁且无障碍的方式显示时间。

a6cb0e1c328b75ad.original: SegmentedControl is used to pick one choice from a linear set of closely related choices, and immediately apply that selection.
a6cb0e1c328b75ad.translationZh: 分段控件用于从线性排列的相近选项中选择一个，并立即生效。

6775d659b081b2cf.original: Select is for choosing a single option from a dropdown menu of predefined choices.
6775d659b081b2cf.translationZh: 选择控件用于从下拉菜单的预设选项中选择一个。
