It includes a text input for filtering, supports item grouping, and supports optional primary and secondary actions. In anchored panels, changes are applied when the panel closes; in modal or full-screen variants, changes are applied when the primary action (for example, Save) is confirmed.
e994ed141be452b7.translationZh: 选择面板是让用户快速浏览并从列表中选择一个或多个条目的对话框，内置筛选输入，支持分组与主次操作；锚定面板关闭时应用更改，模态或全屏变体在确认主操作时应用。

9a82c9b925de3407.original: SkeletonAvatars are placeholders for loading Avatars. They support the same variants as the Avatar component.
9a82c9b925de3407.translationZh: 骨架头像用于头像加载时的占位，支持与头像组件相同的变体。

2d51097594075af6.original: A SkeletonBox provides a placeholder for non-text, non-Avatar elements (e.g., hero images) that are still loading.
2d51097594075af6.translationZh: 骨架方块为仍处于加载中的非文本、非头像元素（如主视觉图）提供占位。

d706cc5930e08527.original: SkeletonText shows a placeholder for loading text to improve perceived performance.
d706cc5930e08527.translationZh: 骨架文本为加载中的文本提供占位，改善感知性能。

efed4e7431f07497.original: A Spinner is an indeterminate loading indicator, ideal for processes with unknown or variable durations.
efed4e7431f07497.translationZh: 加载圈是不确定时长的加载指示器，适合时长未知或可变的流程。

426f46ddbf96730d.original: SplitPageLayout is a layout component that allows you to create a two-column layout with a main content area and a sidebar.
426f46ddbf96730d.translationZh: 分栏页面布局组件用于创建主内容区加侧边栏的两栏布局。

4cf0a9affe4de2d3.original: Stack is a layout component that creates responsive horizontal and vertical flows.
4cf0a9affe4de2d3.translationZh: Stack 是创建响应式水平与垂直排布的布局组件。

7352da41ce6f2edf.original: StateLabel is used for rendering the status of an issue or pull request.
7352da41ce6f2edf.translationZh: 状态标签用于渲染 issue 或 pull request 的状态。

0dc352dff992e8d8.original: An abstraction for using Primer's typographic styles.
0dc352dff992e8d8.translationZh: 使用 Primer 排版样式的抽象层。

6b0f3c1390b3f03e.original: TextInput is used to set a value that is a single line of text.
6b0f3c1390b3f03e.translationZh: 文本输入框用于设置单行文本值。

18a4f0c8ae708f5d.original: TextInputWithTokens is an input for a value that is a list.
18a4f0c8ae708f5d.translationZh: 带令牌的文本输入框用于输入列表类型的值。

55494d8d55caea0e.original: Textarea is used to set a value that is multiple lines of text.
55494d8d55caea0e.translationZh: 文本域用于设置多行文本值。

0f6a8b8c5362649c.original: The Timeline component is used to display items on a vertical Timeline, connected by Timeline elements.
0f6a8b8c5362649c.translationZh: 时间轴组件用于在垂直时间轴上展示条目，并通过时间轴元素连接。

15105c886d1f94df.original: ToggleSwitch is used to immediately toggle a setting on or off.
15105c886d1f94df.translationZh: 开关用于立即切换设置的开启或关闭。

29c8b5af79557d0a.original: Token is a compact representation of an object, and is typically used to show a collection of related metadata.
29c8b5af79557d0a.translationZh: 令牌是对象的紧凑表示，通常用于展示一组相关元数据。

cc9078faf00c6fd2.original: Tooltips add additional context to interactive UI elements and appear on mouse hover or keyboard focus.
cc9078faf00c6fd2.translationZh: 提示气泡为交互元素附加上下文信息，在鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时出现。

a4face4b09024ffa.original: TreeView is a hierarchical list of items that may have a parent-child relationship where children can be toggled into view by expanding or collapsing their parent item.
a4face4b09024ffa.translationZh: 树形视图是具有父子关系的层级条目列表，可通过展开或收起父项切换子项显示。

ebe21534a3b0d029.original: Use Truncate to shorten overflowing text with an ellipsis.
ebe21534a3b0d029.translationZh: 使用截断组件以省略号缩短溢出文本。

0472ba780ba7cce0.original: The UnderlineNav is used to display navigation in a horizontal tabbed format.
0472ba780ba7cce0.translationZh: 下划线导航以水平标签页格式展示导航。

06ad98a6ab1016ef.original: The UnderlinePanels are used to break related content into tabbed panels.
06ad98a6ab1016ef.translationZh: 下划线面板用于将相关内容拆分为标签页面板。

3b28b3632e6be77c.original: A light wrapper around the native button element that provides more opinionated states for things like hover and focus.
3b28b3632e6be77c.translationZh: 围绕原生按钮元素的轻量封装，为悬停、聚焦等状态提供更明确的处理。

009f346e3d2e1010.original: Checkboxes provide the same functionality as native HTML checkboxes, without any of the styling, giving you a clean slate to design them however you'd like.
009f346e3d2e1010.translationZh: 复选框提供原生 HTML 复选框的全部功能但没有任何样式，让你从零开始自由设计。

0b8473b723cfa522.original: Comboboxes are the foundation of accessible autocompletes and command palettes for your app, complete with robust support for keyboard navigation.
0b8473b723cfa522.translationZh: 组合框是无障碍自动补全与命令面板的基础，具备完善的键盘导航支持。

d560d6d99124e3d5.original: A fully-managed, renderless dialog component jam-packed with accessibility and keyboard features, perfect for building completely custom dialogs and alerts.
d560d6d99124e3d5.translationZh: 完全托管的无渲染对话框组件，内置丰富无障碍与键盘特性，适合构建完全自定义的对话框与警告。

ca37b4cfae4b9b1b.original: A simple, accessible foundation for building custom UIs that show and hide content, like togglable accordion panels.
ca37b4cfae4b9b1b.translationZh: 用于构建显示/隐藏内容（如可切换的手风琴面板）的简单无障碍基础。

a1cc6b3d23983136.original: Group a set of form controls together with these fully accessible but much easier-to-style versions of the native fieldset and legend elements.
a1cc6b3d23983136.translationZh: 用这些完全无障碍且更易样式的原生 fieldset 与 legend 版本，将一组表单控件分组。

46d5ef9526b953f3.original: A light wrapper around the native input element that handles tedious accessibility concerns and provides more opinionated states for things like hover and focus.
46d5ef9526b953f3.translationZh: 围绕原生 input 元素的轻量封装，处理繁琐的无障碍问题，并为悬停、聚焦等状态提供更明确的处理。

d4b370bfcdacc293.original: Listboxes are a great foundation for building custom, accessible select menus for your app, complete with robust support for keyboard navigation.
d4b370bfcdacc293.translationZh: 列表框是构建自定义无障碍选择菜单的绝佳基础，具备完善的键盘导航支持。

284af0cd6877965a.original: Menus offer an easy way to build custom, accessible dropdown components with robust support for keyboard navigation.
284af0cd6877965a.translationZh: 菜单提供了构建自定义无障碍下拉组件的简便方式，键盘导航支持完善。

d33ba2bf7bae526e.original: Popovers are perfect for floating panels with arbitrary content like navigation menus, mobile menus and flyout menus.
d33ba2bf7bae526e.translationZh: 气泡非常适合承载导航菜单、移动菜单、飞出菜单等任意内容的浮动面板。

15f670d7d46a831e.original: Radio groups give you the same functionality as native HTML radio inputs, without any of the styling. They're perfect for building out custom UIs for selectors.
15f670d7d46a831e.translationZh: 单选组提供原生 HTML 单选输入的全部功能但无任何样式，非常适合构建自定义选择器界面。

028ed7c8a2cb0b8e.original: A light wrapper around the native select element that handles tedious accessibility concerns and provides more opinionated states for things like hover and focus.
028ed7c8a2cb0b8e.translationZh: 围绕原生 select 元素的轻量封装，处理繁琐的无障碍问题，并为悬停、聚焦等状态提供更明确的处理。

157e5c28e61fc3f8.original: Switches are a pleasant interface for toggling a value between two states, and offer the same semantics and keyboard navigation as native checkbox elements.
157e5c28e61fc3f8.translationZh: 开关是在两种状态间切换值的友好界面，语义与键盘导航和原生复选框一致。

6d6d6787c55ff15d.original: Easily create accessible, fully customizable tab interfaces, with robust focus management and keyboard navigation support.
6d6d6787c55ff15d.translationZh: 轻松创建无障碍、可完全自定义的标签页界面，具备完善的焦点管理与键盘导航支持。

683fff55054c8c92.original: A light wrapper around the native textarea element that handles tedious accessibility concerns and provides more opinionated states for things like hover and focus.
683fff55054c8c92.translationZh: 围绕原生 textarea 元素的轻量封装，处理繁琐的无障碍问题，并为悬停、聚焦等状态提供更明确的处理。

3901ea8dcc9f549d.original: Control the transition styles of conditionally rendered elements, including nested child transitions, using CSS classes.
3901ea8dcc9f549d.translationZh: 使用 CSS 类控制条件渲染元素的过渡样式，包括嵌套子元素的过渡。

1ea2421810839324.original: A password input field with an integrated button to toggle the value's visibility.
1ea2421810839324.translationZh: 带有集成按钮的密码输入字段，用于切换值的可见性。

ba2b62d6cfa5e2ad.original: A breadcrumbs is a list of links that help visualize a page's location within a site's hierarchical structure, it allows navigation up to any of the ancestors.
ba2b62d6cfa5e2ad.translationZh: 面包屑是一个链接列表，有助于可视化页面在站点层次结构中的位置，它允许导航到任何祖先。

60a55aaf411ca10e.original: On longer web pages, it's helpful to stick component into the viewport. This is common for menus and actions.
60a55aaf411ca10e.translationZh: 在较长的网页上，将组件粘贴到视口中会很有帮助。这对于菜单和操作来说很常见。

16b3de43ecf6d6a9.original: Ant Design 是 Ant Design 的组件。
16b3de43ecf6d6a9.translationZh: Ant Design 是 Ant Design 的组件。

ad78c7a2870cab80.original: For displaying anchor hyperlinks on page and jumping between them.
ad78c7a2870cab80.translationZh: 用于在页面上显示锚点超链接并在它们之间跳转。

1a1c0820c5c9c2c9.original: Three sizes and two shapes are available.
1a1c0820c5c9c2c9.translationZh: 提供三种尺寸和两种形状。

f58a976354bcc625.original: Badge normally appears in proximity to notifications or user avatars with eye-catching appeal, typically displaying unread messages count.
f58a976354bcc625.translationZh: 徽章通常出现在通知或用户头像附近，具有引人注目的吸引力，通常显示未读消息数。

80ccadc7d5cb2cc4.original: Basic usage. Wrap any container with BorderBeam to add a continuous decorative beam effect along its border.
80ccadc7d5cb2cc4.translationZh: 基本用法。用 BorderBeam 包裹任何容器，以沿其边框添加连续的装饰光束效果。

15bc98e2fbfe8248.original: The separator can be customized by setting the separator property: separator=">".
15bc98e2fbfe8248.translationZh: 可以通过设置分隔符属性来自定义分隔符：separator=">"。

81a6bb1960c0df67.original: A button means an operation (or a series of operations). Clicking a button will trigger its corresponding business logic.
81a6bb1960c0df67.translationZh: 按钮表示一个操作（或一系列操作）。点击按钮会触发其对应的业务逻辑。

e418695abb55b901.original: Timing of scrolling to the next card/picture.
e418695abb55b901.translationZh: 滚动到下一张卡片/图片的定时。

14da768ffffb5dec.original: Cascade selection box for selecting province/city/district.
14da768ffffb5dec.translationZh: 用于选择省/市/区的级联选择框。

2469893fee9c7e09.original: Used when the user needs to make a customized color selection.
2469893fee9c7e09.translationZh: 当用户需要进行自定义颜色选择时使用。

9b365e4adc542293.original: By clicking the input box, you can select a date from a popup calendar.
9b365e4adc542293.translationZh: 通过单击输入框，您可以从弹出的日历中选择日期。

0601d8fbce2be3bf.original: Commonly displayed on the details page.

f2c0dc0e7635043a.original: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed nonne merninisti licere mihi ista probare, quae sunt a te dicta? Refert tamen, quo modo.
f2c0dc0e7635043a.translationZh: Lorem ipsum dolor sat amet，consectetur adipiscing elit。 Sed nonne merninisti licere mihi ista probare，quae sunt a te dicta？请参阅tamen，原样。

ab08a864e815ea50.original: A Drawer is a panel that is typically overlaid on top of a page and slides in from the side. It contains a set of information or actions. Since the user can interact with the Drawer without leaving the current page, tasks can be achieved more efficiently within the same context.
ab08a864e815ea50.translationZh: 抽屉是通常覆盖在页面顶部并从侧面滑入的面板。它包含一组信息或操作。由于用户可以在不离开当前页面的情况下与抽屉进​​行交互，因此可以在相同的上下文中更有效地完成任务。

3cdf439c26b94841.original: When there are more than a few options to choose from, you can wrap them in a Dropdown. By hovering or clicking on the trigger, a dropdown menu will appear, which allows you to choose an option and execute the relevant action.
3cdf439c26b94841.translationZh: 当有多个选项可供选择时，您可以将它们包装在下拉列表中。通过将鼠标悬停或单击触发器，将出现一个下拉菜单，您可以在其中选择一个选项并执行相关操作。

5081bbdab7a27663.original: You can choose another style of image by setting image to Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE.
5081bbdab7a27663.translationZh: 您可以通过将 image 设置为 Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE 来选择其他样式的图像。

9d2af053144e5e1f.original: Set the gap between elements, which has three preset sizes: small, medium, and large. You can also customize the gap size.
9d2af053144e5e1f.translationZh: 设置元素之间的间隙，有小、中、大三种预设大小。您还可以自定义间隙大小。

7623eeea64e359b2.original: Change the shape of the FloatButton with the shape property.
7623eeea64e359b2.translationZh: 使用 shape 属性更改 FloatButton 的形状。

8b6aa2e6248bab5f.original: Basic Form data control. Includes layout, initial values, validation and submit.
8b6aa2e6248bab5f.translationZh: 基本表单数据控件。包括布局、初始值、验证和提交。

d97c43e44311e85c.original: In most business situations, Ant Design needs to solve a lot of information storage problems within the design area, so based on 12 Grids System, we divided the design area into 24 sections.
d97c43e44311e85c.translationZh: 在大多数业务场景中，Ant Design 需要解决设计区域内的大量信息存储问题，因此基于 12 Grids System，我们将设计区域划分为 24 个部分。

05fd74ef384784e4.original: Before using icons, you need to install the @ant-design/icons package:
05fd74ef384784e4.translationZh: 使用图标之前，需要安装@ant-design/icons包：

6e83634867307c18.original: Set placeholder via placeholder prop. When placeholder is { progress: true }, it shows a watercolor ink loading animation; when set to { progress: { percent: number } }, it shows a progress bar; you can also pass a custom React node as placeholder.
6e83634867307c18.translationZh: 通过 placeholder 属性设置占位符。当placeholder为{progress: true}时，显示水彩墨迹加载动画；当设置为 {progress: {percent:number}} 时，显示进度条；您还可以传递自定义 React 节点作为占位符。

8288a2bf61aaf3b9.original: Variants of Input, there are four variants: outlined filled borderless and underlined.
8288a2bf61aaf3b9.translationZh: 输入的变体，有四种变体：轮廓填充无边框和下划线。

3ee15311ae14e393.original: When a numeric value needs to be provided.

ee69126f2b49897c.original: A list can be used to display content related to a single subject. The content can consist of multiple elements of varying type and size.
ee69126f2b49897c.translationZh: 列表可用于显示与单个主题相关的内容。内容可以由不同类型和大小的多个元素组成。

6b748f4f1ca403b0.original: A long list of 10,000 rows. Set virtual and height to enable virtual scrolling, so only the rows in view are rendered.
6b748f4f1ca403b0.translationZh: 10,000 行的长列表。设置虚拟和高度以启用虚拟滚动，因此仅渲染视图中的行。

5763ce041c84f575.original: A masonry layout component for displaying content with different heights.
5763ce041c84f575.translationZh: 一个砖石布局组件，用于显示不同高度的内容。

97ced7c0b1a77006.original: When you need to mention someone or something.
97ced7c0b1a77006.translationZh: 当你需要提及某人或某事时。

732ad4ef410a34ca.original: Navigation is an important part of any website, as a good navigation setup allows users to move around the site quickly and efficiently. Ant Design offers two navigation options: top and side. Top navigation provides all the categories and functions of the website. Side navigation provides the multi-level structure of the website.
732ad4ef410a34ca.translationZh: 导航是任何网站的重要组成部分，因为良好的导航设置可以让用户快速有效地在网站上移动。 Ant Design 提供两种导航选项：顶部和侧面。顶部导航提供了网站的所有类别和功能。侧边导航提供了网站的多层次结构。

86e6589bfd550cbc.original: Use message.useMessage to get contextHolder with context accessible issue. Please note that, we recommend to use top level registration instead of message static method, because static method cannot consume context, and ConfigProvider data will not work.
86e6589bfd550cbc.translationZh: 使用 message.useMessage 获取上下文可访问问题的 contextHolder。请注意，我们建议使用顶级注册而不是消息静态方法，因为静态方法无法消耗上下文，并且 ConfigProvider 数据将不起作用。

88464b51ff2560ce.original: When requiring users to interact with the application, but without jumping to a new page and interrupting the user's workflow, you can use Modal to create a new floating layer over the current page to get user feedback or display information.
88464b51ff2560ce.translationZh: 当需要用户与应用程序交互，但又不想跳转到新页面并中断用户的工作流程时，可以使用Modal在当前页面上创建一个新的浮动层，以获取用户反馈或显示信息。

2d8eac416eed86e3.original: To display a notification message at any of the four corners of the viewport. Typically it can be used in the following cases:
2d8eac416eed86e3.translationZh: 在视口四个角的任意一个角显示通知消息。通常可以在以下情况下使用：

3dfffdb300e4b472.original: You can show the total number of data by setting showTotal.
3dfffdb300e4b472.translationZh: 可以通过设置showTotal来显示数据总数。

f9c16be0d9cde87c.original: A simple and compact dialog used for asking for user confirmation.
f9c16be0d9cde87c.translationZh: 一个简单紧凑的对话框，用于请求用户确认。

5f8bef1f8694407b.original: A simple popup menu to provide extra information or operations.
5f8bef1f8694407b.translationZh: 一个简单的弹出菜单，提供额外的信息或操作。

c1d4837c87b8ce2b.original: If it will take a long time to complete an operation, you can use Progress to show the current progress and status.
c1d4837c87b8ce2b.translationZh: 如果完成某项操作需要很长时间，可以使用Progress来显示当前的进度和状态。

8a9c78fa4285723a.original: Used when the text needs to be converted into a QR Code.
8a9c78fa4285723a.translationZh: 当文本需要转换为QR码时使用。

248d0e8ca9177f12.original: The block property will make a Radio.Group fit to its parent width.
248d0e8ca9177f12.translationZh: 块属性将使 Radio.Group 适合其父宽度。

733539d0513804fc.original: Read only, can't use mouse to interact.
733539d0513804fc.translationZh: 只读，无法使用鼠标交互。

a3316eae7b9cd51a.original: Use when important operations need to inform the user to process the results and the feedback is more complicated.
a3316eae7b9cd51a.translationZh: 当重要操作需要通知用户处理结果且反馈比较复杂时使用。

390072b6783641cd.original: This component is available since antd@4.20.0.
390072b6783641cd.translationZh: 该组件自 antd@4.20.0 起可用。

9a97b9c7b896f1d5.original: Complex combination with avatar and multiple paragraphs.
9a97b9c7b896f1d5.translationZh: 头像和多个段落的复杂组合。

73ede8520bdb1f13.original: Used to input a value within a specified range.
73ede8520bdb1f13.translationZh: 用于输入指定范围内的值。

4356fb4b9bbda642.original: When part of the page is waiting for asynchronous data or during a rendering process, an appropriate loading animation can effectively alleviate users' inquietude.
4356fb4b9bbda642.translationZh: 当页面部分等待异步数据或渲染过程中，适当的加载动画可以有效缓解用户的不安。

5c03674b9bce0de2.original: Can be used to separate areas horizontally or vertically. When you need to freely drag and adjust the size of each area. When you need to specify the maximum and minimum width and height of an area.
5c03674b9bce0de2.translationZh: 可用于水平或垂直分隔区域。当您需要自由拖动并调整各个区域的大小时。当您需要指定区域的最大和最小宽度和高度时。

6f96fbad0a9b2009.translationZh: 带有反应计数的动画数字。

e4752672918f21a6.original: Mark a pending state of switch.
e4752672918f21a6.translationZh: 标记开关的待处理状态。

ebd0df28db1e6be8.original: Specify dataSource of Table as an array of data.

4f7726e8026b4f14.original: Ant Design has 3 types of Tabs for different situations.
4f7726e8026b4f14.translationZh: Ant Design 有 3 种类型的 Tabs，适合不同的情况。

cdfac936548146ba.original: It can be used to tag by dimension or property.
cdfac936548146ba.translationZh: 可用于按维度或属性进行标记。

6695cc349ed8f8dc.original: By clicking the input box, you can select a time from a popup panel.
6695cc349ed8f8dc.translationZh: 通过单击输入框，您可以从弹出面板中选择时间。

b8c3396ddf958a36.original: Node supports loading to indicate loading, and reverse property to control the order of nodes.
b8c3396ddf958a36.translationZh: 节点支持loading表示正在加载，支持reverse属性控制节点的顺序。

b73dc6b3b3f92852.translationZh: 有 12 个可用的放置选项。

c0ce7f71604ecca4.original: Use when you want to guide users through a product.
c0ce7f71604ecca4.translationZh: 当您想要引导用户使用产品时使用。

517ddd36facd7e45.original: Transfer the elements between two columns in an intuitive and efficient way.
517ddd36facd7e45.translationZh: 以直观高效的方式在两列之间传输元素。

b5bb1f2eefe5deba.original: Almost anything can be represented in a tree structure. Examples include directories, organization hierarchies, biological classifications, countries, etc. The Tree component is a way of representing the hierarchical relationship between these things. You can also expand, collapse, and select a treeNode within a Tree.
b5bb1f2eefe5deba.translationZh: 几乎任何东西都可以用树结构来表示。示例包括目录、组织层次结构、生物分类、国家/地区等。树组件是表示这些事物之间的层次关系的一种方式。您还可以展开、折叠和选择树中的树节点。

9b85579b28e03330.original: TreeSelect is similar to Select, but the values are provided in a tree like structure. Any data whose entries are defined in a hierarchical manner is fit to use this control. Examples of such case may include a corporate hierarchy, a directory structure, and so on.
9b85579b28e03330.translationZh: TreeSelect 与 Select 类似，但值以树状结构提供。任何以分层方式定义条目的数据都适合使用此控件。这种情况的示例可以包括公司层次结构、目录结构等等。

7defcbcbebb3bcc2.original: Uploading is the process of publishing information (web pages, text, pictures, video, etc.) to a remote server via a web page or upload tool.
7defcbcbebb3bcc2.translationZh: 上传是通过网页或上传工具将信息（网页、文字、图片、视频等）发布到远程服务器的过程。

aff3d1770a2deed1.original: Use content to set an array of strings and WatermarkText to specify multi-line text watermark content with custom font styles per line.
aff3d1770a2deed1.translationZh: 使用 content 设置字符串数组，使用 WatermarkText 指定多行文本水印内容，每行具有自定义字体样式。

b8f64abbcc01dcfd.original: Indicate the current page’s location within a navigational hierarchy that automatically adds separators via CSS.
b8f64abbcc01dcfd.translationZh: 指示当前页面在导航层次结构中的位置，该导航层次结构通过 CSS 自动添加分隔符。

a83dd859cf50d470.original: Use Bootstrap’s custom button styles for actions in forms, dialogs, and more with support for multiple sizes, states, and more.
a83dd859cf50d470.translationZh: 使用 Bootstrap 的自定义按钮样式执行表单、对话框等中的操作，并支持多种尺寸、状态等。

fa605253ce2cb6f6.original: Bootstrap’s cards provide a flexible and extensible content container with multiple variants and options.
fa605253ce2cb6f6.translationZh: Bootstrap 的卡片提供了灵活且可扩展的内容容器，具有多种变体和选项。

4f281a24c7002915.original: Use Bootstrap’s JavaScript modal plugin to add dialogs to your site for lightboxes, user notifications, or completely custom content.
4f281a24c7002915.translationZh: 使用 Bootstrap 的 JavaScript 模式插件向您的网站添加对话框，以显示灯箱、用户通知或完全自定义的内容。

995b4247c2f3dc1b.original: Documentation and examples for Bootstrap’s powerful, responsive navigation header, the navbar. Includes support for branding, navigation, and more, including support for our collapse plugin.
995b4247c2f3dc1b.translationZh: Bootstrap 强大的响应式导航标题（导航栏）的文档和示例。包括对品牌、导航等的支持，包括对我们的折叠插件的支持。

3e09e6fe10b15ce3.original: Documentation and examples for how to use Bootstrap’s included navigation components.
3e09e6fe10b15ce3.translationZh: 有关如何使用 Bootstrap 包含的导航组件的文档和示例。

c4b660e076adad7c.original: A simple container to divide your page into sections , like the one you’re currently reading

8324eb270a1a1df1.original: A collection of horizontally aligned IconButtons. The IconButtons can be split into groups by adding a divider. When there is not enough space, IconButtons that don't fit will be added to an overflow menu.

05c5b074d6ff4d3d.original: ActionList is a vertical list of interactive actions or options. It's composed of items presented in a consistent, single-column format, with room for icons, descriptions, side information, and other rich visuals.
05c5b074d6ff4d3d.translationZh: ActionList 是交互式操作或选项的垂直列表。它由以一致的单列格式呈现的项目组成，并为图标、描述、辅助信息和其他丰富的视觉效果留有空间。

0cd26e52f77904e9.original: An abstraction for using Primer's typographic styles.

84cf87c035f7411b.translationZh: 使用应用程序定义的所有子组件的区域设置覆盖默认浏览器区域设置。

690f3095ca66c46d.translationZh: 管理异步列表数据，包括加载、分页、排序和过滤。

becb8a927904b0bf.original: Handles interactions with the clipboard, including copy and paste operations.
becb8a927904b0bf.translationZh: 处理与剪贴板的交互，包括复制和粘贴操作。

6ebb7ee63988bbe6.original: Wraps Intl.DateTimeFormat and formats dates for the current locale.
6ebb7ee63988bbe6.translationZh: 包装 Intl.DateTimeFormat 并格式化当前区域设置的日期。

ec79433ab8b1eb83.original: Handles drag interactions for an element, providing accessibility and cross-browser support.
ec79433ab8b1eb83.translationZh: 处理元素的拖动交互，提供可访问性和跨浏览器支持。

ed1abea74e4d56c9.original: Provides the behavior and accessibility implementation for dragging items within a collection.
ed1abea74e4d56c9.translationZh: 提供在集合中拖动项目的行为和可访问性实现。

bfb3dddbf5e67b32.original: Handles drop interactions for a target element, providing accessibility and cross-browser support.
bfb3dddbf5e67b32.translationZh: 处理目标元素的放置交互，提供可访问性和跨浏览器支持。

c4d2c723fd03d490.original: Provides the behavior and accessibility implementation for dropping items onto a collection.
c4d2c723fd03d490.translationZh: 提供将项目拖放到集合中的行为和可访问性实现。

3d06185211de9e15.original: Provides accessibility and labeling support for form field components.
3d06185211de9e15.translationZh: 为表单字段组件提供可访问性和标签支持。

0439de6b53b59cce.original: Provides locale-sensitive string matching for filtering and searching.
0439de6b53b59cce.translationZh: 提供区域设置敏感的字符串匹配以进行过滤和搜索。

f264dbcbb97a6f5c.original: Handles focus events for the target element only, not descendants.
f264dbcbb97a6f5c.translationZh: 仅处理目标元素的焦点事件，而不处理后代元素的焦点事件。

b29142b15c435fcf.original: Determines whether a focus ring should be displayed for keyboard focus.
b29142b15c435fcf.translationZh: 确定是否应显示聚焦环以进行键盘聚焦。

daf79258e7160f8b.original: Determines whether keyboard focus should be visible based on interaction mode.
daf79258e7160f8b.translationZh: 根据交互模式确定键盘焦点是否可见。

4c2f6e0a35ea74b0.original: Handles focus interactions for an element and its descendants.
4c2f6e0a35ea74b0.translationZh: 处理元素及其后代的焦点交互。

b5144e0a3667a5f5.original: Handles hover interactions with proper support for touch devices.
b5144e0a3667a5f5.translationZh: 通过对触摸设备的适当支持来处理悬停交互。

f1e8681218c4429f.original: Generates unique element ids with SSR support.
f1e8681218c4429f.translationZh: 生成具有 SSR 支持的唯一元素 ID。

716a87a9a075adc5.original: Returns whether the app is currently in server-side rendering or hydration.
716a87a9a075adc5.translationZh: 返回应用程序当前是否处于服务器端渲染或水合状态。

34a71e672a363703.original: Handles keyboard interactions with improved event propagation behavior.
34a71e672a363703.translationZh: 通过改进的事件传播行为处理键盘交互。

c350994f1d07e62d.original: Associates a label with a form field for accessibility.
c350994f1d07e62d.translationZh: 将标签与表单字段关联起来以实现可访问性。

8080806feea105fb.original: Enables keyboard navigation between page landmarks.
8080806feea105fb.translationZh: 启用页面标志之间的键盘导航。

d82027375ecac588.original: Manages an immutable list of items and its selection state.
d82027375ecac588.translationZh: 管理不可变的项目列表及其选择状态。

31231a95ce36e193.original: Wraps Intl.ListFormat and formats lists of values for the current locale.
31231a95ce36e193.translationZh: 包装 Intl.ListFormat 并格式化当前区域设置的值列表。

821438741fe41a3a.original: Provides access to the current locale and layout direction.
821438741fe41a3a.translationZh: 提供对当前区域设置和布局方向的访问。

eb3bc3d04da63bde.original: Handles long press interactions across mouse and touch devices.
eb3bc3d04da63bde.translationZh: 处理鼠标和触摸设备上的长按交互。

2d7184a09092a621.original: Handles move interactions for pointer and keyboard, useful for sliders and drag operations.
2d7184a09092a621.translationZh: 处理指针和键盘的移动交互，对于滑块和拖动操作非常有用。

334677b17be9ddc2.original: Wraps Intl.NumberFormat and formats numbers for the current locale.
334677b17be9ddc2.translationZh: 包装 Intl.NumberFormat 并格式化当前区域设置的数字。

9d9a53959c120638.original: Converts a callback ref or object ref to an object ref.
9d9a53959c120638.translationZh: 将回调引用或对象引用转换为对象引用。

5304b7eb230c21f9.original: Handles press interactions across mouse, touch, and keyboard.
5304b7eb230c21f9.translationZh: 处理鼠标、触摸和键盘之间的按下交互。

8d3f120726b8090f.original: Manages an immutable tree of items and its selection state.
8d3f120726b8090f.translationZh: 管理不可变的项目树及其选择状态。

b23ca1a0180c5d32.original: axis makes it easy to constrain the user gesture to a specific axis.
b23ca1a0180c5d32.translationZh: 轴可以轻松地将用户手势限制到特定轴。

92ce5c880f97ebea.original: A gesture axis is determined whenever x-axis and y-axis displacements reach a threshold.
92ce5c880f97ebea.translationZh: 每当x轴和y轴位移达到阈值时就确定手势轴。

c420ecf339842f72.original: If you want to set constraints to the user gesture, then you should use the bounds option. In that case, **both** the gesture movement and offset will be clamped to the specified bounds. bounds will be defaulted to Infinity when not set.
c420ecf339842f72.translationZh: 如果你想对用户手势设置约束，那么你应该使用bounds选项。在这种情况下，**手势移动和偏移**都将被限制在指定的范围内。未设置时，bounds 将默认为 Infinity。

b920a009237cb628.original: delay delays the drag gesture for the amount of milliseconds you specify. This might be useful if you don't want your logic to fire right away. The below example has a delay set to 1000. Try clicking on the square without moving your mouse.
b920a009237cb628.translationZh: 延迟将拖动手势延迟指定的毫秒数。如果您不希望立即触发逻辑，这可能很有用。下面的示例将延迟设置为 1000。尝试单击正方形而不移动鼠标。

45a9eb2f7095b6f7.original: When eventOptions.capture is set to true, [events will be captured](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Building_blocks/Events#Event_bubbling_and_capture).
45a9eb2f7095b6f7.translationZh: 当 eventOptions.capture 设置为 true 时，[将捕获事件](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Building_blocks/Events#Event_bubbling_and_capture)。

fe8bca77dee75c3f.original: Making a draggable component tappable or clickable can be tricky: differenciating a click from a drag is not always trivial. When you set filterTaps to true, the [tap](/docs/state/#tap) state attribute will be true on release if the total displacement is inferior to 3 pixels while down will remain false all along.
fe8bca77dee75c3f.translationZh: 使可拖动组件可点击或可点击可能很棘手：区分点击和拖动并不总是那么简单。当您将 filterTaps 设置为 true 时，如果总位移小于 3 像素，[tap](/docs/state/#tap) 状态属性在释放时将为 true，而 down 将始终保持 false。

bdc7c565cbfd6549.original: Everytime a gesture starts, the offset state attribute starts with its previous value. But in some cases, you might want to start offset from an initial position that is external to your logic[^1].
bdc7c565cbfd6549.translationZh: 每次手势开始时，偏移状态属性都会以其之前的值开始。但在某些情况下，您可能希望从逻辑外部的初始位置开始偏移[^1]。

43d4e8468b9adfd8.original: This option lets you set the modifier key that triggers a scale gesture when using wheel inside the onPinch handler.
43d4e8468b9adfd8.translationZh: 此选项允许您设置在 onPinch 处理程序内使用滚轮时触发缩放手势的修改键。

a004dd3677645047.original: Most of the time you'll want the drag gesture to start when the left / main button of your device is pressed. You can change that behavior by submitting a [buttons combination](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MouseEvent/buttons) that matches one or several buttons to be pressed at once in order for the drag gesture to start.
a004dd3677645047.translationZh: 大多数时候，您会希望在按下设备的左/主按钮时启动拖动手势。您可以通过提交与一次按下的一个或多个按钮匹配的[按钮组合](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MouseEvent/buttons)来更改该行为，以便启动拖动手势。

39e8eb0e3721d3c8.original: By default, drag uses [setPointerCapture](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/setPointerCapture) to track the pointer movement. When a pointer is captured by a target, it won't trigger any listener from another target (even a CSS :hover). Most of the time this is fine, but in some situations, you may want to drag an element and still receive events from another target.
39e8eb0e3721d3c8.translationZh: 默认情况下，拖动使用 setPointerCapture 来跟踪指针移动。当指针被目标捕获时，它不会触发来自另一个目标的任何侦听器（甚至 CSS :hover）。大多数情况下，这很好，但在某些情况下，您可能希望拖动元素并仍然接收来自另一个目标的事件。

8ffdb3dd4d4c3e45.original: By default, the drag gesture is accessible, meaning you can control the drag of an element with arrow keys. The shiftKey modifier will make the drag 10x faster, the altKey will make the drag 10x slower.
8ffdb3dd4d4c3e45.translationZh: 默认情况下，可以使用拖动手势，这意味着您可以使用箭头键控制元素的拖动。 shiftKey 修饰符将使拖动速度加快 10 倍，altKey 将使拖动速度减慢 10 倍。

6dd0f36b7eafeca6.original: Set lock to true and the drag gesture will [requestPointerLock](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/requestPointerLock) when the drag starts and exitPointerLock when the drag gesture ends. This feature is only relevant on non-touch devices.
6dd0f36b7eafeca6.translationZh: 将 lock 设置为 true，当拖动开始时拖动手势将 [requestPointerLock](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/requestPointerLock) 并在拖动手势结束时退出PointerLock。此功能仅适用于非触摸设备。

8306f83a445d49fb.original: Most gestures, drag included, use [pointer events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Pointer_events). This works well in 99 situations in 100, but pointer events get canceled on touch devices when the user starts scrolling. Usually this is what you actually want, and the browser does it for you. But in some situations you may want the drag to persist while scrolling. In that case you'll need to indicate to use touch events, which aren't canceled on scroll.
8306f83a445d49fb.translationZh: 大多数手势（包括拖动）都使用[指针事件](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Pointer_events)。这在 100 种情况中的 99 种情况下效果很好，但当用户开始滚动时，指针事件在触摸设备上被取消。通常这是您真正想要的，浏览器会为您完成。但在某些情况下，您可能希望在滚动时持续拖动。在这种情况下，您需要指示使用触摸事件，这些事件不会在滚动时取消。

c647abee0287a5b3.original: Will run event.cancelable && event.preventDefault() on all events triggered by the handler. Can be useful when dragging links or images.
c647abee0287a5b3.translationZh: 将对处理程序触发的所有事件运行 event.cancelable && event.preventDefault()。拖动链接或图像时非常有用。

eb4af27e5bc5e4f8.original: **This is an experimental feature, relevant for mobile devices**.
eb4af27e5bc5e4f8.translationZh: **这是一项实验性功能，与移动设备相关**。

f04bf52b2cc17639.original: This can optionally be used together with preventScroll. This defines the axis/axes in which scrolling is permitted, unless the user taps and holds on the element for the specified duration. Afterwhich, all scrolling is blocked. Depending on the complexity of the nesting of the element, you may need to assign the property touch-action: pan-x, touch-action: pan-y, or both, to the element to allow for the correct behavior.
f04bf52b2cc17639.translationZh: 这可以选择与 PreventScroll 一起使用。这定义了允许滚动的一个或多个轴，除非用户点击并按住该元素达指定的持续时间。此后，所有滚动都将被阻止。根据元素嵌套的复杂性，您可能需要将属性 touch-action: pan-x、touch-action: pan-y 或两者分配给元素以允许正确的行为。

84e601ce4287e68c.original: In some cases, you may want to simulate resistance when the user drags a component, for example when the end of a content is reached[^4].
84e601ce4287e68c.translationZh: 在某些情况下，您可能希望模拟用户拖动组件时的阻力，例如到达内容末尾时[^4]。

4cc466a383ce6b03.original: See the [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) state attribute for more.
4cc466a383ce6b03.translationZh: 请参阅 [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) 状态属性了解更多信息。

1679813ee34e3567.original: A drag gesture lasting more than swipe.duration (in milliseconds) will never be considered a swipe. See the [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) state attribute for more.
1679813ee34e3567.translationZh: 持续时间超过 swipe.duration（以毫秒为单位）的拖动手势永远不会被视为滑动。有关更多信息，请参阅 [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) 状态属性。

b217c35b7012f617.original: When using the [filterTaps](#filterTaps) option, taps are only triggered when the displacement is inferior to 3 pixels. You can customize that value by using tapsThreshold.
b217c35b7012f617.translationZh: 使用 [filterTaps](#filterTaps) 选项时，仅当位移小于 3 像素时才会触发点击。您可以使用 tapsThreshold 自定义该值。

c11cfb3534e3c9d5.original: > In , you need to attach a target to the gesture as its first argument. Therefore this options is irrelevant.
c11cfb3534e3c9d5.translationZh: > 在 中，您需要将目标附加到手势作为其第一个参数。因此这个选项是无关紧要的。

91fa52cacafdc42c.original: By default, your gesture handler will be triggered as soon as an event is fired. However, there are situations where you want to make sure the user action is **intentional**: that's where threshold comes into play.
91fa52cacafdc42c.translationZh: 默认情况下，一旦触发事件，您的手势处理程序就会被触发。但是，在某些情况下，您希望确保用户操作是**有意的**：这就是阈值发挥作用的地方。

dbddf9faa0feb600.original: When you're interacting with canvas objects, you're dealing with space coordinates that aren't measured in pixels. In that case, you can tell to map screen values to the space with a transform function.
dbddf9faa0feb600.translationZh: 当您与画布对象交互时，您正在处理不以像素为单位测量的空间坐标。在这种情况下，您可以使用变换函数将屏幕值映射到空间。

fd94f1d32366411d.original: Forces the handler to fire even for non intentional displacement (ignores the threshold). In that case, the intentional attribute from state will remain false until the threshold is reached.
fd94f1d32366411d.translationZh: 即使是非故意位移，也强制处理程序开火（忽略阈值）。在这种情况下，状态的有意属性将保持为假，直到达到阈值。

67adb21e279e29fd.original: Handles multiple gestures in one hook
67adb21e279e29fd.translationZh: 在一个钩子中处理多个手势

a3992d0283af3ed8.original: Handles mouse enter and mouse leave events
a3992d0283af3ed8.translationZh: 处理鼠标进入和鼠标离开事件

a972450bec8b1f95.original: Lets you specify which window element the gesture should bind events to (only relevant for the drag gesture).
a972450bec8b1f95.translationZh: 允许您指定手势应将事件绑定到哪个窗口元素（仅与拖动手势相关）。

55899c35220d6a65.original: This component must be used as a child of ` `. Please see the [Accordion docs](/docs/components/accordion) to see examples of this component in action.
55899c35220d6a65.translationZh: 该组件必须用作``的子组件。请参阅 [Accordion 文档](/docs/components/accordion) 以查看此组件的实际示例。

32e17b20a1f6dc8f.original: Accordions use [accordion items](/docs/components/accordion-item) to create a vertically stacked set of expandable sections.
32e17b20a1f6dc8f.translationZh: 手风琴使用[手风琴项目](/docs/components/accordion-item) 创建一组垂直堆叠的可扩展部分。

cecc9eb23e3ad2f4.original: Both GIF and WEBP images are supported.
cecc9eb23e3ad2f4.translationZh: GIF 和 WEBP 图像均受支持。

82c84e888b6d7f5d.original: To animate an element, wrap it in ` ` and set the `name` attribute. The animation will not start until you add the `play` attribute. Refer to the [properties table](#attributes-and-properties) for a list of all animation options.
