e9e783e2bc9b0b0c.translationZh: 使用“wa-cluster”类以均匀的间距内联排列元素，允许项目在空间有限时换行。

bd0b76a28c8696e7.original: Color utilities allow you to apply the brand, neutral, success, warning, and danger colors from your theme to any element.
bd0b76a28c8696e7.translationZh: 颜色实用程序允许您将主题中的品牌、中性、成功、警告和危险颜色应用到任何元素。

e631d9a32997eda7.original: Use the `wa-flank` class to position two items side-by-side, with one item positioned alongside, or _flanking_, content that stretches to fill the available space.
e631d9a32997eda7.translationZh: 使用“wa-flank”类并排放置两个项目，其中一个项目位于拉伸以填充可用空间的内容旁边或_flanking_。

4a906301e0ad4fb7.original: Flex wrap utilities specify how items within flex containers wrap.
4a906301e0ad4fb7.translationZh: Flex 包装实用程序指定 Flex 容器中的项目如何包装。

13c86c955272f122.original: Utility to improve the loading experience by hiding non-prerendered custom elements until they are registered.
13c86c955272f122.translationZh: 通过隐藏非预渲染的自定义元素直到注册为止来改善加载体验的实用程序。

4807f03a01039f19.original: Use the `wa-frame` class to create a responsive container with consistent proportions to enclose content.
4807f03a01039f19.translationZh: 使用“wa-frame”类创建一个比例一致的响应式容器来封装内容。

9b3fa167cd75f4a2.original: Gap utilities set the gap property of flex and grid containers, like other Web Awesome layout utilities.
9b3fa167cd75f4a2.translationZh: 间隙实用程序设置 Flex 和网格容器的间隙属性，就像其他 Web Awesome 布局实用程序一样。

f31965063a499da0.original: Use the `wa-grid` class to arrange elements into rows and columns that automatically adapt to the available space.
f31965063a499da0.translationZh: 使用“wa-grid”类将元素排列成自动适应可用空间的行和列。

1ef19edbddfd63a4.original: Justify content utilities determine how space is distributed between items in flex and grid containers.
1ef19edbddfd63a4.translationZh: Justify 内容实用程序确定如何在 Flex 和网格容器中的项目之间分配空间。

a2b2fb734c895a93.original: Native styles apply your theme to native HTML elements so they match the look and feel of Web Awesome components.
a2b2fb734c895a93.translationZh: 本机样式将您的主题应用到本机 HTML 元素，以便它们与 Web Awesome 组件的外观和感觉相匹配。

0aa196bfcd09a974.original: The wa-prose utility applies hierarchical, asymmetric typographic rhythm to long-form content like documentation, articles, and marketing copy.
0aa196bfcd09a974.translationZh: wa-prose 实用程序将分层、不对称的印刷节奏应用于文档、文章和营销文案等长格式内容。

3bf334b667c5aab3.original: Border radius utilities set an element's border radius property.
3bf334b667c5aab3.translationZh: 边框半径实用程序设置元素的边框半径属性。

547cda69801e7fe1.original: Use the `wa-split` class to distribute two or more items evenly across available space, either in a row or a column.
547cda69801e7fe1.translationZh: 使用“wa-split”类在可用空间（行或列）中均匀分布两个或多个项目。

1412cfc558e70854.original: Use `wa-stack` to arrange elements in the block direction with even spacing.
1412cfc558e70854.translationZh: 使用`wa-stack`将元素以均匀的间距沿块方向排列。

1b7160e63207a220.original: Text utility classes use design tokens from your Web Awesome theme and standard CSS properties to style text elements on the fly.
1b7160e63207a220.translationZh: 文本实用程序类使用 Web Awesome 主题中的设计标记和标准 CSS 属性来动态设置文本元素的样式。

7742776b16d03b20.original: The visually hidden utility makes content accessible to assistive devices without displaying it on the screen.
7742776b16d03b20.translationZh: 视觉上隐藏的实用程序使辅助设备可以访问内容，而无需将其显示在屏幕上。

e17f1ea09adc0bbc.original: The v-alert component is used to convey information to the user. Designed to stand out, the alerts come in four contextual styles.
e17f1ea09adc0bbc.translationZh: v-alert 组件用于向用户传达信息。为了脱颖而出，警报有四种上下文样式。

073e5b04c844071c.original: Browse all of the available Vuetify components or group by category.
073e5b04c844071c.translationZh: 浏览所有可用的 Vuetify 组件或按类别分组。

be33dc3668422a9b.original: The app bar component is a supercharged toolbar with advanced scrolling techniques and application layout support.
be33dc3668422a9b.translationZh: 应用程序栏组件是一个强大的工具栏，具有先进的滚动技术和应用程序布局支持。

1c109fe515febb41.original: Vuetify comes equipped with a default markup that makes it easy to create layouts (boilerplate) for any Vue application.
1c109fe515febb41.translationZh: Vuetify 配备了默认标记，可以轻松为任何 Vue 应用程序创建布局（样板文件）。

c61e32ca781d595c.original: The responsive component is used as a wrapper component to force custom aspect ratios for its children.
c61e32ca781d595c.translationZh: 响应式组件用作包装器组件，以强制其子组件自定义宽高比。

1a09815e73402a3d.original: The autocomplete component provides type-ahead autocomplete functionality and provides a list of available options.
1a09815e73402a3d.translationZh: 自动完成组件提供预先输入自动完成功能并提供可用选项列表。

bb7766ee06b10f1e.original: The avatar group component combines multiple avatars into a stacked or inline group display.
bb7766ee06b10f1e.translationZh: 头像组组件将多个头像组合成堆叠或内联组显示。

fe16319708cb5c0c.original: The avatar component is used to control the size and border radius of an image. It can be used with numerous components to provide better visual context.
fe16319708cb5c0c.translationZh: 头像组件用于控制图像的大小和边框半径。它可以与许多组件一起使用，以提供更好的视觉环境。

4c91621dcf5f7f27.original: The badge component is a small status descriptor for elements. This typically contains a small number or short set of characters.
4c91621dcf5f7f27.translationZh: 徽章组件是元素的小型状态描述符。这通常包含少量或简短的字符集。

e42dbfb2ed1a8ff1.original: The banner component displays an important and concise message for a user to address. It can also indicate actions that the user can take.
e42dbfb2ed1a8ff1.translationZh: 横幅组件显示重要而简洁的消息供用户处理。它还可以指示用户可以采取的操作。

6447beff7364b5c1.original: The bottom navigation component is used for mobile devices and acts as the primary navigation for your application.
6447beff7364b5c1.translationZh: 底部导航组件用于移动设备，并充当应用程序的主要导航。

0dc37b67ff780c75.original: The bottom sheet component is used for elevating content above other elements in a dialog style fashion.
0dc37b67ff780c75.translationZh: 底部工作表组件用于以对话框样式的方式将内容提升到其他元素之上。

28ddfb48978b07c6.original: The breadcrumbs component is a navigational helper for pages. It can accept a Material Icons icon or characters as a divider.
28ddfb48978b07c6.translationZh: 面包屑组件是页面的导航助手。它可以接受 Material Icons 图标或字符作为分隔符。

57b273bfca9a44e6.original: The button toggle component allows you to combine a series of selectable buttons together in a single element.
57b273bfca9a44e6.translationZh: 按钮切换组件允许您将一系列可选按钮组合在一个元素中。

4cc48d30a231a532.original: The button component communicates actions that a user can take and are typically placed in dialogs, forms, cards and toolbars.
4cc48d30a231a532.translationZh: 按钮组件传达用户可以采取的操作，通常放置在对话框、表单、卡片和工具栏中。

24b379c5e7f1190b.original: The calendar component is a clean and simple adaptation to the popular Google Calendar application.
24b379c5e7f1190b.translationZh: 日历组件是对流行的 Google 日历应用程序的干净简单的改编。

2fc986ced0026ed0.original: The v-card component is a versatile and enhanced sheet of paper that provides a simple interface for headings, text, images, and actions.
2fc986ced0026ed0.translationZh: v-card 组件是一种多功能且增强的纸张，为标题、文本、图像和操作提供了简单的界面。

0fcd2cd61eb17b73.original: The carousel component is used to cycle through visual content such as images or slides of text.
0fcd2cd61eb17b73.translationZh: 轮播组件用于循环浏览视觉内容，例如图像或文本幻灯片。

d73a1eb2ba1f0407.original: The checkbox component permits users to select between two values.
d73a1eb2ba1f0407.translationZh: 复选框组件允许用户在两​​个值之间进行选择。

5ecba8bd097c3f5d.original: The chip group component combines numerous selectable chips into single or multiple lines.
5ecba8bd097c3f5d.translationZh: 芯片组组件将众多可选芯片组合成单行或多行。

59df339c6e00af17.original: The chip component allows a user to enter information, make selections, filter content or trigger actions.
59df339c6e00af17.translationZh: 芯片组件允许用户输入信息、进行选择、过滤内容或触发操作。

c0d62b7b4a692d4f.original: The color input is a specialized input that provides a clean interface for selecting colors.
c0d62b7b4a692d4f.translationZh: 颜色输入是一种专门的输入，为选择颜色提供了干净的界面。

07b21a3b18f9fdcf.original: The color picker component allows users to select a from pre-defined or custom colors using a variety of different inputs and formats.
07b21a3b18f9fdcf.translationZh: 颜色选择器组件允许用户使用各种不同的输入和格式从预定义或自定义颜色中进行选择。

066150db6eee171f.original: The combobox component provides type-ahead autocomplete functionality and allows users to provide a custom values beyond the provided list of options.
066150db6eee171f.translationZh: 组合框组件提供预先输入自动完成功能，并允许用户提供超出所提供选项列表的自定义值。

0f57e0bd88ebcb81.original: A keyboard-driven command palette component that provides a searchable dialog interface for executing commands and actions.
0f57e0bd88ebcb81.translationZh: 键盘驱动的命令选项板组件，提供用于执行命令和操作的可搜索对话框界面。

19f3bdbb09b6cc48.original: The confirm edit component lets users verify changes before they are committed — preventing accidental edits or letting them cancel before saving.
19f3bdbb09b6cc48.translationZh: 确认编辑组件允许用户在提交更改之前验证更改 - 防止意外编辑或在保存之前取消编辑。

a4d54a552e861195.original: The data iterator component is used for filter and displaying data including sorting, searching, pagination, and selection.
a4d54a552e861195.translationZh: 数据迭代器组件用于过滤和显示数据，包括排序、搜索、分页和选择。

dada3fe1d8d149f1.original: The data table component is used for displaying tabular data in a way that is easy for users to scan. It includes sorting, searching, pagination and selection.
dada3fe1d8d149f1.translationZh: 数据表格组件用于以易于用户浏览的方式显示表格数据。它包括排序、搜索、分页和选择。

d84c170587755586.original: The date input is a specialized input that provides a clean interface for selecting dates, showing detailed selection information.
d84c170587755586.translationZh: 日期输入是一个专门的输入，它为选择日期提供了一个干净的界面，显示详细的选择信息。

d56f4b9aaa2cc18c.original: The month picker component is a stand-alone interface that allows the selection of month or both month and year.
d56f4b9aaa2cc18c.translationZh: 月份选择器组件是一个独立的界面，允许选择月份或月份和年份。

3ad1ba170254f57d.original: The date picker component is a stand-alone interface that allows the selection of a date, month and year.
3ad1ba170254f57d.translationZh: 日期选择器组件是一个独立的界面，允许选择日期、月份和年份。

f05b74ac1447b9c5.original: The date range picker component lets users select a start and end date across two adjacent months.
f05b74ac1447b9c5.translationZh: 日期范围选择器组件允许用户选择相邻两个月份的开始日期和结束日期。

545103112649607a.original: The defaults provider allows you to provide specific default prop values to components in a section of your application
545103112649607a.translationZh: 默认提供程序允许您为应用程序部分中的组件提供特定的默认属性值

170216dea1120de4.original: The dialog component informs a user about a specific task and may contain critical information or require the user to take a specific action.
170216dea1120de4.translationZh: 对话框组件向用户通知特定任务，并且可能包含关键信息或要求用户采取特定操作。

01cfe5cbf264df0b.original: The divider component is a thin line commonly used to separate groups of content in lists or layouts.
01cfe5cbf264df0b.translationZh: 分隔线组件是一条细线，通常用于分隔列表或布局中的内容组。

97e4d4c89f8dc727.original: The empty state component is used to indicate that a list is empty or that no search results were found.
97e4d4c89f8dc727.translationZh: 空状态组件用于指示列表为空或未找到搜索结果。

e7288fba55e1ee46.original: The expansion panel component is a lightweight container that hides information behind expandable and contractable containers.
e7288fba55e1ee46.translationZh: 扩展面板组件是一个轻量级容器，它将信息隐藏在可扩展和可收缩容器后面。

69143341b455151b.original: The file input component is a specialized input that provides a clean interface for selecting files, showing detailed selection information and upload progress.
69143341b455151b.translationZh: 文件输入组件是一个专门的输入，它提供了一个干净的界面来选择文件，显示详细的选择信息和上传进度。

a149cd911f5036af.original: The file upload component is a drag and drop area for uploading files.
a149cd911f5036af.translationZh: 文件上传组件是上传文件的拖放区域。

11d81d56582a6b68.original: The floating action button (or FAB) component is a promoted action that is elevated above the UI or attached to an element such as a card.
11d81d56582a6b68.translationZh: 浮动操作按钮（或 FAB）组件是提升到 UI 之上或附加到卡片等元素的提升操作。

bbb7c433c03b8dd4.original: The footer component provides a container for displaying additional navigation information about a site.
bbb7c433c03b8dd4.translationZh: 页脚组件提供了一个用于显示有关站点的附加导航信息的容器。

dc146b2ddd60497a.original: The form component provides a wrapper that makes it easy to process and control validation states of input components.
dc146b2ddd60497a.translationZh: 表单组件提供了一个包装器，可以轻松处理和控制输入组件的验证状态。

eb8fe71064c29cd6.original: Vuetify supports the 12 point Material Design grid for laying out and controlling breakpoints for your application.
eb8fe71064c29cd6.translationZh: Vuetify 支持 12 点 Material Design 网格，用于布局和控制应用程序的断点。

d48d930d88f0e9b9.original: The heatmap component visualizes tabular data as a grid of colored cells.
d48d930d88f0e9b9.translationZh: 热图组件将表格数据可视化为彩色单元格网格。

26a7cc31fd58d236.original: The highlight component visually marks matching substrings within a block of text, supporting plain string queries and pre-computed match ranges.
26a7cc31fd58d236.translationZh: 突出显示组件以可视方式标记文本块中的匹配子字符串，支持纯字符串查询和预先计算的匹配范围。

7c90b506b6a8d79a.original: The hotkey component displays keyboard shortcuts in a visually consistent and platform-aware manner.
7c90b506b6a8d79a.translationZh: 热键组件以视觉一致和平台感知的方式显示键盘快捷键。

d58274a232003069.original: The hover component makes it easy respond when the user hover events by wrapping selectable content.
d58274a232003069.translationZh: 悬停组件可以通过包装可选内容来轻松响应用户悬停事件。

f727a734d92c69cb.original: The icon component is compatible with multiple common icon fonts such as Material Design Icons, Font Awesome and more.
f727a734d92c69cb.translationZh: 图标组件兼容Material Design Icons、Font Awesome等多种常见图标字体。

6a814fdb0f76324f.original: The image component provides a flexible interface for displaying different types of images.
6a814fdb0f76324f.translationZh: 图像组件提供了灵活的接口来显示不同类型的图像。

57467699b7aecbf2.original: The Infinite scroll component is a container that loads more items when scrolling. It is useful when you need to display an unknown but large number of items.
57467699b7aecbf2.translationZh: 无限滚动组件是一个在滚动时加载更多项目的容器。当您需要显示未知但大量的项目时，它非常有用。

7ccd6d4b6c002bab.original: The input component is the baseline functionality for all of Vuetify's form components and provides a baseline for custom implementations.
7ccd6d4b6c002bab.translationZh: 输入组件是所有 Vuetify 表单组件的基线功能，并为自定义实现提供基线。

010aee65a6cc9bce.original: The item group components provides the ability to create a group of selectable items out of any component.
010aee65a6cc9bce.translationZh: 项目组组件提供了从任何组件创建一组可选项目的能力。

f06edd21e72fefdf.original: The lazy component allows you to dynamically render content based upon the user's viewport.
f06edd21e72fefdf.translationZh: 惰性组件允许您根据用户的视口动态渲染内容。

216df2ae23c22699.original: The list component is a continuous group of text, images and icons that may contain primary or supplemental actions.
216df2ae23c22699.translationZh: 列表组件是一组连续的文本、图像和图标，可能包含主要或补充操作。

3b2ca95390abb723.original: The locale provider allows you to modify the application's current language scoped within a template
3b2ca95390abb723.translationZh: 区域设置提供程序允许您修改模板内应用程序的当前语言

62c08d28ab5fb5a8.original: The mask input component is a input component for masking input values.
62c08d28ab5fb5a8.translationZh: 屏蔽输入组件是用于屏蔽输入值的输入组件。

ad1990954478677f.original: The menu component exposes a dropdown of potential selections or actions that the user can make.
ad1990954478677f.translationZh: 菜单组件公开了用户可以进行的潜在选择或操作的下拉列表。

ef72fd7146d4f966.original: The month picker component allows users to select a specific month and year.
ef72fd7146d4f966.translationZh: 月份选择器组件允许用户选择特定的月份和年份。

79f6e1ecc254677c.original: The navigation drawer component contains internal navigation links for an application and can be permanently on-screen or controlled programmatically.
79f6e1ecc254677c.translationZh: 导航抽屉组件包含应用程序的内部导航链接，可以永久显示在屏幕上或以编程方式进行控制。

81a5495903bfa629.original: The No SSR component is a simple component that doesn't get rendered on the server, but only on the client.
81a5495903bfa629.translationZh: No SSR 组件是一个简单的组件，不会在服务器上渲染，而仅在客户端上渲染。

dbc7808c0e001e6e.original: The number input component provides a clean interface for entering numeric values with increment and decrement controls.
dbc7808c0e001e6e.translationZh: 数字输入组件提供了一个干净的界面，用于通过增量和减量控件输入数值。

34f30bf40413a194.original: The OTP input component is used for MFA authentication via input field.
34f30bf40413a194.translationZh: OTP 输入组件用于通过输入字段进行 MFA 身份验证。

b5e62edc725aefac.original: The overlay component makes it easy to create a scrim over components or your entire application.
b5e62edc725aefac.translationZh: 覆盖组件可以轻松地在组件或整个应用程序上创建稀松布。

e10c96c5500ac967.original: The pagination component is used to separate long sets of data so that it is easier for a user to consume information.
e10c96c5500ac967.translationZh: 分页组件用于分隔长数据集，以便用户更轻松地消费信息。

91391f92cb651764.original: The parallax component creates a 3d effect that makes an image appear to scroll slower than the window.
91391f92cb651764.translationZh: 视差组件创建 3D 效果，使图像看起来比窗口滚动得慢。

32e96044b9832c52.original: The pie/donut chart component is versatile and fully customizable.
32e96044b9832c52.translationZh: 饼图/圆环图组件用途广泛且完全可定制。

4245fb61dcec44d2.original: The progress circular component is useful for displaying a visual indicator of numerical data in a circle.
4245fb61dcec44d2.translationZh: 进度圆形组件对于在圆形中显示数字数据的视觉指示器非常有用。

1db11b33a4b13255.original: The progress-linear component is useful for displaying a visual indicator of numerical data in a straight line.
1db11b33a4b13255.translationZh: 进度线性组件对于以直线显示数字数据的视觉指示器非常有用。

cfae0f18354adec0.original: A unified progress indicator component that supports both linear and circular variants with labels and accessible value formatting.
cfae0f18354adec0.translationZh: 统一的进度指示器组件，支持带有标签和可访问值格式的线性和循环变体。

28eb2764c0b20f13.original: The PullToRefresh allows users to update content with a simple downward swipe on their screen.
28eb2764c0b20f13.translationZh: PullToRefresh 允许用户通过在屏幕上简单地向下滑动来更新内容。

dc866e193b0dc217.original: A radio button allows the user to choose only one of a set of options using a radio group.
dc866e193b0dc217.translationZh: 单选按钮允许用户使用单选组仅选择一组选项中的一个。

2b182cfa21767759.original: The range slider component is a better visualization of the number input. It is used for gathering a range of numerical user data.
2b182cfa21767759.translationZh: 范围滑块组件可以更好地可视化数字输入。它用于收集一系列数字用户数据。

3eaabdbb4995dd37.original: The star rating component is a specialized widget for collecting user feedback via ratings.
3eaabdbb4995dd37.translationZh: 星级评分组件是一个专门用于通过评分收集用户反馈的小部件。

d4add12040a99d7a.original: The select component provides a list of options that a user can make selections from.
d4add12040a99d7a.translationZh: 选择组件提供用户可以从中进行选择的选项列表。

50fb70f05345e0da.original: The sheet component is the baseline for many Material Design implementations used in Vuetify.
50fb70f05345e0da.translationZh: 工作表组件是 Vuetify 中使用的许多 Material Design 实现的基线。

4fd4852d76c27376.original: The skeleton loader component provides a placeholder loading state while content is fetched or loaded asynchronously — ideal for cards, lists, and tables.
4fd4852d76c27376.translationZh: 骨架加载器组件在异步获取或加载内容时提供占位符加载状态 - 非常适合卡片、列表和表格。

f9b42179a893dc0e.original: The slide group component is similar to item groups in that you can make selectable content out of elements but does so in a single line fashion.
f9b42179a893dc0e.translationZh: 幻灯片组组件与项目组类似，您可以从元素中制作可选择的内容，但以单行方式完成。

1db3b8039d6ec4a0.original: The slider component can be used as an alternative visualization instead of a number input.
1db3b8039d6ec4a0.translationZh: 滑块组件可用作替代可视化而不是数字输入。

cd4e096afe8081c7.original: The snackbar component informs users of a process your application has performed or will perform. It is often temporary and can contain actions.
cd4e096afe8081c7.translationZh: 小吃栏组件通知用户您的应用程序已执行或将执行的进程。它通常是临时的并且可以包含操作。

bdf0491367bb58e8.original: The sparkline component creates beautiful and expressive simple graphs for displaying numerical data.
bdf0491367bb58e8.translationZh: 迷你图组件创建漂亮且富有表现力的简单图表来显示数值数据。

deb9ef92d0eaedd9.original: The speed dial component is a floating action button that can reveal additional actions when clicked.
deb9ef92d0eaedd9.translationZh: 快速拨号组件是一个浮动操作按钮，单击时可以显示其他操作。

819b2fabdd6c7023.original: The stepper component provides a linear progression process for gathering and displaying information to a user, similar to a form wizard.
819b2fabdd6c7023.translationZh: 步进器组件提供了一个线性进展过程，用于收集并向用户显示信息，类似于表单向导。

ff3e21e1938f4de9.original: The switch component is a simple and eloquent toggle used to select between two values.
ff3e21e1938f4de9.translationZh: 开关组件是一个简单而有力的切换开关，用于在两个值之间进行选择。

f09a77f5f07ca778.original: The system bar component creates an android style status bar that rests on the very top of your application.
f09a77f5f07ca778.translationZh: 系统栏组件创建一个 Android 风格的状态栏，位于应用程序的最顶部。

26c5f581b2446b7c.original: The table component is a lightweight wrapper around the table element that provides a Material Design feel without all the baggage.
26c5f581b2446b7c.translationZh: 表格组件是表格元素的轻量级包装，提供了材料设计的感觉，但没有任何负担。

8ce8c1201078eba1.original: The tabs component provides a way to organize and navigate between groups of content that are related at the same level of hierarchy.
8ce8c1201078eba1.translationZh: 选项卡组件提供了一种在同一层次结构级别相关的内容组之间组织和导航的方法。

7d17d06e0541fe23.original: The text field component accepts textual input from users.
7d17d06e0541fe23.translationZh: 文本字段组件接受用户的文本输入。

6e08da63343a9cd4.original: The textarea component is a text field that accepts lengthy textual input from users.
6e08da63343a9cd4.translationZh: textarea 组件是一个文本字段，接受用户的冗长文本输入。

323aef2444f065d3.original: The theme provider allows you to style a section of your application in a different theme from the default
323aef2444f065d3.translationZh: 主题提供程序允许您使用与默认主题不同的主题来设计应用程序的一部分

99cdf11e4888ae9a.original: The time picker component is a stand-alone interface that allows the selection of hours and minutes in AM/PM and 24hr formats.
99cdf11e4888ae9a.translationZh: 时间选择器组件是一个独立的界面，允许选择 AM/PM 和 24 小时格式的小时和分钟。

fe7190bcd99beced.original: The timeline component is used to display chronological information either vertically or horizontally.
fe7190bcd99beced.translationZh: 时间线组件用于垂直或水平显示时间信息。

b33676579f83d50b.original: The toolbar component sits above the content that it affects and provides an area for labeling and additional actions.
b33676579f83d50b.translationZh: 工具栏组件位于其影响的内容之上，并提供一个用于标记和其他操作的区域。

211ef3893439fb60.original: The tooltip component displays textual information regarding the element it is attached to.
211ef3893439fb60.translationZh: 工具提示组件显示有关其所附加元素的文本信息。

54b104d7cdb4346b.original: The treeview component is a user interface that is used to represent hierarchical data in a tree structure.
54b104d7cdb4346b.translationZh: 树视图组件是一个用户界面，用于表示树结构中的分层数据。

5034d80599f16b52.original: The vertical stepper component is a navigation element that guides users through a sequence of steps.
5034d80599f16b52.translationZh: 垂直步进器组件是一个导航元素，可引导用户完成一系列步骤。

cca1d34bcf041eee.original: The video component acts as a customizable wrapper for native video element.
cca1d34bcf041eee.translationZh: 视频组件充当本机视频元素的可定制包装器。

a7126a93ff7ad3ad.original: The Virtual scroll component is a container that renders only visible elements. It is useful when you need to display large amounts of uniform data.
a7126a93ff7ad3ad.translationZh: 虚拟滚动组件是一个仅呈现可见元素的容器。当您需要显示大量统一数据时，它非常有用。

70b5b76491c9768a.original: The window component is a wrapper container that allows transitioning between content. It serves as the baseline for tabs and carousels.
70b5b76491c9768a.translationZh: 窗口组件是一个包装容器，允许在内容之间进行转换。它充当选项卡和轮播的基线。

09ddc7744040716c.original: The QAjaxBar Vue component displays a loading bar whenever an Ajax call is in progress.
09ddc7744040716c.translationZh: 每当 Ajax 调用正在进行时，QAjaxBar Vue 组件就会显示加载栏。

8311631e96573bc3.original: The QAvatar Vue component creates an element that can embed a letter, an icon or an image within its shape.
8311631e96573bc3.translationZh: QAvatar Vue 组件创建一个可以在其形状中嵌入字母、图标或图像的元素。

4e9c62012ceb8e15.original: The QBadge Vue component allows you to display information like contextual data that needs to stand out and get noticed.
4e9c62012ceb8e15.translationZh: QBadge Vue 组件允许您显示需要脱颖而出并引起注意的信息，例如上下文数据。

3a4cd547166ae560.original: The QBanner Vue component displays a prominent message and related optional actions.
3a4cd547166ae560.translationZh: QBanner Vue 组件显示突出的消息和相关的可选操作。

29db016efe33d13a.original: The QBar Vue component is used to create the top bar on different platforms.
29db016efe33d13a.translationZh: QBar Vue组件用于在不同平台上创建顶部栏。

da4a26e4ce3af60e.original: The QBreadcrumbs Vue component is a navigational aid for your UI. It allows users to keep track of their location within programs, documents, or websites.
da4a26e4ce3af60e.translationZh: QBreadcrumbs Vue 组件是 UI 的导航辅助工具。它允许用户跟踪他们在程序、文档或网站中的位置。

db0489f8733ee7d2.original: The QBtnDropdown Vue component is used to display dropdown content on a button.
db0489f8733ee7d2.translationZh: QBtnDropdown Vue 组件用于在按钮上显示下拉内容。

00fb15daafa6c1b9.original: The QBtnGroup Vue component groups QBtn and QBtnDropdown into a single unit.
00fb15daafa6c1b9.translationZh: QBtnGroup Vue 组件将 QBtn 和 QBtnDropdown 分组为一个单元。

2fa2ae7d2ba25cbb.original: The QBtnToggle Vue component is a basic element for user input, similar to QRadio but with buttons.
2fa2ae7d2ba25cbb.translationZh: QBtnToggle Vue 组件是用户输入的基本元素，类似于 QRadio 但带有按钮。

78f3fa195e543f1c.original: The QBtn Vue component is a button with features like shaping, loading state, ripple and more.
78f3fa195e543f1c.translationZh: QBtn Vue 组件是一个按钮，具有形状、加载状态、波纹等功能。

599b8a8d237d6c57.original: The QCard Vue component is a great way to display important pieces of grouped content. It assists the viewer by containing and organizing information, while also setting up predictable expectations.
599b8a8d237d6c57.translationZh: QCard Vue 组件是显示重要的分组内容的好方法。它通过包含和组织信息来帮助观众，同时还建立可预测的期望。

cff7ab43d1ec684e.original: The QCarousel Vue component allows you to display a series of slides, useful for wizards or an image gallery.
cff7ab43d1ec684e.translationZh: QCarousel Vue 组件允许您显示一系列幻灯片，对于向导或图像库很有用。

2c56ea9a38d65124.original: The QChatMessage Vue component displays a chat entry containing one or more user messages.
2c56ea9a38d65124.translationZh: QChatMessage Vue 组件显示包含一条或多条用户消息的聊天条目。

47421788122c4fe9.original: The QCheckbox Vue component is a checkbox with features like coloring, ripple and indeterminate state.
47421788122c4fe9.translationZh: QCheckbox Vue 组件是一个复选框，具有着色、波纹和不确定状态等功能。

2be6592f9541ca8a.original: The QChip Vue component is a simple UI block entity, representing for example more advanced underlying data, such as a contact, but in a compact way.
2be6592f9541ca8a.translationZh: QChip Vue 组件是一个简单的 UI 块实体，以紧凑的方式表示例如更高级的底层数据，例如联系人。

8162b3fee68fc85b.original: The QCircularProgress Vue component displays a colored circular loading indicator. The bar can either have a determinate progress, or an indeterminate animation.
8162b3fee68fc85b.translationZh: QCircularProgress Vue 组件显示彩色圆形加载指示器。该栏可以具有确定的进度，也可以具有不确定的动画。

d67edeb240cd92d2.original: The QColorPicker Vue component provides a way for the user to input colors.
d67edeb240cd92d2.translationZh: QColorPicker Vue 组件为用户提供了一种输入颜色的方法。

3fcde08493a77886.original: The QDate Vue component provides a method to input dates from Gregorian or Persian calendars.
3fcde08493a77886.translationZh: QDate Vue 组件提供了一种输入公历或波斯历日期的方法。

96ec432cbd211545.original: The QDialog component provides a UI for modals with functionalities like positioning, styling, maximizing and more.
96ec432cbd211545.translationZh: QDialog 组件为模态提供了一个 UI，具有定位、样式化、最大化等功能。

ea8a647f81574299.original: The QEditor Vue component is a WYSIWYG editor that enables writing and pasting HTML.
ea8a647f81574299.translationZh: QEditor Vue 组件是一个所见即所得编辑器，可以编写和粘贴 HTML。

0dce6d747140b72e.original: The QExpansionItem Vue component allows visibility toggling like an accordion.
0dce6d747140b72e.translationZh: QExpansionItem Vue 组件允许像手风琴一样切换可见性。

24e9b516b931f5b9.original: The QField Vue component is used to provide common functionality and aspect to form components.
24e9b516b931f5b9.translationZh: QField Vue 组件用于提供通用功能和方面来形成组件。

dc9245d2b2a80732.original: The QFile Vue component is used as a file picker.
dc9245d2b2a80732.translationZh: QFile Vue 组件用作文件选择器。

bec9399ee18c4914.original: How to use the QFab component. Floating Action Buttons for your Quasar app.
bec9399ee18c4914.translationZh: 如何使用 QFab 组件。 Quasar 应用程序的浮动操作按钮。

6211317627ca0685.original: The QForm Vue component renders a form and allows easy validation of child form components like QInput, QSelect or QField.
6211317627ca0685.translationZh: QForm Vue 组件呈现表单并允许轻松验证 QInput、QSelect 或 QField 等子表单组件。

52a04834597bf656.original: The QIcon Vue component allows you to insert icons within other components or any other area of your pages.
52a04834597bf656.translationZh: QIcon Vue 组件允许您在其他组件或页面的任何其他区域中插入图标​​。

ab53391a0ad0a8c9.original: The QImg Vue component makes working with responsive images easy and also adds a nice loading effect to them along with many other features like custom aspect ratio and captions.
ab53391a0ad0a8c9.translationZh: QImg Vue 组件使处理响应式图像变得容易，并且还为其添加了良好的加载效果以及许多其他功能，例如自定义长宽比和标题。

5722cb9314d764e6.original: The QInfiniteScroll Vue component allows you to load new content as the user scrolls the page.
5722cb9314d764e6.translationZh: QInfiniteScroll Vue 组件允许您在用户滚动页面时加载新内容。

85547b562d7166d7.original: The QInnerLoading Vue component allows you to add a loading indicator within a component in the form of a local overlay.
85547b562d7166d7.translationZh: QInnerLoading Vue 组件允许您以本地覆盖的形式在组件内添加加载指示器。

88cc30eb909c968a.original: The QInput Vue component is used to capture text input from the user.
88cc30eb909c968a.translationZh: QInput Vue 组件用于捕获用户的文本输入。

811a9e2d464c2dd8.original: The QIntersection vue component, a wrapper over Quasar's Intersection directive.
811a9e2d464c2dd8.translationZh: QIntersection vue 组件，Quasar 的 Intersection 指令的包装器。

74c350b5ac630806.original: The QKnob Vue component is used to take a number input through mouse or touch panning.
74c350b5ac630806.translationZh: QKnob Vue 组件用于通过鼠标或触摸平移获取数字输入。

887e4396eb470263.original: The QLinearProgress Vue component displays a colored loading bar. The bar can either have a determinate progress or an indeterminate animation.
887e4396eb470263.translationZh: QLinearProgress Vue 组件显示彩色加载栏。该栏可以具有确定的进度或不确定的动画。

a91ed50ee464d141.original: How to use the QList, QItem, QItemSection and QItemLabel Vue components.
a91ed50ee464d141.translationZh: 如何使用 QList、QItem、QItemSection 和 QItemLabel Vue 组件。

0ad8b92998a3f46b.original: The QMarkupTable Vue component is a helper wrapper which styles a native table.
0ad8b92998a3f46b.translationZh: QMarkupTable Vue 组件是一个辅助包装器，用于设置本机表格的样式。

d24c81f2e4b35b23.original: The QMenu Vue component is a convenient way to show menus.
d24c81f2e4b35b23.translationZh: QMenu Vue 组件是显示菜单的便捷方式。

ad0cb92104064eca.original: The QNoSsr Vue component makes it easy to differentiate content between server-side and client-side.
ad0cb92104064eca.translationZh: QNoSsr Vue 组件可以轻松区分服务器端和客户端之间的内容。

93a96e7192f880c0.original: The QOptionGroup Vue component allows you better control for grouping binary form input components like checkboxes, radios or toggles.
93a96e7192f880c0.translationZh: QOptionGroup Vue 组件允许您更好地控制分组二进制表单输入组件，例如复选框、单选按钮或切换开关。

eb7cf81dea74a33b.original: The QPagination Vue component allows you to easily display a pagination control on a page.
eb7cf81dea74a33b.translationZh: QPagination Vue 组件允许您轻松在页面上显示分页控件。

9241f4a793ef8931.original: The QParallax Vue component makes it easy to embed a parallax scrolling effect into a page.
9241f4a793ef8931.translationZh: QParallax Vue 组件可以轻松地将视差滚动效果嵌入到页面中。

becde6cf7169a524.original: The QPopupEdit Vue component can be used to edit a value 'in place', like for example on a cell in QTable.
becde6cf7169a524.translationZh: QPopupEdit Vue 组件可用于“就地”编辑值，例如 QTable 中的单元格。

1c0188396d34d83a.original: The QPopupProxy is a Vue component that should be used when you need either a QMenu or a QDialog (on smaller screens) to be displayed.
1c0188396d34d83a.translationZh: QPopupProxy 是一个 Vue 组件，当您需要显示 QMenu 或 QDialog（在较小的屏幕上）时应该使用它。

f6eb85b9431234d3.original: The QPullToRefresh Vue component allows the user to pull down in order to refresh or retrieve the newest content on a page.
f6eb85b9431234d3.translationZh: QPullToRefresh Vue 组件允许用户下拉以刷新或检索页面上的最新内容。

27f71e183c7aa4f3.original: The QRadio Vue component is a basic element for user input. It can be used to supply a way for the user to pick an option from multiple choices.
27f71e183c7aa4f3.translationZh: QRadio Vue 组件是用户输入的基本元素。它可用于为用户提供一种从多个选项中选择一个选项的方法。

2a395ecdd29f21ea.original: The QRange Vue component offers a way for the user to select from a sub-range of values between a maximum and maximum value, with optional steps.
2a395ecdd29f21ea.translationZh: QRange Vue 组件为用户提供了一种从最大值和最大值之间的子范围中进行选择的方法，并具有可选步骤。

3122463fce71e5ef.original: The QRating Vue component allows the user to rate items. It's usually known as 'star rating'.
3122463fce71e5ef.translationZh: QRating Vue 组件允许用户对项目进行评分。它通常被称为“星级评定”。

9f0bec008655536e.translationZh: 调整观察者的大小（对于元素）

5ebe77013d88d73c.original: The QResizeObserver Vue component emits a 'resize' event whenever the wrapping DOM element changes its width or height.
5ebe77013d88d73c.translationZh: 每当包装 DOM 元素更改其宽度或高度时，QResizeObserver Vue 组件就会发出“调整大小”事件。

6e34365d17780be7.original: The QResponsive Vue component forces the content to maintain an aspect ratio based on its width.
6e34365d17780be7.translationZh: QResponsive Vue 组件强制内容根据其宽度保持长宽比。

19f0cb149b212499.original: The QScrollArea Vue component offers a way of customizing the scrollbars for all desktop browsers.
19f0cb149b212499.translationZh: QScrollArea Vue 组件提供了一种为所有桌面浏览器自定义滚动条的方法。

71de5bad1d320c7a.original: The QScrollObserver Vue component emits an event whenever the user scrolls the page or the parent scrollable container.
71de5bad1d320c7a.translationZh: 每当用户滚动页面或父可滚动容器时，QScrollObserver Vue 组件都会发出一个事件。

1c0f99be6e4a4c50.original: The QSelect Vue component has two types of selection - single or multiple. This component opens up a menu for the selection list and action. A filter can also be used for longer lists.
1c0f99be6e4a4c50.translationZh: QSelect Vue 组件有两种选择类型 - 单项选择或多项选择。该组件打开一个用于选择列表和操作的菜单。过滤器也可用于较长的列表。

6a14a3de5001efac.original: The QSeparator Vue component is used to separate sections of text or other components or elements. It creates a colored line across the width of the parent. It can be horizontal or vertical.
6a14a3de5001efac.translationZh: QSeparator Vue 组件用于分隔文本部分或其他组件或元素。它会在父级的宽度上创建一条彩色线。它可以是水平的或垂直的。

850164fc11bd6b71.original: The QSkeleton Vue component is used to display a placeholder preview of your content before you load the actual page data.
850164fc11bd6b71.translationZh: QSkeleton Vue 组件用于在加载实际页面数据之前显示内容的占位符预览。

3ac9c59ca3adaecf.original: The QSlideItem Vue component is essentially a QItem with two additional slots (left and right) which allows the user to drag it to one of the sides in order to apply a specific action.
3ac9c59ca3adaecf.translationZh: QSlideItem Vue 组件本质上是一个具有两个附加插槽（左侧和右侧）的 QItem，允许用户将其拖动到一侧以应用特定操作。

4da44a729acf0403.original: The QSlideTransition Vue component slides the encapsulated element up or down, based on its visibility. Works alongside v-show and v-if.
4da44a729acf0403.translationZh: QSlideTransition Vue 组件根据封装元素的可见性向上或向下滑动。与 v-show 和 v-if 一起使用。

8ddcdcc03718fc0b.original: The QSlider Vue component is a great way for the user to specify a number value between a minimum and maximum value, with optional steps between valid values.
8ddcdcc03718fc0b.translationZh: QSlider Vue 组件是用户指定最小值和最大值之间的数值的好方法，并且在有效值之间具有可选步骤。

7930e24e13b93f27.original: The QSpace Vue component fills all the available space inside of a flexbox DOM element.
7930e24e13b93f27.translationZh: QSpace Vue 组件填充了 Flexbox DOM 元素内的所有可用空间。

9a43ee70f7e8127c.original: The QSpinner and its derived Vue components are used to show the user a timely process is currently taking place. It gives the user the feeling the system is continuing to work for longer term activities.
9a43ee70f7e8127c.translationZh: QSpinner 及其派生的 Vue 组件用于向用户显示当前正在进行的及时流程。它给用户一种系统正在继续为长期活动工作的感觉。

23c050e7f3aea9ae.original: The QSplitter Vue component allow containers to be split vertically and/or horizontally through a draggable separator bar.
23c050e7f3aea9ae.translationZh: QSplitter Vue 组件允许通过可拖动的分隔栏垂直和/或水平拆分容器。

ed6255fcd66c08f3.original: The QStepper Vue component conveys progress through a sequence of numbered steps. It may also be used for navigation. It's usually useful when the user has to follow steps to complete a process, like in a wizard.
ed6255fcd66c08f3.translationZh: QStepper Vue 组件通过一系列编号步骤传达进度。它还可以用于导航。当用户必须按照步骤完成流程时（例如在向导中），它通常很有用。

0f0b51e027540717.original: The QTabPanel Vue component is a way of displaying more information using less window real estate.
0f0b51e027540717.translationZh: QTabPanel Vue 组件是一种使用更少的窗口空间显示更多信息的方法。

e5bf6b503cfc3460.original: The QTable Vue component allows you to display data in a tabular manner and it's packed with a lot of related features. It's generally called a datatable.
e5bf6b503cfc3460.translationZh: QTable Vue 组件允许您以表格方式显示数据，并且它包含许多相关功能。它通常被称为数据表。

0aed6bf7e89d1f0c.original: The QTabs, QTab and QRouteTab Vue components are a way of helping the user navigate between pages or tab panels.
0aed6bf7e89d1f0c.translationZh: QTabs、QTab 和 QRouteTab Vue 组件是帮助用户在页面或选项卡面板之间导航的一种方式。

5ed9da38cdab2c6a.original: The QTime component provides a method to input time.
5ed9da38cdab2c6a.translationZh: QTime组件提供了一种输入时间的方法。

7832339824454590.original: The QTimeline Vue component displays a list of events in chronological order. It is typically a graphic design showing a long bar labelled with dates alongside itself and usually events.
7832339824454590.translationZh: QTimeline Vue 组件按时间顺序显示事件列表。它通常是一种图形设计，显示一个长条，旁边标有日期，通常还有事件。

d5e7f0886ea5dab9.original: The QToggle component is a basic element for user input. You can use it for turning settings, features or true/false inputs on and off.
d5e7f0886ea5dab9.translationZh: QToggle 组件是用户输入的基本元素。您可以使用它来打开和关闭设置、功能或真/假输入。

287b7e8eb88032b5.original: The QToolbar and QToolbarTitle Vue components are usually part of QHeader or QFooter, but it can be used anywhere on the page.
287b7e8eb88032b5.translationZh: QToolbar 和 QToolbarTitle Vue 组件通常是 QHeader 或 QFooter 的一部分，但它可以在页面上的任何位置使用。

a3febe924d29aad8.original: The QTooltip Vue component is to be used when you want to offer the user more information about a certain area in your App. When hovering the mouse over the target element (or touching and holding on touch-capable devices), the tooltip will appear.
a3febe924d29aad8.translationZh: 当您想向用户提供有关应用程序中某个区域的更多信息时，可以使用 QTooltip Vue 组件。将鼠标悬停在目标元素上（或触摸并按住支持触摸的设备）时，将出现工具提示。

33b769b4589bc439.original: The QTree is a highly configurable Vue component which displays hierarchical data, such as a table of contents in a tree structure.
33b769b4589bc439.translationZh: QTree 是一个高度可配置的 Vue 组件，它显示分层数据，例如树结构中的目录。

99373fe2aa705754.original: The QUploader Vue component is a way for the user to upload files to a backend server.
99373fe2aa705754.translationZh: QUploader Vue 组件是用户将文件上传到后端服务器的一种方式。

3aef2562b74dd8f3.original: The QVideo Vue components makes embedding a video like Youtube easy. It also resizes to fit the container by default.
3aef2562b74dd8f3.translationZh: QVideo Vue 组件使嵌入 Youtube 等视频变得容易。默认情况下，它还会调整大小以适合容器。

4a14af1ac7a75918.original: The QVirtualScroll component renders a big list of items as the user scrolls in the container, keeping DOM tree clean and eating the lowest amount of memory possible.
4a14af1ac7a75918.translationZh: 当用户在容器中滚动时，QVirtualScroll 组件会呈现一个大的项目列表，保持 DOM 树干净并占用尽可能少的内存。

45898e2d0db3aeaf.original: A collapsible component for displaying content in a vertical stack.
45898e2d0db3aeaf.translationZh: 用于在垂直堆栈中显示内容的可折叠组件。

d1275b818c2b5dfa.original: A component for selecting a value within a circular range.
d1275b818c2b5dfa.translationZh: 用于选择循环范围内的值的组件。

c2b4a56c46ca0e6d.original: A graphical representation of the user, often used in profile sections.
c2b4a56c46ca0e6d.translationZh: 用户的图形表示，通常用于个人资料部分。

9a35ac8bb1b55276.original: An interactive slideshow component for cycling through elements.
9a35ac8bb1b55276.translationZh: 用于循环浏览元素的交互式幻灯片组件。

685617ad3ce10b10.original: A control element that allows for multiple selections within a set.
685617ad3ce10b10.translationZh: 允许在一组内进行多项选择的控制元素。

84f00767ab853f50.original: A component to copy text to the clipboard
84f00767ab853f50.translationZh: 将文本复制到剪贴板的组件

e02b33da5a9f93e8.original: An interactive component that can be expanded or collapsed.
e02b33da5a9f93e8.translationZh: 可展开或折叠的交互式组件。

3673bff9641d7c42.original: A component that allows users to select a color from a color picker.
3673bff9641d7c42.translationZh: 允许用户从颜色选择器中选择颜色的组件。

3feac36c2adec435.original: A single input field that combines the functionality of a select and input.
3feac36c2adec435.translationZh: 结合了选择和输入功能的单个输入字段。

f7e0b095bdf564a3.original: A segment-based date input that allows users to enter dates by navigating individual date parts.
f7e0b095bdf564a3.translationZh: 基于分段的日期输入，允许用户通过导航各个日期部分来输入日期。

64c56768e20968a8.original: A component that allows users to select a date from a calendar.
64c56768e20968a8.translationZh: 允许用户从日历中选择日期的组件。

0ba7e495892104c9.original: A modal window that appears on top of the main content.
0ba7e495892104c9.translationZh: 出现在主要内容顶部的模式窗口。

4861e1568cf70585.original: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, typically used for navigation or forms.
4861e1568cf70585.translationZh: 从屏幕边缘滑入的面板，通常用于导航或表单。

7b52fb7abb492a5e.original: A component that allows users to edit text in place.
7b52fb7abb492a5e.translationZh: 允许用户就地编辑文本的组件。

5284bbc3d896294e.original: Provides a flexible container for form inputs, labels, and helper text.
5284bbc3d896294e.translationZh: 为表单输入、标签和帮助文本提供灵活的容器。

e47a1b6f34e26d2d.original: A component that is used to upload multiple files.
e47a1b6f34e26d2d.translationZh: 用于上传多个文件的组件。

aa758015cfc374dd.original: Used to display content in a non-modal floating window.
aa758015cfc374dd.translationZh: 用于在非模态浮动窗口中显示内容。

659177f35b96d4d2.original: A card that appears when a user hovers over an element.
659177f35b96d4d2.translationZh: 当用户将鼠标悬停在元素上时出现的卡片。

db89c6d4b8840e0c.original: Crop and transform images with zoom, rotation, and aspect ratio controls.
db89c6d4b8840e0c.translationZh: 使用缩放、旋转和纵横比控件裁剪和变换图像。

12f0539c1cd2ebe3.original: A component for selecting a single or multiple items from a list.
12f0539c1cd2ebe3.translationZh: 用于从列表中选择单个或多个项目的组件。

1bd3cdfa477bcf07.original: A continuous scrolling component for displaying content in a seamless loop.
1bd3cdfa477bcf07.translationZh: 连续滚动组件，用于无缝循环显示内容。

af10c62f30120f3a.original: A list of options that appears when a user interacts with a button.
af10c62f30120f3a.translationZh: 用户与按钮交互时出现的选项列表。

de03d07a506d03c9.original: A collection of links and menus for website navigation.
de03d07a506d03c9.translationZh: 用于网站导航的链接和菜单的集合。

3bc2d297a8cc5997.original: A field that allows user input of numeric values.
3bc2d297a8cc5997.translationZh: 允许用户输入数值的字段。

919be52a156c3f5d.original: A navigation component that allows users to browse through pages.
919be52a156c3f5d.translationZh: 允许用户浏览页面的导航组件。

02ae05c62f129468.original: A component that allows users to enter secure text like (passwords and api keys)
02ae05c62f129468.translationZh: 允许用户输入安全文本（例如密码和 API 密钥）的组件

155ec48542ec90ff.original: For pin or verification codes with auto-focus transfer and masking options.
155ec48542ec90ff.translationZh: 用于具有自动对焦传输和屏蔽选项的密码或验证码。

df2befcfc54bf0fe.original: An overlay that displays additional information or options when triggered.
df2befcfc54bf0fe.translationZh: 触发时显示附加信息或选项的叠加层。

d0e13d402abcb65f.original: An element that shows either determinate or indeterminate progress.
d0e13d402abcb65f.translationZh: 显示确定或不确定进度的元素。

4dafae880fc793e6.original: Allows single selection from multiple options.
4dafae880fc793e6.translationZh: 允许从多个选项中进行单选。

fe69552c054ddf07.original: Allows users to rate items using a set of icons.
fe69552c054ddf07.translationZh: 允许用户使用一组图标对项目进行评分。

b5f554120b83f9e5.original: A custom scrollable area component with styled scrollbars.
b5f554120b83f9e5.translationZh: 带有样式滚动条的自定义可滚动区域组件。

4151bc2feb8c56d0.original: Organizes and navigates between sections in a view.
4151bc2feb8c56d0.translationZh: 在视图中的各部分之间组织和导航。

4327142c3b0a9234.original: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from.
4327142c3b0a9234.translationZh: 显示选项列表供用户选择。

ea5604ffbedc7c94.original: A component that allows users to draw a signature using a signature pad.
ea5604ffbedc7c94.translationZh: 允许用户使用签名板绘制签名的组件。

dc7ba88f7001a673.original: A control element that allows for a range of selections.
dc7ba88f7001a673.translationZh: 允许进行一系列选择的控制元素。

69b0ab72d0a1890d.original: A component that divides your interface into resizable sections
69b0ab72d0a1890d.translationZh: 将界面划分为可调整大小的部分的组件

77f1e8284de84796.original: Used to guide users through a series of steps in a process
77f1e8284de84796.translationZh: 用于指导用户完成流程中的一系列步骤

f8aaf3b0d016fbea.original: A control element that allows for a binary selection.
f8aaf3b0d016fbea.translationZh: 允许二进制选择的控制元件。

3849349664fd239b.original: Flexible navigation tool with various modes and features.
3849349664fd239b.translationZh: 具有多种模式和功能的灵活导航工具。

3706fa3f6d446d40.original: A component that allows users to add tags to an input field.
3706fa3f6d446d40.translationZh: 允许用户向输入字段添加标签的组件。

898323a419b54c2c.original: Used to record the time elapsed from zero or since a specified target time.
898323a419b54c2c.translationZh: 用于记录从零或自指定目标时间起经过的时间。

bfb2793bec438bed.original: A message that appears on the screen to provide feedback on an action.
bfb2793bec438bed.translationZh: 屏幕上显示的一条消息，用于提供操作反馈。

4ef59db646b44240.original: A two-state button that can be toggled on or off.
4ef59db646b44240.translationZh: 可以打开或关闭的两种状态按钮。

9f7e6986aac9c40d.original: A label that provides information on hover or focus.
9f7e6986aac9c40d.translationZh: 提供有关悬停或焦点信息的标签。

bfa2c33e017fbd43.original: A guided tour that helps users understand the interface.
bfa2c33e017fbd43.translationZh: 帮助用户理解界面的导览。

34672e3f4ef1daf9.original: A component that is used to show a tree hierarchy.
34672e3f4ef1daf9.translationZh: 用于显示树层次结构的组件。

3b09427824a5b55f.original: Render content only on the client side.

17a4c628bb3b5b5a.translationZh: 以编程方式触发文件下载。

671f8b1f84b7797c.original: Set up components for custom environments like iframes, Shadow DOM, or Electron.
671f8b1f84b7797c.translationZh: 为 iframe、Shadow DOM 或 Electron 等自定义环境设置组件。

b26db0074fcec268.original: Trap focus within a specified container.
b26db0074fcec268.translationZh: 将焦点捕获在指定容器内。

0d43c37632d6f25f.original: Used to format byte values with various options and units
0d43c37632d6f25f.translationZh: 用于使用各种选项和单位格式化字节值

24bc1d2e6a4d8def.original: Used to format numbers to a specific locale and options
24bc1d2e6a4d8def.translationZh: 用于将数字格式化为特定区域设置和选项

9c23ef42e999a694.original: Used to format relative time to a specific locale and options
9c23ef42e999a694.translationZh: 用于格式化特定区域设置和选项的相对时间

3551b64acee30d2b.original: Used to format time values to a specific locale and options
3551b64acee30d2b.translationZh: 用于将时间值格式化为特定区域设置和选项

6a130ee19f7df76e.original: Used to render a component in an iframe
6a130ee19f7df76e.translationZh: 用于渲染 iframe 中的组件

58f7dbcd87e1c2b6.original: Used to emphasize specific words or phrases within a larger body of text.
58f7dbcd87e1c2b6.translationZh: 用于强调较大文本正文中的特定单词或短语。

7962d19e6717f8ab.original: Register keyboard shortcuts, sequences and scopes, and read them back to build a command palette.
7962d19e6717f8ab.translationZh: 注册键盘快捷键、序列和范围，并将它们读回以构建命令面板。

afbd04fe0bc67d42.original: A component that displays JSON data in an interactive, collapsible tree structure.
afbd04fe0bc67d42.translationZh: 以交互式、可折叠树结构显示 JSON 数据的组件。

4e7b3f71cf5a21f6.original: Locale provider for setting the locale and direction of the app.
4e7b3f71cf5a21f6.translationZh: 用于设置应用程序的区域设置和方向的区域设置提供程序。

406ef30b32dac8d5.original: Helps control the rendering and unmounting of your content based on a given state.
406ef30b32dac8d5.translationZh: 帮助根据给定状态控制内容的渲染和卸载。

83597a883c739a7e.original: Animate between two visual states with smooth transitions.
83597a883c739a7e.translationZh: 在两种视觉状态之间进行平滑过渡的动画。

3fb3bd6d489ce64b.original: Used for connecting or disconnecting a store to various accounts, like Facebook for the sales channel.
3fb3bd6d489ce64b.translationZh: 用于将商店与各种帐户连接或断开连接，例如用于销售渠道的 Facebook。

a38e74a0866cabf5.original: Displays multiple related actions stacked or in a horizontal row for arrangement and spacing.
a38e74a0866cabf5.translationZh: 显示堆叠或水平行的多个相关操作，以进行排列和间距。

405f9496a81fa79c.original: Used primarily for actions like 'Add', 'Close', 'Cancel', or 'Save'. Plain buttons are used for less important actions.
405f9496a81fa79c.translationZh: 主要用于“添加”、“关闭”、“取消”或“保存”等操作。普通按钮用于不太重要的操作。

b29ca80287bf046a.original: Caption text is smaller than the recommended size for general reading. Used in graphs, timestamps, or as secondary text.
b29ca80287bf046a.translationZh: 标题文本小于一般阅读的建议大小。用于图表、时间戳或作为辅助文本。

498119a4393aedf3.original: Informs merchants of their options once they have made changes to a form on the page or while creating a new object.
498119a4393aedf3.translationZh: 一旦商家对页面上的表单进行更改或创建新对象时，通知商家他们的选项。

70f855add9676917.original: Display styles make a bold visual statement. Used for visual storytelling, marketing content, or capturing attention.
70f855add9676917.translationZh: 显示风格呈现出大胆的视觉效果。用于视觉叙事、营销内容或吸引注意力。

8f083f269d996125.original: Creates the structure of the Shopify admin. All of the main sections of the admin are nested in the frame.
8f083f269d996125.translationZh: 创建 Shopify 后台的结构。管理的所有主要部分都嵌套在框架中。

917c458fac6dac0d.original: Used as the titles of each major section of a page in the interface, like in card components.
917c458fac6dac0d.translationZh: 用作界面中页面每个主要部分的标题，就像在卡片组件中一样。

bacf39bcee7a9284.original: Legacy version of the Card component. Used to group similar concepts and tasks together for easier scanning and reading.
bacf39bcee7a9284.translationZh: 卡组件的旧版本。用于将相似的概念和任务分组在一起，以便于扫描和阅读。

20ea1bb900476704.original: Legacy version of the Filters component. Used to filter the items of a list or table.
20ea1bb900476704.translationZh: 过滤器组件的旧版本。用于过滤列表或表格的项目。

1ba9a4fe615ab51d.original: Legacy version of the Stack component. Used for layout of a horizontal row of components or vertical centering.
1ba9a4fe615ab51d.translationZh: 堆栈组件的旧版本。用于水平排列组件或垂直居中的布局。

be3bcafcfafb4890.original: Used to alternate among related views within the same context.
be3bcafcfafb4890.translationZh: 用于在同一上下文中的相关视图之间交替。

ab4d1d98f4546212.original: Used to indicate to merchants that a page is loading or an upload is processing.
ab4d1d98f4546212.translationZh: 用于向商家指示页面正在加载或上传正在处理。

0eb0c002b1c2c1a2.original: Used to interrupt merchants with urgent information, details, or actions.
0eb0c002b1c2c1a2.translationZh: 用于打断商家提供紧急信息、细节或操作。

24d18f60f8d271bd.original: Allows merchants to take key actions at the bottom of specific pages in the interface.
24d18f60f8d271bd.translationZh: 允许商户在界面中特定页面的底部执行关键操作。

371b574e803262ae.original: Used to control a feature or option that can be turned on or off.
371b574e803262ae.translationZh: 用于控制可打开或关闭的功能或选项。

540e7a0ba982b8a8.original: A large container providing actions and information contextual to the page without interrupting flow like a modal.
540e7a0ba982b8a8.translationZh: 一个大型容器，提供与页面上下文相关的操作和信息，而不会像模态一样中断流程。

d110a662ff3970a4.original: Used for the title of any sub-sections in top-level page sections.
d110a662ff3970a4.translationZh: 用于顶级页面部分中任何子部分的标题。

3a4f3e6f62b173b1.original: Used to wrap text elements like paragraphs, headings, and lists for vertical spacing.
3a4f3e6f62b173b1.translationZh: 用于包裹文本元素，如段落、标题和垂直间距列表。

6e3e304553e447d7.original: Enhances text with additional visual meaning, like using subdued text to de-emphasize it.
6e3e304553e447d7.translationZh: 通过额外的视觉意义增强文本，例如使用柔和的文本来弱化它。

75608c7dfa1ab0f6.original: A non-disruptive message that provides quick feedback on the outcome of an action.
75608c7dfa1ab0f6.translationZh: 一种非中断性消息，可提供有关操作结果的快速反馈。

ec1cd482381aa28c.original: Appears at the top of the page and is used to brand and navigate major applications areas.
ec1cd482381aa28c.translationZh: 出现在页面顶部，用于品牌化和导航主要应用领域。

d6c6ffeb65093734.original: Used when an element needs to be available to assistive technology but otherwise hidden.
d6c6ffeb65093734.translationZh: 当某个元素需要可用于辅助技术但以其他方式隐藏时使用。

3dd736bb9ac046fd.original: Used to inform merchants of the tone of an object or an action taken.
3dd736bb9ac046fd.translationZh: 用于告知商家某物体或所采取动作的语气。

f5498baf936dcc9d.original: Informs merchants about important changes or persistent conditions in a prominent way.
f5498baf936dcc9d.translationZh: 以显着方式告知商户重要变化或持续情况。

c9a8d5f23e249d05.original: Helps merchants notice important, standout information that adds extra context to a task.
c9a8d5f23e249d05.translationZh: 帮助商家注意到重要、突出的信息，为任务添加额外的上下文。

f8bd747b1e14ea1a.original: Used to visually represent the completion of a task or operation.
f8bd747b1e14ea1a.translationZh: 用于直观地表示任务或操作的完成情况。

8a736fcc94f6f652.original: Provides a low fidelity representation of content before it appears, improving perceived load times.
8a736fcc94f6f652.translationZh: 在内容出现之前提供内容的低保真度表示，从而缩短感知加载时间。

491b8558e2b966e0.original: Used with other skeleton loading components to provide a low fidelity representation of the UI before content appears.
491b8558e2b966e0.translationZh: 与其他骨架加载组件一起使用，在内容出现之前提供 UI 的低保真度表示。

f8509ea5d1f13a6d.original: Provides a low fidelity representation of an image before it appears, improving perceived load times.
f8509ea5d1f13a6d.translationZh: 在图像出现之前提供图像的低保真度表示，从而缩短感知加载时间。

ac7a138106281604.original: Used to notify merchants that their action is being processed. Used for content that can't be represented with skeleton loading components.
ac7a138106281604.translationZh: 用于通知商户其操作正在处理中。用于无法用骨架加载组件表示的内容。

53689defa94e95f8.original: Used to show a thumbnail representation of an individual or business in the interface.
53689defa94e95f8.translationZh: 用于在界面中显示个人或企业的缩略图。

b5ab8efd6a7fe6b3.translationZh: 自定义属性 (-*): CSS 变量

3ed854b6f52aa74e.original: Property names that are prefixed with --, like --example-name, represent custom properties that contain a value that can be used in other declarations using the var() function.
3ed854b6f52aa74e.translationZh: 前缀的属性名称 -- -- 如 -- -- 示例名称, 代表自定义属性, 包含一个值, 可用于使用 var() 函数的其他声明 。

058112c3fe502483.original: The non-standard -moz-float-edge CSS property specifies whether the height and width properties of the element include the margin, border, or padding thickness.
058112c3fe502483.translationZh: 非标准- moz- float- sedge CSS 属性指定元素的高度和宽度属性是否包括比值,边框,或粘厚度.

e78598e6c450246f.original: The -moz-force-broken-image-icon extended CSS property can be used to force the broken image icon to be shown even when a broken image has an alt attribute.
e78598e6c450246f.translationZh: –moz-force-brooken-image-icon扩展的CSS属性可以用来强迫断开的图像图标被显示,即使断开的图像有alt属性.

6141aff32a9eff0b.original: The -moz-orient CSS property specifies the orientation of the element to which it's applied.
6141aff32a9eff0b.translationZh: -moz-orient CSS 属性指定其应用的元素的方向.

45a6e9ff682c1220.original: The -moz-user-focus CSS property is used to indicate whether an element can have the focus.
45a6e9ff682c1220.translationZh: 使用 -moz-user-焦点 CSS 属性来表示元素是否可以有焦点.

199bd04ce563ef55.original: In Mozilla applications, -moz-user-input determines if an element will accept user input.
199bd04ce563ef55.translationZh: 在 Mozilla 应用程序中, -moz-user- input 确定元素是否会接受用户输入 。

d2a8743cbf59c232.original: The -webkit-border-before CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical block start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
d2a8743cbf59c232.translationZh: CSS 短手属性前的 -webkit- 边界设置单个逻辑块在样式表的单个位置启动边框属性值 。

cf579b24fe6067a9.original: The -webkit-box-reflect CSS property lets you reflect the content of an element in one specific direction.
cf579b24fe6067a9.translationZh: -webkit-box-reflect CSS 属性允许您在一个特定方向反映元素的内容 。

9a28ad1d204e9dfe.original: The non-standard prefixed -webkit-mask-box-image CSS shorthand property sets the mask image for an element's border box.
9a28ad1d204e9dfe.translationZh: 非标准前缀 -webkit-mask-box-image CSS 短手属性为元素边框设置遮罩图像.

4c678e36f372309c.translationZh: -webkit-mask-composite 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2011-12-02.

2ac806fe1f3eb180.original: The -webkit-mask-composite property specifies the manner in which multiple mask images applied to the same element are composited with one another. Mask images are composited in the opposite order that they are declared with the mask-image property.
2ac806fe1f3eb180.translationZh: -webkit-mask-composite属性指定了适用于同一元素的多个遮罩图像相互混合的方式. 面具图像按相反的顺序进行复合,即以面具图像属性来宣告.

f59f172a39bfce23.original: The -webkit-mask-position-x CSS property sets the initial horizontal position of a mask image.
f59f172a39bfce23.translationZh: -webkit-mask-position-x CSS 属性设置了面具图像的初始水平位置.

5c495c04c7a9eddb.original: The -webkit-mask-position-y CSS property sets the initial vertical position of a mask image.
5c495c04c7a9eddb.translationZh: -webkit-mask-position-y CSS 属性设置了面具图像的初始垂直位置.

b0ca1d4e15c35991.original: The -webkit-mask-repeat-x property specifies whether and how a mask image is repeated (tiled) horizontally.
b0ca1d4e15c35991.translationZh: -webkit-mask-repeat-x属性指定一个面具图像是否和如何横向重复(图).

ede33718a3e14d00.translationZh: -webkit-mask-repeat-y - 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆 - Webkit-mask-repeat-y

10aa61db3a477a6c.original: The -webkit-mask-repeat-y property sets whether and how a mask image is repeated (tiled) vertically.
10aa61db3a477a6c.translationZh: -webkit-mask-repeat-y 属性设置一个面具图像是否和如何垂直重现(图) 。

43d41d718a00804f.original: -webkit-tap-highlight-color is a non-standard CSS property that sets the color of the highlight that appears over a link while it's being tapped. The highlighting indicates to the user that their tap is being successfully recognized, and indicates which element they're tapping on.
43d41d718a00804f.translationZh: -webkit-tap-highlight-color是一个非标准的CSS属性,它设置了在被调用时在链接中出现的亮点的颜色. 突出显示显示用户,他们的水龙头正在被成功识别,并表明他们正在利用的元素.

3d81abd7c77b6b24.original: The -webkit-text-fill-color CSS property specifies the fill color of characters of text. If this property is not set, the value of the color property is used.
3d81abd7c77b6b24.translationZh: -webkit-text-fill-color CSS 属性指定文本字符的填充颜色 。 如果没有设置此属性, 则使用颜色属性的值 。

bbdeb96eb075d00c.original: -webkit-text-security is a non-standard CSS property that obfuscates characters in a form field (such as input or textarea) by replacing them with a shape. It only affects fields that are not of type=password.
bbdeb96eb075d00c.translationZh: -webkit-text-security是一个非标准的CSS属性,它通过用形状取代来混淆一个形式字段(如输入或文本区域)中的字符. 它只影响不是类型=密码字的字段.

0f6503f40db1e79c.original: The -webkit-text-stroke CSS shorthand property specifies the width and color of strokes for text characters.
0f6503f40db1e79c.translationZh: -webkit-text-stroke CSS 短手属性指定文字字符的宽度和颜色 。

60edee67134714c3.original: The -webkit-text-stroke-color CSS property specifies the stroke color of characters of text. If this property is not set, the value of the color property is used.
60edee67134714c3.translationZh: -webkit-text-stroke-color CSS 属性指定文本字符的中风颜色 。 如果没有设置此属性, 则使用颜色属性的值 。

25ed2cec30760ba1.original: The -webkit-text-stroke-width CSS property specifies the width of the stroke for text.
25ed2cec30760ba1.translationZh: -webkit-text-stroke-width CSS 属性指定文字的中风宽度 。

fc128d38c44fe407.original: The -webkit-touch-callout CSS property controls the display of the default callout shown when you touch and hold a touch target.
fc128d38c44fe407.translationZh: -webkit-touch-callout CSS 属性控制您触摸和持有触摸目标时显示的默认触碰的显示.

41a990d69a2c716d.original: The accent-color CSS property sets the accent color for user-interface controls generated by some elements.
41a990d69a2c716d.translationZh: 重音-color CSS 属性为一些元素产生的用户界面控制设置重音颜色.

914270a224d7a4b0.original: The CSS align-content property sets the distribution of space between and around content items along a flexbox's cross axis, or a grid or block-level element's block axis.
914270a224d7a4b0.translationZh: CSS对齐内容属性将内容项目之间和周围的空间分布设置在一个弹性框的交叉轴上,或者一个网格或块级元素的块轴上.

d2e74bfa18224d40.original: The CSS align-items property sets the align-self value on all direct children as a group. In flexbox, it controls the alignment of items on the cross axis. In grid layout, it controls the alignment of items on the block axis within their grid areas.
d2e74bfa18224d40.translationZh: CSS对齐项目属性为所有直接儿童作为一个群体设定对齐自我值. 在flexbox中,它控制横轴上项目的对齐. 在网格布局中,它控制其网格区域内区块轴上项目的对齐.

0ef17a9cf354bf2b.original: The align-self CSS property overrides a grid or flex item's align-items value. In grid, it aligns the item inside the Grid Areas. In flexbox, it aligns the item on the cross axis.
0ef17a9cf354bf2b.translationZh: 对齐自 CSS 属性覆盖网格或弹性项目对齐项目值 。 在网格中,它将网格区域内部的项目对齐. 在flexbox中,它与横轴上的项目对齐.

d4fb534abda78565.original: The alignment-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. Baseline alignment is the relationship among the baselines of multiple alignment subjects within an alignment context. When performing baseline alignment, the alignment-baseline property value specifies which baseline of the box is aligned to the corresponding baseline of its alignment context.
d4fb534abda78565.translationZh: 校正基线 CSS 属性指定了用于对齐框文本和内置级内容的具体基线. 基线调整是在调整背景下多个调整主题的基线之间的关系。 在进行基线对齐时,调整基线属性值规定了该框的哪些基线与其对齐上下文的相应基线一致.

5c8303e1dcb8fedf.original: The all CSSshorthand property resets all of an element's properties except unicode-bidi, direction, and CSS Custom Properties. It can set properties to their initial or inherited values, or to the values specified in another cascade layer or stylesheet origin.
5c8303e1dcb8fedf.translationZh: CSSshorthand 属性全部重置元素属性, unicode- bidi, 方向和 CSS Custom 属性除外 。 它可以将属性设定为它们的初始值或继承值,或者设定为另一个级联层或样式表来源中指定的值.

62db9b95501a312a.original: The anchor-name CSS property enables defining an element as an anchor element by giving it one or more identifying anchor names. Each name can then be set as the value of a positioned element's position-anchor property to associate it with the anchor.
62db9b95501a312a.translationZh: 锚名CSS属性能够通过给出一个或多个识别锚名来将元素定义为锚名元素. 然后可以将每个名称设定为定位元素的位置-锁定属性与锚连接的值.

5d4bdcb1fbf2a16c.original: The anchor-scope CSS property can be used to limit the scope in which a positioned element can be associated with anchor elements to a particular subtree.
5d4bdcb1fbf2a16c.translationZh: 锚镜CSS属性可以用来将定位元素与锚点元素关联的范围限制到特定的子树.

3e4a9e72e7935bda.original: The animation CSS shorthand property applies an animation between styles. It is a shorthand for animation-name, animation-duration, animation-timing-function, animation-delay, animation-iteration-count, animation-direction, animation-fill-mode, animation-play-state, and animation-timeline.
3e4a9e72e7935bda.translationZh: 动画CSS短手属性在样式间应用动画. 它是动画名称,动画期限,动画计时功能,动画延迟,动画监听计数,动画指导,动画填充模式,动画游戏状态,动画时线的简称.

a2be0dde5d47fab7.original: The animation-composition CSS property specifies the composite operation to use when multiple animations affect the same property simultaneously.
a2be0dde5d47fab7.translationZh: 动画组合 CSS 属性指定了当多个动画同时影响同一属性时使用的复合操作.

ccaad8750c369823.original: The animation-delay CSS property specifies the amount of time to wait from applying the animation to an element before beginning to perform the animation. The animation can start later, immediately from its beginning, or immediately and partway through the animation.
ccaad8750c369823.translationZh: 动画-延迟 CSS 属性指定了从动画应用到元素到开始进行动画之前的等待时间. 动画可以稍后开始,即刻开始,也可以立即和部分地通过动画.

78d2c4bf935a0d73.original: The animation-direction CSS property sets whether an animation should play forward, backward, or alternate back and forth between playing the sequence forward and backward.
78d2c4bf935a0d73.translationZh: 动画方向 CSS 属性设定动画是向前播放,向后播放,还是向后播放顺序之间交替播放.

70f12f293c804971.original: The animation-duration CSS property sets the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.
70f12f293c804971.translationZh: 动画持续时间CSS属性设定动画完成一个周期所需的时间长度.

ebefd5f4904de776.original: The animation-fill-mode CSS property sets how a CSS animation applies styles to its target before and after its execution.
ebefd5f4904de776.translationZh: 动画填充模式CSS属性设定了CSS动画在执行前后如何对其目标应用样式.

ee56bc8de16af3d7.original: The animation-iteration-count CSS property sets the number of times an animation sequence should be played before stopping.
ee56bc8de16af3d7.translationZh: 动画输入计数 CSS 属性在停止前设定一个动画序列应当播放的次数.

15db0432218d3632.original: The animation-name CSS property specifies the names of one or more @keyframes at-rules that describe the animation to apply to an element. Multiple @keyframes at-rules are specified as a comma-separated list of names. If the specified name does not match any @keyframes at-rule, no properties are animated.
15db0432218d3632.translationZh: 动画名称 CSS 属性指定一个或多个 @ keyframes at- rules 描述动画应用到元素的名称 。 多个@ keyframes at- rules 指定为逗号分隔名称列表 。 如果指定的名称与任何 @ keyframes at- rule 不符,则没有属性动画 。

1359533e5ee48556.original: The animation-play-state CSS property sets whether an animation is running or paused.
1359533e5ee48556.translationZh: 动画游戏状态 CSS 属性设置是动画正在运行还是暂停.

f46a23294b4ae4c4.original: The animation-range CSS shorthand property is used to set the start and end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e., where along the timeline an animation will start and end.
f46a23294b4ae4c4.translationZh: 动画范围CSS的短手属性用于设定动画附件范围的起始和结尾沿其时间段,即动画沿时间段开始和结束的位置.

b903de0139a42217.original: The animation-range-end CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should end.
b903de0139a42217.translationZh: 动画-距离端 CSS 属性设定了动画应该结束的时间点.

285727bc75c0625e.original: The animation-range-start CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should start.
285727bc75c0625e.translationZh: 动画的距离启动 CSS 属性设定了动画开始的时间点.

5f63b358b2096eb1.original: The animation-timeline CSS property specifies the timeline used to control the progress of a CSS animation.
5f63b358b2096eb1.translationZh: 动画时线CSS属性指定了用于控制CSS动画进度的时间段.

746a1061d5b3e568.original: The animation-timing-function CSS property sets how an animation progresses through the duration of each cycle.
746a1061d5b3e568.translationZh: 动画定时功能 CSS 属性设定了动画如何在每一周期的时间内取得进展.

77c505e7f41db1fa.original: The appearance CSS property specifies the rendered appearance of replaced UI widget elements such as form controls. Most commonly, such elements are given native, platform-specific styling based on the operating system's theme, or a primitive appearance with styles that can be overridden using CSS.
77c505e7f41db1fa.translationZh: 外观 CSS 属性指定了已替换的 UI 部件元素的外观, 如窗体控件 。 最常见的是,这些元素被赋予了基于操作系统主题的本土,平台特有的造型,或者一种原始的外观,其样式可以使用CSS来覆盖.

42e4d29617c37955.original: The aspect-ratio CSS property allows you to define the desired width-to-height ratio of an element's box.
42e4d29617c37955.translationZh: 侧面- ratio CSS 属性允许您定义元素框想要的宽度比高 。

246c47401d3bfd78.original: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element. Because it applies to everything behind the element, to see the effect the element or its background needs to be transparent or partially transparent.
246c47401d3bfd78.translationZh: 背景过滤 CSS 属性允许您应用图形效果, 如模糊或颜色转换到元素后面的区域 。 因为它适用于元素背后的一切,要看到该元素或其背景的效果需要透明或部分透明.

0f8ac8dc61835a5d.original: The backface-visibility CSS property sets whether the back face of an element is visible when turned towards the user.
0f8ac8dc61835a5d.translationZh: 背面可见 CSS 属性设定一个元素的背面在转向用户时是否可见.

c8cdde07a24612af.original: The background CSS shorthand property sets all background style properties at once, such as color, image, origin, size, and repeat method.
c8cdde07a24612af.translationZh: 背景 CSS 短手属性同时设置所有背景样式属性,如颜色,图像,来源,大小,以及重复方法.

888a4e88715e1741.original: The background-attachment CSS property sets whether a background image's position is fixed within the viewport, or scrolls with its containing block.
888a4e88715e1741.translationZh: 背景附图 CSS 属性设定一个背景图像的位置是固定在视图端口内,还是用其包含的块滚动.

0bd7aead73857192.original: The background-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's background images should blend with each other and with the element's background color.
0bd7aead73857192.translationZh: 背景-blend-mode CSS属性设定一个元素的背景图像应如何相互融合,并与元素的背景颜色融合.

480107d6707eebf7.original: The background-clip CSS property sets whether an element's background extends underneath its border box, padding box, or content box.
480107d6707eebf7.translationZh: 背景- clip CSS 属性设定一个元素的背景是否延伸到其边框、 垫框或内容框下面 。

5243fca664c53f7d.original: The background-color CSS property sets the background color of an element.
5243fca664c53f7d.translationZh: 背景颜色 CSS 属性设置元素的背景颜色 。

6708ab17c48cf9c0.original: The background-image CSS property sets one or more background images on an element.
6708ab17c48cf9c0.translationZh: 背景图像 CSS 属性在一个元素上设置一个或多个背景图像.

d27228358e04e297.original: The background-origin CSS property sets the background's origin: from the border start, inside the border, or inside the padding.
d27228358e04e297.translationZh: 起源于背景的CSS财产设定了背景的起源:从边界开始,在边界内,或者在地垫内.

8c02a5d5fa8ac1c4.original: The background-position CSS property sets the initial position for each background image.
8c02a5d5fa8ac1c4.translationZh: 背景位置 CSS 属性为每个背景图像设定初始位置.

451f7ced412bb555.translationZh: 背景位置- x 数据

39583a9b51e20ee1.original: The background-position-x CSS property sets the initial horizontal position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.
39583a9b51e20ee1.translationZh: 背景位置-x CSS 属性为每个背景图像设置初始水平位置. 该位置与背景起源设定的位置层相对.

e637ab9134b0d77b.original: The background-position-y CSS property sets the initial vertical position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.
e637ab9134b0d77b.translationZh: 背景位置-y CSS 属性为每个背景图像设置初始垂直位置. 该位置与背景起源设定的位置层相对.

dce1f42805e873da.original: The background-repeat CSS shorthand property sets how background images are repeated. A background image can be repeated along the horizontal and vertical axes, or not repeated at all.
dce1f42805e873da.translationZh: 背景复制 CSS 的短手属性设置背景图像如何重复 。 背景图像可以沿着水平轴和垂直轴重复,或者完全不重复.

2795b2512dca9810.original: The background-repeat-x CSS property sets how background images are repeated, or not, along the horizontal axis.
2795b2512dca9810.translationZh: 背景- repeat-x CSS 属性设定背景图像如何沿水平轴重复或不重复.

18e8351cbecfc47b.original: The background-repeat-y CSS property sets how background images are repeated, or not, along the vertical axis.
18e8351cbecfc47b.translationZh: 背景- repeat-y CSS 属性设定背景图像如何沿着垂直轴重复或不重复.

ebb57e501f08eec2.original: The background-size CSS property sets the size of the element's background image. The image can be left to its natural size, stretched, or constrained to fit the available space.
ebb57e501f08eec2.translationZh: 背景大小的 CSS 属性设定元素背景图像的大小. 图像可以留给它的自然大小,拉伸,或者被限制以适应可用的空间.

43ea516b69637f3c.original: The baseline-shift CSS property repositions the dominant-baseline of a text element relative to the dominant-baseline of its parent text content element. The shifted element might be a sub- or superscript. If the property is present, the value overrides the element's attribute.
43ea516b69637f3c.translationZh: 基线转换的CSS属性相对于其母文本内容要素的主导基线调整了文本要素的主导基线。 变换的元素可能是下标或上标. 如果属性存在,则值将超过元素的属性.

cddcc5e45be42aad.original: The baseline-source CSS property defines which baseline to use when inline-level boxes have multiple possible baselines, such as multi-line inline blocks or inline flex containers. The values allow for choosing between aligning to the box's first baseline, last baseline, or letting the browser decide automatically based on the box type.
cddcc5e45be42aad.translationZh: 基线源 CSS 属性定义了当内线级框有多个可能的基线时,如多线内块或内线弹性容器时使用的基线. 数值允许在与框的第一个基线,最后一个基线对齐或者让浏览器根据框类型自动决定之间作出选择.

b733d2032ace317e.original: The block-size CSS property defines the size of an element's block along the block axis. If the writing-mode is horizontal, it corresponds to the height; if the writing mode is vertical, it corresponds to the width. A related property is inline-size, which defines the other dimension of the element.
b733d2032ace317e.translationZh: 块大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块沿块轴的大小. 如果书写模式是水平的,则对应高度;如果书写模式是垂直的,则对应宽度. 一个相关的属性是内在大小,它定义了元素的另一方面.

4229df288396b019.original: The border CSS shorthand property sets an element's border. It sets the values of border-width, border-style, and border-color.
4229df288396b019.translationZh: 边界 CSS 短手属性设置元素的边界 。 它设定了边框宽度,边框风格和边框颜色的值.

3f5360521f45451b.original: The border-block CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical block border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
3f5360521f45451b.translationZh: 边框块 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑块边框属性值设置在样式表的单个位置.

1e00c805a7af8bd2.original: The border-block-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
1e00c805a7af8bd2.translationZh: 边框-color CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑块边框的颜色,根据元素的书写模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色和边框-下色,或边框-右色和边框-左色属性,这取决于为书写模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

5d2a25602bb23e64.original: The border-block-end CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical block-end border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
5d2a25602bb23e64.translationZh: 边框-区块-端 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑区块-端边框属性值设置在样式表的单个位置.

c78b8e92bdc16367.original: The border-block-end-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
c78b8e92bdc16367.translationZh: 边框-block-end-color CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-端边框的颜色,根据元素的书写模式,方向,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色,边框-右色,边框-下色,或边框-左色属性,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

5dba0663a25f5e3c.original: The border-block-end-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
5dba0663a25f5e3c.translationZh: 边框-block-end-style CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-端边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框样式. 它与边框-顶部风格,边框-右部风格,边框-下部风格,或边框-左部风格的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

1c9a11669945f340.original: The border-block-end-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
1c9a11669945f340.translationZh: 边框-block-end-width CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-端边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽,边框-右宽,边框-下宽,或边框-左宽的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

e2125aaabd848407.original: The border-block-start CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical block-start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
e2125aaabd848407.translationZh: 边框-块启动 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑块启动边框属性值设置在样式表的单个位置.

7eefa3e61c3b365c.original: The border-block-start-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
7eefa3e61c3b365c.translationZh: 边框-block-start-color CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-启动边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色,边框-右色,边框-下色,或边框-左色属性,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

5b46bf51930e7672.original: The border-block-start-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block start border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
5b46bf51930e7672.translationZh: 边框-block-start-style CSS属性定义了元素逻辑块起始边框的样式,根据元素的书写模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它与边框-顶部风格,边框-右部风格,边框-下部风格,或边框-左部风格的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

219417bf3eb3fdc3.translationZh: 边框- 块- 启动宽

f1f87e726f44c225.original: The border-block-start-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
f1f87e726f44c225.translationZh: 边框-block-start-width CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-启动边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽,边框-右宽,边框-下宽,或边框-左宽的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

85b429d0211987d4.original: The border-block-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
85b429d0211987d4.translationZh: 边框式的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框样式. 它对应边框-顶部风格和边框-底部风格,或边框-左部风格和边框-右部风格的属性,这取决于为写法模式、方向和文字定向定义的值。

1dd7288e5da01a65.original: The border-block-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
1dd7288e5da01a65.translationZh: 边框-block-width CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽和边框-下宽,或边框-左宽,以及边框-右宽属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向和文字导向定义的值.

6605d14cff82d7c4.original: The border-bottom CSS shorthand property sets an element's bottom border. It sets the values of border-bottom-width, border-bottom-style and border-bottom-color.
6605d14cff82d7c4.translationZh: 边框- 底部 CSS 短手属性设置元素的底部边框 。 它设定了边框-底宽,边框-底色和边框-底色的值.

4affad6216765aa3.original: The border-bottom-color CSS property sets the color of an element's bottom border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-bottom.
4affad6216765aa3.translationZh: 边框- 底色 CSS 属性设置元素底边框的颜色 。 也可以用短手的 CSS 属性边框颜色或边框底设置.

2dfb7e0291689f36.translationZh: 边框- 左下- 弧度

b19cc0a74a661262.original: The border-bottom-left-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
b19cc0a74a661262.translationZh: 边框-左下方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来包围元素的左下角.

ff29a77b45fa8cc9.original: The border-bottom-right-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
ff29a77b45fa8cc9.translationZh: 边框-下方右射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半大轴和半小轴的半径)来包围元素的下方右角.
