6c98fd8dfb2b80b1.original: The border-bottom-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's bottom border.
6c98fd8dfb2b80b1.translationZh: 边框- 底部风格 CSS 属性设置元素底边框的线条样式 。

14541c7322872dc0.original: The border-bottom-width CSS property sets the width of the bottom border of an element.
14541c7322872dc0.translationZh: 边框- 下宽 CSS 属性设置元素底边框的宽度 。

36abc7fec38db597.original: The border-collapse CSS property sets whether cells inside a table have shared or separate borders.
36abc7fec38db597.translationZh: 边框缩合 CSS 属性设置表内的单元格是共享还是单独的边框 。

f861f414ad93c3b6.original: The border-color CSS shorthand property sets the color of an element's border.
f861f414ad93c3b6.translationZh: 边框颜色 CSS 短手属性设置元素边框的颜色 。

5d5f301439dbee05.original: The border-end-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.
5d5f301439dbee05.translationZh: 边框-端辐射 CSS 属性定义了元素上的逻辑边框半径,该边框半径可映射到物理边框半径,这取决于元素的写法-模式,方向,以及文本导向. 这在构建样式以工作时是有用的,不管文字方向和写法模式如何.

f5d005bb3e39a3c9.translationZh: 边框 - 端端 - 启动 - 辐射

af999eeeeb3665e9.original: The border-end-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.
af999eeeeb3665e9.translationZh: 边框-end-start-radius CSS属性定义了元素上的逻辑边框半径,根据元素的写法模式,方向和文字导向,将边框映射到物理边框半径. 这在构建样式以工作时是有用的,不管文字方向和写法模式如何.

7bca522591e20dd4.original: The border-image CSS shorthand property draws an image around a given element. It replaces the element's regular border.
7bca522591e20dd4.translationZh: 边框图像 CSS 的短手属性围绕给定元素绘制图像. 它取代了元素的常规边框.

f2da586f146cfc1a.original: The border-image-outset CSS property sets the distance by which an element's border image is set out from its border box.
f2da586f146cfc1a.translationZh: 边框图像集 CSS 属性设定了元素边框图像的设置距离 。

530da478c869c470.original: The border-image-repeat CSS property defines how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. The middle region can be displayed by using the keyword "fill" in the border-image-slice property.
530da478c869c470.translationZh: 边框图像复制的 CSS 属性定义了边框图像的侧面和中间部分的图像如何缩放和平整. 中间区域可以通过边框-图像切片属性中的关键词"填充"来显示.

052ce3005b998cfc.original: The border-image-slice CSS property divides the image specified by border-image-source into regions. These regions form the components of an element's border image.
052ce3005b998cfc.translationZh: 边框-图像切片 CSS 属性将边框-图像源指定的图像划分为区域. 这些地区构成了元素边框图像的组成部分.

2262d231445c6e90.original: The border-image-source CSS property sets the source image used to create an element's border image.
2262d231445c6e90.translationZh: 边框-图像源 CSS 属性设置用于创建元素边框图像的源图像.

0217a55f95c919bc.original: The border-image-width CSS property sets the width of an element's border image.
0217a55f95c919bc.translationZh: 边框图像宽度 CSS 属性设置元素边框图像的宽度 。

aaed951e5c6af92f.original: The border-inline CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical inline border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
aaed951e5c6af92f.translationZh: 边框 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑内线边框属性值设置在样式表的单个位置.

52dfa1134e6eab7d.original: The border-inline-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
52dfa1134e6eab7d.translationZh: 边框-内线-彩色 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向,和文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色和边框-下色,或边框-右色和边框-左色属性,这取决于为书写模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

47b5c97a8d10c483.original: The border-inline-end CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical inline-end border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
47b5c97a8d10c483.translationZh: 边框-内端 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑内端边框属性值设置在样式表单位.

4c289176c4a4d695.original: The border-inline-end-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
4c289176c4a4d695.translationZh: 边框-inline-end-color CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内端边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色,边框-右色,边框-下色,或边框-左色属性,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

888c52361e495ab6.original: The border-inline-end-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline end border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
888c52361e495ab6.translationZh: 边框内端风格的 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑内端边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它与边框-顶部风格,边框-右部风格,边框-下部风格,或边框-左部风格的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

c07188c17b2fcc87.original: The border-inline-end-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
c07188c17b2fcc87.translationZh: 边框-端宽 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内端边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽,边框-右宽,边框-下宽,或边框-左宽的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

2e5a3a9ec28c0e75.original: The border-inline-start CSS shorthand property sets the individual logical inline-start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.
2e5a3a9ec28c0e75.translationZh: 边框-内启动 CSS 短手属性将单个逻辑内启动边框属性值设置在样式表的单个位置.

7b39383dcc94ea71.original: The border-inline-start-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline start border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
7b39383dcc94ea71.translationZh: 边框-inline-start-color CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线起始边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色,边框-右色,边框-下色,或边框-左色属性,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

586e3ba7c9327f23.original: The border-inline-start-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline start border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
586e3ba7c9327f23.translationZh: 边框-内线启动风格 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内线起始边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它与边框-顶部风格,边框-右部风格,边框-下部风格,或边框-左部风格的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

a6dc422802b5b4ba.original: The border-inline-start-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
a6dc422802b5b4ba.translationZh: 边框-inline-start-width CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线启动边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽,边框-右宽,边框-下宽,或边框-左宽的属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

6c152a3ce4f77d8e.original: The border-inline-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
6c152a3ce4f77d8e.translationZh: 边框式的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内线边框的样式,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边框样式. 它对应边框-顶部风格和边框-底部风格,或边框-左部风格和边框-右部风格的属性,这取决于为写法模式、方向和文字定向定义的值。

b2b60bebfeb4bc54.original: The border-inline-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
b2b60bebfeb4bc54.translationZh: 边框-内线宽度 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线边框的宽度,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框宽度. 它与边框-上宽和边框-下宽,或边框-左宽,以及边框-右宽属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向和文字导向定义的值.

444e63e47a32d05f.original: The border-left CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's left border.
444e63e47a32d05f.translationZh: 边框左侧 CSS 短手属性设置元素左侧边框的所有属性 。

0128144b996a1bdc.original: The border-left-color CSS property sets the color of an element's left border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-left.
0128144b996a1bdc.translationZh: 边框左色 CSS 属性设置元素左边框的颜色 。 也可以使用短手CSS属性边框颜色或边框左侧设置.

45f6139876c3f410.original: The border-left-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's left border.
45f6139876c3f410.translationZh: 边框左风格的 CSS 属性设置元素左边框的行样式 。

79b6609f5828c3e1.original: The border-left-width CSS property sets the width of the left border of an element.
79b6609f5828c3e1.translationZh: 边框- 左宽 CSS 属性设置元素左边框的宽度 。

662ee58b80a7a45f.original: The border-radius CSS shorthand property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge. You can set a single radius to make circular corners, or two radii to make elliptical corners.
662ee58b80a7a45f.translationZh: 边界辐射CSS的短手属性环绕元素外边边缘的角. 可以设定一个半径来制作圆角,也可以设定两个弧度来制作椭圆角.

e0242a5c9d5ac1b2.original: The border-right CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's right border.
e0242a5c9d5ac1b2.translationZh: 边框右侧 CSS 快捷属性设置元素右侧边框的所有属性 。

9f58fcfd4f8ffaa7.original: The border-right-color CSS property sets the color of an element's right border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-right.
9f58fcfd4f8ffaa7.translationZh: 边框右色 CSS 属性设置元素右边框的颜色 。 也可以使用短手CSS属性边框颜色或边框右侧设置.

b29d3f3722c5bcf5.original: The border-right-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's right border.
b29d3f3722c5bcf5.translationZh: 边框右侧风格的 CSS 属性设置元素右侧边框的线条样式.

c86a63a72038f0da.original: The border-right-width CSS property sets the width of the right border of an element.
c86a63a72038f0da.translationZh: 边框右宽 CSS 属性设置元素右边框的宽度 。

34ea1eed45ce64d5.original: The border-shape CSS property defines an element's border shape using basic-shape values.
34ea1eed45ce64d5.translationZh: 边框形状 CSS 属性使用基本形状值定义元素的边框形状.

be851537aeca0d36.original: The border-spacing CSS property sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in a table. This property applies only when border-collapse is separate.
be851537aeca0d36.translationZh: CSS 边框间隔属性将相邻单元格的边框之间的距离设置在一个表格中。 此属性仅在边界碰撞分离时适用 。

1a671a167e051227.original: The border-start-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.
1a671a167e051227.translationZh: 边框-启动端-radius属性定义了元素上的逻辑边框半径,根据元素的写法模式,方向,文字导向,将边框映射到物理边框半径. 这在构建样式以工作时是有用的,不管文字方向和写法模式如何.

f11cef749f623d3a.original: The border-start-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.
f11cef749f623d3a.translationZh: 边框-启动-radius CSS属性定义一个元素上的逻辑边框半径,这个边框半径可以映射到一个物理边框半径,这取决于元素的写法-模式,方向,以及文本导向. 这在构建样式以工作时是有用的,不管文字方向和写法模式如何.

4722424bc06b4bbe.original: The border-style CSS shorthand property sets the line style for all four sides of an element's border.
4722424bc06b4bbe.translationZh: 边框式的CSS短手属性为元素边框的所有四面设置线条样式.

2fad61e949743d42.original: The border-top CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's top border.
2fad61e949743d42.translationZh: 边框顶端 CSS 短手属性设置元素顶端边框的所有属性 。

4e2f590dc2039a79.original: The border-top-color CSS property sets the color of an element's top border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-top.
4e2f590dc2039a79.translationZh: 边框- 顶色 CSS 属性设置元素顶端边框的颜色 。 也可以用短手CSS属性边框颜色或边框顶端设置.

d080e2e746891e66.original: The border-top-left-radius CSS property rounds the top-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
d080e2e746891e66.translationZh: 边框-左上方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来包围一个元素的左上角.

d069330525b4def4.original: The border-top-right-radius CSS property rounds the top-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
d069330525b4def4.translationZh: 边框-右上方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来绕过一个元素的上方右角.

dbb27c604c42318d.original: The border-top-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's top border.
dbb27c604c42318d.translationZh: 边框-顶部风格的 CSS 属性设置元素顶端边框的线条样式.

a5f63a3a7c834e6b.original: The border-top-width CSS property sets the width of the top border of an element.
a5f63a3a7c834e6b.translationZh: 边框- 顶宽 CSS 属性设置元素顶端边框的宽度 。

5aaf8c4fdea377e7.original: The border-width CSS shorthand property sets the width of an element's border.
5aaf8c4fdea377e7.translationZh: 边框宽度的 CSS 快捷属性设置元素边框的宽度 。

84fb30a586b0ff5d.original: The bottom CSS property participates in setting the vertical position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
84fb30a586b0ff5d.translationZh: 底层 CSS 属性参与设置位置元素的垂直位置 。 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.

70ba8ca317bd02d6.original: The box-align CSS property specifies how an element aligns its contents across its layout in a perpendicular direction. The effect of the property is only visible if there is extra space in the box.
70ba8ca317bd02d6.translationZh: 框对齐的 CSS 属性指定一个元素如何按垂直方向在布局上调整其内容 。 只有在框内有额外空格时,属性的效果才会可见.

e2867ef7ee5c7781.original: The box-decoration-break CSS property specifies how an element's fragments should be rendered when broken across multiple lines, columns, or pages.
e2867ef7ee5c7781.translationZh: 框解码- 破解 CSS 属性指定了元素的碎片在突破多行、 列或页时应当如何渲染 。

e3ec8654dc756a48.original: The box-direction CSS property specifies whether a box lays out its contents normally (from the top or left edge), or in reverse (from the bottom or right edge).
e3ec8654dc756a48.translationZh: 框方向 CSS 属性指定一个框是正常地(从上边还是左边),还是反向地(从下边还是右边)列出其内容.

7bd7b2c467d36cdf.original: The -moz-box-flex and -webkit-box-flex CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box grows to fill the box that contains it, in the direction of the containing box's layout.
7bd7b2c467d36cdf.translationZh: -moz-box-flex和 -webkit-box-flex CSS 属性指定一个-moz-box或 -webkit-box是怎样生长来填充包含它的盒子的,在装箱的布局方向上.

0a5e7f3202a6a376.original: The box-flex-group CSS property assigns the flexbox's child elements to a flex group.
0a5e7f3202a6a376.translationZh: Box-flex-group CSS属性将flexbox的孩子元素分配到一个flex组.

1cabc0c4e9fea02d.original: The box-lines CSS property determines whether the box may have a single or multiple lines (rows for horizontally oriented boxes, columns for vertically oriented boxes).
1cabc0c4e9fea02d.translationZh: 框线 CSS 属性决定该框是单行还是多行(水平方向框的列,垂直方向框的列).

b510904bc6d79df6.original: The box-ordinal-group CSS property assigns the flexbox's child elements to an ordinal group.
b510904bc6d79df6.translationZh: 框-正则组 CSS 属性将flexbox的孩子元素分配到正则组中.

71220d0d7f82a69b.original: The box-orient CSS property sets whether an element lays out its contents horizontally or vertically.
71220d0d7f82a69b.translationZh: 框向 CSS 属性设定元素是横向还是纵向设置内容 。

f469412e521a1e2e.original: The -moz-box-pack and -webkit-box-pack CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box packs its contents in the direction of its layout. The effect of this is only visible if there is extra space in the box.
f469412e521a1e2e.translationZh: -moz-box-pack和-webkit-box-pack CSS 属性指定一个-moz-box或-webkit-box如何按其布局方向包装其内容. 只有在框内有额外空间时,才会看到这个效果.

08b8c9084562f622.original: The box-shadow CSS property adds shadow effects around an element's frame. You can set multiple effects separated by commas. A box shadow is described by X and Y offsets relative to the element, blur and spread radius, and color.
08b8c9084562f622.translationZh: 盒形阴影 CSS 属性在元素的框架周围添加阴影效果. 您可以设置以逗号分隔的多个效果 。 一个框阴影由X和Y相对元素的抵消来描述,模糊和分散半径,以及颜色.

7dd1abc75450935c.original: The box-sizing CSS property sets how the total width and height of an element is calculated.
7dd1abc75450935c.translationZh: 箱大小 CSS 属性设置一个元素的总宽度和高度的计算方式 。

4cd60683657ffbb2.original: The break-after CSS property sets how page, column, or region breaks should behave after a generated box. If there is no generated box, the property is ignored.
4cd60683657ffbb2.translationZh: CSS 属性的断开后设置了在生成的框之后的页面、列或区域断开应如何表现 。 如果没有生成框,则忽略属性 。

ee575b3aff095a05.original: The break-before CSS property sets how page, column, or region breaks should behave before a generated box. If there is no generated box, the property is ignored.
ee575b3aff095a05.translationZh: CSS 属性前的断开设置在生成的框之前的页面、列或区域断开应如何操作 。 如果没有生成框,则忽略属性 。

ecc231b773431e58.original: The break-inside CSS property sets how page, column, or region breaks should behave inside a generated box. If there is no generated box, the property is ignored.
ecc231b773431e58.translationZh: CSS 破损侧面属性设置了页面、列或区域破损在生成的框内应如何表现 。 如果没有生成框,则忽略属性 。

c63a2e4b29d75538.original: The caption-side CSS property puts the content of a table's caption on the specified side. The values are relative to the writing-mode of the table.
c63a2e4b29d75538.translationZh: 标题侧 CSS 属性将表格标题的内容放在指定的侧面 。 值是相对于表格的写法模式的.

225f91e2e633cb87.original: The caret CSS shorthand property sets the appearance and behavior of the insertion caret in a single declaration.
225f91e2e633cb87.translationZh: 护身符CSS的短手属性将插入护身符的外观和行为设置在单一的宣告中.

ff2e76592452cc4b.original: The caret-animation CSS property is used to enable or disable the blinking behavior of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.
ff2e76592452cc4b.translationZh: caret-animation CSS属性用于启用或禁用插入caret的闪烁行为,即可编辑元素中出现的可见标记,以表示下一个字符将插入或删除的地方.

93e5bad760159a4a.original: The caret-color CSS property sets the color of the insertion caret, sometimes referred to as the text input cursor. This is the visible marker appearing at the insertion point where the next character typed will be added or where the next character deleted will be removed.
93e5bad760159a4a.translationZh: caret-color CSS 属性设置了插入cet的颜色,有时被称为文本输入光标. 这是显示在插入点的可见标记,该插入点将输入下一个字符,或者删除下一个字符。

3a36b819529f71bf.original: The caret-shape CSS property sets the shape of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.
3a36b819529f71bf.translationZh: caret-shape CSS属性设置了插入caret的形状,即可编辑元素中出现的可见标记,以表示下一个字符将插入或删除的地方.

f02783be4364327c.original: The clear CSS property sets whether an element must be moved below (cleared) floating elements that precede it. The clear property applies to floating and non-floating elements.
f02783be4364327c.translationZh: 清晰的 CSS 属性设定一个元素是否必须移动到它之前的(已清除)浮动元素下面 。 清晰的财产适用于浮动和非浮动的元素.

9ed6e5eca7668105.original: The clip CSS property defines a visible portion of an element. The clip property applies only to absolutely positioned elements — that is, elements with position or position.
9ed6e5eca7668105.translationZh: 剪辑 CSS 属性定义元素的可见部分 。 剪辑属性仅适用于绝对位置元素——即具有位置或位置元素.

20ad0b789281587e.original: The clip-path CSS property creates a clipping region that sets what part of an element should be shown. Parts that are inside the region are shown, while those outside are hidden.
20ad0b789281587e.translationZh: 剪辑路径 CSS 属性会创建剪辑区域, 设定元素的哪一部分应该显示 。 区域内部的部分被显示,而外部的部分被隐藏.

cb43a5e5dba12854.original: The clip-rule CSS property determines, when parts of the path overlap other parts, which pixels in a mask's box are inside the clipping shape defined by a clip path and which are outside.
cb43a5e5dba12854.translationZh: 剪辑规则CSS属性决定,当路径部分与其他部分重叠时,面具盒中哪些像素在剪辑路径定义的剪辑形状内,哪些在外.

3eb195959fda866b.original: The color CSS property sets the foreground color value of an element's text and text decorations, and sets the currentColor value. currentColor may be used as an indirect value on other properties and is the default for other color properties, such as border-color.
3eb195959fda866b.translationZh: 色彩 CSS 属性设置元素文本和文本装饰的前景色值,并设置当前颜色值. 当前Color可能被用作其他属性的间接值,是其他色彩属性的默认值,例如边框-颜色.

a47aae74b919abf7.original: The color-interpolation CSS property is used in SVG to specify which color space to use for and SVG elements.
a47aae74b919abf7.translationZh: SVG中使用彩色插座CSS属性来指定用于和SVG元素的颜色空间.

73c2e6e5710ddbc3.original: The color-interpolation-filters CSS property specifies the color space for imaging operations performed via SVG filter effects. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides any value given in the element's attribute.
73c2e6e5710ddbc3.translationZh: 彩色插件-过滤器 CSS 属性指定了通过 SVG 滤波效果进行成像操作的色彩空间. 如果明确声明,CSS属性的值将超过元素属性中给出的任何值.

7f83b725c3e5ecdb.original: The color-scheme CSS property allows an element to indicate which color schemes it can comfortably be rendered in. User agents change the following aspects of the UI chrome to match the used color scheme:
7f83b725c3e5ecdb.translationZh: 色彩方案 CSS 属性允许一个元素来表示它可以舒适地提供哪些色彩方案. 用户代理更改UI染色体的以下方面,以匹配使用的颜色方案:

13e81b9c40a0e532.original: The column-count CSS property breaks an element's content into the specified number of columns.
13e81b9c40a0e532.translationZh: 列计 CSS 属性将元素内容分解为指定列数 。

cbc9671f666c8b54.original: The column-fill CSS property controls how an element's contents are balanced when broken into columns.
cbc9671f666c8b54.translationZh: 列填充 CSS 属性控制一个元素的内容在分解为列时如何平衡 。

2faa84955a0cdc09.original: The column-gap CSS property sets the size of the gap (Gutters) between an element's columns in multi-column, flexible box, and grid layouts.
2faa84955a0cdc09.translationZh: 列-gap CSS属性在多列,柔性框,以及网格布局中设置元素列之间的间隔(Gutters)大小.

9b9fa5894bf707d5.original: The column-height CSS property specifies the height of the columns in a CSS multi-column layout.
9b9fa5894bf707d5.translationZh: 列高的 CSS 属性在 CSS 多列布局中指定列高.

174d26ee7cf68616.original: The column-rule CSS shorthand property sets the width, style, and color of the lines drawn between columns in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
174d26ee7cf68616.translationZh: 列规则 CSS 短手属性设置多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列之间所绘制的线条的宽度,样式和颜色.

db43e14360c2f505.original: The column-rule-break CSS property sets the behavior for breaking column rules into segments wherever column rules intersect row gaps.
db43e14360c2f505.translationZh: 纵列规则断开的 CSS 属性将纵列规则断开的行为设置为纵列规则交叉行间隙的区段.

ac5998bffe978868.original: The column-rule-color CSS property defines the colors of the lines drawn between columns in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
ac5998bffe978868.translationZh: 列规则-颜色 CSS 属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列之间所绘制的线条的颜色.

04d42ef990dca81b.original: The column-rule-style CSS property defines the line style of the lines drawn between columns in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
04d42ef990dca81b.translationZh: 列规则式的CSS属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局的列之间的线条样式.

990dbbb71e5802cc.original: The column-rule-visibility-items CSS property defines whether a column-rule segment is painted in gaps adjacent to empty areas.
990dbbb71e5802cc.translationZh: 列-规则-可见项目 CSS 属性定义了列-规则段是否在与空区域相邻的空隙中绘制.

1562521076acdb95.original: The column-rule-width CSS property defines the widths of the lines drawn between columns in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
1562521076acdb95.translationZh: 列规则宽的 CSS 属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局的列之间的线条宽度.

f7aa6eb5a92d1e69.original: The column-span CSS property makes it possible for an element to span across all columns when its value is set to all.
f7aa6eb5a92d1e69.translationZh: 列宽的 CSS 属性使得一个元素在设定为全部值时可以跨过所有列.

08d4d8b958b44f88.original: The column-width CSS property sets the ideal column width in a multi-column layout. The container will have as many columns as can fit without any of them having a width less than the column-width value. If the width of the container is narrower than the specified value, the single column's width will be smaller than the declared column width.
08d4d8b958b44f88.translationZh: 列宽 CSS 属性以多列布局设置理想的列宽. 容器将尽量多的柱子,其中任何柱子的宽度都小于柱宽值。 如果容器的宽度小于指定的值,则单列的宽度将小于宣布的列宽.

a1f46cc35155219e.original: The column-wrap CSS property specifies the wrapping behavior of overflow columns in a CSS multi-column layout.
a1f46cc35155219e.translationZh: 列- wrap CSS 属性在 CSS 多列布局中指定了溢出列的包装行为 。

0097e29bd79e8b2f.original: The columns CSS shorthand property sets the maximum number of columns to use when drawing an element's contents, along with the minimum width and maximum height of the element's columns.
0097e29bd79e8b2f.translationZh: CSS 的短手属性设置了在绘制元素内容时使用的最大列数,以及元素列的最小宽度和最大高度.

aaa40854f1022051.original: The contain CSS property indicates that an element and its contents are, as much as possible, independent from the rest of the document tree. Containment enables isolating a subsection of the DOM, providing performance benefits by limiting calculations of layout, style, paint, size, or any combination to a DOM subtree rather than the entire page. Containment can also be used to scope CSS counters and quotes.
aaa40854f1022051.translationZh: 包含的 CSS 属性表明,一个元素及其内容尽可能独立于文档树的其他部分. 封装可以隔离DOM的一个小节,通过将布局,样式,油漆,大小或任何组合的计算限制在一个DOM子树上而不是整个页面,从而提供性能效益. 封装还可以用于范围CSS计数器和引文.

862f563d912868ec.original: The contain-intrinsic-block-size CSS logical property defines the block size of an element that a browser can use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
862f563d912868ec.translationZh: 内置-内置-块大小 CSS 逻辑属性定义了一个元素的块大小,当该元素受到大小封装时,浏览器可以用于布局.

723103e90acfc4a0.original: The contain-intrinsic-height CSS property sets the height of an element that a browser can use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
723103e90acfc4a0.translationZh: 内置-内置-高度 CSS 属性设置一个元素的高度,当该元素受大小封装时,浏览器可以用于布局.

3ef98f67dbcca608.original: The contain-intrinsic-inline-size CSS logical property defines the inline-size of an element that a browser can use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
3ef98f67dbcca608.translationZh: 内装-内装-内装大小 CSS 逻辑属性定义了一个元素的内装大小,当该元素受大小限制时,浏览器可以用于布局.

88cf51ac6826859a.original: The contain-intrinsic-size CSS shorthand property sets the size of an element that a browser will use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
88cf51ac6826859a.translationZh: 包含- intrinsic 大小 CSS 的短手属性设置一个元素的大小, 当该元素受大小封装时, 浏览器会用于布局 。

d695975362cb6ad0.original: The contain-intrinsic-width CSS property sets the width of an element that a browser will use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
d695975362cb6ad0.translationZh: 包含- intrinsic- width CSS 属性设置了一个元素的宽度, 当该元素受到大小封装时, 浏览器会用于布局 。

27f4da8303ba7981.original: The container shorthand CSS property establishes the element as a query container and specifies the name and type of the containment context used in a container query.
27f4da8303ba7981.translationZh: 集装箱短手CSS属性确定该元素为查询容器,并具体说明集装箱查询中使用的封装上下文的名称和类型.

d44d6d928e11a4a8.original: The container-name CSS property specifies a list of query container names used by the @container at-rule in a container query.
d44d6d928e11a4a8.translationZh: 容器名称 CSS 属性指定了 @ container at-rule 在容器查询中使用的查询容器名称列表 。

69ae6f6d16742d42.original: The container-type CSS property specifies the type of container context used in a container query.
69ae6f6d16742d42.translationZh: 集装箱类型的CSS属性规定了集装箱查询中使用的集装箱上下文类型。

268d4267a4f192c6.original: The content CSS property replaces content with a generated value. It can be used to define what is rendered inside an element or pseudo-element. For elements, the content property specifies whether the element renders normally (normal or none) or is replaced with an image (and associated "alt" text). For pseudo-elements and margin boxes, content defines the content as images, text, both, or none, which determines whether the element renders at all.
268d4267a4f192c6.translationZh: 内容 CSS 属性以生成值替换内容 。 它可用于定义在元素或伪元素内得到的东西. 对于元素,内容属性指定该元素是正常地(正常的还是没有的)还是被图像(以及相关的"alt"文本)所取代. 对于伪元素和边框,内容将内容定义为图像,文本,两者皆为,或无,决定元素是否完全成型.

0cf770353dd3a1f3.original: The content-visibility CSS property controls whether or not an element renders its contents at all, along with forcing a strong set of containments, allowing user agents to potentially omit large swathes of layout and rendering work until it becomes needed. It enables the user agent to skip an element's rendering work (including layout and painting) until it is needed — which makes the initial page load much faster.
0cf770353dd3a1f3.translationZh: 内容可见度CSS属性控制一个元素是否使其内容完全成型,同时强迫一组强大的封装,允许用户代理可能省略大片布局,并渲染工作直至需要. 它使得用户代理可以跳过元素的渲染工作(包括布局和绘画)直到需要它——这使得初始的页面加载速度要快得多.

caa78141fa7d70a8.translationZh: 角落- 街区- 端- 形状

4b5f3dddc4aa6b13.original: The corner-block-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's block-end edge, within their border-radius area.
4b5f3dddc4aa6b13.translationZh: 角-挡-端-形状 CSS 属性指定了两个角的形状,位于一个盒子的挡-端边缘,在它们的边界-射线区域内.

0e1b7932b7b0623b.original: The corner-block-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's block-start edge, within their border-radius area.
0e1b7932b7b0623b.translationZh: 角-块-启动-形状 CSS 属性指定了两个角的形状,位于一个盒子的块-启动边缘,在其边界-射线区域内.

50172e61bb46ddb8.original: The corner-bottom-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's bottom-left corner, within its border-radius area.
50172e61bb46ddb8.translationZh: 角-下-左-形状的 CSS 属性指定一个盒子的左下角的形状,在其边角区域之内.

a1b5677631d0d880.original: The corner-bottom-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's bottom-right corner, within its border-radius area.
a1b5677631d0d880.translationZh: 角-下-右-形状的 CSS 属性指定一个盒子的下-右角的形状,在其边界-射线区域内.

e63a0f693dbebd93.original: The corner-bottom-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's bottom edge, within their border-radius area.
e63a0f693dbebd93.translationZh: 角-下方-形状的 CSS 属性指定了两个角的形状,位于一个盒子的底边,在其边界-射线区域内.

947c6e98ef38661c.original: The corner-end-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-end and inline-end corner, within its border-radius area.
947c6e98ef38661c.translationZh: 角端-末端-形状的CSS属性在其边界-射线区域内指定一个盒子的挡端和内端角的形状.

dafeb72440c4ff80.original: The corner-end-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-end and inline-start corner, within its border-radius area.
dafeb72440c4ff80.translationZh: 角-端-启动-形状 CSS 属性在其边界-射线区域内指定一个盒子的块-端和内侧启动角的形状.

0b67ed7619265f2b.original: The corner-inline-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's inline-end edge, within their border-radius area.
0b67ed7619265f2b.translationZh: 角-内端-端-形状 CSS 属性指定了盒子内端边缘上两个角的形状,在其边界-射线区域内.

4d10cddcaec02dcd.original: The corner-inline-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's inline-start edge, within their border-radius area.
4d10cddcaec02dcd.translationZh: 角-内线启动-形状 CSS 属性指定了两个角的形状,位于盒子的内线启动边缘,在其边界-射线区域内.

84cac0cfa1bea824.original: The corner-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's left-hand edge, within their border-radius area.
84cac0cfa1bea824.translationZh: 左角形状的 CSS 属性指定了两个角的形状,在盒子的左手边,在它们的边界-射线范围内.

5de23f504d8bf301.original: The corner-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's right-hand edge, within their border-radius area.
5de23f504d8bf301.translationZh: 角-右形状的CSS财产在其边界射线区域内,指定了盒子右侧边缘两个角的形状.

02eff1dae5ede50e.original: The corner-shape CSS shorthand property specifies the shape of a box's corners, within the area specified by its border-radius property value.
02eff1dae5ede50e.translationZh: 角形状的 CSS 短手属性指定一个盒子角的形状,在它的边界辐射属性值指定的区域内.

c07c3f0776abd662.original: The corner-start-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-start and inline-end corner, within its border-radius area.
c07c3f0776abd662.translationZh: 角-启动-端-形状 CSS 属性在其边界-辐射区域内指定一个盒子的块-启动和内端角的形状.

87bd51db3e920d89.original: The corner-start-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-start and inline-start corner, within its border-radius area.
87bd51db3e920d89.translationZh: 角启动-启动-形状 CSS 属性在其边界-射线区域内指定一个盒子的块启动和内线启动角的形状.

95e1c47e1c0b72d4.original: The corner-top-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's top-left corner, within its border-radius area.
95e1c47e1c0b72d4.translationZh: 左上角形状的 CSS 属性指定了一个盒子左上角的形状,在它的边角区域内.

29b418b29610e912.original: The corner-top-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's top-right corner, within its border-radius area.
29b418b29610e912.translationZh: 角-上-右-外形的CSS地产在它的边界-射线区域内,指定了一个盒子的顶-右角的形状.

8dfac497cedf0165.original: The corner-top-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's top edge, within their border-radius area.
8dfac497cedf0165.translationZh: 角-顶-形状的CSS属性在盒子的顶端边缘,其边界-射线区域内,指定了两个角的形状.

d6cc7de8dd4f279a.original: The counter-increment CSS property can be used to increase or decrease the value of the named CSS counters by the specified values, or to prevent all counters or an individual counter's value from being changed.
d6cc7de8dd4f279a.translationZh: 反递增的CSS属性可以用来通过指定值来增加或减少命名的CSS计数器的值,也可以用来防止所有计数器或个人计数器的值被改变.

bccb9242777af845.original: The counter-reset CSS property creates named CSS counters and initializes them to a specific value. It supports creating counters that count up from one to the number of elements, as well as those that count down from the number of elements to one.
bccb9242777af845.translationZh: 反重置的CSS属性创建了命名为CSS的计数器并初始化为特定值. 它支持创建从一个数到数的计数器,以及从一个数到数的计数器.

980fef09f06e818e.original: The counter-set CSS property sets CSS counters on the element to the given values.
980fef09f06e818e.translationZh: 反设 CSS 属性设置 CSS 在元素到给定值上的计数器.

e6adff8128e7e166.original: The cursor CSS property sets the mouse cursor, if any, to show when the mouse pointer is over an element.
e6adff8128e7e166.translationZh: 光标 CSS 属性设置鼠标光标(如果有的话),以显示鼠标指针在元素之上的时间 。

7ffb87c21bc2e72c.original: The cx CSS property defines the x-axis center point of an SVG or element. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
7ffb87c21bc2e72c.translationZh: cx CSS 属性定义了 SVG 或元素的x轴中心点. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

90ca371d9ba9ebb5.original: The cy CSS property defines the y-axis center point of an SVG or elements. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
90ca371d9ba9ebb5.translationZh: cy CSS属性定义了 SVG 或元素的y轴中心点. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

01de4f75798446aa.original: The d CSS property defines a path to be drawn by the SVG element. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
01de4f75798446aa.translationZh: d CSS 属性定义了由 SVG 元素绘制的路径 。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

d8f9eda32f6d740a.original: The direction CSS property sets the direction of text, table and grid columns, and horizontal overflow. Use rtl for languages written from right to left (like Hebrew or Arabic), and ltr for those written from left to right (like English and most other languages).
d8f9eda32f6d740a.translationZh: CSS 属性的方向设定了文本、表格和网格列的方向以及水平溢出。 对从右到左写语言(如希伯来语或阿拉伯语)使用rtl,对从左到右写语言(如英语和大多数其他语言)使用ltr.

23b14f91f05db77b.original: The display CSS property sets whether an element is treated as a block or inline box and the layout used for its children, such as flow layout, grid or flex.
23b14f91f05db77b.translationZh: 显示 CSS 属性设置一个元素是被作为块还是内框处理,以及用于其子的布局,如流布局,网格还是弹性.

07b81f5f313a039d.original: The dominant-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. It also indicates the default alignment baseline of any boxes participating in baseline alignment in the box's alignment context. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
07b81f5f313a039d.translationZh: 主流基线 CSS 属性指定了用于对齐框文本和内含级内容的具体基线。 它还表示在框的对齐上下文中参加基线对齐的任何框的默认对齐基线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.

33becd0543f8a052.original: The dynamic-range-limit CSS property specifies the maximum luminance allowed for High Dynamic Range (HDR) content.
33becd0543f8a052.translationZh: 动态范围限制CSS属性规定了允许高动态范围内容的最大亮度.

a5dede34973828bc.original: The empty-cells CSS property sets whether borders and backgrounds appear around table cells that have no visible content.
a5dede34973828bc.translationZh: 空单元格 CSS 属性设定是否在表格单元格周围出现没有可见内容的边框和背景 。

c823510d4a9064ef.original: The field-sizing CSS property enables you to control the sizing behavior of elements that are given a default preferred size, such as form control elements. This property enables you to override the default sizing behavior, allowing form controls to adjust in size to fit their contents.
c823510d4a9064ef.translationZh: 字段缩放的 CSS 属性使您能够控制给定默认首选大小的元素的缩放行为,例如窗体控制元素. 此属性使您能够覆盖默认的大小行为, 允许格式控制调整大小以适应其内容 。

e367fc3dd3c05044.original: The fill CSS property defines how SVG text content and the interior canvas of SVG shapes are filled or painted. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
e367fc3dd3c05044.translationZh: 填充 CSS 属性定义了 SVG 文本内容和 SVG 形状的内部画布是如何填充或绘画的. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

cc9120f7cab963fc.original: The fill-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of the painting operation (color, gradient, pattern, etc.) applied to SVG shapes or text content elements to fill the element. The property defines the opacity of the element's fill only; it does not affect the stroke. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
cc9120f7cab963fc.translationZh: Full-opacity CSS属性定义了用于SVG形状或文本内容元素以填充元素的绘画操作的不透明性(颜色,梯度,图案等). 属性只定义元素填充的不透明度;不影响中风. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

0a451b04b678fa51.original: The fill-rule CSS property defines the rule used to determine which parts of the SVG shape's canvas are included inside a shape to be filled. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
0a451b04b678fa51.translationZh: 填充规则CSS属性定义了用于确定SVG形状画布中哪些部分包含在待填充的形状内的规则. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

b1060ddc4c6133a1.original: The filter CSS property applies graphical effects like blur or color shift to an element. Filters are commonly used to adjust the rendering of images, backgrounds, and borders.
b1060ddc4c6133a1.translationZh: 滤波器 CSS 属性将模糊或色移等图形效果应用到元素上. 过滤器通常用于调整图像的渲染,背景,和边框.

a0f7af8cdb97263b.original: The flex CSS shorthand property sets how a flex item will grow or shrink to fit the space available in its flex container.
a0f7af8cdb97263b.translationZh: 弹性CSS短手属性设定一个弹性项将如何生长或缩小,以适应其弹性容器中的空间。

2e484f0f018b3d2d.original: The flex-basis CSS property sets the initial main size of a flex item. It sets the size of the content box unless otherwise set with box-sizing.
2e484f0f018b3d2d.translationZh: 弹性基底CSS属性设定了弹性项的初始主大小. 它设定了内容框的大小,除非另用框大小设定.

2457771f284e4b56.original: The flex-direction CSS property sets how flex items are placed in the flex container defining the main axis and the direction (normal or reversed).
2457771f284e4b56.translationZh: 弹性定向CSS属性设定如何将弹性项目放置在界定主轴和方向(正常或倒转)的弹性容器中.

8fd14a4200c8ca03.original: The flex-flow CSS shorthand property specifies the direction of a flex container, as well as its wrapping behavior.
8fd14a4200c8ca03.translationZh: 弹性流CSS的短手属性指定了弹性容器的方向及其包装行为.

f5fefe6d3a5df457.original: The flex-grow CSS property sets the flex grow factor, which specifies how much of the flex container's positive free space, if any, should be assigned to the flex item's main size.
f5fefe6d3a5df457.translationZh: 弹性成形的 CSS 属性设置了弹性成形因子,该因子指定了弹性容器正自由空间的多少(如果有的话)应该分配给弹性项目的主要大小.

90ceb2e51623a49c.original: The flex-line-count CSS property sets the minimum number of flex lines that flex items will be balanced over in cases where a flex container's flex-wrap or flex-flow property includes the balance keyword.
90ceb2e51623a49c.translationZh: 在弹性容器的弹性包装或弹性流动财产包括余额关键词的情况下,灵活组合项目的最低灵活组合项目数目将予以平衡。

e193b137800b1733.original: The flex-shrink CSS property sets the flex shrink factor of a flex item. If the size of all flex items is larger than the flex container, the flex items can shrink to fit according to their flex-shrink value. Each flex line's negative free space is distributed between the line's flex items that have a flex-shrink value greater than 0.
e193b137800b1733.translationZh: 弹性收缩 CSS 属性设置弹性项的弹性收缩系数. 如果所有弹性物品的大小大于弹性容器,弹性物品可以根据其弹性收缩值收缩以适应. 每条弹性线的负自由空格在线的弹性项之间分布,弹性收缩值大于0.

499b108ab8695c04.original: The flex-wrap CSS property sets whether flex items are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines. If wrapping is allowed, it sets the direction that lines are stacked.
499b108ab8695c04.translationZh: 弹性包装 CSS 属性设定是将弹性项目强制放在一条线上还是可以包裹到多条线上。 如果允许包装,它会设定线条堆叠的方向.

efedae6cf96b3186.original: The float CSS property places an element on the left or right side of its container, allowing text and inline elements to wrap around it. The element is removed from the normal flow of the page, though still remaining a part of the flow (in contrast to absolute positioning).
efedae6cf96b3186.translationZh: 浮式CSS属性在其容器的左侧或右侧放置一个元素,使文本和内线元素可以包围它. 该元素从页面的正常流量中去除,尽管仍然是流量的一部分(相对于绝对定位).

10cdd3c2893a609c.original: The flood-color CSS property defines the color of the current filter primitive subregion in and elements within a . If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
10cdd3c2893a609c.translationZh: 洪水彩色 CSS 属性定义了当前过滤器原始分区的颜色和其中的元素。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

6f166c6be94322b5.original: The flood-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of the current filter primitive subregion in and elements within a . If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
6f166c6be94322b5.translationZh: 洪水- Opacity CSS 属性定义了当前过滤器原始分区在 a 中的不透明度以及元素在 a 中的不透明度. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

87b3695f730ce398.original: The font CSS shorthand property sets all the different properties of an element's font. Alternatively, it sets an element's font to a system font.
87b3695f730ce398.translationZh: 字体 CSS 短手属性设置元素字体的所有不同属性 。 或者,它将元素的字体设置为系统字体.

41a941b285ae116b.original: The font-family CSS property specifies a prioritized list of one or more font family names and/or generic family names for the selected element.
41a941b285ae116b.translationZh: 字体家庭 CSS 属性为选定元素指定了一个或多个字体姓氏和(或)通用姓氏的优先列表.

50b744ff5b90ea34.original: The font-feature-settings CSS property controls advanced typographic features in OpenType fonts.
50b744ff5b90ea34.translationZh: 字体版面设置 CSS 属性控制 OpenType 字体中的高级打字功能.

4330a233c6f9481b.original: The font-kerning CSS property sets the use of the kerning information stored in a font.
4330a233c6f9481b.translationZh: 字体刻录的 CSS 属性设置使用存储在字体中的刻录信息 。

ec97a3adceb5da6a.original: The font-language-override CSS property controls the use of language-specific glyphs in a typeface.
ec97a3adceb5da6a.translationZh: 字体语言覆盖 CSS 属性控制在类型面中使用语言特定格言.

5e21a00dd332201c.original: The font-optical-sizing CSS property sets whether text rendering is optimized for viewing at different sizes.
5e21a00dd332201c.translationZh: 字体-光学-尺寸 CSS 属性设置是否优化文本渲染,用于不同大小的视图.

f92c7fa4da6103b6.original: The font-palette CSS property allows specifying one of the many palettes contained in a color font that a user agent may use for the font. Users can also override the values in a palette or create a new palette by using the @font-palette-values at-rule.
f92c7fa4da6103b6.translationZh: 字体-palette CSS 属性允许指定一个用户代理用于字体的颜色字体中包含的许多调色板之一. 用户也可以通过使用@font-palette-values at-rule来覆盖调色板中的值或创建新的调色板.

252165743bc19bde.original: The font-size CSS property sets the size of the font. Changing the font size also updates the sizes of the font size-relative <length> units, such as em, ex, and so forth.
252165743bc19bde.translationZh: 字体大小的 CSS 属性设置字体大小. 更改字体大小也会更新字体大小相对的<长度>单位的大小,如em,ex等.

9164785d1ddf744b.original: The font-size-adjust CSS property adjusts the size of a font to match a chosen font metric, such as the height of lowercase letters, to a specified proportion of the font-size. This property is intended for adjusting fallback fonts to have similar metrics as the first-choice font.
9164785d1ddf744b.translationZh: 字体大小- adjust CSS 属性调整字体大小, 以匹配一个选定的字体度量, 如小写字母的高度, 以指定字体大小的比例 。 此属性用于调整倒置字体,使其具有与首选字体相似的度量.

6d132b472c47c30e.original: The font-smooth CSS property controls the application of anti-aliasing when fonts are rendered.
6d132b472c47c30e.translationZh: 字体模糊的 CSS 属性控制在字体渲染时应用反异名.

2a9c40e699c179dd.original: The font-stretch CSS property selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font.
2a9c40e699c179dd.translationZh: 字体字符串 CSS 属性从字体中选择一个普通的,缩合的,或扩展的面部.

b6076e425f5c5dec.original: The font-style CSS property sets whether a font should be styled with a normal, italic, or oblique face from its font-family.
b6076e425f5c5dec.translationZh: 字体风格的 CSS 属性设定一个字体是应该用普通的,斜体的,还是用其字体家族的斜面的.

45d6072f1956b493.original: The font-synthesis CSS shorthand property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold, italic, small-caps, and/or subscript and superscript typefaces when they are missing in the specified font-family.
45d6072f1956b493.translationZh: 字体合成 CSS 的短手属性允许您指定浏览器在指定字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成粗体,斜体,小盖,和/或下标和上标类型面.

a872818249ae8320.original: The font-synthesis-position CSS property lets you specify whether or not a browser may synthesize the subscript and superscript "position" typefaces when they are missing in a font family, while using font-variant-position to set the positions.
a872818249ae8320.translationZh: 字体合成-位置 CSS 属性允许您指定浏览器在字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成下标和上标的"位置"类型面,同时使用字体变量位置来设置位置.

1a89045fe5042bc8.original: The font-synthesis-small-caps CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize small-caps typeface when it is missing in a font family. Small-caps glyphs typically use the form of uppercase letters but are reduced to the size of lowercase letters.
1a89045fe5042bc8.translationZh: 字体合成-小盖 CSS 属性允许您指定浏览器在字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成小盖类型面 。 小盖盖一般使用大写字母的形式,但缩小为小写字母的大小.

b1d6568598309ebe.original: The font-synthesis-style CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the oblique typeface when it is missing in a font family.
b1d6568598309ebe.translationZh: 字体合成风格的 CSS 属性允许您指定浏览器在字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成斜面类型 。

c8d426bae7a2e800.original: The font-synthesis-weight CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold typeface when it is missing in a font family.
c8d426bae7a2e800.translationZh: 字体合成-重量 CSS 属性允许您指定浏览器在字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成粗体字面 。

80e9a9a375e4e910.original: The font-variant CSS shorthand property allows you to set all the font variants for a font.
80e9a9a375e4e910.translationZh: 字体变量 CSS 的短手属性允许您为字体设置所有字体变体 。

2886380392b009a2.original: The font-variant-alternates CSS property controls the usage of alternate glyphs. These alternate glyphs may be referenced by alternative names defined in @font-feature-values.
2886380392b009a2.translationZh: 字体变异的 CSS 属性控制替代格言的使用. 这些备选格言可以用在@font-feature-values中定义的替代名称来引用 。

8fae44d30b34a12b.original: The font-variant-caps CSS property controls the use of alternate glyphs used for small or petite capitals or for titling.
8fae44d30b34a12b.translationZh: CSS 属性的字体变式控制用于小首都或小首都或产权的替代格莱弗。

b0154407c09a0c6b.translationZh: 字体变量 - 东- 西安

62e089cde61ed22f.original: The font-variant-east-asian CSS property controls the use of alternate glyphs for East Asian scripts, like Japanese and Chinese.
62e089cde61ed22f.translationZh: 字体变异-东-西安 CSS 属性控制东亚脚本使用替代格言,如日语和汉语.

416f364dd123ff14.original: The font-variant-emoji CSS property specifies the default presentation style for displaying emojis.
416f364dd123ff14.translationZh: 字体变异-emoji CSS属性指定了显示emojis的默认演示风格.

7c7bf764ae832ca5.original: The font-variant-ligatures CSS property controls which ligature and contextual forms are used in the textual content of the elements it applies to. This leads to more harmonized forms in the resulting text.
7c7bf764ae832ca5.translationZh: CSS 属性控件,在它所应用的元素的文字内容中,使用绑定形式和上下文形式。 这导致由此产生的案文形式更加统一。

4b99618c1ae525d5.original: The font-variant-numeric CSS property controls the usage of alternate glyphs for numbers, fractions, and ordinal markers.
4b99618c1ae525d5.translationZh: 字体-变量-数字 CSS 属性控制对数字,分数和正数标记使用替代格法.

8826fd273bf20732.original: The font-variant-position CSS property controls the use of alternate, smaller glyphs that are positioned as superscript or subscript.
8826fd273bf20732.translationZh: 字体变位 CSS 属性控制使用定位为上标或下标的替代,较小的格子.

2523d4033881a739.original: The font-variation-settings CSS property provides low-level control over variable font characteristics by letting you specify the four letter axis names of the characteristics you want to vary along with their values.
2523d4033881a739.translationZh: 字体变异设置 CSS 属性通过让您指定您想要随其值变化的特性的四个字母轴名称,为可变字体特性提供低级控制.

6072693a58198023.original: The font-weight CSS property sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. The weights available depend on the font-family that is currently set.
6072693a58198023.translationZh: 字体加权的CSS属性设置字体的权重(或粗体). 可用的权重取决于当前设置的字体家族.

d727424783d35789.original: The font-width CSS property selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font.
d727424783d35789.translationZh: 字体宽的 CSS 属性从字体中选择一个普通的,缩合的,或扩展的面部.

fde38c859e5ac72a.translationZh: 强迫 - 颜色 - 规范

aec14ca981318462.original: The forced-color-adjust CSS property allows authors to opt certain elements out of forced colors mode. This then restores the control of those values to CSS.
aec14ca981318462.translationZh: 强制色彩- adjust CSS 属性允许作者从强制色彩模式中选择某些元素. 然后将这些值的控制恢复到CSS.

18d79f721acb2fd4.original: The frame-sizing CSS property can be used to set an iframe element's horizontal or vertical size to equal the layout size of its embedded document in the same dimension, but only if the embedded document has opted in to sharing its size information.
18d79f721acb2fd4.translationZh: 帧大小的 CSS 属性可以用来设定一个iframe元素的横向或纵向大小,以等同其嵌入式文档在同一维度的布局大小,但只有当嵌入式文档选择了共享其大小信息时.

c266033ea914ad29.original: The gap CSS shorthand property sets the gaps (also called gutters) between rows and columns on multi-column, flex, and grid containers.
c266033ea914ad29.translationZh: CSS的短手属性在多栏,弹性和网格容器上设置行与列之间的间隙(也称为沟槽).

ee10ddb4e21168f1.original: The grid CSS shorthand property sets all of the explicit and implicit grid properties in a single declaration.
ee10ddb4e21168f1.translationZh: 网格CSS的短手属性将全部的明示和隐含网格属性设置在单一的声明中.

62bc86d8a6d63e0a.original: The grid-area CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the edges of its grid areas.
62bc86d8a6d63e0a.translationZh: 网格区 CSS 的短手属性通过贡献一条线,一个跨,或无(自动)于其网格位置来指定网格项目在一个网格内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的边缘.

7d07cce96b530148.original: The grid-auto-columns CSS property specifies the size of an implicitly-created grid column grid tracks or pattern of tracks.
7d07cce96b530148.translationZh: 网格-自动列 CSS 属性指定了默认创建的网格列网格轨迹或轨迹图案的大小.

87dc943e91ca533d.original: The grid-auto-flow CSS property controls how the auto-placement algorithm works, specifying exactly how auto-placed items get flowed into the grid.
87dc943e91ca533d.translationZh: 网格-自动流 CSS 属性控制自动放置算法的运作方式,具体指明自动放置的项目如何流入网格.

687c777b262459ea.original: The grid-auto-rows CSS property specifies the size of an implicitly-created grid row grid tracks or pattern of tracks.
687c777b262459ea.translationZh: 网格-自动行 CSS 属性指定默认创建的网格行网格轨迹或轨迹图案的大小.

a05570d8ef8ab8e4.original: The grid-column CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start and inline-end edge of its grid areas.
a05570d8ef8ab8e4.translationZh: 网格柱 CSS 的短手属性通过贡献一条线,一个跨,或任何(自动)到其网格位置来指定网格项在网格列内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的内启动和内端边缘.

34ac9fbf84284097.original: The grid-column-end CSS property specifies a grid item's end position within the grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the block-end edge of its grid areas.
34ac9fbf84284097.translationZh: 网格柱-端CSS属性通过将其网格位置贡献一个线,一个跨,或无(自动)来指定网格项目在网格柱内的端位置,从而指定其网格区域的块端边缘.

b8e61aea0d7e9732.original: The grid-column-start CSS property specifies a grid item's start position within the grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement. This start position defines the block-start edge of the grid areas.
b8e61aea0d7e9732.translationZh: 网格柱启动 CSS 属性指定网格项在网格柱内的起始位置,方法是贡献一条线,一个跨度,或者在其网格位置上没有任何(自动). 此起始位置定义了网格区域的块启动边缘.

9315bab3877734c1.original: The grid-row CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start and inline-end edge of its grid areas.
9315bab3877734c1.translationZh: 网格行 CSS 的短手属性通过给其网格位置贡献一条线,一个跨,或一无所有(自动)来指定网格项目在网格行内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的内始和内端边缘.

66f589744bd12b23.original: The grid-row-end CSS property specifies a grid item's end position within the grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-end edge of its grid areas.
66f589744bd12b23.translationZh: 网格浏览端 CSS 属性通过给其网格位置贡献一条线,一个跨度,或无(自动)来指定网格项目在网格行内的端位置,从而指定其网格区域的内端边缘.

4a082799278ab18f.original: The grid-row-start CSS property specifies a grid item's start position within the grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start edge of its grid areas.
4a082799278ab18f.translationZh: 网格启动的 CSS 属性指定网格项目在网格行内的起始位置,方法是为它的网格位置贡献一条线,一个横跨,或者什么(自动),从而指定其网格区域的内线启动边缘.

e76d1ba6e915d8b4.original: The grid-template CSS shorthand property specifies the grid column, gridrow, and grid areas.
e76d1ba6e915d8b4.translationZh: 网格模板 CSS 的短手属性指定了网格列,网格,和网格区域.

d90b104fa6cf50ae.original: The grid-template-areas CSS property specifies named grid areas, establishing the cells in the grid and assigning them names.
d90b104fa6cf50ae.translationZh: CSS属性指定了命名的网格区域,在网格中建立单元格并指定其名称。

b8b0fccb699cb396.original: The grid-template-columns CSS property defines the line names and track sizing functions of the grid column.
b8b0fccb699cb396.translationZh: 网格-模板-列 CSS 属性定义了网格列的行名和跟踪大小函数.

67cecd15d952e93a.original: The grid-template-rows CSS property defines the line names and track sizing functions of the gridrow.
67cecd15d952e93a.translationZh: 网格-template-rows CSS属性定义了网格的行名和跟踪大小函数.

e5e8cff5e771c58b.original: The hanging-punctuation CSS property specifies whether a punctuation mark should hang at the start or end of a line of text. Hanging punctuation may be placed outside the line box.
e5e8cff5e771c58b.translationZh: CSS 的挂号属性指定了在文本行的起始或结尾处应当挂号。 悬浮标注可置于线框外.

d0fff16a097884d3.original: The height CSS property specifies the height of an element. By default, the property defines the height of the content area. If box-sizing is set to border-box, however, it instead determines the height of the border area.
d0fff16a097884d3.translationZh: 高度 CSS 属性指定元素的高度 。 默认情况下,属性定义了内容区域的高度. 然而,如果将框大小设定为边框,则它决定了边框区域的高度。

2e4c9bdacc799f70.original: The hyphenate-character CSS property sets the character (or string) used at the end of a line before a hyphenation break.
2e4c9bdacc799f70.translationZh: 连字符特征 CSS 属性在连字符断开前设置一行末尾所使用的字符(或字符串).

c8b190ef8f9bbbdc.original: The hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property specifies the minimum word length to allow hyphenation of words as well as the minimum number of characters before and after the hyphen.
c8b190ef8f9bbbdc.translationZh: 连字符限制-chars CSS 属性指定最小的字长,以允许单词的连字符,以及连字符前后的最小字符数.

b7e5a3132a7d09c4.original: The hyphens CSS property specifies how words should be hyphenated when text wraps across multiple lines.
b7e5a3132a7d09c4.translationZh: 连字符 CSS 属性指定在文本横跨多行时应如何用连字符表示单词.

a5a954b0f0599558.original: The image-orientation CSS property specifies a layout-independent correction to the orientation of an image.
a5a954b0f0599558.translationZh: 图像定向 CSS 属性指定了对图像定向的布局独立校正.

db26273ab8fdcf28.original: The image-rendering CSS property sets an image scaling algorithm. The property applies to an element itself, to any images set in its other properties, and to its descendants.
db26273ab8fdcf28.translationZh: 图像还原CSS属性设置了图像缩放算法. 财产适用于某一要素本身、其其他财产中的任何图像及其后代。

8c827cceb3ec3e68.original: The image-resolution CSS property specifies the intrinsic resolution of all raster images used in or on the element. It affects content images such as replaced elements and generated content, and decorative images such as background-image images.
8c827cceb3ec3e68.translationZh: 图像分辨率 CSS 属性指定了元素中或元素上使用的所有光栅图像的内在分辨率. 它影响内容图像,如替换元素和生成的内容,以及背景图像等装饰图像.

6b4aa985b7947ddd.original: The initial-letter CSS property sets the size and sink for dropped, raised, and sunken initial letters. This property applies to ::first-letter pseudo-elements and inline-level first children of block containers.
6b4aa985b7947ddd.translationZh: 初始字母 CSS 属性设置大小和沉积,用于抛放,提升和沉没的初始字母. 该财产适用于区块容器的首字母伪内容和内置一级儿童。

518e52ddf7d7563b.original: The inline-size CSS property defines the size of an element's block along the inline axis. If the writing-mode is horizontal, it corresponds to the width; if the writing mode is vertical, it corresponds to the height. A related property is block-size, which defines the other dimension of the element.
518e52ddf7d7563b.translationZh: 内置大小的 CSS 属性定义了元素块沿内置轴的大小. 如果书写模式是水平的,则对应宽度;如果书写模式是垂直的,则对应高度. 一个相关的属性是块大小,它定义了元素的另一个维度.

f65f201cea073f97.original: The inset CSS shorthand property corresponds to the top, right, bottom, and/or left properties. It has the same multi-value syntax of the margin shorthand.
f65f201cea073f97.translationZh: 设置的 CSS 短手属性对应上,右,下,和/或左属性. 其比值简写法的多值语法相同.

132899fc7ea623a3.original: The inset-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end offsets of an element, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
132899fc7ea623a3.translationZh: 内置区块 CSS 短手属性定义了元素的逻辑区块始末抵消,该区块根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射为物理抵消. 它与上下或左右属性相对应,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

3789955e983f8c6a.original: The inset-block-end CSS property defines the logical block end offset of an element, which maps to a physical inset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
3789955e983f8c6a.translationZh: 内置区块-端 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑区块末端抵消,它会根据该元素的写法模式,方向性,和文本方向来映射到一个物理设置. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

27b4eb1a06bd8724.original: The inset-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start offset of an element, which maps to a physical inset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
27b4eb1a06bd8724.translationZh: 内置块启动 CSS 属性定义了一个元素的逻辑块启动抵消,该元素根据元素的写法模式,方向性,和文本方向,将它映射到物理设置中. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

e3ae5c82909fbe22.original: The inset-inline CSS shorthand property defines the logical start and end offsets of an element in the inline direction, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
e3ae5c82909fbe22.translationZh: 内置的 CSS 短手属性定义了内置方向中一个元素的逻辑起始和结尾抵消,该属性根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向来映射物理抵消. 它与上下或左右属性相对应,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。

a384f43ba14a95ad.original: The inset-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end inset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
a384f43ba14a95ad.translationZh: 内置式的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内置式的端套,根据元素的写法模式,方向性和文本方向,将元素映射到物理偏移. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

38744dd14bc95890.original: The inset-inline-start CSS property defines the logical inline start inset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
38744dd14bc95890.translationZh: 内置启动的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内置启动设置,该设置根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理偏移. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.

6483e90493122eab.original: The interactivity CSS property specifies whether an element and its descendant nodes are set to be inert.
6483e90493122eab.translationZh: 交互 CSS 属性指定一个元素及其子节点是否设定为惰性.

970e3948edc55fd5.original: The interest-delay CSS property specifies the delay between the user showing interest in an interest invoker element and the HTMLElement.interestevent event firing, and the delay between the user losing interest and the HTMLElement.loseinterestevent event firing.
970e3948edc55fd5.translationZh: 利息延迟 CSS 属性指定了用户显示对利息引用器元素的兴趣与 HTMLElement 之间的延迟. 利息事件点火,以及用户失去兴趣和HTMLElement之间的延迟。 失去兴趣事件发射。

f906b1b9924487dd.original: The interest-delay-end CSS property specifies the delay between the user losing interest in an interest invoker element and the HTMLElement.loseinterestevent event firing.
f906b1b9924487dd.translationZh: 利息延迟端 CSS 属性指定了用户对利息引用器元素失去利息与 HTMLElement 之间的延迟. 失去兴趣事件发射。

fdac4a8dd460b349.original: The interest-delay-start CSS property specifies the delay between the user showing interest in an interest invoker element and the HTMLElement.interestevent event firing.
fdac4a8dd460b349.translationZh: 利息延迟启动 CSS 属性指定了用户对利息引用元素显示利息与 HTMLElement 之间的延迟. 兴趣事件发射。

ef9700ed1324a111.original: The interpolate-size CSS property allows you to enable animations and transitions between a <length-percentage> value and an intrinsic size, fit-content, or max-content.
ef9700ed1324a111.translationZh: 内插大小 CSS 属性允许您在 < 长度- 百分比 > 值和内在大小、 适合内容或最大内容之间实现动画和转换 。

1effcdc4f1a561c5.original: The isolation CSS property determines whether an element must create a new stacking context.
1effcdc4f1a561c5.translationZh: 孤立的 CSS 属性决定元素是否必须创建新的堆叠上下文 。

b891b80511c63eac.original: The CSS justify-content property defines how the browser distributes space between and around content items along the main axis of a flex container and the inline axis of grid and multicol containers.
b891b80511c63eac.translationZh: CSS说明内容属性定义了浏览器如何沿弹性容器主轴和网格及多曲线容器内置轴在内容项目之间和周围分配空间.

2a45ecefd4badee3.original: The CSS justify-items property defines the default justify-self for all items of the box, giving them all a default way of justifying each box along the appropriate axis.
2a45ecefd4badee3.translationZh: CSS 正当项目属性定义了框中所有项目的默认正当性,并赋予它们按照适当的轴对每个框进行解释的默认方式。

e5eff674e109ea26.original: The CSS justify-self property sets the way a box is justified inside its alignment container along the appropriate axis.
e5eff674e109ea26.translationZh: 中央支助系统说明理由的自有财产确定了一个盒子在适当轴线的对齐容器内的合理性。

80d63b571670d1f1.original: The left CSS property participates in specifying the horizontal position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
80d63b571670d1f1.translationZh: 左侧CSS财产参与指定定位元素的横向位置. 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.

bb53efe523743bb7.original: The letter-spacing CSS property sets the spacing between text characters. This value is added to the natural spacing between characters while rendering the text. Positive values of letter-spacing spread characters further apart, while negative values of letter-spacing bring characters closer together.
bb53efe523743bb7.translationZh: 字母间隔 CSS 属性设置文本字符之间的间隔 。 此值会在渲染文本时添加到字符之间的自然间隔中 。 字母间距的正值将字符进一步分散,而字母间距的负值则使字符更加接近.

d7a3eb56d2fd94a6.original: The lighting-color CSS property defines the color of the light source for the and SVG lighting filter primitives within an SVG . If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
d7a3eb56d2fd94a6.translationZh: 照明-彩色 CSS 属性定义了 SVG 内部的照明源和 SVG 照明过滤器原始的颜色 。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

697d455ce6e9aa49.original: The line-break CSS property sets how to break lines of Chinese, Japanese, or Korean (CJK) text when working with punctuation and symbols.
697d455ce6e9aa49.translationZh: 换行的 CSS 属性设定了在使用标点和符号时如何突破汉语,日语或韩语(CJK)文本的线条.

d27d6142927d80cc.original: The line-clamp CSS property allows limiting of the contents of a block to the specified number of lines.
d27d6142927d80cc.translationZh: 行-惊厥CSS属性允许将块的内容限制在指定的行数.

3b3f66244f19540b.original: The line-height CSS property sets the height of a line box in horizontal writing modes. In vertical writing modes, it sets the width of a line box. It's commonly used to set the distance between lines of text. On block-level elements in horizontal writing modes, it specifies the preferred height of line boxes within the element, and on non-replaced inline elements, it specifies the height that is used to calculate line box height.
3b3f66244f19540b.translationZh: 行高 CSS 属性以水平写法模式设置行框的高度. 在垂直写入模式中,它设置行框的宽度. 通常用于确定文本行之间的距离. 在水平写法模式的块级元素上,它指定了元素内线框的首选高度,在非替换的内线元素上,它指定了用于计算线框高度的高度.

dbc7ea4e35f1fc23.original: The line-height-step CSS property sets the step unit for line box heights. When the property is set, line box heights are rounded up to the closest multiple of the unit.
dbc7ea4e35f1fc23.translationZh: 线高步CSS属性设置行箱高度的步数单位. 设置属性时,行框高度将四舍五入到单位最接近的倍数.

32bd7d3a7b397f99.original: The link-parameters CSS property sets values of external resources, such as SVGs, whose attributes have been set with the env CSS function
32bd7d3a7b397f99.translationZh: 链接参数 CSS 属性设置外部资源的值, 如 SVG , 其属性设定为 env CSS 函数

62330d1aaa882114.original: The list-style CSS shorthand property allows you to set all the list style properties at once.
62330d1aaa882114.translationZh: 列表风格的 CSS 短手属性允许您同时设置列表样式属性 。

4bc5ff7d8e5a7975.original: The list-style-image CSS property sets an image to be used as the list item marker.
4bc5ff7d8e5a7975.translationZh: 列表风格的图像 CSS 属性设置一个图像,用作列表项目标记.

e2ac67463e1e3d6e.original: The list-style-position CSS property sets the position of the ::marker relative to a list item.
e2ac67463e1e3d6e.translationZh: 列表式位置 CSS 属性相对于列表项设定了  :: 标记的位置 。

5171845fb4d7b0e6.original: The list-style-type CSS property sets the marker (such as a disc, character, or custom counter style) of a list item element.
5171845fb4d7b0e6.translationZh: 列表风格的 CSS 属性设置列表项元素的标记(如盘,字符,或自定义计数器样式).

7bb79a1da53c1759.original: The margin CSS shorthand property sets the margin area on all four sides of an element.
7bb79a1da53c1759.translationZh: 差值 CSS 短手属性将差值区域设置在一个元素的所有四边.

a593d160856637f3.original: The margin-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
a593d160856637f3.translationZh: 边距-块 CSS 的短手属性定义了元素的逻辑块起始和结尾边距,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理边距.

6711ddf887ef4e0b.original: The margin-block-end CSS property defines the logical block end margin of an element, which maps to a physical margin depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
6711ddf887ef4e0b.translationZh: 边距-块端 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块端边距,该边距根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向来映射到物理边距.

a8ceabeaf03aedf6.original: The margin-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start margin of an element, which maps to a physical margin depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
a8ceabeaf03aedf6.translationZh: 边距-块启动 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块起始边距,该边距根据元素的写法模式,方向性,和文本方向来映射到物理边距.

66ee845a15168d82.original: The margin-bottom CSS property sets the margin area on the bottom of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
66ee845a15168d82.translationZh: 边角底 CSS 属性将边角区域设置在元素底部。 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.

7475aa0ac8815968.original: The margin-inline CSS shorthand property defines both the logical inline start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
7475aa0ac8815968.translationZh: 边距内置的 CSS 短手属性既定义了元素的逻辑内置起始和结尾边距,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,文本方向,将元素映射到物理边距.

df2c8c17e9852e7a.original: The margin-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end margin of an element, which maps to a physical margin depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. In other words, it corresponds to the margin-top, margin-right, margin-bottom or margin-left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
df2c8c17e9852e7a.translationZh: 边距内置的 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内置端边距,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将元素映射到物理边距. 换句话说,它与比值上方、比值右方、比值下方或比值左方属性相对应,这取决于为写法、方向和文字导向定义的值。

6fab3d9c3b9b08b4.original: The margin-inline-start CSS property defines the logical inline start margin of an element, which maps to a physical margin depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the margin-top, margin-right, margin-bottom, or margin-left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
6fab3d9c3b9b08b4.translationZh: 边距-内线启动 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑内线起始边距,该边距根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向来映射到物理边距. 它与比值上方、比值右方、比值下方或比值左方属性相对应,取决于为写法、方向和文字导向定义的值。

087676585f9085cf.original: The margin-left CSS property sets the margin area on the left side of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
087676585f9085cf.translationZh: 差值左侧 CSS 属性将差值区域设置在元素左侧. 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.

0060fdec8b14b9f1.original: The margin-right CSS property sets the margin area on the right side of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
0060fdec8b14b9f1.translationZh: 边角右 CSS 属性将边角区域设置在一个元素的右侧. 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.

424980b8c2f826a0.original: The margin-top CSS property sets the margin area on the top of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
424980b8c2f826a0.translationZh: 边距顶端的 CSS 属性将边距区域设置在元素顶端. 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.

18628dac8d6e804e.original: The margin-trim property allows the container to trim the margins of its children where they adjoin the container's edges.
18628dac8d6e804e.translationZh: 边际财产允许集装箱在紧邻集装箱边缘的地方修剪其子女的边际。

e12ab7faba46878f.original: The marker CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first, middle, and last vertices of the element's path; that is, at all of its vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start, marker, and marker-end attributes in the SVG.
e12ab7faba46878f.translationZh: 标记 CSS 属性指将绘制在元素路径的第一个,中间,最后一个顶点上的标记;即其所有顶点. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记启动,标记,和标记端属性的任何值.

4e5a401f577dd689.original: The marker-end CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the last vertex of the element's path; that is, at its ending vertex. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-end attribute in the SVG.
4e5a401f577dd689.translationZh: 标记端 CSS 属性指将在元素路径的最后一个顶点上绘制的标记;即在其结尾顶点上. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记端属性的任何值.

2f830e03549bf551.original: The marker-mid CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the middle vertices of the element's path; that is, at each of its vertices between the start and end vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-mid attribute in the SVG.
2f830e03549bf551.translationZh: 标记中间的CSS属性指向在元素路径的中间顶点上绘制的标记;即在其起始顶点和结束顶点之间的每个顶点上. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记中间属性的任何值.

6d659e490fe3d94f.original: The marker-start CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first vertex of the element's path; that is, at its starting vertex. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start attribute in the SVG.
6d659e490fe3d94f.translationZh: 标记启动 CSS 属性指向在元素路径的第一个顶点上绘制的标记;即在其起始顶点上. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记启动属性的任何值.

acaaa6f3779863ed.original: The mask CSS shorthand property hides an element (partially or fully) by masking or clipping a specified area of the image. It is a shorthand for all the mask- properties. The property accepts one or more comma-separated values, where each value corresponds to a .
acaaa6f3779863ed.translationZh: 面具 CSS 的短手属性通过遮盖或剪辑图像指定区域来隐藏元素(部分或全部). 这是所有面具的缩写 属性接受一个或多个逗号分隔的值,其中每个值对应 。

bacc8ef6f993721a.original: The mask-border CSS shorthand property lets you create a mask along the edge of an element's border.
bacc8ef6f993721a.translationZh: 遮罩边框 CSS 的短手属性允许您在元素边框边缘处创建遮罩 。

bb4a627132fc98cc.original: The mask-border-mode CSS property specifies the blending mode used in a mask border.
bb4a627132fc98cc.translationZh: 口罩-边框-模式 CSS 属性指定了口罩边框使用的混合模式.

b45137fd68f16c9c.original: The mask-border-outset CSS property specifies the distance by which an element's mask border is set out from its border box.
b45137fd68f16c9c.translationZh: 遮盖边框的 CSS 属性指定了元素遮盖边框的设置距离 。

a5f42344ae53bbb5.translationZh: 面罩- 边框- 重复

01290324cd7001db.original: The mask-border-repeat CSS property specifies how the images for the sides and the middle part of the mask border image are scaled and tiled.
01290324cd7001db.translationZh: 遮盖边框重现 CSS 属性指定了遮盖边框图像的侧面和中段的图像如何缩放和平整.

0229b86033951c62.original: The mask-border-slice CSS property divides the image set by mask-border-source into regions. These regions are used to form the components of an element's mask border.
0229b86033951c62.translationZh: 面罩-边框切片 CSS 属性将面罩-边框源设置的图像分割为区域. 这些区域被用来构成元素的遮盖边框的组件.

880c6c2e170c8c78.original: The mask-border-source CSS property sets the source image used to create an element's mask border.
880c6c2e170c8c78.translationZh: 遮罩-边境源 CSS 属性设置用于创建元素遮罩边框的源图像.

907ca6288a7492c2.original: The mask-border-width CSS property sets the width of an element's mask border.
907ca6288a7492c2.translationZh: 遮盖- 边界宽度 CSS 属性设置元素遮盖边框的宽度 。

27fc0604992be4a3.original: The mask-clip CSS property determines the area which is affected by a mask. The painted content of an element must be restricted to this area.
27fc0604992be4a3.translationZh: 口罩- clip CSS 属性决定受口罩影响的区域. 元素的涂装内容必须限于此区域。

20b2c85c1b955bb6.original: The mask-composite CSS property represents a compositing operation used on the current mask layer with the mask layers below it.
20b2c85c1b955bb6.translationZh: 口罩复合CSS属性代表了当前口罩层上使用的一种混合操作,其下方的口罩层.

107fdb516358ac04.original: The mask-image CSS property sets the image that is used as the mask layer for an element, hiding sections of the element on which the masking image is set based on the alpha channel of the mask image and, depending on the mask-mode property value, the luminance of the mask image's colors.
107fdb516358ac04.translationZh: 面具图像 CSS 属性设置一个元素用作遮罩层的图像,隐藏遮罩图像基于遮罩图像的α通道设定的元素部分,并根据遮罩-模度属性值,遮罩图像颜色的亮度.

a327a2e3f9fff1ad.original: The mask-mode CSS property is set on the element being masked. It sets whether the mask reference defined by the mask-image is treated as a luminance or alpha mask.
a327a2e3f9fff1ad.translationZh: 口罩-mode CSS属性设定在被遮盖的元素上. 它设定了由面具-图像定义的面具引用是被作为亮度还是α面罩处理.

bd6abdf45ce26067.original: The mask-origin CSS property sets the origin of a mask. This property determines the mask positioning area: the area within which a mask image is positioned. HTML elements can have masks contained within their content border box, padding box, or content box, whereas SVG elements (which don't have the associated CSS layout boxes) can have masks contained inside their fill, stroke, or view box. For elements rendered as multiple boxes, such as a span of text that spans more than one line, the mask-origin property specifies which boxes the box-decoration-break property operates on to determine the mask positioning area.
bd6abdf45ce26067.translationZh: 面具来源的CSS财产设定了面具的来源. 这个属性决定了面具定位区域:面具图像定位所在区域. HTML元素可以在其内容边框框,补丁框,或内容框内装有口罩,而SVG元素(没有相关的CSS布局框)可以在其填充,中风,或视图框内装有口罩. 对于作为多个框提供的元素,例如跨过一行以上的文字,口罩属性指定了哪个框的箱的装饰破损属性用于确定口罩定位区域。

202929400d1be058.original: The mask-position CSS property sets the initial position, relative to the mask position layer set by mask-origin, for each defined mask image.
202929400d1be058.translationZh: 口罩位置 CSS 属性设定了初始位置,相对于口罩起源设定的口罩位置层,用于每个定义的口罩图像.

f941818f678ae20c.original: The mask-repeat CSS property sets how mask images are repeated. A mask image can be repeated along the horizontal axis, the vertical axis, both axes, or not repeated at all.
f941818f678ae20c.translationZh: 面具复制的CSS属性设定了面具图像如何重复. 面具图像可以沿着水平轴,垂直轴,双轴重复,也可以完全不重复.

977ff86d9f51f371.original: The mask-size CSS property specifies the sizes of specified mask images. Mask image sizes can be fully or partially constrained to preserve their aspect ratio.
977ff86d9f51f371.translationZh: 遮罩大小 CSS 属性指定指定遮罩图像的大小 。 遮罩图像大小可以完全或部分受限,以保持其容积比.

d87b0120ee1ccda4.original: The mask-type CSS property applies to the SVG element. It defines whether to use the luminance (brightness) or alpha (transparency) content of the mask. This property may be overridden by the mask-mode property. The mask-type property has no effect on image or gradient masks.
d87b0120ee1ccda4.translationZh: 面具型CSS属性适用于SVG元素. 它定义是使用面具的亮度(亮度)还是α(透明)内容. 这种财产可能被面具模式财产所压倒。 面具类型的属性对图像或梯度面具没有影响.

b308b333d762552b.original: The math-depth property describes a notion of depth for each element of a mathematical formula, with respect to the top-level container of that formula. This is used to scale the computed value of the font-size of elements when font-size: math is applied.
b308b333d762552b.translationZh: 数学深度属性描述数学公式每个要素的深度概念,即该公式的顶级容器。 用于在字体大小: 应用数学时, 缩放元素字体大小的计算值 。

ffc2fbc10a33ee68.original: The math-shift property indicates whether superscripts inside MathML formulas should be raised by a normal or compact shift.
ffc2fbc10a33ee68.translationZh: 数学移位属性表示是否应该通过普通移位或紧凑移位来提升数学ML公式中的上标.

fe489eddfce396b2.original: The math-style property indicates whether MathML equations should render with normal or compact height.
fe489eddfce396b2.translationZh: 数学风格属性表示数学ML方程是否应当以正常高度或紧凑高度渲染.

aeb6c1fb6881b0b2.original: The max-block-size CSS property specifies the maximum size of an element in the direction opposite that of the writing direction as specified by writing-mode. That is, if the writing direction is horizontal, then max-block-size is equivalent to max-height; if the writing direction is vertical, max-block-size is the same as max-width.
aeb6c1fb6881b0b2.translationZh: 最大块大小的 CSS 属性指定一个元素的最大大小,其方向与书写模式指定的书写方向相反。 也就是说,如果书写方向是水平的,那么最大块大小等于最大高度;如果书写方向是垂直的,最大块大小等于最大宽.

9748857c573164b8.original: The max-height CSS property sets the maximum height of an element. It prevents the used value of the height property from becoming larger than the value specified for max-height.
9748857c573164b8.translationZh: 最大高度 CSS 属性设置元素的最大高度 。 它防止高度属性的用值变得大于指定的最大高度值.
