f693bb2e10fdf732.original: The max-inline-size CSS property defines the horizontal or vertical maximum size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the max-width or the max-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
f693bb2e10fdf732.translationZh: 最大内置大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的横向或垂直最大大小,取决于其写入模式. 它与最大宽度或最大高度属性相对应,取决于写入模式的值。

bc1cd68c6756c2b5.original: The max-width CSS property sets the maximum width of an element. It prevents the used value of the width property from becoming larger than the value specified by max-width.
bc1cd68c6756c2b5.translationZh: 最大宽度 CSS 属性设置元素的最大宽度 。 它防止宽度属性的用值变得大于最大宽度指定的值.

248c54ce4dfe1761.original: The min-block-size CSS property defines the minimum horizontal or vertical size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the min-width or the min-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
248c54ce4dfe1761.translationZh: min-block大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的最小水平大小或垂直大小,取决于其写入模式. 根据写法-模式的值,它或对应分钟宽度,或对应分钟高度属性.

4b05f051a6e678f5.original: The min-height CSS property sets the minimum height of an element. It prevents the used value of the height property from becoming smaller than the value specified for min-height.
4b05f051a6e678f5.translationZh: Min-hight CSS 属性设定元素最小高度. 它防止高度属性的用值变得小于指定的毫高值.

bc89a6f177d21c45.original: The min-inline-size CSS property defines the horizontal or vertical minimal size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the min-width or the min-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
bc89a6f177d21c45.translationZh: min-inline大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的横向或垂直最小大小,取决于其写入模式. 根据写法-模式的值,它或对应分钟宽度,或对应分钟高度属性.

baf0465b3552a1fd.original: The min-width CSS property sets the minimum width of an element. It prevents the used value of the width property from becoming smaller than the value specified for min-width.
baf0465b3552a1fd.translationZh: Min-width CSS 属性设定元素最小宽度 。 它防止宽度属性的用值变得小于指定的毫微宽值.

7367cbdbfaaeb6fa.original: The mix-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's content should blend with its backdrop — the content rendered behind the element within the same stacking context.
7367cbdbfaaeb6fa.translationZh: 混凝土-blend-mode CSS属性设定一个元素的内容应当如何与其背景融合——在同一堆叠上下文中元素背后的内容.

7aa1ea51c5c02f7b.original: The object-fit CSS property sets how the content of a replaced elements, such as an img or video, should be resized to fit its container.
7aa1ea51c5c02f7b.translationZh: 对象适配的CSS属性设定了置换元素的内容,如img或视频,应如何调整大小以适应其容器.

84056179a64ed895.original: The object-position CSS property specifies the alignment of the selected replaced elements's contents within the element's box. Areas of the box which aren't covered by the replaced element's object will show the element's background.
84056179a64ed895.translationZh: 对象位置 CSS 属性指定选定替换元素内容在元素框中的对齐. 框中未覆盖被替换元素对象的区域将显示元素的背景.

f85858df838acd53.original: The object-view-box CSS property defines a rectangle as a viewable area (viewbox) within a replaced elements, enabling the content of the replaced element to be zoomed or panned. It works similarly to the SVG attribute.
f85858df838acd53.translationZh: 对象-视图框 CSS 属性将矩形定义为被替换元素内的可查看区域(viewbox),使得被替换元素的内容能够被放大或平板化. 它的工作原理类似于SVG属性.

99b905dd02abc48d.original: The offset CSS shorthand property sets all the properties required for animating an element along a defined path. The offset properties together help to define an offset transform, a transform that aligns a point in an element (offset-anchor) to an offset position (offset-position) on a path (offset-path) at various points along the path (offset-distance) and optionally rotates the element (offset-rotate) to follow the direction of the path.
99b905dd02abc48d.translationZh: 抵消的 CSS 短手属性设置了在定义路径上动画元素所需的所有属性. 抵消属性共同帮助定义抵消变换,将元素(抵消-锁定)中的点与路径(抵消-路径)上各个点(抵消-路径)上的抵消位置(抵消-位置)对齐的转变,并可选择地旋转元素(抵消-旋转)以遵循路径的方向.

512c3fe236ae91c1.original: The offset-anchor CSS property specifies the point inside the box of an element traveling along an offset-path that is actually moving along the path.
512c3fe236ae91c1.translationZh: CSS 偏移控制器属性指定一个元素沿偏移路径行驶的框内点,该路径实际上沿路径行驶.

4ae0f8885309d72f.original: The offset-distance CSS property specifies a position along an offset-path for an element to be placed.
4ae0f8885309d72f.translationZh: 抵消-距离 CSS 财产为要放置的元素指定了一条抵消路径的位置。

cf7e62136964c9d0.original: The offset-path CSS property specifies a path for an element to follow and determines the element's positioning within the path's parent container or the SVG coordinate system. The path is a line, a curve, or a geometrical shape along which the element gets positioned or moves.
cf7e62136964c9d0.translationZh: 偏移路径 CSS 属性指定了元素要遵循的路径,并确定元素在路径母容器或SVG坐标系统中的定位. 路径是一个线,一个曲线,或者一个几何形状,元素沿它被定位或移动.

d542384faf19b8ef.original: The offset-position CSS property defines the initial position of an element along a path. This property is typically used in combination with the offset-path property to create a motion effect. The value of offset-position determines where the element gets placed initially for moving along an offset path if an offset-path function such as does not specify its own starting position.
d542384faf19b8ef.translationZh: 抵消位置 CSS 属性定义了元素沿路径的初始位置. 这种属性一般与抵消路径属性结合使用,以产生运动效应. 如果一个抵消路径函数,如未指定其自身起始位置,则抵消位置的值将决定该元素最初被放置在何处,以便沿着抵消路径移动。

92d3bb8152fbc8ee.original: The offset-rotate CSS property defines the orientation/direction of the element as it is positioned along the offset-path.
92d3bb8152fbc8ee.translationZh: 抵消旋转式CSS财产界定了元素的方向/方向,因为它沿抵消路径定位。

ce7cc983262bcba6.original: The opacity CSS property sets the opacity of an element. Opacity is the degree to which content behind an element is hidden, and is the opposite of transparency.
ce7cc983262bcba6.translationZh: 不透明 CSS 属性设置元素的不透明 。 不透明是元素背后的内容隐藏的程度,与透明度相反.

463cbd546780c44d.original: The order CSS property sets the order to lay out an item in a flex or grid container. Items in a container are sorted by ascending order value and then by their source code order. Items not given an explicit order value are assigned the default value of 0.
463cbd546780c44d.translationZh: CSS财产令规定了在弹性容器或网格容器中放置物品的命令。 容器中的物品按升序值排序,然后按其源代码顺序排序。 未给出明确顺序值的项目,指定默认值为0。

85ad27db09feede1.original: The orphans CSS property sets the minimum number of lines in a block container that must be shown at the bottom of a page, region, or column.
85ad27db09feede1.translationZh: 孤儿 CSS 属性在一个块容器中设定最小行数,必须显示在页面、区域或列的底部。

b6a90d54bee0d92c.original: The outline CSS shorthand property sets most of the outline properties in a single declaration.
b6a90d54bee0d92c.translationZh: 大纲 CSS 短手属性将大纲属性的大部分设置在单一的声明中.

940f1b4356608020.original: The outline-color CSS property sets the color of an element's outline.
940f1b4356608020.translationZh: 大纲颜色 CSS 属性设置元素大纲的颜色 。

4a4a69ba43f902ac.original: The outline-offset CSS property sets the amount of space between an outline and the edge or border of an element.
4a4a69ba43f902ac.translationZh: 大纲抵消的 CSS 属性设定了大纲与元素边缘或边框之间的间距。

91ac7eec57c0dda1.original: The outline-style CSS property sets the style of an element's outline. An outline is a line that is drawn around an element, outside the border.
91ac7eec57c0dda1.translationZh: 大纲式 CSS 属性设置元素大纲的样式 。 大纲是指围绕某一元素在边界外绘制的线条.

a1dcfe3702a7ae85.original: The CSS outline-width property sets the thickness of an element's outline. An outline is a line that is drawn around an element, outside the border.
a1dcfe3702a7ae85.translationZh: CSS 大纲宽度属性设置元素大纲的厚度。 大纲是指围绕某一元素在边界外绘制的线条.

927ca1768fa8c47d.original: The overflow CSS shorthand property sets the desired behavior when content does not fit in the element's padding box (overflows) in the horizontal and/or vertical direction.
927ca1768fa8c47d.translationZh: 溢出 CSS 的短手属性设定了在元素的粘贴框(溢出流)中与水平和/或垂直方向不匹配时所需的行为.

2fa32e49269e9557.original: The overflow-anchor CSS property provides a way to opt out of the browser's scroll anchoring behavior, which adjusts scroll position to minimize content shifts.
2fa32e49269e9557.translationZh: 溢出-anchor CSS属性提供了一个选择退出浏览器滚动锚定行为的方法,它调整了滚动位置,以尽量减少内容转移.

9df2c89bdc3a5968.original: The overflow-block CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the block start and block end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.
9df2c89bdc3a5968.translationZh: 溢出区块 CSS 属性设定了内容溢出区块起始和块尾边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。

38075ac426c4d020.original: The overflow-clip-margin CSS property determines how far outside its bounds an element with overflow: clip may be painted before being clipped. The bound defined by this property is called the overflow clip edge of the box.
38075ac426c4d020.translationZh: 溢出- clip- 边距 CSS 属性决定了溢出元素的边界之外有多远: 夹片在被剪辑之前可以画出来 。 此属性定义的边框称为框的溢出夹边.

32d08258116cf440.original: The overflow-inline CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the inline start and end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.
32d08258116cf440.translationZh: 溢出内置的 CSS 属性设定了当内容溢出一个框的内置起始和结尾边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。

9c0ce7c630f847bb.original: The overflow-wrap CSS property applies to text, setting whether the browser should insert line breaks within an otherwise unbreakable string to prevent text from overflowing its line box.
9c0ce7c630f847bb.translationZh: 溢出- rap CSS 属性适用于文本, 设定浏览器是否应在一个无法断开的字符串中插入换行符, 以防止文本溢出其行框 。

7f1f2606c8dccb09.original: The overflow-x CSS property sets what shows when content overflows a block-level element's left and right edges. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content. This property may also be set by using the overflow shorthand property.
7f1f2606c8dccb09.translationZh: 溢出- x CSS 属性设定了内容溢出区块元素左右边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。 也可以使用溢出的短手财产来确定这种财产。

6910c8e26268ff0e.original: The overflow-y CSS property sets what shows when content overflows a block-level element's top and bottom edges. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content. This property may also be set by using the overflow shorthand property.
6910c8e26268ff0e.translationZh: 溢出式 CSS 属性设定了内容溢出区块元素上下边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。 也可以使用溢出的短手财产来确定这种财产。

244b15537dd8fd03.original: The overlay CSS property specifies whether an element appearing in the top layer (for example, a shown popover or modal dialog element) is actually rendered in the top layer. This property is only relevant within a list of transition-property values, and only if allow-discrete is set as the transition-behavior.
244b15537dd8fd03.translationZh: 覆盖 CSS 属性指定在顶层出现的元素(例如显示的弹出式或模式对话框元素)是否在顶层实际渲染. 此属性仅在过渡-财产值列表中相关,并且只有在允许-差异被设定为过渡-行为时才相关.

326e38e842886d66.original: The overscroll-behavior CSS property sets what a browser does when reaching the boundary of a scrolling area.
326e38e842886d66.translationZh: 过度滚动行为 CSS 属性设定浏览器在到达滚动区域的边界时会做什么 。

3517f8dda8ab9fa2.original: The overscroll-behavior-block CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the block direction boundary of a scrolling area is reached.
3517f8dda8ab9fa2.translationZh: 过度滚动-行为块 CSS 属性在滚动区域的块方向边界到达时设定浏览器的行为.

2e31bc5a18aa4917.original: The overscroll-behavior-inline CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the inline direction boundary of a scrolling area is reached.
2e31bc5a18aa4917.translationZh: 过度滚动-行为-内置 CSS 属性在滚动区域的内向边界到达时设定浏览器的行为.

dc61e854ec81e732.original: The overscroll-behavior-x CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the horizontal boundary of a scrolling area is reached.
dc61e854ec81e732.translationZh: 过度滚动-行为-x CSS 属性设定了浏览器在滚动区域水平边界到达时的行为.

4b10add8a0766403.original: The overscroll-behavior-y CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the vertical boundary of a scrolling area is reached.
4b10add8a0766403.translationZh: 过度滚动-行为Y CSS 属性设定了浏览器在滚动区域垂直边界到达时的行为.

21a10ed2763d3edd.original: The padding CSS shorthand property sets the padding area on all four sides of an element at once.
21a10ed2763d3edd.translationZh: 粘贴的 CSS 短手属性将粘贴区域一次性设置在一个元素的四边.

bde4583e9a8b9fa6.original: The padding-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
bde4583e9a8b9fa6.translationZh: padding-block CSS 的短手属性定义了元素的逻辑块始末的padding,根据元素的写法模式,方向,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理的padding属性.

e35060e7d088b2dc.original: The padding-block-end CSS property defines the logical block end padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
e35060e7d088b2dc.translationZh: padding-block-end CSS属性定义了元素的逻辑块端的pading,它根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理的padding.

f6c6c081ddb2a879.original: The padding-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
f6c6c081ddb2a879.translationZh: padding-block-start CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块开始padding,它根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理padding.

6c629aaf4bb66f61.original: The padding-bottom CSS property sets the height of the padding area on the bottom of an element.
6c629aaf4bb66f61.translationZh: 垫底 CSS 属性将垫底区域的高度设置在一个元素的底部.

4738f743f8556e08.original: The padding-inline CSS shorthand property defines the logical inline start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
4738f743f8556e08.translationZh: 嵌入式 CSS 短手属性定义了元素的逻辑内线起始和末端的嵌入式,根据元素的写法模式,方向,以及文本方向,将嵌入式属性映射到物理上.

c35113125858dc97.original: The padding-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
c35113125858dc97.translationZh: padding-inline-end CSS属性定义了元素的逻辑内在端贴,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将元素映射到物理端贴.

5cce30d9af8afa5c.original: The padding-inline-start CSS property defines the logical inline start padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
5cce30d9af8afa5c.translationZh: 嵌入式启动 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑嵌入式启动嵌入式,它根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,映射到物理嵌入式.

67c1d78c153ffab1.original: The padding-left CSS property sets the width of the padding area to the left of an element.
67c1d78c153ffab1.translationZh: 垫片左侧 CSS 属性将垫片区域的宽度设置在一个元素的左边 。

7e10bdf8efe4a06a.original: The padding-right CSS property sets the width of the padding area on the right of an element.
7e10bdf8efe4a06a.translationZh: 粘贴右侧 CSS 属性设置元素右侧粘贴区域的宽度 。

e4a7a2137b7b8b10.original: The padding-top CSS property sets the height of the padding area on the top of an element.
e4a7a2137b7b8b10.translationZh: 垫顶 CSS 属性将垫顶区域的高度设置在一个元素的顶端.

d1c8a97dd5d14691.original: The page CSS property is used to specify the named page, a specific type of page defined by the @page at-rule.
d1c8a97dd5d14691.translationZh: 页面 CSS 属性用于指定命名的页面,由 @page at-rule 定义的特定类型的页面.

ee69c6fec95150ea.original: The page-break-after CSS property adjusts page breaks after the current element.
ee69c6fec95150ea.translationZh: CSS 属性后断页调整当前元素后的分页符 。

de712764b9091929.original: The page-break-before CSS property adjusts page breaks before the current element.
de712764b9091929.translationZh: CSS 属性前的分页符调整当前元素前的分页符 。

34a6d0e5a3780291.original: The page-break-inside CSS property adjusts page breaks inside the current element.
34a6d0e5a3780291.translationZh: 断页 CSS 属性调整当前元素内的断页 。

ef387b8d3042aa3b.original: The paint-order CSS property lets you control the order in which the fill and stroke (and painting markers) of text content and shapes are drawn.
ef387b8d3042aa3b.translationZh: 彩绘顺序 CSS 属性允许您控制文本内容和形状的填充和中线(和绘画标记)的顺序 。

bde1001df6d167a1.original: The path-length CSS property specifies a total path length, in user units. All path computations are then scaled using the ratio path-length / (computed value of path length) — this includes text paths, animation paths, and various stroke operations.
bde1001df6d167a1.translationZh: 路径长 CSS 属性指定一个总路径长度,以用户单位表示. 所有路径的计算然后使用比例路径长度 /(路径长度的计算值)进行缩放——这包括文本路径,动画路径,以及各种中风操作.

0bc2594b791a21bd.original: The perspective CSS property determines the distance between the z=0 plane and the user in order to give a 3D-positioned element some perspective.
0bc2594b791a21bd.translationZh: 视角 CSS 属性决定了z=0平面与用户之间的距离,以便给出一个3D定位元素一些视角.

634fa0867c83b588.original: The perspective-origin CSS property determines the position at which the viewer is looking. It is used as the vanishing point by the perspective property.
634fa0867c83b588.translationZh: 视角起源的 CSS 属性决定了查看者正在查看的位置 。 它被视角属性用作消失点。

e19807553983c183.original: The place-content CSS shorthand property allows you to align content along both the block and inline directions at once (i.e., the align-content and justify-content properties) in a relevant layout system such as Grid or Flexbox.
e19807553983c183.translationZh: 位置内容 CSS 的短手属性允许您在Grid 或 Flexbox 等相关布局系统中同时按照块和内线方向对齐内容(即对齐内容和合理内容属性).

93a44d2f47a11cbd.original: The place-items CSS shorthand property aligns items along both the block and inline directions at once. It sets the values of the align-items and justify-items properties. If the second value is not set, the first value is also used for it.
93a44d2f47a11cbd.translationZh: CSS 的短手属性将项目与块和内线方向同步。 它设定了对齐项目的值和对齐项目的属性。 如果第二个值没有设定,第一个值也用于它.

f9a21bd5f6f370e3.original: The place-self CSS shorthand property allows you to align an individual item in both the block and inline directions at once (i.e., the align-self and justify-self properties). This property applies to block-level boxes, absolutely-positioned boxes, and grid items. If the second value is not present, the first value is also used for it.
f9a21bd5f6f370e3.translationZh: 位自 CSS 的短手属性允许您同时对齐块和内线方向中的单个项目(即对齐自身和正当自身属性). 此属性适用于块级的框,绝对位置的框,以及网格项. 如果第二个值不存在,第一个值也用于它.

4b1323f17aa3e448.original: The pointer-events CSS property sets under what circumstances (if any) a particular graphic element can become the target of pointer events.
4b1323f17aa3e448.translationZh: 指针事件 CSS 属性设定在什么情况下(如果有的话)特定图形元素可以成为指针事件的目标.

f39211d91f00fb7a.original: The position CSS property sets how an element is positioned in a document. The top, right, bottom, and left physical properties and the inset-block-start, inset-block-end, inset-inline-start, and inset-inline-end flow-relative logical properties can be used to determine the final location of positioned elements.
f39211d91f00fb7a.translationZh: CSS 属性位置设定一个元素在文档中的位置 。 上,右,下,和左物理属性以及内置-块启动,内置-块端启动,内置-内置-端启动,内置-内置-端流相对逻辑属性可以用来确定定位元素的最终位置.

67d426f4e6b857bf.original: The position-anchor CSS property specifies the default anchor element for a positioned element. This default is used by position-area and position-try, and by anchor functions (anchor() and anchor-size()) when no argument is provided to those functions.
67d426f4e6b857bf.translationZh: 位置锁定器 CSS 属性指定定位元素的默认锚定元素 。 这种默认用于位置区和位置 Try,以及在不为这些函数提供参数时用于锚定函数(锚定器()和锚定大小()).

b3775f178ece725e.original: The position-area CSS property enables an anchor-positioned element to be positioned relative to the edges of its associated anchor element by placing the positioned element on one or more tiles of an implicit 3x3 grid, where the anchoring element is the center cell.
b3775f178ece725e.translationZh: 位置区 CSS 属性使锚定点元素相对于其相关锚定点元素的边缘定位,将位置元素放置在隐含的3x3格的一块或数块上,其中锚定点元素为中心单元格.

9b65f544749764ca.original: The position-try CSS shorthand property corresponds to the position-try-order and position-try-fallbacks properties.
9b65f544749764ca.translationZh: 位置-try CSS 的短手属性对应位置-try顺序和位置-try回落属性.

0b92f3c9d1f31b65.original: The position-try-fallbacks CSS property enables you to specify a list of one or more alternative position try fallback options for anchor-positioned elements to be placed relative to their associated anchor elements. When the element would otherwise overflow its inset-modified containing block, the browser will try placing the positioned element in these different fallback positions, in the order provided, until it finds a value that stops it from overflowing its container or the viewport.
0b92f3c9d1f31b65.translationZh: 位置- try-falls CSS 属性使您能够指定一个或多个替代位置的列表,尝试对锁定位置的元素进行相对于其关联锚要素的置放的倒置选项. 当元素否则会溢出其嵌入式修改后包含的块时,浏览器会尝试按照所提供的顺序将定位元素置于这些不同的倒置位置,直到找到一个值来阻止其溢出容器或景点.

b446561c6a223db7.original: The position-try-order CSS property allows you to specify various fallback options that result in an available position-try fallback being used to set an anchor-positioned element's position, instead of its initial position settings.
b446561c6a223db7.translationZh: 位置- try-order CSS 属性允许您指定各种后退选项,这些选项会导致可用的位置-try后退用于设定锚位元素的位置,而不是其初始位置设置.

a324babc724eafd4.original: The position-visibility CSS property enables conditionally hiding an anchor-positioned element depending on, for example, whether it is overflowing its containing element or the viewport.
a324babc724eafd4.translationZh: 位置可见CSS属性可以有条件地隐藏锚定位置的元素,这取决于其是否溢出其包含的元素或视窗.

1b36ffc5ebfc8084.translationZh: 打印 - 颜色 - 规范

844cb6194cf7e0be.original: The print-color-adjust CSS property sets what, if anything, the user agent may do to optimize the appearance of the element on the output device. By default, the browser is allowed to make any adjustments to the element's appearance it determines to be necessary and prudent given the type and capabilities of the output device.
844cb6194cf7e0be.translationZh: 打印-彩色-adjust CSS 属性设置,如果有的话,用户代理可以做些什么来优化元素在输出设备上的外观. 默认情况下,鉴于输出设备的类型和能力,浏览器被允许对元素的外观作任何它认定是必要和谨慎的调整.

e24c1ae6f849cc74.original: The CSS quotes property sets how the browser should render quotation marks that are automatically added to the HTML q element or added using the open-quotes or close-quotes (or omitted using the no-open-quote and no-close-quote) values of the of the CSS content property.
e24c1ae6f849cc74.translationZh: CSS引用属性设定浏览器应如何将自动添加到HTML q元素的引号或者使用CSS内容属性的开放引号或近引号添加(或省略使用不开放引号或近引号).

5029fa1e180be846.original: The r CSS property defines the radius of a circle. It can only be used with the SVG element. If present, it overrides the circle's attribute.
5029fa1e180be846.translationZh: r CSS 属性定义一个圆的半径. 它只能使用SVG元素. 如果存在,它会超越圆的属性.

bb4c1348518d3480.original: The reading-flow CSS property enables modifying the reading order of child elements of a block, flex, or grid layout. This affects the order in which they are rendered to speech and navigated to when using sequential navigation such as tabbing to links or buttons.
bb4c1348518d3480.translationZh: 读取流 CSS 属性可以修改块,弹性或网格布局中孩子元素的读取顺序. 这影响到在使用顺序导航(例如对链接或按钮的触动)时,将其用于语音和导航的顺序。

6a852be633da5365.original: The reading-order CSS property enables changing the order in which a child of a reading flow container is read relative to its element siblings.
6a852be633da5365.translationZh: 阅读命令CSS属性可以改变阅读流程容器的孩子相对于其元素兄弟姐妹的读取顺序.

65e5bbffc326e1b9.original: The resize CSS property sets whether an element is resizable, and if so, in which directions.
65e5bbffc326e1b9.translationZh: 调整 CSS 属性的大小, 设定元素是否可以重新配置, 如果可以的话, 设定方向 。

16a575373a75b3ee.original: The right CSS property participates in specifying the horizontal position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
16a575373a75b3ee.translationZh: 右侧CSS财产参与指定定位元素的横向位置. 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.

ed3e5b3fa9b23e56.original: The rotate CSS property allows you to specify rotation transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform property.
ed3e5b3fa9b23e56.translationZh: 旋转的 CSS 属性允许您指定旋转转换 单独且独立于转换属性 。 这个地图更适合典型的用户界面使用,并省去在变换属性中需要记住变换功能的确切顺序.

1fcdb2ed47277e87.original: The row-gap CSS property sets the size of the gap (gutters) between an element's rows.
1fcdb2ed47277e87.translationZh: 行-gap CSS属性设置元素行间间间隙(gutters)的大小.

04d76b9e8493e8af.original: The row-rule CSS shorthand property sets the width, style, and color of the line drawn between rows in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
04d76b9e8493e8af.translationZh: 行规则CSS的短手属性在多行网格,弹性,和多列布局中设置行间所划线的宽度,样式和颜色.

8470f591b8183f1a.original: The row-rule-break CSS property sets the behavior for breaking row rules into segments where row rules intersect column gaps.
8470f591b8183f1a.translationZh: 行规则破解 CSS 属性将打破行规则的行为设置为行规则交叉列间隙的区段.

b23570deefe0b59b.original: The row-rule-color CSS property defines the colors of the lines drawn between rows in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
b23570deefe0b59b.translationZh: 行规则-彩色 CSS 属性定义了多行网格,弹性,多列布局中各行之间所绘制的线条的颜色.

9b8b7e9392ce189a.original: The row-rule-style CSS property defines the line style of the lines drawn between rows in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
9b8b7e9392ce189a.translationZh: 行规则风格的CSS属性定义了多行网格,弹性,多列布局中行间所绘制的线条样式.

9c98af3e033b313a.original: The row-rule-visibility-items CSS property defines whether a row-rule segment is painted in gaps adjacent to empty areas.
9c98af3e033b313a.translationZh: 行规则-可见性-项目 CSS 属性定义了行规则段是否在与空区域相邻的空隙中画出来.

6bf3bb3867ebd415.original: The row-rule-width CSS property defines the widths of the lines drawn between rows in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts.
6bf3bb3867ebd415.translationZh: 行规则宽度的 CSS 属性定义了多行网格,弹性,和多列布局中行间所绘制的线的宽度.

0c1d851d5bf51eb0.original: The ruby-align CSS property defines the distribution of the different ruby elements over the base.
0c1d851d5bf51eb0.translationZh: 红宝石-对齐的CSS属性定义了不同红宝石元素在基座上的分布.

a9dd3d84cfcdfbe1.original: The ruby-overhang CSS property specifies whether or not a ruby annotation overhangs any surrounding text.
a9dd3d84cfcdfbe1.translationZh: 红宝石overhang CSS 属性指定红宝石注释是否覆盖任何周边文本 。

0eb731d8998e1c88.original: The ruby-position CSS property defines the position of a ruby element relative to its base element. It can be positioned over the element (over), under it (under), or to the right (inter-character).
0eb731d8998e1c88.translationZh: 红宝石位置 CSS 属性定义了红宝石元素相对于其基元素的位置. 它可以在元素(over)之上,在元素(over)之下(under),或者在右边(inter-charter)放置.

145e649e57a1be73.original: The rule CSS shorthand property sets the width, style, and color of the line drawn between rows and columns in multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting both the column and row rules to the same values.
145e649e57a1be73.translationZh: 规则CSS的短手属性将多排网格,弹性,多列布局中行与列之间所绘制的线条的宽度,样式和颜色设定为相同值的列规则和行规则.

b769fc6e13e81593.original: The rule-break CSS shorthand property sets the behavior for breaking column and row rules into segments where rows and column gaps intersect, setting column-rule-break and row-rule-break to the same value.
b769fc6e13e81593.translationZh: 规则破解 CSS 的短手属性将断列规则的行为设置为行和列间间隙交叉的区段,将列规则破解和行规则破解设定为相同值.

7b23d9c6d5d76cc2.original: The rule-color CSS shorthand property defines the colors of the lines drawn between columns and rows in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the colors of the column and row rules to the same value.
7b23d9c6d5d76cc2.translationZh: 规则-color CSS 短手属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列和行之间所绘制的线条的颜色,将列和行规则的颜色设置为相同的值.

1260be7452fe9d92.original: The rule-style CSS shorthand property defines the line style of the lines drawn between columns and rows in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the styles of the column and row rules to the same value.
1260be7452fe9d92.translationZh: 规则风格的CSS短手属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列和行之间所绘制的线条样式,将列和行规则的样式设置为相同值.

e02a9e83cd4679d8.original: The rule-visibility-items CSS shorthand property defines whether rule segments are painted in both row and column gaps adjacent to empty areas.
e02a9e83cd4679d8.translationZh: 规则可视性-项目 CSS 的短手属性定义规则片段是否在与空区域相邻的行和列间间隙中绘制.

4ee0b55badea8b7c.original: The rule-width CSS shorthand property defines the widths of any lines drawn in the gutters of multi-row grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the widths of the column and row rules to the same value.
4ee0b55badea8b7c.translationZh: 规则宽的 CSS 短手属性定义了多排网格,弹性,和多列布局的沟槽中绘制的任何线条的宽度,将列和行规则的宽度设定为相同的值.

1ad3fce3a9b44b90.original: The rx CSS property defines the x-axis, or horizontal, radius of an SVG and the horizontal curve of the corners of an SVG rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
1ad3fce3a9b44b90.translationZh: rx CSS属性定义了一个SVG的x轴,或水平,半径以及一个SVG矩形的角的横向曲线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.

cf33a94c40f339d0.original: The ry CSS property defines the y-axis, or vertical, radius of an SVG and the vertical curve of the corners of an SVG rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's attribute.
cf33a94c40f339d0.translationZh: ry CSS属性定义了一个SVG的Y轴或垂直半径和一个SVG矩形的角的垂直曲线. 如果存在,它会超越形状的属性.

5d2af88a82f5ceff.original: The scale CSS property allows you to specify scale transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.
5d2af88a82f5ceff.translationZh: 缩放 CSS 属性允许您指定 缩放 转换 , 并独立于 转换 属性 。 这个地图更适合典型的用户界面使用,并节省了在转换值中需要记住转换函数的准确顺序来指定.

d0cef2edb2b1667b.original: The scroll-behavior CSS property sets the behavior for a scrolling box when scrolling is triggered by the navigation or CSSOM scrolling APIs.
d0cef2edb2b1667b.translationZh: 滚动-行为 CSS 属性将滚动由导航或 CSSOM 滚动 API 触发时的行为设置为滚动框.

52fb44c065a60096.original: The scroll-initial-target CSS property enables the definition of elements that are potential snap targets when their ancestor scroll container is first rendered.
52fb44c065a60096.translationZh: 滚动-初始目标 CSS 属性使得在首次提供其祖先滚动容器时能够定义潜在快速目标的要素。

9aab386f4f8d96a7.original: The scroll-margin CSS shorthand property sets all of the scroll margins of an element at once, assigning values much like the margin property does for margins of an element.
9aab386f4f8d96a7.translationZh: 滚动边距 CSS 短手属性将元素的全部滚动边距同时设置, 分配值与元素边距的边距相似 。

822bcab9d745a197.original: The scroll-margin-block CSS shorthand property sets the scroll margins of an element in the block dimension.
822bcab9d745a197.translationZh: 滚动-边距-块 CSS 短手属性设置块维度中元素的滚动边.

911ae22420fee685.original: The scroll-margin-block-end property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the end of the block dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
911ae22420fee685.translationZh: 滚动-边距- 块端属性定义了在块尺寸结尾处的滚动坐标区域的边距, 用于将此框切换到快捷键 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

ae2ae8092495b9b8.translationZh: 滚动- 边距- 块启动

c8018a47fc915a1d.original: The scroll-margin-block-start property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the start of the block dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
c8018a47fc915a1d.translationZh: 滚动- 边距- 块启动属性定义了在块尺寸开头的滚动坐标区域的边距, 用于将此框切换到坐标点 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

96ecc5828e722b9b.original: The scroll-margin-bottom property defines the bottom margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
96ecc5828e722b9b.translationZh: 滚动边距- 底部属性定义了用于将此框剪切到剪切口的滚动坐标区域的底边 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

975908f3ba8bf676.original: The scroll-margin-inline CSS shorthand property sets the scroll margins of an element in the inline dimension.
975908f3ba8bf676.translationZh: 滚动-边距-内置 CSS 短手属性设置内置维度中元素的滚动边距.

8f7258351034d59f.original: The scroll-margin-inline-end property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the end of the inline dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
8f7258351034d59f.translationZh: 滚动-边距-内端属性定义了用于将此框剪切到剪切口的内侧尺寸末端的滚动坐标区域边距。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

1da6ac447548bf92.translationZh: 滚动边距- 内置启动

b6e2ed923b94557d.original: The scroll-margin-inline-start property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the start of the inline dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
b6e2ed923b94557d.translationZh: 滚动边距- 内线启动属性定义了滚动坐标区域在内线维度起始处的边距, 用于将此框切换到坐标端口 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

ed5435c8445d029f.original: The scroll-margin-left property defines the left margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
ed5435c8445d029f.translationZh: 滚动- 边距- 左侧属性定义了用于将此框剪辑到剪辑口的滚动坐标区域的左侧边距 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

942d68e32527660a.original: The scroll-margin-right property defines the right margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
942d68e32527660a.translationZh: 滚动- 边距- 右侧属性定义了用于将此框剪辑到剪辑口的滚动坐标区域的右侧边距。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

fede2ceaf7c0dd37.original: The scroll-margin-top property defines the top margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container's coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.
fede2ceaf7c0dd37.translationZh: 滚动边距- 顶端属性定义了用于将此框抓到抓图的滚动坐标区域的顶端边距 。 卷轴坐标区域通过取变换的边框,找到其矩形边框(轴对齐在卷轴容器的坐标空间)来决定,然后添加指定的起始点.

cccd4aedaa3858ad.original: The scroll-marker-group CSS property controls whether a scroll container element has a ::scroll-marker-group pseudo-element generated. If present, the property also specifies whether the scroll marker group should be placed before or after the contents of the scroll group container in the default visual and tab order.
cccd4aedaa3858ad.translationZh: 滚动标记组 CSS 属性控制一个滚动容器元素是否有 *scroll-marker-组伪元素生成. 如果存在,则属性还指定滚动标记组应放在滚动组容器内容之前还是之后的默认视觉和标签顺序中.

ed2b2082840f1e82.original: The scroll-padding CSS shorthand property sets scroll padding on all sides of an element at once. It specifies offsets that define the optimal viewing region of a scrollport within a scroll container.
ed2b2082840f1e82.translationZh: 滚动刻录 CSS 短手属性将滚动刻录在元素的四边。 它具体规定了用于定义滚动容器内滚动端口最佳视图区域的抵消。

981c3fc29309b5c0.original: The scroll-padding-block CSS shorthand property sets the scroll padding of an element in the block dimension.
981c3fc29309b5c0.translationZh: CSS 的缩写属性设置了块维度中元素的滚动粘贴.

c16d4f088edf0871.translationZh: 滚动- 打印- 块端

273b8bbdaa1b5428.original: The scroll-padding-block-end property defines offsets for the end edge in the block dimension of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
273b8bbdaa1b5428.translationZh: 卷轴-铺设-块端属性定义了卷轴口最佳视图区域的块维度的端边的偏移:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

1e414270055da50b.translationZh: 滚动- 打印- 块启动

b256fe3dc70163b0.original: The scroll-padding-block-start property defines offsets for the start edge in the block dimension of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
b256fe3dc70163b0.translationZh: 滚动-铺设-块启动属性定义了滚动港最佳视图区域块维度的起始边:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域。 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

1b6d1e51bffd27a8.original: The scroll-padding-bottom property defines offsets for the bottom of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
1b6d1e51bffd27a8.translationZh: 滚动-铺面-底部属性定义了滚动端最佳视图区域的底部的抵消:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域。 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

990df4a99b87c6bf.original: The scroll-padding-inline CSS shorthand property sets the scroll padding of an element in the inline dimension.
990df4a99b87c6bf.translationZh: 滚动-内嵌 CSS 的短手属性设置内嵌维度中元素的滚动粘贴.

6135fed47a0f564c.translationZh: 滚动- 打印- 内置端

2af6740b93369cdd.original: The scroll-padding-inline-end property defines offsets for the end edge in the inline dimension of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
2af6740b93369cdd.translationZh: 卷轴-铺面-内端属性定义了卷轴口最佳视图区域的内置维度中端边的偏移:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

caaad935eea10b38.translationZh: 滚动- 打印- 内置启动

4b9a03314aa3a87b.original: The scroll-padding-inline-start property defines offsets for the start edge in the inline dimension of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
4b9a03314aa3a87b.translationZh: 滚动-铺设-内线启动属性定义了滚动口最佳视图区域内置维度的起始边缘偏移:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

14a0518db58047d8.original: The scroll-padding-left property defines offsets for the left of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
14a0518db58047d8.translationZh: 卷轴-左侧属性定义了卷轴端口最佳视图区域的左侧偏移:用于将事物置于用户视线下的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

bc02ca913d866605.original: The scroll-padding-right property defines offsets for the right of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
bc02ca913d866605.translationZh: 卷轴平面右侧属性定义了卷轴端口最佳视图区域的权利的抵消:用于将事物置于用户视线下的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

f9ab3c3fc0755dcd.translationZh: 滚动- 打印- 顶端

3c44121eb5bf5261.original: The scroll-padding-top property defines offsets for the top of the optimal viewing region of the scrollport: the region used as the target region for placing things in view of the user. This allows the author to exclude regions of the scrollport that are obscured by other content (such as fixed-positioned toolbars or sidebars) or to put more breathing room between a targeted element and the edges of the scrollport.
3c44121eb5bf5261.translationZh: 卷轴-铺面-顶部属性定义了卷轴端口最佳取景区域的顶端的抵消:用于将事物置于用户视野内的目标区域. 这使得作者可以排除卷轴port中被其他内容(如固定位置的工具栏或侧边栏)遮蔽的区域,或者在目标元素和卷轴port边缘之间设置更多的呼吸空间.

def5df24f0592893.original: The scroll-snap-align property specifies the box's snap position as an alignment of its snap area (as the alignment subject) within its snap container's snap port (as the alignment container).
def5df24f0592893.translationZh: 滚动-snap-ign属性指定了盒的坐标位置,作为其坐标容器的坐标端口(作为坐标容器)内的坐标区域(作为坐标标的)的坐标位置。

69087819b03b10c6.original: The scroll-snap-stop CSS property defines whether or not the scroll container is allowed to "pass over" possible snap positions.
69087819b03b10c6.translationZh: 滚动-snap-stop CSS属性定义了滚动容器是否允许"通过"可能的坐标位置.

80bb6fb72b14beda.original: The scroll-snap-type CSS property is set on a scroll container, opting it into scroll snapping by setting the direction and strictness of snap point enforcement within the snap port.
80bb6fb72b14beda.translationZh: 卷轴-snap-型CSS属性设置在一个卷轴容器上,通过在卷轴端口内设定坐标点执行的方向和严格性,将其选择为滚动抓取.

16a6120b3a9da595.original: The scroll-target-group CSS property specifies whether an element is a scroll marker group container.
16a6120b3a9da595.translationZh: 滚动-目标组 CSS 属性指定元素是否为滚动标记组容器 。

1279c50d8d550360.original: The scroll-timeline CSS shorthand property is used to define a named scroll progress timeline, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller) between top and bottom (or left and right).
1279c50d8d550360.translationZh: 卷轴时间线CSS的短手属性用于定义一个命名的卷轴进度时间表,通过在上下(或左右)之间滚动一个可滚动元素(滚动器)来推进.

bab68d555b5ed362.original: The scroll-timeline-axis CSS property is used to specify the scrollbar direction that will be used to provide the timeline for a scroll driven animation, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller).
bab68d555b5ed362.translationZh: 滚动时轴 CSS 属性用于指定滚动条方向,用于提供滚动驱动动画的时长,通过滚动可滚动元素(croller)推进.

4e3bfd43941f69dd.original: The scroll-timeline-name CSS property is used to define the name of a named scroll progress timeline, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller) between top and bottom (or left and right). scroll-timeline-name is set on the scroller that will provide the timeline.
4e3bfd43941f69dd.translationZh: 卷轴-时间线名称 CSS 属性用于定义一个命名的卷轴进度时间表的名称,通过在上下(或左右)之间滚动一个可滚动元素(滚动器)来推进. 滚动-时间线名称设置在提供时间轴的滚动器上.

25a7bbe5074b54de.original: The scrollbar-color CSS property sets the color of the scrollbar track and thumb.
25a7bbe5074b54de.translationZh: 滚动条-彩色 CSS 属性设置滚动条音轨和拇指的颜色.

c809c753e2593cab.original: The scrollbar-gutter CSS property allows authors to reserve space for the scrollbar, preventing unwanted layout changes as the content grows while also avoiding unnecessary visuals when scrolling isn't needed.
c809c753e2593cab.translationZh: 滚动条-gutter CSS属性允许作者为滚动条保留空间,防止随着内容的增长而出现不必要的布局变化,同时避免在不需要滚动时出现不必要的视觉.

3f5bf1366d0df91f.original: The scrollbar-width property allows the author to set the desired thickness of an element's scrollbars when they are shown.
3f5bf1366d0df91f.translationZh: 滚动条-宽度属性允许作者在显示元素滚动条时设定其想要的厚度.

b09ce2b6b505727d.original: The shape-image-threshold CSS property sets the alpha channel threshold used to extract the shape using an image as the value for shape-outside.
b09ce2b6b505727d.translationZh: 形状-图像-阈值 CSS 属性设定了用于以图像作为形状外值提取形状的α通道阈值.

4505e4c299e488a2.original: The shape-margin CSS property sets a margin for a CSS shape created using shape-outside.
4505e4c299e488a2.translationZh: 形状边距 CSS 属性为使用形状外侧创建的 CSS 形状设置了边距 。

b11b2ddb14d99bb6.original: The shape-outside CSS property defines a shape—which may be non-rectangular—around which adjacent inline content should wrap. By default, inline content wraps around its margin box; shape-outside provides a way to customize this wrapping, making it possible to wrap text around complex objects rather than rectangular boxes.
b11b2ddb14d99bb6.translationZh: CSS外侧的形状属性定义了一个形状——可能是非矩形的——周围,相邻的内线内容应该包起来。 默认情况下,内线内容会环绕它的边框;形状外侧提供了一种自定义这种包装的方法,使得可以围绕复杂的对象而不是长方形框来包裹文字.

3694fac8acbff8db.original: The shape-rendering CSS property provides hints to the renderer about what tradeoffs to make when rendering shapes like paths, circles, or rectangles. It only has an effect on the , , , , , , and elements. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides the any values of the element's attribute.
3694fac8acbff8db.translationZh: 形状递归的CSS属性为渲染器提供了在渲染形状如路径,圆圈,或矩形时如何权衡的提示. 它只会对,,,,,,和元素产生影响. 如果明确声明,CSS属性的值将超过元素属性的任何值.

56a37658853a0ce5.original: The speak-as CSS property is used to define how HTML content is spoken. The one to three enumerated key terms determine the manner by which elements and text get rendered by aural technologies, such as screen reader and digital assistants.
56a37658853a0ce5.translationZh: CSS 属性用于定义 HTML 内容的表达方式。 所列举的一到三个关键术语决定了元件和文本通过屏幕阅读器和数字助理等人工技术获得的方式.

69b02938967d7463.original: The stop-color CSS property defines the color to use for an SVG element within a gradient. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
69b02938967d7463.translationZh: stop-color CSS 属性定义了在梯度内用于 SVG 元素的颜色. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

0e29bf6783486790.original: The stop-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of a given color gradient stop in the SVG element within an SVG gradient. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
0e29bf6783486790.translationZh: stop-opacity CSS 属性定义了 SVG 梯度内 SVG 元素中给定的颜色梯度停止的不透明度. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

a4f6f2d7e72aa852.original: The stroke CSS property defines the color or SVG paint server used to draw an element's stroke. As such, stroke only has an effect on elements that can be given a stroke (for example, or ); see the page on the SVG attribute for a complete list. When declared, the CSS value overrides any value of the element's SVG attribute.
a4f6f2d7e72aa852.translationZh: 中风 CSS 属性定义了用于绘制元素中风的颜色或 SVG 涂料服务器. 因此,中风只对可以给予中风的元素产生影响(例如,或.);完整列表参见SVG属性上的页面. 声明时,CSS值将超过元素SVG属性的任何值.

58b2d5a2cf97a8ed.original: The stroke-dasharray CSS property defines a pattern of dashes and gaps used in the painting of the SVG shape's stroke. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
58b2d5a2cf97a8ed.translationZh: 中风-dasharray CSS属性定义了SVG形状的中风画中使用的破折痕和缺口图案. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

85f3f611162f8fd2.original: The stroke-dashoffset CSS property defines an offset for the starting point of the rendering of an SVG element's associated dash array. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
85f3f611162f8fd2.translationZh: 中风-dashoffset CSS 属性定义了 SVG 元素相关破损阵列渲染的起点的偏移. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

72d271c810aa9a1d.original: The stroke-linecap CSS property defines the shape to be used at the end of open subpaths of SVG elements' unclosed strokes. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
72d271c810aa9a1d.translationZh: 中风线盖 CSS 属性定义了在 SVG 元素的未闭合中风的开放子路径末端使用的形状. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

74dcbbf148dcc561.original: The stroke-linejoin CSS property defines the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked paths. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
74dcbbf148dcc561.translationZh: 中风线连接 CSS 属性定义了 SVG 元素中风路径的角落所使用的形状. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

62c36b9b10fabe07.original: The stroke-miterlimit CSS property defines a limit on the ratio of the miter length to the stroke-width when the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked path is a mitered join. If the limit defined by this property is exceeded, the join is converted from miter to bevel, thus making the corner appear truncated.
62c36b9b10fabe07.translationZh: 中风-中风限制 CSS 属性定义了当 SVG 元素中风路径的角落所使用的形状是中风-width 中风长度与中风-width 比例的上限. 如果超过此属性所定义的限度,则结合从miter转换为belvel,从而使得角显得截断.

69854762440a43e4.original: The stroke-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of an SVG shape's stroke. The effect is identical to that of , except it is applied only to the stroke, not to the entire element. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
69854762440a43e4.translationZh: 中风偏倾CSS属性定义了SVG形状中风的不透明度. 效果与......相同,但只适用于中风,而不是整个元素。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

31feb9d20a435969.original: The stroke-width CSS property defines the width of a stroke applied to the SVG shape. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
31feb9d20a435969.translationZh: 中风宽度的 CSS 属性定义了适用于 SVG 形状的中风宽度 。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

f19a269524a69e05.original: The tab-size CSS property is used to customize the width of tab characters (U+0009).
f19a269524a69e05.translationZh: 标签大小的CSS属性用于自定义标签字符的宽度(U+0009)。

027c925660302f50.original: The table-layout CSS property sets the algorithm used to lay out table cells, rows, and columns.
027c925660302f50.translationZh: 表格显示的 CSS 属性设置了用于设置表格单元格、行和列的算法。

658f3585fd40c64e.original: The text-align CSS property sets the horizontal alignment of the inline-level content inside a block element or table-cell box. This means it works like vertical-align but in the horizontal direction.
658f3585fd40c64e.translationZh: 文本对齐的 CSS 属性在一个块元素或表格单元格框内设置线内级内容的水平对齐. 这意味着它的工作方式是纵向对齐,但在水平方向上.

0c50a557c4618ac9.original: The text-align-last CSS property sets how the last line of a block or a line, right before a forced line break, is aligned.
0c50a557c4618ac9.translationZh: 文本对齐的最后一行 CSS 属性设置一个块或一行的最后一行在强制换行前的对齐方式 。

ee906e580990601e.original: The text-anchor CSS property aligns a box containing a string of text where the wrapping area is determined from the inline-size property, and the text is then placed relative to the anchor point of the element, which is defined using the and (or and ) attributes. If present, the value of the CSS property overrides any value of the element's attribute.
ee906e580990601e.translationZh: 文本锁定器 CSS 属性对齐一个框,其中包含从内置大小属性中确定包装区域的文本字符串,然后将文本相对于元素的锚点放置,该锚点使用属性和(或)属性定义. 如果存在, CSS 属性的值将压倒元素属性的任何值.

8fefdaf1350cb98e.original: The text-autospace CSS property allows you to specify the space applied between Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) and non-CJK characters.
8fefdaf1350cb98e.translationZh: 文本自动空间 CSS 属性允许您指定在汉语/日语/韩语(CJK)和非CJK字符之间应用的空间.

aecb56885a517c47.original: The text-box CSS shorthand property corresponds to the text-box-trim and text-box-edge properties, which together specify the amount of space to trim from the block-start edge and block-end edge of a text element's block container.
aecb56885a517c47.translationZh: 文本框 CSS 的短手属性对应文本框-trim和文本框-sedge属性,它们共同指定了从文本元素块容器的块启动边缘和块端边缘到剪切的空间.

f7c403ac1466c8ce.original: The text-box-edge CSS property specifies an amount of space to trim from a text element's block container.
f7c403ac1466c8ce.translationZh: 文本框对齐的 CSS 属性指定了文本元素块容器中剪切的空间 。

0b2c79a6253075f5.original: The text-box-trim CSS property specifies which of the over and under edges of text content to trim from a text element's block container.
0b2c79a6253075f5.translationZh: CSS 的文本框属性指定了文本内容的边框到文本元素块容器的剪切线的哪个。

003aec69459856c5.original: The text-combine-upright CSS property sets the combination of characters into the space of a single character. If the combined text is wider than 1em, the user agent must fit the contents within 1em. The resulting composition is treated as a single upright glyph for layout and decoration. This property only has an effect in vertical writing modes.
003aec69459856c5.translationZh: 文本-combine-upright CSS属性将字符组合设置为单个字符的空间. 如果合并文本宽于1em,用户代理必须匹配1em内的内容. 由此形成的成分被作为布局和装饰的单直立格法处理. 此属性只在垂直写入模式中具有效果 。

c026c1af45d08381.original: The text-decoration CSS shorthand property sets the appearance of decorative lines on text. It is a shorthand for text-decoration-line, text-decoration-color, text-decoration-style, and the newer text-decoration-thickness property.
c026c1af45d08381.translationZh: 文本装饰CSS的短手属性设置了文本上装饰线的外观. 它是文本装饰线,文本装饰色,文本装饰风格的简称,也是较新的文本装饰层层属性.

6812a0b2647b8717.original: The text-decoration-color CSS property sets the color of decorations added to text by text-decoration-line.
6812a0b2647b8717.translationZh: 文本-装饰-彩色 CSS 属性通过文本-装饰-行设置添加到文本中的装饰的颜色.

982d5fc2634996e7.original: The text-decoration-inset CSS property enables adjusting the start and end points of an element's text decoration so it can be shortened, lengthened, or have its position shifted with respect to the rendered text.
982d5fc2634996e7.translationZh: 文本装饰-设置 CSS 属性可以调整元素文本装饰的起始点和结尾点,从而可以缩短、加长或改变其对已渲染文本的立场。

28c5027d7e02c0ce.original: The text-decoration-line CSS property sets the kind of decoration that is used on text in an element, such as an underline or overline.
28c5027d7e02c0ce.translationZh: 文本-装饰-行 CSS 属性在元素中设置文本中使用的装饰类型,如下划线或上划线.

2486ada20d762fd7.original: The text-decoration-skip CSS property sets what parts of an element's content any text decoration affecting the element must skip over. It controls all text decoration lines drawn by the element and also any text decoration lines drawn by its ancestors.
2486ada20d762fd7.translationZh: 文本装饰- skip CSS 属性设定元素内容中任何影响元素的文本装饰必须跳过 。 它控制元素绘制的所有文字装饰线,以及其祖先绘制的任何文字装饰线.

f1d993e994db252c.original: The text-decoration-skip-ink CSS property specifies how overlines and underlines are drawn when they pass over glyph ascenders and descenders.
f1d993e994db252c.translationZh: 文本装饰-skip-ink CSS 属性指定了过格律升降器和降降格器时如何划线和下划线.

c41914141446444f.original: The text-decoration-style CSS property sets the style of the lines specified by text-decoration-line. The style applies to all lines that are set with text-decoration-line.
c41914141446444f.translationZh: 文本装饰风格的CSS属性设置了文本装饰线所指定的行的样式. 样式适用于所有设置有文字装饰线的行.

7aa63bd28d29c5c8.original: The text-decoration-thickness CSS property sets the stroke thickness of the decoration line that is used on text in an element, such as a line-through, underline, or overline.
7aa63bd28d29c5c8.translationZh: 文本-装饰-厚度 CSS 属性设置在一个元素中用于文本的装饰线的中风厚度,例如线通过,下划线,或上线.

088f72a921c2271b.original: The text-emphasis CSS shorthand property applies emphasis marks to text (except spaces and control characters).
088f72a921c2271b.translationZh: 文本强调的CSS短手属性对文本(空格和控件字符除外)应用了强调标记.

ddd879b675283320.original: The text-emphasis-color CSS property sets the color of emphasis marks. This value can also be set using the text-emphasis shorthand.
ddd879b675283320.translationZh: 文字-强调-颜色 CSS 属性设置了强调标记的颜色. 此值也可以使用文本强调的简写设定 。

172c7a40829c5fee.original: The text-emphasis-position CSS property sets where emphasis marks are drawn. Similar to the text rendered by the HTML element, if there isn't enough room for emphasis marks, the line height is increased.
172c7a40829c5fee.translationZh: 标注了重点的CSS属性的文本加亮位置。 与HTML元素所渲染的文字类似,如果没有足够的强调标记空间,则会增加行高.

324627f51fa04309.original: The text-emphasis-style CSS property sets the appearance of emphasis marks. It can also be set, and reset, using the text-emphasis shorthand.
324627f51fa04309.translationZh: 文本强调式CSS属性设置了强调标记的外观. 也可以设置,并重置,使用文字强调的简写.

ab8559ca4f3e0546.original: The text-indent CSS property sets the length of empty space (indentation) that is put before lines of text in a block.
ab8559ca4f3e0546.translationZh: 文本缩进 CSS 属性设置在块中文本行之前的空格(缩进)长度 。

dca12ef0fc2a1f7f.original: The text-justify CSS property sets what type of justification should be applied to text when text-align is set on an element.
dca12ef0fc2a1f7f.translationZh: 文本说明CSS属性,在文本对齐设定在某一要素时,对文本应用何种类型的理由。

80431a687b4159e2.original: The text-orientation CSS property sets the orientation of the text characters in a line. It only affects text in vertical mode (when writing-mode is not horizontal-tb). It is useful for controlling the display of languages that use vertical script, and also for making vertical table headers.
80431a687b4159e2.translationZh: 文本导向 CSS 属性将文本字符的方向设置在一行中. 它只在垂直模式下影响文字(当写-mode不是水平-tb时). 用于控制使用垂直脚本的语言的显示,也用于制作垂直的表头.

7724525f3dd52d7a.original: The text-overflow CSS property sets how hidden overflow content is signaled to users.
7724525f3dd52d7a.translationZh: 文本流 CSS 属性设定隐藏的溢出内容如何向用户发出信号.

2c559456ab78ee94.original: The text-rendering CSS property provides information to the rendering engine about what to optimize for when rendering text.
2c559456ab78ee94.translationZh: 文本发送的 CSS 属性为渲染引擎提供了在渲染文本时需要优化的信息.

945f834b71186c43.original: The text-shadow CSS property adds shadows to text. It accepts a comma-separated list of shadows to be applied to the text and any of its text-decoration. Each shadow is described by some combination of X and Y offsets from the element, blur radius, and color.
945f834b71186c43.translationZh: 文本阴影 CSS 属性在文本中添加阴影 。 它接受一个逗号分隔的阴影列表,用于文本及其任何文本装饰. 每个阴影都由元素的X和Y抵消,模糊半径,和颜色的某种组合来描述.

af43744123f2c656.original: The text-size-adjust CSS property controls the text inflation algorithm used on some smartphones and tablets. Other browsers will ignore this property.
af43744123f2c656.translationZh: 文本大小的规范CSS属性控制了一些智能手机和平板电脑中使用的文本膨胀算法. 其他浏览器会忽略此属性.

143efed5438928eb.original: The text-spacing-trim CSS property controls the internal spacing set on Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) punctuation characters between adjacent characters (kerning) and at the start or end of text lines.
143efed5438928eb.translationZh: 文本间距-trim CSS属性控制了中/日/韩(CJK) punctuation字符在相邻字符(kerning)之间以及文本行开头或结尾处的内部间隔.

2e1af7519499e57f.original: The text-transform CSS property specifies how to capitalize an element's text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. It also can help improve legibility for ruby.
2e1af7519499e57f.translationZh: 文本转换 CSS 属性指定如何利用元素的文本 。 它可以用来使文本出现在全大写或全小写中,或者每个单词都资本化. 也可以帮助提高红宝石的可视性.

6bf3fb9d73ac1a9b.original: The text-underline-offset CSS property sets the offset distance of an underline text decoration line (applied using text-decoration) from its original position.
6bf3fb9d73ac1a9b.translationZh: 文本下置的 CSS 属性设置了下划线文本装饰线(使用文本装饰)与原位置的抵消距离.

0c9a4f6ffb7ee6d2.original: The text-underline-position CSS property specifies the position of the underline which is set using the text-decoration property's underline value.
0c9a4f6ffb7ee6d2.translationZh: 文本下行位置 CSS 属性指定了使用文本装饰属性下划线值设置的下划线位置 。

5d910ffc96fbbebd.original: The text-wrap CSS shorthand property controls how text inside an element is wrapped. The different values provide:
5d910ffc96fbbebd.translationZh: 文本 Wrap CSS 短手属性控制元素内部的文本是如何包裹的 。 不同的数值提供:

b10267adc8543477.original: The text-wrap-mode CSS property controls whether the text inside an element is wrapped.
b10267adc8543477.translationZh: 文本- wrap- mode CSS 属性控制元素内部的文本是否被包裹 。

58e530ed9b5a28e7.original: The text-wrap-style CSS property controls how text inside an element is wrapped, providing alternate ways of determining where to create line breaks in order to fit the content within a block element.
58e530ed9b5a28e7.translationZh: 文本- wrap 风格 CSS 属性控制元素内部的文本是怎样包裹的,提供了选择方法来决定在哪里创建换行符,以适应块元素中的内容.

94eb04333f1f8c68.original: The timeline-scope CSS property modifies the scope of a named animation timeline.
94eb04333f1f8c68.translationZh: 时间范围 CSS 属性修改了命名动画时间范围.

0e0fedba0e81f86e.original: The top CSS property sets the vertical position of a positioned element. This inset properties has no effect on non-positioned elements.
0e0fedba0e81f86e.translationZh: CSS顶部属性设置了位置元素的垂直位置. 这种内置属性对非定位元素没有影响.

724541732faadc23.original: The touch-action CSS property sets how an element's region can be manipulated by a touchscreen user (for example, by zooming features built into the browser).
724541732faadc23.translationZh: 触摸动作CSS属性设定了一个元素的区域如何被触摸屏用户操纵(例如,通过放大浏览器中构建的特性).

09b5592b4399df4b.original: The transform CSS property lets you rotate, scale, skew, or translate an element. It modifies the coordinate space of the CSS visual formatting model.
09b5592b4399df4b.translationZh: 转换 CSS 属性允许您旋转、 缩放、 扭曲或翻译元素 。 它修改了CSS视觉格式化模型的坐标空间.

e65f8cf757cdc245.original: The transform-box CSS property defines the layout box to which the transform, individual transform properties translate, scale, and rotate, and transform-origin properties relate.
e65f8cf757cdc245.translationZh: 变换箱 CSS 属性定义了变换,个人变换属性翻译,规模化,旋转,变换原产属性相关的布局框.

42ed91a198d4c0e7.original: The transform-origin CSS property sets the origin for an element's transformations.
42ed91a198d4c0e7.translationZh: 变换原产地CSS财产为元素的变换设定了原产地.

060a1e09b8a9de28.original: The transform-style CSS property sets whether children of an element are positioned in the 3D space or are flattened in the plane of the element.
060a1e09b8a9de28.translationZh: 变换风格的CSS属性设定一个元素的子孙是否位于3D空间,或者在元素的平面上被平整.

8c2668170704fc4c.original: The transition CSS shorthand property for transition-property, transition-duration, transition-timing-function, transition-delay, and transition-behavior.
8c2668170704fc4c.translationZh: 过渡-财产、过渡-期限、过渡-激励-功能、过渡-延迟和过渡-行为过渡的CSS短手财产。

9c7e0caf504ad63e.original: The transition-behavior CSS property specifies whether transitions will be started for properties whose animation behavior is discrete.
9c7e0caf504ad63e.translationZh: 过渡行为 CSS 属性指定,对于动画行为是离散的属性,是否将启动过渡.

345f6dfa449dd4d2.original: The transition-delay CSS property specifies the duration to wait before starting a property's transition effect when its value changes.
345f6dfa449dd4d2.translationZh: 过渡-延迟 CSS 属性指定了等待时间, 以在属性值变化时启动属性的过渡效果 。

d2da4ba106a57e1a.original: The transition-duration CSS property sets the length of time a transition animation should take to complete. By default, the value is 0s, meaning that no animation will occur.
d2da4ba106a57e1a.translationZh: CSS的过渡期限属性设定了过渡动画完成所需的时间长度. 默认值为0s,表示不会发生动画.

9415c004c56028ce.original: The transition-property CSS property sets the CSS properties to which a transition effect should be applied.
9415c004c56028ce.translationZh: 过渡财产CSS财产设定了应适用过渡效应的CSS财产.

724adf57d63a9b35.original: The transition-timing-function CSS property sets how intermediate values are calculated for CSS properties being affected by a transition effect.
724adf57d63a9b35.translationZh: CSS 属性如何计算受过渡效应影响的CSS属性的中间值。

503ced2163217b9f.original: The translate CSS property allows you to specify translation transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.
503ced2163217b9f.translationZh: 翻译的 CSS 属性允许您指定翻译转换 , 并独立于转换属性 。 这个地图更适合典型的用户界面使用,并节省了在转换值中需要记住转换函数的准确顺序来指定.

a6aea879bef85580.original: The unicode-bidi CSS property, together with the direction property, determines how bidirectional text in a document is handled. For example, if a block of content contains both left-to-right and right-to-left text, the user-agent uses a complex Unicode algorithm to decide how to display the text. The unicode-bidi property overrides this algorithm and allows the developer to control the text embedding.
a6aea879bef85580.translationZh: Unicode-bidi CSS 属性,连同方向属性,决定文档中双向文本的处理方式. 例如,如果一个块的内容既包含左对右文本,也包含右对左文本,则用户代理使用复杂的Unicode算法来决定如何显示文本. unicode-bidi属性凌驾于此算法,允许开发者控制文本嵌入.

26d82f143e67d32a.original: The user-modify property has no effect in Firefox. It was originally planned to determine whether or not the content of an element can be edited by a user.
26d82f143e67d32a.translationZh: 用户修改属性在Firefox中没有效果. 最初计划确定一个元素的内容是否可以由用户编辑.

67bb608d52746efe.original: The user-select CSS property controls whether the user can select text. This doesn't have any effect on content loaded as part of a browser's user interface (its Chrome), except in textboxes.
67bb608d52746efe.translationZh: 用户选择的 CSS 属性控制用户是否能够选择文本 。 这对作为浏览器用户界面(its Chrome)的一部分加载的内容没有任何影响,除了文本框.

1b12b246855e850b.original: The vector-effect CSS property suppresses specific transformation effects in SVG, thus permitting effects like a road on a map staying the same width no matter how the map is zoomed, or allowing a diagram key to retain its position and size regardless of other transforms. It can only be used with SVG elements that accept the attribute. When used, the CSS value overrides any values of the element's vector-effect attribute.
1b12b246855e850b.translationZh: 矢量效应 CSS 属性在 SVG 中抑制特定的变换效果,从而可以像地图上的道路一样保持相同的宽度,无论地图如何缩放,或者允许图键保留其位置和大小,无论其他变换如何. 它只能与接受属性的SVG元素一起使用. 使用时,CSS值会凌驾于元素的矢量效应属性的任何值.

ff5fc75ec0b89a86.original: The vertical-align CSS shorthand property sets the vertical alignment of an inline, inline-block, or table-cell box.
ff5fc75ec0b89a86.translationZh: 垂直对齐的 CSS 短手属性设置一个内线,内线块,或表格单元格框的垂直对齐.

65a999a400bd3e97.original: The view-timeline CSS shorthand property defines a named view progress timeline's name, direction, and inset values.
65a999a400bd3e97.translationZh: 视图时线 CSS 的短手属性定义了一个命名的视图进度时间表的名称,方向,以及设置的值.

87b8bdcbc612ce0e.original: The view-timeline-axis CSS property specifies the scroll direction to be used for a named view progress timeline.
87b8bdcbc612ce0e.translationZh: 视图时轴 CSS 属性指定了用于命名视图进度时间表的滚动方向.

cdf763281c575145.original: The view-timeline-inset CSS property is used to specify one or two values representing an adjustment to the position of the scrollport (see Scroll container for more details) in which the subject element of a named view progress timeline animation is deemed to be visible. Put another way, this allows you to specify start and/or end inset (or outset) values that offset the position of the timeline.
cdf763281c575145.translationZh: 视图-时线-设置 CSS 属性用于指定一个或两个值,表示对滚动端口位置的调整(详见Scroll 容器),其中一个命名的视图进度时序动画的主题要素被视为可见. 换句话说, 这使得您可以指定设置( 或初始) 的起始和/ 结束值来抵消时间线的位置 。

e144bd9f08d8cd13.original: The view-timeline-name CSS property specifies the names of one or more named view progress timelines associated with the element.
e144bd9f08d8cd13.translationZh: 视图时线名称 CSS 属性指定了与元素相关的一个或多个命名视图进度时间段的名称.

8413b21c3c5eb757.original: The view-transition-class CSS property provides the selected elements with one or more identifying classes (custom-idents), providing an additional method of styling the view transitions for those elements.
8413b21c3c5eb757.translationZh: 视图过渡类CSS属性为选定的元素提供了一个或多个识别类(custom-IDents),为这些元素的视图过渡提供了另一种造型方法.

e9b3ef810037b381.original: The view-transition-name CSS property specifies the view transition snapshot that selected elements will participate in. This enables you to animate those elements separately from the rest of the page, which uses the default cross-fade animation during a view transition. You can then define custom animation styles for these elements.
e9b3ef810037b381.translationZh: 视图- 过渡名称 CSS 属性指定选定元素将参与的视图过渡快照 。 这使得您可以将这些元素与页面的其余部分分开激活,这些部分在视图过渡时使用默认的交叉虚构动画. 然后可以定义这些元素的自定义动画风格.

e1558dc110fbeea0.original: The view-transition-scope CSS property enables the discoverability of elements with view-transition-name values set on them (and therefore the creation of view transition snapshots) to be isolated to a specific element subtree.
e1558dc110fbeea0.translationZh: 视图-过渡范围 CSS 属性使设定在它们上的视图-过渡名称值的元素的可发现性(因此创建视图过渡快照)被隔离到特定的元素子树.

a8a5ba2b1649fc0b.original: The visibility CSS property shows or hides an element without changing the layout of a document. The property can also hide rows or columns in a table.
a8a5ba2b1649fc0b.translationZh: 可见度 CSS 属性在不改变文档布局的情况下显示或隐藏元素. 属性也可以在表格中隐藏行或列.

4e0d7af030baa53f.original: The white-space CSS shorthand property sets how whitespace inside an element is handled.
4e0d7af030baa53f.translationZh: 白空 CSS 短手属性设置一个元素内部的白空处理方式 。

cecec31403a446f8.original: The white-space-collapse CSS property controls how whitespace inside an element is collapsed.
cecec31403a446f8.translationZh: 白- 空间- 缩合 CSS 属性控制元素内部的白空间是如何崩溃的 。

9c7be49b5a2211a0.original: The widows CSS property sets the minimum number of lines in a block container that must be shown at the top of a page, region, or column.
9c7be49b5a2211a0.translationZh: 寡妇的CSS财产在一个块状容器中设置最小行数,必须显示在页、区域或栏的顶部。

1fb17379ad355833.original: The width CSS property sets an element's width. By default, it sets the width of the content area, but if box-sizing is set to border-box, it sets the width of the border area.
1fb17379ad355833.translationZh: 宽度 CSS 属性设置元素宽度 。 默认情况下,它会设置内容区域的宽度,但如果将框大小设置为边框,则会设置边框区域的宽度.

179a166aeaade7be.original: The will-change CSS property enables optimizing animations by providing a rendering hint to a browser about how an element is expected to change.
179a166aeaade7be.translationZh: 将更改的 CSS 属性通过向浏览器提供渲染提示来优化动画,从而实现元素的预期变化.

be29a5df612c40b5.original: The word-break CSS property sets whether line breaks appear wherever the text would otherwise overflow its content box.
be29a5df612c40b5.translationZh: 断字 CSS 属性设定, 是否在文本会溢出其内容框的地方出现换行符 。

2a8008926cf3da23.original: The word-spacing CSS property sets the spacing between words and between tags.
2a8008926cf3da23.translationZh: 单词间隔 CSS 属性设置单词之间和标记之间的间隔.

4dec378dec0054e4.original: The writing-mode CSS property sets whether lines of text are laid out horizontally or vertically, as well as the direction in which text flows.
4dec378dec0054e4.translationZh: 写法-模式 CSS 属性设定是横向还是纵向设置的文本行,以及文本流动的方向.

0bb6a50274f384cc.original: The x CSS property defines the x-axis coordinate of the top left corner of the SVG shape, image, viewport or nested viewport relative to the nearest ancestor's user coordinate system. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
0bb6a50274f384cc.translationZh: x CSS属性定义了相对于最近的祖先用户坐标系统的SVG形状左上角的x轴坐标,图像,视图或嵌入式视图port. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

b990320e9f78f26c.original: The y CSS property defines the y-axis coordinate of the top left corner of the SVG shape, image, viewport and nested viewport relative to the nearest ancestor's user coordinate system. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
b990320e9f78f26c.translationZh: y CSS属性定义了相对于最近的祖先用户坐标系统的SVG形状左上角的y轴坐标,图像,视图和嵌入式视图port. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.

a43829672bcda840.original: The z-index CSS property sets the z-order of a positioned element and its descendants or flex and grid items. Overlapping elements with a larger z-index cover those with a smaller one.
a43829672bcda840.translationZh: z-index CSS 属性设置一个位置元素及其后代或弹性和网格项的z-顺序. 用更大的z指数重叠的元素覆盖那些用较小的元素.

21a7d9771c1b7ad3.original: The zoom CSS property can be used to control the magnification level of an element. can be used as an alternative to this property.
21a7d9771c1b7ad3.translationZh: 缩放的 CSS 属性可用于控制元素的放大级. 可用作该财产的替代物。

3b8631ade6229c1a.original: The :-moz-broken CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements representing broken image links.
3b8631ade6229c1a.translationZh: :-moz-brooken CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,匹配代表断裂图像链接的元素.

abbf607c06d65368.original: The :-moz-drag-over CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches an element when a HTMLElement/dragoverevent event is called on it.
abbf607c06d65368.translationZh: :-moz-drag-over CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,在HTMLElement/dragoverevent事件被调用时匹配元素.

560af9b6a818c21c.original: The :-moz-first-node CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that represents any element that is the first child node of some other element. It differs from :first-child because it does not match a first-child element with (non-whitespace) text before it.
560af9b6a818c21c.translationZh: :-moz-first-node CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,代表着某些其他元素的第一个儿童节点的任何元素. 它不同于: 第一子,因为它与其面前的(非白空间)文本不匹配第一子元素.

21b05b69e35c8ee2.original: The :-moz-handler-blocked CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements that can't be displayed because their handlers have been blocked.
21b05b69e35c8ee2.translationZh: :-moz-handler-blocked CSS伪类是Mozilla的扩展,它匹配了由于其处理器被屏蔽而无法显示的元素.

4d6db8ce935a592b.original: The :-moz-handler-crashed CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements that can't be displayed because the plugin responsible for drawing them has crashed.
4d6db8ce935a592b.translationZh: :-moz-handler-crashed CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,它匹配了无法显示的元素,因为负责绘制它们的插件已经崩溃.

25a1fa5cfb093fa7.original: The :-moz-handler-disabled CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements that can't be displayed because their handlers have been disabled by the user.
25a1fa5cfb093fa7.translationZh: :-moz-handler-disabled CSS伪类是Mozilla的扩展,它匹配了无法显示的元素,因为其处理器已被用户禁用.

446eaaea9349f94e.original: The :-moz-last-node CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that represents any element that is the last child node of some other element. It differs from :last-child because it does not match a last-child element with (non-whitespace) text after it.
446eaaea9349f94e.translationZh: :-moz-last-node CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,它代表任何元素,是某些其他元素的最后一个子节点. 它与: last-child 不同,因为它与后面的(非白空)文本不匹配上一个子元素.

f713b79f1dc92dc5.original: The :-moz-loading CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements that can't be displayed because they have not started loading, such as images that haven't started to arrive yet. Note that images that are in the process of loading are not matched by this pseudo-class.
f713b79f1dc92dc5.translationZh: :-moz-loating CSS伪类是Mozilla扩展,它匹配那些因为尚未开始加载而无法显示的元素,例如尚未开始到达的图像. 注意正在装入过程中的图像不匹配此伪类.

f4d7b3c556ed7f9f.original: The :-moz-locale-dir(ltr) CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches an element if the user interface is being displayed left-to-right. This is determined by the preference intl.uidirection.locale (where locale is the current locale) being set to "ltr".
f4d7b3c556ed7f9f.translationZh: :-moz-locale-dir(ltr) CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,如果用户界面显示为左对右,则它匹配一个元素. 这是由偏好intl.uidiction决定的。 locale(其中locale为当前locale)被设置为"ltr".

4cc0e6c6e9c90119.original: The :-moz-locale-dir(rtl) CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches an element if the user interface is being displayed right-to-left. This is determined by the preference intl.uidirection.locale (where locale is the current locale) being set to "rtl".
4cc0e6c6e9c90119.translationZh: :-moz-locale-dir(rtl) CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,如果用户界面被显示在右到左的位置,则它匹配一个元素. 这是由偏好intl.uidiction决定的。 locale(其中locale是当前locale)被设置为"rtl".

2a6ab924476684ec.original: The :-moz-only-whitespace CSS pseudo-class matches elements that only contain text nodes that only contain whitespace. (This includes elements with empty text nodes and elements with no child nodes.)
2a6ab924476684ec.translationZh: :-moz- only-whitespace CSS 伪类元素匹配只包含文本节点且只包含白空间的元素. (这包括带有空文本节点的元素和没有子节点的元素.

1f2220954a8882ee.original: The :-moz-submit-invalid CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that represents any submit button on forms whose contents aren't valid based on their validation constraints.
1f2220954a8882ee.translationZh: :-moz-submit-invalid CSS伪类是Mozilla扩展名,代表其内容根据其验证限制无效的表格上的任何提交按钮.

6bca2d8ca02e623e.original: The :-moz-suppressed CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements representing images that were suppressed because loading images from the specified site has been blocked.
6bca2d8ca02e623e.translationZh: :-moz-suppressed CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,它匹配代表由于从指定的站点装入图像而被压制的图像的元素.

a1aac578a19c71ec.original: The :-moz-user-disabled CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements representing images that were not loaded because images have been entirely disabled by the user's preferences.
a1aac578a19c71ec.translationZh: :-moz-user-disable CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,匹配代表未加载的图像的元素,因为图像已被用户的偏好完全禁用.

d23719b15b101804.original: The :-moz-window-inactive CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches any element while it's in an inactive window.
d23719b15b101804.translationZh: :-moz-window-inactive CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,在不活动窗口时匹配任何元素.

90c525a5bef404f8.original: The :active CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as a button) that is being activated by the user. When using a mouse, "activation" typically starts when the user presses down the primary mouse button.
90c525a5bef404f8.translationZh: :活性CSS伪类代表了用户正在激活的元素(如按钮). 在使用鼠标时,"激活"通常在用户按下主鼠标按钮时开始.

76c8645ef3d608da.original: The :active-view-transition CSS pseudo-class matches the root element of a document when a view transition is in progress (active) and stops matching once the transition has completed.
76c8645ef3d608da.translationZh: :active-view-Terrival CSS伪类在视图过渡正在进行时匹配文档的根元素(active),并在过渡完成后停止匹配.

3680ba96fd2c19dd.translationZh: : 活动视图- 过渡类型( )

5159d2324b0fa3e6.original: The functional :active-view-transition-type() CSS pseudo-class matches elements when a view transition with one or more specific types is in progress (is active) and stops matching once the view transition has completed.
5159d2324b0fa3e6.translationZh: 函数 :活动-视图-过渡型() CSS 假类 匹配元素 当一个带有一个或多个特定类型的视图过渡正在进行中(正在活动),并在视图过渡完成后停止匹配.

aca34fee71750876.original: The :any-link CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that acts as the source anchor of a hyperlink, independent of whether it has been visited. In other words, it matches every a or area element that has an href attribute. Thus, it matches all elements that match :link or :visited.
aca34fee71750876.translationZh: : Any-link CSS 伪类选择器代表着一个元素,它充当超链接的源锚,独立于它是否被访问过. 换句话说,它匹配每个具有href属性的a或区域元素. 因此,它匹配所有匹配:link或:visited的元素.

aefaf1f400cc2ad5.original: The :autofill CSS pseudo-class matches when an input element has its value autofilled by the browser. The class stops matching if the user edits the field.
aefaf1f400cc2ad5.translationZh: 当一个输入元素的值被浏览器自动填充时, 自动填充 CSS 伪类匹配 。 如果用户编辑字段, 类会停止匹配 。

d84f7e82f101ae4a.original: The :blank CSS pseudo-class selects empty user input elements (e.g., input or textarea).
d84f7e82f101ae4a.translationZh: :blank CSS伪类选择空用户输入元素(如输入或文本区).

d66d7046652f370a.original: The :buffering CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is playable, such as audio or video, when the playable element is buffering a media resource.
d66d7046652f370a.translationZh: : 缓冲 CSS 假类选择器代表了可播放元素缓冲媒体资源时可播放的元素,如音频或视频.

dae8a4daa3a5d7af.original: The :checked CSS pseudo-class selector represents any radio ( ), checkbox ( ), or option (option in a select element) that is checked or toggled to an on state.
dae8a4daa3a5d7af.translationZh: : 选中的 CSS 伪类选择器代表任何被选中或切换到状态上的收音机( ) 、 复选框( ) 或选项( 选定元素中的选项) 。

d14eb0cb05fa54dd.original: The :current CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element or the ancestor of an element that is currently being displayed or highlighted.
d14eb0cb05fa54dd.translationZh: : 当前 CSS 伪类选择器代表当前正在显示或突出显示的元素的一个元素或元素的祖先.

da05405b4e460e2d.original: The :default CSS pseudo-class selects form elements that are the default in a group of related elements.
da05405b4e460e2d.translationZh: :default CSS伪类选择一组相关元素中的默认形式元素.

79820de250d3c0a3.original: The :defined CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has been defined. This includes any standard element built into the browser and custom elements that have been successfully defined (i.e., with the CustomElementRegistry.define() method).
79820de250d3c0a3.translationZh: : 定义 CSS 伪类代表任何已定义的元素. 这包括浏览器中包含的任何标准元素和已成功定义的自定义元素(即使用CustomElementRegistry.define()方法).

839cad708377641c.original: The :dir() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on the directionality of the text contained in them.
839cad708377641c.translationZh: :dir() CSS 假类元素基于其中文本的方向性匹配.

1ed18eae85283d25.original: The :disabled CSS pseudo-class represents any disabled element. An element is disabled if it can't be activated (selected, clicked on, typed into, etc.) or accept focus. The element also has an enabled state, in which it can be activated or accept focus.
1ed18eae85283d25.translationZh: : 残疾 CSS 伪类代表任何已禁用的元素. 一个元素如果无法被激活(选择,点击,输入等)或接受焦点,则被禁用. 该元素还具有被启用状态,在这种状态下可以启动或接受焦点.

d3f5021b62815ab5.original: The :empty CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has no children. Children can be either element nodes or text (including whitespace). Comments, processing instructions, and CSS content do not affect whether an element is considered empty.
d3f5021b62815ab5.translationZh: 空空的CSS伪类代表任何没有孩子的元素. 儿童可以是元素节点,也可以是文本(包括白空间). 评论,处理指令,以及CSS内容不影响一个元素是否被认为是空的.

60d6efdf831e2680.original: The :enabled CSS pseudo-class represents any enabled element. An element is enabled if it can be activated (selected, clicked on, typed into, etc.) or accept focus. The element also has a disabled state, in which it can't be activated or accept focus.
60d6efdf831e2680.translationZh: : 启用的 CSS 伪类代表任何启用的元素. 如果一个元素可以被激活(选中、点击、输入等)或接受焦点,则启用。 该元素还具有一个禁用状态,在这种状态下它不能被激活或接受焦点.

b5cbe3d9e653e95e.original: The :first CSS pseudo-class, used with the @page at-rule, represents the first page of a printed document. (See :first-child for general first element of a node.)
b5cbe3d9e653e95e.translationZh: 使用@page at-rule的首个 CSS 假类代表打印文档的首页 。 (一个节点的一般第一元素,见:第一子.
