2a6487b8b5103db7.original: The :first-child CSS pseudo-class represents the first element among a group of sibling elements.
2a6487b8b5103db7.translationZh: :第一子CSS假类代表一组兄弟元素中的第一元素.

c9e721ea5bbf117b.original: The :first-of-type CSS pseudo-class represents the first element of its type (tag name) among a group of sibling elements.
c9e721ea5bbf117b.translationZh: :型号第一的CSS伪类代表其型号(tag name)在一组兄弟姐妹元素中的第一个元素.

6727eb964511025a.original: The :focus CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as a form input) that has received focus. It is generally triggered when the user clicks or taps on an element or selects it with the keyboard's Tab key.
6727eb964511025a.translationZh: 焦点 CSS 假类代表了一个已经获得焦点的元素(如窗体输入). 通常在用户点击或点击某个元素或用键盘的 Tab 键选择某个元素时触发.

12b8af15014ed307.original: The :focus-visible pseudo-class applies while an element matches the :focus pseudo-class and the UA (User Agent) determines via heuristics that the focus should be made evident on the element. (Many browsers show a "focus ring" by default in this case.)
12b8af15014ed307.translationZh: :焦点可见的伪类适用,而一个元素匹配:焦点伪类,而UA(用户代理)则通过Heuristics决定该元素的焦点应当明显. (许多浏览器在此情况下默认显示"焦点环".

4c1235de1ad2b1a3.original: The :focus-within CSS pseudo-class matches an element if the element or any of its descendants are focused. In other words, it represents an element that is itself matched by the :focus pseudo-class or has a descendant that is matched by :focus. (This includes descendants in shadow trees.)
4c1235de1ad2b1a3.translationZh: 如果元素或其任何后代被聚焦,CSS伪类中的:焦点匹配元素. 换句话说,它代表着一个本身与:焦点伪类相匹配的元素,或者有一个与:焦点相匹配的后代. (此包括阴树之后代.

99afa757a581623c.original: The :fullscreen CSS pseudo-class matches every element that is currently in fullscreen mode. If multiple elements have been put into fullscreen mode, this selects them all.
99afa757a581623c.translationZh: : fullscreen CSS 伪类匹配当前全屏模式中的每个元素. 如果多个元素已被放入全屏模式, 则选择全部元素 。

0eff9b494fdefd7d.original: The :future CSS pseudo-class selector is a time-dimensional pseudo-class that will match for any element which appears entirely after an element that matches :current. For example in a video with captions which are being displayed by WebVTT.
0eff9b494fdefd7d.translationZh: :future CSS 伪类选择器是一个时间维的伪类,它将匹配任何完全在匹配: current 的元素之后出现的元素. 例如,在WebVTT显示的带字幕的视频中。

469158397f935403.original: The functional :has() CSS pseudo-class represents an element if any of the relative selectors that are passed as an argument match at least one element when anchored against this element. This pseudo-class presents a way of selecting a parent element or a previous sibling element with respect to a reference element by taking a relative selector list as an argument.
469158397f935403.translationZh: 函数 : has() CSS 伪类代表一个元素,如果任何相对选择器作为参数在锁定此元素时至少匹配一个元素。 此伪类通过将相对选择者列表作为参数来选择一个母元素或之前的比比元素的参考元素.

ffe6531a7b1f173d.original: The :has-slotted CSS pseudo-class matches when the content of a slot element is not empty or not using the default value (see Using templates and slots for more information).
ffe6531a7b1f173d.translationZh: :has-slotted CSS 伪类匹配,当一个位点元素的内容不是空的或者没有使用默认值(更多信息请参见使用模板和位点).

e07fba87a4c48385.original: The :heading CSS pseudo-class matches all heading elements in a document.
e07fba87a4c48385.translationZh: :标题 CSS 假类匹配文档中的所有标题元素。

640c2b28e5a551eb.original: The :heading() CSS pseudo-class function represents all heading elements whose levels match a comma-separated list of integers. This allows you to style elements at specific heading levels at once, rather than matching and styling them individually.
640c2b28e5a551eb.translationZh: :heading () CSS 伪类函数代表所有与逗号分隔的整数列表相匹配的标题元素. 这使得您可以同时在特定标题级别上样式元素,而不是单独匹配和样式.

227364abaac4b8b9.original: The :host CSS pseudo-class selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside — in other words, this allows you to select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM.
227364abaac4b8b9.translationZh: :host CSS伪类选择包含它内部使用的CSS的阴影DOM的阴影主机——换句话说,这允许您从它的阴影DOM内部选择自定义元素.

575fded2f903acd3.original: The :host-context() CSS pseudo-class allows you to style elements within a shadow DOM differently based on the selector of the shadow host (the element that has the shadow root) and its DOM ancestors.
575fded2f903acd3.translationZh: :host-context () CSS 伪类允许您根据阴影主机(具有阴影根的元素)及其 DOM 祖先的选择器,在阴影 DOM 内对元素进行不同的样式.

cb070a761121c8b3.original: The :host() CSS pseudo-class function selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside (so you can select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM) — but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches the shadow host. :host() has no effect when used outside a shadow DOM.
cb070a761121c8b3.translationZh: :host () CSS 假类函数选择包含其内部使用的 CSS 的阴影 DOM 的阴影主机(这样您就可以从它的阴影 DOM 内部选择一个自定义元素)——但前提是作为函数参数给出的选定器与阴影主机匹配. :host()在阴影DOM外使用时没有效果.

8fcf03796c55eac7.original: The :hover CSS pseudo-class matches an element when a user interacts with it using a pointing device. The pseudo-class is generally triggered when the user moves the cursor (mouse pointer) over an element without pressing the mouse button.
8fcf03796c55eac7.translationZh: :hover CSS 假类在用户使用指针设备与其交互时,匹配一个元素. 当用户将光标(mouse pointer)移动到一个元素上而不按鼠标按钮时,通常会触发伪类.

3a249395a6ea7a11.original: The :in-range CSS pseudo-class represents an input element whose current value is within the range limits specified by the min and max attributes.
3a249395a6ea7a11.translationZh: : in-range CSS伪类代表一个输入元素,其当前值在分钟和最大属性指定的范围范围内.

0ce6715e442be238.original: The :indeterminate CSS pseudo-class represents any form element whose state is indeterminate, such as checkboxes that have been set to an indeterminate state with JavaScript, radio buttons which are members of a group in which all radio buttons are unchecked, and progress elements with no value attribute.
0ce6715e442be238.translationZh: :不确定 CSS 伪类代表状态不确定的任意形式元素,如已设置为带有 JavaScript 的不确定状态的复选框,属于所有无线电按钮不受限制的组合的无线电按钮,以及没有值属性的进度元素.

60bd770aaf76a735.original: The :interest-source CSS pseudo-class represents an interest invoker element when interest is shown on it.
60bd770aaf76a735.translationZh: : interest-source CSS 伪类在其中显示利息时代表利息引用元素.

5b2c54c3f25e0d7d.original: The :interest-target CSS pseudo-class represents the target element associated with an interest invoker when interest is shown on that invoker.
5b2c54c3f25e0d7d.translationZh: : 利息目标 CSS 假类,当利息显示于该援引者时,代表与利息援引者相关的目标要素.

4049b0435e2a7262.original: The :invalid CSS pseudo-class represents any form, fieldset, input or other form element whose contents fail to validate.
4049b0435e2a7262.translationZh: :无效的 CSS 伪类代表任何形式,字段集,输入或内容无法验证的其他形式元素.

6792d999a50675a0.original: The :is() CSS pseudo-class function takes a selector list as its argument, and selects any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list. This is useful for writing large selectors in a more compact form.
6792d999a50675a0.translationZh: :is() CSS 伪类函数将一个选择器列表作为其参数,并选择该列表中一个选择器可以选择的任何元素. 这对于以更紧凑的形式写大选择器是有用的.

27042e80ddca6a7c.original: The :lang() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on the language they are determined to be in.
27042e80ddca6a7c.translationZh: :lang() CSS 假类元素根据它们确定使用的语言匹配.

c31ce3d39f8102d1.original: The :last-child CSS pseudo-class represents the last element among a group of sibling elements.
c31ce3d39f8102d1.translationZh: :last-child CSS伪类代表一组兄弟元素中的最后一个元素.

b9d0cef8f0204886.original: The :last-of-type CSS pseudo-class represents the last element of its type (tag name) among a group of sibling elements.
b9d0cef8f0204886.translationZh: :last-type CSS伪类代表其类型(tag name)的最后元素在一组兄弟姐妹元素中.

2a0e78f84514a96e.original: The :left CSS pseudo-class, used with the @page at-rule, represents all left-hand pages of a printed document.
2a0e78f84514a96e.translationZh: 用 @ page at- rule 使用的 :left CSS 伪类, 代表打印文档的所有左手页 。

8185da9c012e2b67.original: The :link CSS pseudo-class represents an element that has not yet been visited. It matches every unvisited a or area element that has an href attribute.
8185da9c012e2b67.translationZh: :link CSS伪类代表尚未访问的元素. 它匹配每个未访问的具有href属性的域元素.

6164fb4549288a3e.original: The :local-link CSS pseudo-class represents a link to the same document. Therefore an element that is the source anchor of a hyperlink whose target's absolute URL matches the element's own document URL.
6164fb4549288a3e.translationZh: : local-link CSS伪类代表同一文档的链接. 因此,一个元素是超链接的源锚,其目标绝对URL与元素自己的文档URL匹配.

1502440971e6fc93.original: The :modal CSS pseudo-class matches an element that is in a state in which it excludes all interaction with elements outside it until the interaction has been dismissed. Multiple elements can be selected by the :modal pseudo-class at the same time, but only one of them will be active and able to receive input.
1502440971e6fc93.translationZh: :module CSS伪类匹配的元素处于一种状态,它排除了与外在元素的所有交互,直到该交互被解析. 多个元素可以同时由: 模式伪类进行选择,但其中只有一个将活动并能够接收输入.

31c98f04044cf2a2.original: The :muted CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is capable of making sound, such as audio or video, but is muted (forced silent).
31c98f04044cf2a2.translationZh: :muded CSS伪类选择器代表能够发出声音的元素,如音频或视频,但被哑音(强制沉默).

95d82d454332a33a.original: The :not() CSS pseudo-class represents elements that do not match a list of selectors. Since it prevents specific items from being selected, it is known as the negation pseudo-class.
95d82d454332a33a.translationZh: :not() CSS伪类代表不匹配选手列表的元素. 由于它阻止特定项目被选中,因此被称为否定伪类.

1e96b5e0e6af9a14.original: The :nth-child() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on the indexes of the elements in the child list of their parents. In other words, the :nth-child() selector selects child elements according to their position among all the sibling elements within a parent element.
1e96b5e0e6af9a14.translationZh: :nth- child () CSS 假类元素与其父母孩子列表中元素的索引匹配. 换句话说,nth- child()选择者根据孩子元素在父母元素中所有兄弟姐妹元素中的位置进行选择.

d0a0918790f1c879.original: The :nth-last-child() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on their position among a group of siblings, counting from the end.
d0a0918790f1c879.translationZh: :nth-last- child() CSS 假类元素根据它们在一组兄弟姐妹中的位置进行匹配,从头算起.

e4b62f05680c0a8e.original: The :nth-last-of-type() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on their position among siblings of the same type (tag name), counting from the end.
e4b62f05680c0a8e.translationZh: :n-last-of () CSS 假类元素根据它们在同类型兄弟姐妹(tag name)中的位置进行匹配,从尾数.

f7ec689347590b3d.original: The :nth-of-type() CSS pseudo-class matches elements based on their position among siblings of the same type (tag name).
f7ec689347590b3d.translationZh: :nth type () CSS 假类元素根据它们在同类型兄弟姐妹中的位置进行匹配(tag name).

193115f975a2439a.original: The :only-child CSS pseudo-class represents an element without any siblings. This is the same as :first-child:last-child or :nth-child(1):nth-last-child(1), but with a lower specificity.
193115f975a2439a.translationZh: :只有孩子的CSS假类代表一个没有兄弟姐妹的元素. 这与:第一胎:最后胎或:nth-child(1):nth-最后胎(1)相同,但特异性较低.

f9ae1646d201b0ff.original: The :only-of-type CSS pseudo-class represents an element that has no siblings of the same type (tag name).
f9ae1646d201b0ff.translationZh: :只有型号的CSS伪类代表一个没有同类型兄弟姐妹的元素(tag name).

894c23011c6cf693.original: The :open CSS pseudo-class represents an element that has open and closed states, only when it is currently in the open state.
894c23011c6cf693.translationZh: :open CSS伪类代表了一个具有开放状态和封闭状态的元素,只有在它目前处于开放状态时.

779d97200eb1e087.original: The :optional CSS pseudo-class represents any input, select, or textarea element that does not have the required attribute set on it.
779d97200eb1e087.translationZh: : optional CSS 假类代表任何输入,选择,或文本区域元素,其中没有所需的属性设置.

7810e0c883f9866d.original: The :out-of-range CSS pseudo-class represents an input element whose current value is outside the range limits specified by the min and max attributes.
7810e0c883f9866d.translationZh: : 外程 CSS 伪类代表一个输入元素,其当前值超出分数和最大属性指定的范围限制.

47473235df1d938b.original: The :past CSS pseudo-class selector is a time-dimensional pseudo-class that will match for any element which appears entirely before an element that matches :current. For example in a video with captions which are being displayed by WebVTT.
47473235df1d938b.translationZh: : past CSS 伪类选择器是一个时间维的伪类,它将匹配完全出现在匹配: current 的元素前的任何元素. 例如,在WebVTT显示的带字幕的视频中。

4f2323a0afa7f849.original: The :paused CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is playable, such as audio or video, when that element is "paused" (i.e., not "playing").
4f2323a0afa7f849.translationZh: :已停用的CSS伪类选择器代表一个可播放的元素,如音频或视频,当该元素是"暂停"(即不是"播放")时.

67f070a2ed74a4c4.original: The :picture-in-picture CSS pseudo-class matches the element which is currently in picture-in-picture mode.
67f070a2ed74a4c4.translationZh: :picture-in-picture CSS伪类与目前图片-in-picture模式中的元素匹配.

ae3edc7f7432b443.original: The :placeholder-shown CSS pseudo-class represents any input or textarea element that is currently displaying placeholder text.
ae3edc7f7432b443.translationZh: :placeholders-shown CSS 伪类代表当前显示占位符文本的任何输入或文本区域元素.

10abb6933c275571.original: The :playing CSS pseudo-class selector represents the playback state of an element that is playable, such as audio or video, when that element is "playing". An element is considered to be playing if it is currently playing the media resource, or if it has temporarily stopped for reasons other than user intent (such as :buffering or :stalled).
10abb6933c275571.translationZh: : playing CSS 伪类选择器代表一个可播放元素的回放状态,如音频或视频,当该元素是"播放"时. 一个元素如果正在播放媒体资源,或者由于用户意图以外的原因而暂时停止(如:buffering或:sstalled),则被认为是在播放.

df910c3963d134fa.original: The :popover-open CSS pseudo-class represents a Popover API element (i.e., one with a popover attribute) that is in the showing state. You can use this to apply style to popover elements only when they are shown.
df910c3963d134fa.translationZh: :popover-open CSS伪类代表显示状态下的一个Popover API元素(即一个带有popover属性). 只能当弹出元素被显示时,才能使用它来应用样式 。

d975bef9cb4a151f.original: The :read-only CSS pseudo-class selects elements (such as certain input types and textarea) that are not editable by the user. Elements on which the HTML attribute readonly doesn't have an effect (such as , , and all other non-form elements) are also selected by the :read-only pseudo-class. In fact, :read-only matches anything that :read-write doesn't match, making it equivalent to :not(:read-write).
d975bef9cb4a151f.translationZh: :只读 CSS 伪类选择用户无法编辑的元素(如某些输入类型和文本区域). HTML属性只读没有效果的元素(如,,,以及所有其他非形式元素)也由:read-只读伪类选择. 事实上:只读匹配任何不匹配的:read-write,使其相当于:not(:read-write).

c243b2eb000d8c1e.original: The :read-write CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as input or textarea) that is editable by the user.
c243b2eb000d8c1e.translationZh: :read-write CSS伪类代表了用户可编辑的元素(如输入或文本区).

e627534ff29a3db4.original: The :required CSS pseudo-class represents any input, select, or textarea element that has the required attribute set on it.
e627534ff29a3db4.translationZh: : 必需的 CSS 伪类代表任何输入, 选择, 或文本区域元素, 其上设置了所需的属性 。

21ed78f0dd943b55.original: The :right CSS pseudo-class, used with the @page at-rule, represents all right-hand pages of a printed document.
21ed78f0dd943b55.translationZh: 用 @page at-rule 的 :right CSS 伪类,代表打印文档的所有右手页.

4ee1dc526fba0fb7.original: The :root CSS pseudo-class matches the root element of a tree representing the document. In HTML, :root represents the html element and is identical to the selector html, except that its specificity (0-1-0) is higher than html's (0-0-1).
4ee1dc526fba0fb7.translationZh: :root CSS伪类匹配代表文档的树根元素. 在HTML中,:root代表html元素,与选择器html完全相同,只是其特性(0-1-0)高于html的(0-0-1).

41547994678e72a2.original: The :scope CSS pseudo-class represents elements that are a reference point, or scope, for selectors to match against.
41547994678e72a2.translationZh: :scope CSS伪类代表的元素是一个参考点,或范围,供选手匹配.

cf15a48b2d71b96a.original: The :seeking CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is playable, such as audio or video, when the playable element is seeking a playback position in the media resource. A resource is considered to be seeking if the user has requested playback of a specific position in the media resource, but the media element has not yet reached that position.
cf15a48b2d71b96a.translationZh: 当可播放元素在媒体资源中寻求回放位置时,寻求CSS伪类选择器代表一个可播放的元素,如音频或视频. 如果用户请求重播媒体资源中的特定位置,但媒体要素尚未达到该位置,则资源被视为正在寻求.

8c86d29710cf5da2.original: The :stalled CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is playable, such as audio or video, when playback is stalled. A resource is considered to be stalled if the user has requested playback of a specific position in the media resource, but it has failed to receive any data for some amount of time. This is different from :buffering in that the media element is unexpectedly not loading data when stalled (e.g., due to a network error) for around 3 seconds (the exact time is user agent dependent).
8c86d29710cf5da2.translationZh: 已安装的 CSS 伪类选择器代表一个在播放停止时可以播放的元素,例如音频或视频. 如果用户请求播放媒体资源中某个特定位置,但一段时间内没有收到任何数据,则资源被视为停滞. 这不同于: 缓冲, 即媒体元素在停滞( 如由于网络错误) 时意外地不装入数据, 时间为3秒左右( 具体时间取决于用户代理) 。

61f06a77dbdc5b28.original: The :state() CSS pseudo-class matches custom elements that have the specified custom state.
61f06a77dbdc5b28.translationZh: :state () CSS 伪类匹配具有指定自定义状态的自定义元素 。

309580c44c08138a.original: The :target CSS pseudo-class selects the target element of the document. When the document is loaded, the target element is derived using the document's URL fragment identifier.
309580c44c08138a.translationZh: :目标CSS伪类选择文档的目标元素. 当文档被加载时,目标元素会使用文档的URL片段标识符生成.

e038eb2ed705d7b0.original: The :target-after CSS pseudo-class selects scroll markers that come after the active scroll marker (the one that currently matches :target-current) within a scroll marker group. You can use this selector to style navigation items that come after the current navigation position within a scroll marker group.
e038eb2ed705d7b0.translationZh: :目标后 CSS 伪类在滚动标记组中选择在活动滚动标记后出现的滚动标记(目前匹配:目标-当前). 您可以使用此选择器来样式显示当前滚动标记组内导航位置之后的导航项目。

0b0a53510219f1e0.original: The :target-before CSS pseudo-class selects scroll markers that come before the active scroll marker (the one that currently matches :target-current) within a scroll marker group. You can use this selector to style navigation items that come before the current navigation position within a scroll marker group.
0b0a53510219f1e0.translationZh: CSS伪类之前的 :目标- 在滚动标记组中选择在活动滚动标记(目前匹配:目标-当前)之前的滚动标记. 您可以使用此选择器来样式显示当前滚动标记组中导航位置之前的导航项目。

a6d7a28552810871.original: The :target-current CSS pseudo-class selects the active scroll marker — the scroll marker of a scroll-marker-group that is currently scrolled to. This selector can be used to style the active navigation position within a scroll marker group.
a6d7a28552810871.translationZh: :目标-当前 CSS 伪类选择活动卷轴标记——当前滚动的卷轴标记. 此选择器可用于对滚动标记组内的主动导航位置进行样式化.

b7d136a448d6fb38.original: The :user-invalid CSS pseudo-class represents any validated form element whose value isn't valid based on their validation constraints, after the user has interacted with it.
b7d136a448d6fb38.translationZh: :用户无效的 CSS 伪类代表任何已验证的形式元素,其值根据其验证限制无效,在用户与之互动后.

92c4741e103bf5d4.original: The :user-valid CSS pseudo-class represents any validated form element whose value validates correctly based on its validation constraints. However, unlike :valid it only matches once the user has interacted with it.
92c4741e103bf5d4.translationZh: :user-valid CSS伪类代表任何经验证的形态元素,其值根据它的验证限制正确验证. 然而,与:验证不同,它仅在用户与它互动后才匹配.

cf14f32305213bdf.original: The :valid CSS pseudo-class represents any input or other form element whose contents validate successfully. This allows you to easily make valid fields adopt an appearance that helps the user confirm that their data is formatted properly.
cf14f32305213bdf.translationZh: : valid CSS伪类代表任何内容成功验证的输入或其他形式元素. 这使得您可以轻松地让有效的字段采用一个外观,帮助用户确认其数据格式化为正确.

5c1d91001cdd3b19.original: The :visited CSS pseudo-class applies once the link has been visited by the user. For privacy reasons, the styles that can be modified using this selector are very limited. The :visited pseudo-class applies only to a and area elements that have an href attribute.
5c1d91001cdd3b19.translationZh: :访问的CSS伪类在用户访问链接后即适用. 出于隐私的原因,可以使用此选择器修改的样式非常有限. :visited伪类仅适用于具有href属性的a和域元素.

673982f5ee3c808e.original: The :volume-locked CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is capable of making sound, such as audio or video, but the audio volume of the media element is currently "locked" by the user.
673982f5ee3c808e.translationZh: :volution-clock的CSS伪类选择器代表了能够发出声音的元素,如音频或视频,但媒体元素的音频量目前被用户"锁定".

2eef9ed19346f86f.original: The :where() CSS pseudo-class function takes a selector list as its argument, and selects any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list.
2eef9ed19346f86f.translationZh: : 其中() CSS 伪类函数将一个选择器列表作为其参数,并选择该列表中一个选择器可以选择的任何元素.

dd5e21a062f20110.original: The :xr-overlay CSS pseudo-class, defined in the WebXR DOM overlays module, matches the DOM overlay element when a web page is being viewed in an immersive AR or VR environment.
dd5e21a062f20110.translationZh: 在WebXR DOM重叠模块中定义的:xr-overlay CSS伪类,在浸润的AR或VR环境中查看网页时,匹配DOM重叠元素.

c4be666ffea5a0a8.original: The ::-moz-color-swatch CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the color selected in an input of type="color".
c4be666ffea5a0a8.translationZh: *-moz-color-swatch CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展,代表输入类型="color"中选择的颜色.

065e9f59076cebf0.original: The ::-moz-focus-inner CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents an inner focus ring of the button element as well as the input/button, input/submit, input/reset, and input/color types of the input element.
065e9f59076cebf0.translationZh: *-moz-焦点-内置CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展,代表按钮元素的内置焦点环以及输入元素的输入/按钮,输入/投递,输入/重置,以及输入/颜色类型.

d63f39d4e7801794.original: The ::-moz-list-bullet CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the marker (typically a bullet) of a list item (li) in an unordered list (ul).
d63f39d4e7801794.translationZh: *-moz-list-bullet CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展词,代表一个无序列表(ul)中列表项(li)的标记(典型为子弹).

b6ae7d4feacb980c.original: The ::-moz-list-number CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the marker (typically a number) of a list item (li) in an ordered list (ol).
b6ae7d4feacb980c.translationZh: *-moz-list-number CSS伪元素是Mozilla扩展词,代表一个命令列表(ol)中列表项(li)的标记(通常为数字).

19a2128eea8f5634.original: The ::-moz-meter-bar CSS pseudo-element represents the meter gauge in a meter element. It is used for selecting and applying styles to the gauge inside a meter element.
19a2128eea8f5634.translationZh: * Moz-met-bar CSS的伪元素代表一个度量元素中的度量衡。 它用于在测量元件内选择并应用样式。

da6744f84083568b.original: The ::-moz-progress-bar CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the progress bar inside a progress element. (The bar represents the amount of progress that has been made.)
da6744f84083568b.translationZh: * moz-Progress-bar CSS伪元素是Mozilla扩展,代表进度元素内的进度棒. (该栏代表已取得的进展。 )

f8152f192c49bf02.original: The ::-moz-range-progress CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the lower portion of the track (i.e., groove) in which the indicator slides in an input of type="range". This portion corresponds to values lower than the value currently selected by the thumb (i.e., virtual knob).
f8152f192c49bf02.translationZh: *-moz-range-progress CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展,代表了音轨的下部(即groove),其中指标滑动在类型="距离"的输入中. 此部分对应的值低于拇指当前选择的值(即虚拟 knob).

0c8c26c7af60595a.original: The ::-moz-range-thumb CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the thumb (i.e., virtual knob) of an input of type="range". The user can move the thumb along the input's track to alter its numerical value.
0c8c26c7af60595a.translationZh: *-moz-range-thumb CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展词,代表输入类型="范围"的拇指(即虚拟knob). 用户可以沿着输入的音轨移动拇指,以改变其数值.

d90edeeefaf3a5f8.original: The ::-moz-range-track CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the track (i.e., groove) in which the indicator slides in an input of type="range".
d90edeeefaf3a5f8.translationZh: *-moz-range-track CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展词,代表了在类型="范围"的输入中指标滑动的音轨(即groove).

548113ffdae19e5f.original: The ::-webkit-inner-spin-button CSS pseudo-element is used to style the inner part of the spinner button of number picker input elements.
548113ffdae19e5f.translationZh: *webkit-inner-spin-button CSS伪元素用于样式化数字拾取器输入元素的旋钮内侧部分.

74c29d31cce6ff02.original: The ::-webkit-meter-bar CSS pseudo-element is a WebKit extension that represents the background of a meter element. It is used for selecting and applying styles to the container of a meter gauge.
74c29d31cce6ff02.translationZh: *webkit-meter-bar CSS伪元素是一个WebKit扩展,代表一个米元素的背景. 它用于选择和适用于计量表容器的样式。

42c52b33c0ccb271.translationZh: * 网基米 -- -- 均匀 -- -- 价值

0f2c833f54f82ba7.original: The ::-webkit-meter-even-less-good-value styles the meter element when the value and the optimum attributes fall outside the low-high range, but in opposite zones. To illustrate, it applies when value high > low > optimum.
0f2c833f54f82ba7.translationZh: *webkit-meet-even-good-value 当值和最佳属性在低高范围以外,但位于相反的区域时,会给测量元素样式. 举例来说,当值高 > 低 > 最佳时适用。

0877a905dafb2852.original: ::-webkit-meter-inner-element is a proprietary WebKit CSS pseudo-element for selecting and applying styles to the outer containing element of a meter element. Additional markup to render the meter element as read-only.
0877a905dafb2852.translationZh: *-webkit-met-inner-emlement是专有的WebKit CSS伪元素,用于选择和将样式应用到含有一个米径元素的外部元素. 使测量元素变为只读的附加标记 。

ce548ae30c5ebe93.original: The ::-webkit-meter-optimum-value CSS pseudo-element styles the meter element when its value is inside the low-high range, or when the value is equivalent to the optimum value.
ce548ae30c5ebe93.translationZh: *webkit-meet-opimpleum-value CSS 伪元素样式,当其值在低高范围内,或者当值等同于最佳值时.

629a2f1e2b2eb97f.original: The ::-webkit-meter-suboptimum-value pseudo-element styles the meter element when the value attribute falls outside of the low-high range and is not equivalent to the optimum value.
629a2f1e2b2eb97f.translationZh: *webkit-meet-subopimpleum-value 伪元素当值属性在低高范围之外,不等于最佳值时,会给度量元素样式.

3496377ecaffbcae.original: The ::-webkit-progress-bar CSS pseudo-element represents the entire bar of a progress element. Normally it's only visible as the unfilled portion of the bar, since by default it's rendered below the ::-webkit-progress-value pseudo-element. It is a child of the ::-webkit-progress-inner-element pseudo-element and the parent of the ::-webkit-progress-value pseudo-element.
3496377ecaffbcae.translationZh: *webkit-progress-bar CSS伪元素代表了进度元素的整个栏. 通常它只是作为酒吧的未填充部分可见,因为默认它是在 *-webkit - 进步 - 值伪元素下制成的. 它是 " webkit-进步-内在元素 " 伪元素的孩子,也是 " webkit-进步-价值 " 伪元素的家长。

652aae66c95d34b5.original: The ::-webkit-progress-inner-element CSS pseudo-element represents the outermost container of the progress element. It is the parent of the ::-webkit-progress-bar pseudo-element.
652aae66c95d34b5.translationZh: * 网基进化-内置组件CSS伪组件是进度组件的最外置容器。 它是 * webkit 进步栏伪元素的母体。

09094b265ee799d6.original: The ::-webkit-progress-value CSS pseudo-element represents the filled-in portion of the bar of a progress element. It is a child of the ::-webkit-progress-bar pseudo-element.
09094b265ee799d6.translationZh: * 网基进度值的CSS伪元件代表进度元件栏填充部分。 它是 " webkit - 进步栏 " 伪元素的儿童。

97c15608eacc0d6d.original: The ::-webkit-scrollbar CSS pseudo-element affects the style of an element's scrollbar when it has scrollable overflow.
97c15608eacc0d6d.translationZh: * webkit- scrollbar CSS 伪元素在可滚动溢出时会影响元素滚动条的样式。

e2235f04710124e4.original: The ::-webkit-search-cancel-button CSS pseudo-element represents a button (the "cancel button") at the edge of an input of type="search" which clears away the current value of the input element. This button and pseudo-element are non-standard, supported only in WebKit and Blink, hence the vendor prefix. The clear button is only shown on non-empty search input elements.
e2235f04710124e4.translationZh: *webkit-search-cancel-button CSS伪元素代表一个键("cancel button"),位于输入类型="搜索"的边缘,可以清除输入元素的当前值. 这个按钮和伪元素是非标准的,只在WebKit和Brink中支持,因此是供应商的前缀. 清晰的按钮只在非空搜索输入元素上显示.

db7f87b055fe90b1.original: The ::-webkit-search-results-button CSS pseudo-element represents a button (the "search results button") at the left edge of an input of type="search" which when clicked displays a menu which allows the user to choose from previous recent search queries. This button and pseudo-element are non-standard, supported only in WebKit and Blink, hence the vendor prefix. The search results button is only shown on search input elements that have a results attribute.
db7f87b055fe90b1.translationZh: *-webkit-search-results-按钮CSS伪元素代表一个键("search results button"),位于输入类型="search"的左边缘,在点击时显示一个菜单,允许用户从之前的搜索查询中选择. 这个按钮和伪元素是非标准的,只在WebKit和Brink中支持,因此是供应商的前缀. 搜索结果按钮仅在具有结果属性的搜索输入元素上显示.

33944b9f938029d9.original: The ::-webkit-slider-runnable-track CSS pseudo-element represents the "track" (the groove in which the indicator slides) of an input/range.
33944b9f938029d9.translationZh: *webkit-slipper-runnable-track CSS伪元素代表一个输入/距离的"轨道"(指示滑动的沟槽).

e785209679e450ec.original: The ::-webkit-slider-thumb CSS pseudo-element represents the "thumb" that the user can move within the "groove" of an input of type="range" to alter its numerical value.
e785209679e450ec.translationZh: *webkit-slipper-thumb CSS伪元素代表用户可以在类型="范围"输入的"grouve"内移动的"thumb",以改变其数值.

3970fcead8c152b7.original: In CSS, ::after creates a pseudo-element that is the last child of the selected element. It is often used to add cosmetic content to an element with the content property. It is inline by default.
3970fcead8c152b7.translationZh: 在 CSS 中, *safter 创建了一个伪元素, 即选定元素的最后一个子 。 常用于在内容属性的元素中添加化妆品内容. 默认是内在的。

08ae0cdd29a59c8b.original: The ::backdrop CSS pseudo-element is a box the size of the viewport, which is rendered immediately beneath any element being presented in the top layer.
08ae0cdd29a59c8b.translationZh: * 回放 CSS 伪元素是视图端口大小的框,在顶层显示的任何元素下立即渲染出来.

495adda4bfc9c14d.original: In CSS, ::before creates a pseudo-element that is the first child of the selected element. It is often used to add cosmetic content to an element with the content property. It is inline by default.
495adda4bfc9c14d.translationZh: 在CSS中,在创建伪元素之前,该元素是选定元素的第一个孩子. 常用于在内容属性的元素中添加化妆品内容. 默认是内在的。

8f360c71d52be894.original: The ::checkmark CSS pseudo-element targets the checkmark placed inside the currently-selected option element of a customizable select element. It can be used to provide a visual indication of which option is selected.
8f360c71d52be894.translationZh: * Checkmark CSS 伪元素瞄准当前选择的可自定义选择元素中设置的选项元素中的检查标记。 它可用于提供选择哪个选项的视觉指示.

42ac458299c52169.original: The ::column CSS pseudo-element represents the individual columns generated when a container is set to display its content in multiple columns via CSS multi-column layout. The ::column pseudo-element enables applying styles that do not affect the layout to these generated fragments.
42ac458299c52169.translationZh: *列CSS伪元素代表一个容器在多个列中通过CSS多列布局显示其内容时产生的单个列. *柱式伪元素能够应用不影响这些生成的碎片布局的样式。

54c34ca682fa5e3f.original: The ::cue CSS pseudo-element matches WebVTT cues within a selected element. This can be used to style captions and other cues in media with VTT tracks.
54c34ca682fa5e3f.translationZh: *cue CSS 伪元素匹配选定元素内的WebVTT提示 。 这可以用来在媒体上用VTT音轨来样式字幕和其他提示.

7c2b5346f650cf33.original: The ::details-content CSS pseudo-element represents the expandable/collapsible contents of a details element.
7c2b5346f650cf33.translationZh: * 详细内容CSS伪内容代表一个细节内容的可扩展/可缩合内容。

69f12a2b109e0d1a.original: The ::file-selector-button CSS pseudo-element represents the button of an input of type="file".
69f12a2b109e0d1a.translationZh: *file-selector-button CSS伪元素代表输入类型="file"的按钮.

b85407c8abcbd72e.original: The ::first-letter CSS pseudo-element applies styles to the first letter of the first line of a block container, but only when not preceded by other content (such as images or inline tables).
b85407c8abcbd72e.translationZh: * 首字母CSS伪元件适用于区块容器第一行的第一个字母的样式,但只有在没有其他内容(如图像或内含表)之前。

a6f62650d0965267.original: The ::first-line CSS pseudo-element applies styles to the first line of a block container.
a6f62650d0965267.translationZh: * 一线CSS伪元素适用于区块容器第一线的样式。

e1f6cb840c00edb1.original: The ::grammar-error CSS pseudo-element represents a text segment which the user agent has flagged as grammatically incorrect.
e1f6cb840c00edb1.translationZh: * grammar-error CSS伪元素代表了用户代理标注为语法不正确的文本段.

9fef88993e0a5b86.original: The ::highlight() CSS pseudo-element applies styles to a custom highlight.
9fef88993e0a5b86.translationZh: * 高亮 () CSS 伪元素对自定义亮点应用样式 。

0e538c1bcfcd1d3f.original: The ::marker CSS pseudo-element selects the marker box of a list item, which typically contains a bullet or number. It works on any element or pseudo-element set to display: list-item, such as the li and summary elements.
0e538c1bcfcd1d3f.translationZh: *标记器 CSS 伪元素选择列表项的标记框,该列表项通常包含一个圆点或数字. 它工作于任何元素或伪元素设置来显示:列表-项目,如li和摘要元素.

b01d28e7c2e9f640.original: The ::part CSS pseudo-element represents any element within a shadow tree that has a matching part attribute.
b01d28e7c2e9f640.translationZh: *part CSS伪元素代表阴影树内具有匹配部分属性的任何元素.

d9739627fd63490f.original: The ::picker() CSS pseudo-element targets the picker part of an element, for example the drop-down picker of a customizable select element.
d9739627fd63490f.translationZh: * picker () CSS 伪元素针对元素的拾取部分,例如可自定义选择元素的下拉拾取器.

d9d749de6097e92b.original: The ::picker-icon CSS pseudo-element targets the picker icon inside form controls that have an icon associated with them. In the case of a customizable select element, it selects the arrow icon shown on the element that points down when it is closed.
d9d749de6097e92b.translationZh: *icker-icon CSS伪元素瞄准与它们相关联的拾取者图标内置形式控件. 如果是自定义的选择元素,它会选择关闭时在元素上显示的向下点的箭头图标.

a8c0cc56c60cc7e9.original: The ::placeholder CSS pseudo-element represents the placeholder text in an input or textarea element.
a8c0cc56c60cc7e9.translationZh: * 置位符 CSS 伪元素在输入或文本区域元素中代表占位符文本。

6978257212b0b57e.original: The ::scroll-button() CSS pseudo-element represents a button for controlling the scrolling of a scroll container. They are generated on scroll containers when their content value is not none. The direction of the scrolling is determined by the parameter value.
6978257212b0b57e.translationZh: *scroll-按钮() CSS伪元素代表一个控制滚动容器滚动的按钮. 当其内容值不是零时,它们就会在滚动容器中产生。 滚动的方向由参数值决定.

40e49f2bfb367082.original: The ::scroll-marker CSS pseudo-element can be generated inside any element and represents its scroll marker. All elements can have a ::scroll-marker pseudo-element, which is placed into the ::scroll-marker-group of the nearest scroll container ancestor. A scroll marker behaves like an anchor (a element) whose scroll target is the marker's originating element — and scrolls the scroll container to that element when activated.
40e49f2bfb367082.translationZh: *scroll-marker CSS伪元素可以在任何元素内部生成,并代表其滚动标记. 所有元素都可以有一个 *scroll-marker 伪元素,它被放在最近的滚动容器祖先的 *scroll-marker-组中. 一个卷轴标记的行为就像一个锚(一个元素),它的卷轴目标就是标记的起始元素——并在启动时将卷轴容器滚动到该元素.

f8835ef37d182687.original: The ::scroll-marker-group CSS pseudo-element is generated inside a scroll container and contains any ::scroll-marker pseudo-elements generated on descendants of the scroll container.
f8835ef37d182687.translationZh: *scroll-marker-group CSS伪元素是在卷轴容器内生成的,包含卷轴容器后代生成的任何 *scroll-marker伪元素.

b5192a0fef70f78b.original: The ::search-text CSS pseudo-element applies styles to search results identified by the user agent's "Find" or "Find in page" text search feature.
b5192a0fef70f78b.translationZh: *search-text CSS伪元素应用样式搜索由用户代理的"查找"或"页面查找"文本搜索功能确定的结果.

2185644ad67fce23.original: The ::selection CSS pseudo-element applies styles to the part of a document that has been highlighted by the user (such as clicking and dragging the mouse across text).
2185644ad67fce23.translationZh: *selection CSS伪元素对用户突出显示的文档部分应用样式(例如点击和拖动鼠标横跨文本).

8d685027bb1e018b.original: The ::slotted() CSS pseudo-element represents any element that has been placed into a slot inside an HTML template (see Using templates and slots for more information).
8d685027bb1e018b.translationZh: *slotted() CSS 伪元素代表了HTML模板中放置到槽中的任何元素(更多信息请参见使用模板和槽).

e6d7b9708dcab39d.original: The ::spelling-error CSS pseudo-element represents a text segment which the user agent has flagged as incorrectly spelled.
e6d7b9708dcab39d.translationZh: * spelling-error CSS伪元件代表了用户代理标记为拼写错误的文本段.

8dceea82f8cc14e1.original: The ::target-text CSS pseudo-element represents the text that has been scrolled to if the browser supports text fragments. It allows authors to choose how to highlight that section of text.
8dceea82f8cc14e1.translationZh: * 目标文本 CSS 伪元素代表浏览器支持文本片段时滚动到的文本. 它允许作者选择如何突出该部分文本.

e50dacf9a311abd5.original: The ::view-transition CSS pseudo-element represents the root of the view transitions overlay, which contains all view transition snapshot groups and sits over the top of all other page content.
e50dacf9a311abd5.translationZh: * 视图-过渡 CSS 假元素代表视图过渡覆盖的根,包含所有视图过渡快照组,并坐落在所有其他页面内容的顶端.

3edd34b7b204ffec.original: The ::view-transition-group() CSS pseudo-element represents a single view transition snapshot group.
3edd34b7b204ffec.translationZh: * 视图-过渡组() CSS 伪要素代表单一视图过渡快照组。

595a5e1c8841f761.original: The ::view-transition-image-pair() CSS pseudo-element represents a container for a view transition's "old" and "new" view states — before and after the transition.
595a5e1c8841f761.translationZh: *View-Tariage-image-pair() CSS伪元素代表了一个容器,用于一个视图过渡的"旧"和"新"视图的状态——过渡前后.

3137ca332411c953.original: The ::view-transition-new() CSS pseudo-element represents the "new" view state of a view transition — a snapshot live representation of the state after the transition.
3137ca332411c953.translationZh: *View-Terribution-new() CSS伪元素代表了视图过渡的"新"视角状态——过渡后国家即时表现.

ecaacc37512ebbc9.original: The ::view-transition-old() CSS pseudo-element represents the "old" view state of a view transition — a static snapshot of the old view, before the transition.
ecaacc37512ebbc9.translationZh: *view-Terribution-old() CSS伪元素代表了视图过渡的"老"视图状态——在过渡前对旧视图的静态快照.

6512d8408950b033.original: The CSS attribute selector matches elements based on the element having a given attribute explicitly set, with options for defining an attribute value or substring value match.
6512d8408950b033.translationZh: CSS 属性选择器匹配基于特定属性明确设定的元素的元素,以及定义属性值或子字符串值匹配的选项.

78be78ba597bdc1b.original: The child combinator (>) is placed between two CSS selectors. It matches only those elements matched by the second selector that are the direct children of elements matched by the first.
78be78ba597bdc1b.translationZh: 儿童组合器( >)位于两个CSS选择器之间。 它只匹配第二个选择者所匹配的元素,后者是元素与第一个选择者所匹配的直接子.

d06a0fe87266f34d.original: The CSS class selector matches elements based on the contents of their class attribute.
d06a0fe87266f34d.translationZh: CSS类选择器基于其类属性的内容匹配元素.

a384e3249a3dc668.original: The column combinator (||) is placed between two CSS selectors. It matches only those elements matched by the second selector that belong to the column elements matched by the first.
a384e3249a3dc668.translationZh: 列组合器(QQ)位于两个CSS选择器之间. 它只匹配与第一组相匹配的列元素的第二个选择器。

891b3fd6bf70114f.original: The descendant combinator — typically represented by a single space (" ") character — combines two selectors such that elements matched by the second selector are selected if they have an ancestor (parent, parent's parent, parent's parent's parent, etc.) element matching the first selector. Selectors that utilize a descendant combinator are called descendant selectors.
891b3fd6bf70114f.translationZh: 后人梳理器——一般以单个空间(")字符为代表)——将两个选择器合并,这样,如果有与第一个选择器相匹配的元素(父母亲,父母亲,父母亲等),则会选择与第二个选择器相匹配的元素. 使用后裔组合器的选手被称为后裔选手.

e0f1de86aaa1ddde.original: The CSS ID selector matches an element based on the value of the element's id attribute. In order for the element to be selected, its id attribute must match exactly the value given in the selector.
e0f1de86aaa1ddde.translationZh: CSS ID 选择器根据元素的 id 属性值匹配一个元素. 要选择元素,其id属性必须精确匹配选择器给出的值.

c5fdd529166db9d4.original: CSS keyframe selectors identify specific points in an animation timeline where keyframe styles should be applied. These selectors are used exclusively within the @keyframes at-rule.
c5fdd529166db9d4.translationZh: CSS 键框选择器在动画时间线中识别出应当应用键框样式的特定点. 这些选择器只用于 @ keyframes at- rule 中 。

3432c0c0316a30d5.original: The namespace separator (|) separates the selector from the namespace, identifying the namespace, or lack thereof, for a type selector.
3432c0c0316a30d5.translationZh: 命名空间分隔符 (QQ) 将选择器从命名空间中分离出来, 用于识别一个类型选择器的命名空间, 或者说没有命名空间 。

d3394381206b0f0b.original: The CSS & nesting selector explicitly states the relationship between parent and child rules when using CSS nesting. It makes the nested child rule selectors relative to the parent element. Without the & nesting selector, the child rule selector selects child elements. The child rule selectors have the same specificity weight as if they were within :is().
d3394381206b0f0b.translationZh: CSS & 筑巢选择器在使用 CSS 筑巢时,明确规定了亲子规则之间的关系. 它使巢子规则选择者相对于母元素. 没有巢选择器( N), 儿童规则选择器会选择儿童元素 。 儿童规则选择者具有与在:is()范围内相同的特殊权重。

4c44e2251575c2bf.original: The next-sibling combinator (+) separates two selectors and matches the second element only if it immediately follows the first element, and both are children of the same parent element.
4c44e2251575c2bf.translationZh: 邻接的梳理器(+)将两个选择器分离出来,只有当它立即跟随第一个元素时才匹配第二个元素,两者都是同父元素的孩子.

50a4733770096cab.original: The CSS selector list (,) selects all the matching nodes. A selector list is a comma-separated list of selectors.
50a4733770096cab.translationZh: CSS 选择器列表 (,) 选择所有匹配的节点. 选择器列表是一个以逗号分隔的选择器列表.

15423f8b4e83207c.original: The subsequent-sibling combinator (~, a tilde) separates two selectors and matches all instances of the second element that follow the first element (not necessarily immediately) and share the same parent element.
15423f8b4e83207c.translationZh: 后续的伴奏组合符(~,一个图尔德)将两个选择符分开,并匹配第二个元素中跟随第一个元素的所有实例(不一定是立即),并共享相同的母元素.

90d89fbafb41eeae.original: The CSS type selector matches elements by node name. In other words, it selects all elements of the given type within a document.
90d89fbafb41eeae.translationZh: CSS类型选择器以节点名称匹配元素. 换句话说,它选择文档中指定类型的所有元素.

c148bf638ccae4cf.original: The CSS universal selector () matches elements of any type.
c148bf638ccae4cf.translationZh: CSS 通用选择器 () 匹配任意类型的元素 。

370a94fdce9eb136.original: The @charset CSS rule specifies the character encoding used in the style sheet. This syntax is useful when using non-ASCII characters in some CSS properties, like content. Although the first character in @charset is the @ symbol, it is not an at-rule. It is a specific byte sequence that can only be placed at the very beginning of a stylesheet. No other characters, except the Unicode byte-order mark, are allowed before it. It also does not follow normal CSS syntax rules such as use of quotes or whitespace.
370a94fdce9eb136.translationZh: @ charset CSS 规则指定了样式表中使用的字符编码 。 这个语法在一些CSS属性中使用非ASCII字符时有用,比如内容. 虽然在@charset中的第一个字符是@符号,但它不是规则。 它是一个特定的字节序列,只能放在样式表的开头. 除Unicode字节顺序标记外,其他字符不得在它之前使用. 它也不遵循正常的CSS语法规则,如使用引文或白空.

c480011590434139.original: The @color-profile CSS at-rule defines and names a color profile which can later be used in the function to specify a color.
c480011590434139.translationZh: @ color- profile CSS at- rule 定义并命名一个颜色配置文件, 稍后可以在函数中用于指定颜色 。

97a975fac4f1e9c2.original: The @container CSS at-rule is a conditional group rule that applies styles to a containment context. Style declarations are filtered by a condition and applied to the elements within the container if the condition is true. The condition is evaluated when the queried container size, , or scroll-state changes.
97a975fac4f1e9c2.translationZh: @container CSS at-rule 是有条件的组合规则,将样式应用到封装上下文中. 样式声明通过条件过滤,如果条件属实,则适用于容器内的元素。 当被询问的容器大小、 或滚动状态发生变化时, 对条件进行评估 。

7ca76b249f148e16.original: The @counter-style CSS at-rule lets you extend predefined list styles and define your own counter styles that are not part of the predefined set of styles. The @counter-style rule contains descriptors defining how the counter value is converted into a string representation.
7ca76b249f148e16.translationZh: @ counter-style CSS at- rule 允许您扩展预定义的列表样式,并定义不属于预定义的一组样式的自己的计数器样式. @ counter-tyle 规则包含描述符,定义了如何将计数转换成字符串表示.

14a5e12ced369d49.original: The @custom-media CSS at-rule defines aliases for long or complex media queries. Instead of repeating the same hardcoded in multiple @media at-rules, it can be defined once in a @custom-media at-rule and referenced throughout the stylesheet whenever needed.
14a5e12ced369d49.translationZh: @custom-media CSS at-rule定义了长时间或复杂的媒体查询的别名. 与其在多个@media at-rules中重复同样的硬码,它可以在一个@custom-media at-rule中定义一次,并在需要时在整个样式表中引用。

6a63c71a7f9fd623.original: The @document CSS at-rule restricts the style rules contained within it based on the URL of the document. It is designed primarily for user-defined style sheets (see userchrome.org for more information), though it can be used on author-defined style sheets, too.
6a63c71a7f9fd623.translationZh: @ document CSS at- rule 限制其中基于文档 URL 的样式规则 。 它的设计主要针对用户定义的样式工作表(更多信息请参见userchrome.org),虽然它也可以用于作者定义的样式工作表上.

02598e55ac1725a4.original: The @font-face CSS at-rule specifies a custom font with which to display text; the font can be loaded from either a remote server or a locally-installed font on the user's own computer.
02598e55ac1725a4.translationZh: @font-face CSS at-rule 指定了用于显示文本的自定义字体;该字体可以从远程服务器或用户自己计算机上本地安装的字体中加载.

fe5c3d6729974ee3.original: The @font-feature-values CSS at-rule lets you use a common name in the font-variant-alternates property for features activated differently in OpenType. This can help simplify your CSS when using multiple fonts.
fe5c3d6729974ee3.translationZh: @font- feature-values CSS at-rule 允许您在 OpenType 中启用不同特性的字体变量- 变位属性中使用一个通用名称 。 这可以帮助在使用多个字体时简化您的 CSS 。

dfced6e567648f79.original: The @font-palette-values CSS at-rule allows you to customize the default values of font-palette created by the font-maker.
dfced6e567648f79.translationZh: @ font-palette- values CSS at- rule 允许您自定义字体制造商创建的字体palette的默认值 。

10831547638512a7.original: The @function CSS at-rule enables defining CSS custom functions. Once defined, a custom function can be called using the <dashed-function> syntax (for example, --my-function(30px, 3)) within any property value.
10831547638512a7.translationZh: @ 函数 CSS at- rule 允许定义 CSS 自定义函数 。 一旦定义了,一个自定义函数可以在任何属性值范围内使用<dashed-函数>语法(例如,-my-函数(30px,3))来称呼.

faaca4a9ad175521.original: The @import CSS at-rule is used to import style rules from other valid stylesheets. An @import rule must be defined at the top of the stylesheet, before any other at-rule (except @charset and @layer) and style declarations, or it will be ignored.
faaca4a9ad175521.translationZh: @import CSS at- rule 用于从其他有效样式表导入样式规则 。 @ import 规则必须在样式表的顶端下定义, 在其它规则( 除了 @ charset 和 @layer) 和样式声明之前, 否则会被忽略 。

7ac1d4bf6bc96016.original: The @keyframes CSS at-rule controls the intermediate steps in a CSS animation sequence by defining styles for keyframes (or waypoints) along the animation sequence. This gives more control over the intermediate steps of the animation sequence than transitions.
7ac1d4bf6bc96016.translationZh: @keyframes CSS at-rule 控制 CSS 动画序列中的中间步骤,方法是沿动画序列定义键帧(或方式点)的样式. 这使得对动画序列中间步骤的控制大于过渡.

7a2d85515716b8f9.original: The @layer CSS at-rule is used to declare a cascade layer and can also be used to define the order of precedence in case of multiple cascade layers.
7a2d85515716b8f9.translationZh: @ layer CSS at- rule 用于声明一个级联层, 也可以用于定义多个级联层的排序 。

612e3ef345a1a96a.original: The @media CSS at-rule can be used to apply part of a style sheet based on the result of one or more media queries. With it, you specify a media query and a block of CSS to apply to the document if and only if the media query matches the device on which the content is being used.
612e3ef345a1a96a.translationZh: @media CSS at-rule 可以根据一个或多个媒体查询的结果应用部分样式表. 您用它指定一个介质查询和一个 CSS 块来应用到文档中,如果并且只有在介质查询与使用内容的设备相匹配时。

01bf51621b01ff28.original: @namespace is an at-rule that defines XML namespaces to be used in a CSS style sheet.
01bf51621b01ff28.translationZh: @ namespace 是一条在规则中定义用于 CSS 样式表的 XML 命名空间 。

8afa6aeea937d278.original: The @page at-rule is a CSS at-rule used to modify different aspects of printed pages. It targets and modifies the page's dimensions, orientation, and margins. The @page at-rule can be used to target all pages in a print-out or a subset using its various pseudo-classes.
8afa6aeea937d278.translationZh: @page at-rule 是用于修改打印页面不同方面的 CSS at-rule 。 它针对并修改了页面的尺寸、方向和边距。 @ page at- rule 可以使用它的各种伪类, 在打印输出或子集中瞄准所有页面 。

ab78a286c9f49586.original: The @position-try CSS at-rule is used to define a custom position try fallback option, which can be used to define positioning and alignment for anchor-positioned elements. One or more sets of position try fallback options can be applied to the anchored element via the position-try-fallbacks property or position-try shorthand. When the positioned element is moved to a position where it starts to overflow its containing block or the viewport, the browser will select the first position try fallback option it finds that places the positioned element fully back on-screen.
ab78a286c9f49586.translationZh: @position-try CSS at-rule 用于定义自定义位置尝试倒置选项,用于定义锁定位置元素的定位和对齐. 一组或多组位置尝试倒置选项,可以通过位置-Try倒置属性或位置-Try短手应用到锚定元素上. 当定位元素被移动到它开始溢出其包含的块或视图端口的位置时,浏览器会选择第一个位置尝试倒置选项,它发现将定位元素完全放回屏幕上.

acb5e253fc5e78a6.original: The @property CSS at-rule is used to explicitly define CSS custom properties, allowing for property type checking and constraining, setting default values, and defining whether a custom property can inherit values or not.
acb5e253fc5e78a6.translationZh: @property CSS at-rule 用于明确定义 CSS 自定义属性,允许属性类型检查和约束,设定默认值,并确定自定义属性是否可以继承值.

d5fc6fac34f1727c.original: The @scope CSS at-rule enables you to select elements in specific DOM subtrees, targeting elements precisely without writing overly-specific selectors that are hard to override, and without coupling your selectors too tightly to the DOM structure.
d5fc6fac34f1727c.translationZh: @scope CSS at- rule 使您能够在特定的 DOM 子树中选择元素, 精确地瞄准元素而不会写入过于特定的选择器, 而不会将您的选择器与 DOM 结构过于紧密地结合 。

5ed93203e515251a.original: The @starting-style CSS at-rule is used to define starting values for properties set on an element that you want to transition from when the element receives its first style update, i.e., when an element is first displayed on a previously loaded page.
5ed93203e515251a.translationZh: @ starting-style CSS at-rule 用于定义在元素上设定的属性的起始值,您想要从元素收到其第一个样式更新时,即元素首次显示在先前加载的页面上时,来转换这些属性.

f7a4d71575c6ac0a.original: The @supports CSS at-rule lets you specify CSS declarations that depend on a browser's support for CSS features. Using this at-rule is commonly called a feature query. The rule must be placed at the top level of your code or nested inside any other conditional group at-rule.
f7a4d71575c6ac0a.translationZh: @ supports CSS at- rule 允许您指定依赖于浏览器支持 CSS 特性的 CSS 声明 。 使用此规则通常称为特性查询. 该规则必须置于您的代码的顶端, 或嵌入其他有条件的组在规则中 。

3a44e6133f4a5eac.original: The @view-transition CSS at-rule is used to opt in the current and destination documents to undergo a view transition, in the case of a cross-document navigation.
3a44e6133f4a5eac.translationZh: @view- Transition CSS at-rule 用于在当前和目的文件中选择进行视图转换,如果是交叉文档导航.

99fd4babc3c8e412.original: Figma Plugin API declares AUTO as a counter axis track alignment option.

5af5417f65fa043e.translationZh: Figma 插件 API 宣布 Space BETWEEN 为反轴轨道对齐选项 。

71eb380edc21bdc9.original: Variable font axis: AR Retinal Resolution
71eb380edc21bdc9.translationZh: 可变字体轴:AR视网膜分辨率

9cdd1c475f6a4cda.original: Resolution-specific enhancements in AR/VR typefaces to optimize rendering across the different resolutions of the headsets making designs accessible and easy to read.
9cdd1c475f6a4cda.translationZh: AR/VR型面的分辨率特定增强,以优化对耳机不同分辨率的渲染,使设计便于查阅和阅读。

1891a0492c82e651.original: Bleed adjusts the overall darkness in the typographic color of strokes or other forms, without any changes in overall width, line breaks, or page layout. Negative values make the font appearance lighter, while positive values make it darker, similarly to ink bleed or dot gain on paper.
1891a0492c82e651.translationZh: 布莱德调整中风或其他形式印刷颜色中的整体黑暗,总体宽度,换行或页面布局没有任何变化. 负值使得字体外观更轻,而正值使它更暗,类似于墨血或点在纸上增益.

1874c7e149ad1436.original: Shift glyphs up and down in the Y dimension, resulting in an uneven, bouncy baseline.
1874c7e149ad1436.translationZh: 在Y维度中上下移动格子,导致一个不平衡,波浪基线.

07372e5490bb5b6e.original: Adjust stroke curvature, contrast, and terminals from a sturdy, rational Linear style to a friendly, energetic Casual style.
07372e5490bb5b6e.translationZh: 调整中风曲率,对比度,以及终端,从稳健,理性的线性风格,转变为友好,充满活力的Casual风格.

a1a54824ffcb4861.original: Contrast describes the stroke width difference between the thick and thin parts of the font glyphs. A value of zero indicates no visible/apparent contrast. A positive number indicates an increase in contrast relative to the zero-contrast thickness, achieved by making the thin stroke thinner. A value of 100 indicates that the thin stroke has disappeared completely. A negative value indicates "reverse contrast": the strokes which would conventionally be thick in the writing system are instead made thinner. In western-language fonts this might be perceived as a 19th-century, "circus" or "old West" effect. A value of -100 indicates that the strokes which would normally be thick have disappeared completely.
a1a54824ffcb4861.translationZh: Contrast描述了字体的粗细部分之间的中风宽度差. 数值为0表示没有可见/明显对比. 一个正数表明,相对于通过使细中风变薄而实现的零相位厚度而言,相对增高. 值为100表示细中风已完全消失. 一个负值表示"反向对比":在写作系统中通常会厚的划线反而变薄. 在西语字体中,这可能被认为是19世纪的一种"circus"或"old West"效应. 数值为 -100 表示通常厚的中风已完全消失。

52e58abfff93dfba.original: Control the substitution of cursive forms along the Slant axis. 'Off' (0) maintains Roman letterforms such as a double-storey a and g, 'Auto' (0.5) allows for Cursive substitution, and 'On' (1) asserts cursive forms even in upright text with a Slant of 0.
52e58abfff93dfba.translationZh: 控制沿斜轴的咒语形式替换. 'Off' (0) 保持罗马字母形式,如双层的a和g,'Auto' (0.5) 允许cursive 替代,而'On' (1) 坚持甚至用直立的文本用0.

c4cb844431ba22f1.original: Controls thickness of edge highlight details.Default
c4cb844431ba22f1.translationZh: 边缘厚度控制突出细节。 默认

2ddacd71e739f742.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 元素扩展

d158afab495b9685.original: As the Element Expansion axis progresses, the elements move apart.
d158afab495b9685.translationZh: 随着元素扩展轴的推进,元素会分开移动.

b6602258f437a442.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 元素网格

0f9a496648bfaea4.original: In modular fonts, where glyphs are composed using multiple copies of the same element, this axis controls how many elements are used per one grid unit.
0f9a496648bfaea4.translationZh: 在模块字体中,在使用同一元素的多个拷贝组成glyphs时,这个轴控制每个网格单元使用多少元素.

151b1e25cf3f47a9.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 元素形状

5b88f8be8b2609a2.original: In modular fonts, where glyphs are composed using multiple copies of the same element, this axis controls the shape of the element
5b88f8be8b2609a2.translationZh: 在模块字体中,使用多个相同元素的复制件组成格言,此轴控制元素的形状

594e38f32120744a.original: Scales lowercase letters to an intermediate size between minuscule and majuscule, as used in medieval manuscripts for enlarged minuscules at sentence openings. Adjusts x-height and character width continuously from 0 (default lowercase) to 100 (fully enlarged).
594e38f32120744a.translationZh: 将小写字母缩放到小写和大写之间的中间大小,如中世纪手稿中用于句子开口时的放大小写. 将x高和字符宽度从0(默认小写)持续调整到100(完全扩大)。

2c08228d2b1bde54.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 外延深度

2c483e3a5280e06d.translationZh: 控制轮廓上的3D深度。 默认

d83798df1d252f66.original: Fill in transparent forms with opaque ones. Sometimes interior opaque forms become transparent, to maintain contrasting shapes. This can be useful in animation or interaction to convey a state transition. Ranges from 0 (no treatment) to 1 (completely filled).
d83798df1d252f66.translationZh: 用不透明的表格填入透明表格。 有时内部不透明的形式变得透明,以保持对比的形状. 这在动画或互动中可以用来传达状态过渡. 范围从0(不治疗)到1(完全填满)。

59867b049f24fe9b.original: As the flare axis grows, the stem terminals go from straight (0%) to develop a swelling (100%).
59867b049f24fe9b.translationZh: 随着耀斑轴的增大,干线终端从直线(0%)发展为膨胀(100%).

ee4364040ca99305.original: It transforms complex letterforms into simplified geometric shapes like circles, triangles, and squares. This transition can occurs through gradual structural shifting and/or character swaps at specific intervals.
ee4364040ca99305.translationZh: 它将复杂的字母形式转化为圆形,三角形,方形等简化几何形状. 这种过渡可以通过在具体时间间隔内通过逐步的结构转移和(或)字符交换来实现。

733dcb17f4f904bb.original: Finesse the style from lighter to bolder in typographic color, without any changes overall width, line breaks or page layout. Negative grade makes the style lighter, while positive grade makes it bolder. The units are the same as in the Weight axis.
733dcb17f4f904bb.translationZh: 在打印颜色中将样式从轻到粗,整体宽度、换行或页面布局不变。 负级使得风格更轻,而正级则使其更大胆. 单位与重量轴相同.

13f108d3c9e084b6.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 指南不透明

03829e93aa97d757.original: Adjust opacity of guides from 100 (fully visible) down to 0 (fully invisible).
03829e93aa97d757.translationZh: 将指南的不透明度从100(完全可见)降至0(完全看不见)。

bb25fd4e96f90acd.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 超扩展

f694cd5ad7a6e69e.original: Expansion of inner and outer space of glyphs.

40cebf792e84ae82.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 非正式

d1c0cd5c75cee2c1.original: Adjusts overall design from formal and traditional (0%) to informal and unconventional (up to 100%).
d1c0cd5c75cee2c1.translationZh: 将总体设计从正规和传统(0%)调整为非正规和非常规(最高达到100%)。

56639c5342948dbe.original: Adjust the style from roman to italic. This can be provided as a continuous range within a single font file, like most axes, or as a toggle between two roman and italic files that form a family as a pair.
56639c5342948dbe.translationZh: 将样式从罗马改为斜体。 这可以作为一个单字体文件中的连续范围提供,就像大多数轴一样,也可以作为两个罗马和斜体文件之间的切换,以成对的形式形成一个家族.

d9016f7c10539725.original: Controls the amount of jitter applied to the glyphs. Higher values emulate the mechanical imperfection and displacement of vintage printers.
d9016f7c10539725.translationZh: 控制适用于格莱特的紧张度。 更高的价值效仿了老式打印机的机械不完善和置换.

58785430d5b9433e.original: Adjust the style from Proportional (natural widths, default) to Monospace (fixed width). With proportional spacing, each glyph takes up a unique amount of space on a line, while monospace is when all glyphs have the same total character width.
58785430d5b9433e.translationZh: 将样式从比例(自然宽度,默认宽度)调整为 Monospace(固定宽度)。 使用比例间距,每个glyph在一条线上占据一个独特的空间,而单空间是所有glyphs的字符总宽度相同的时候.

30d58e1776e43d8f.original: Letterforms morph: Changing in unconventional ways, that don't alter other attributes, like width or weight. The range from 0 to 60 can be understood as seconds.
30d58e1776e43d8f.translationZh: 字母形态:以非常规方式变化,不改变其他属性,如宽度或重量. 0到60之间的范围可以理解为秒.

4a80e4ec636dad5d.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 光学大小

bff1fa452cc02511.original: Adapt the style to specific text sizes. At smaller sizes, letters typically become optimized for more legibility. At larger sizes, optimized for headlines, with more extreme weights and widths. In CSS this axis is activated automatically when it is available.
bff1fa452cc02511.translationZh: 使样式适应特定的文本大小。 在较小的尺寸下,字母一般会变得优化,以便更清晰. 体积较大,为头条新闻优化,重量和宽度均较大. CSS中,此轴在可用时会自动激活.

093a168899afeca3.original: Adjust shapes from angular defaults (0%) to become increasingly rounded (up to 100%).
093a168899afeca3.translationZh: 从角默认值(0%)调整形状,使其变得日益四舍五入(最高达到100%)。

cf870c6840de05b2.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 扫描线

27dab34666043049.original: Break up shapes into horizontal segments without any changes in overall width, letter spacing, or kerning, so there are no line breaks or page layout changes. Negative values make the scanlines thinner, and positive values make them thicker.
27dab34666043049.translationZh: 将形状分解为水平区段,整体宽度,字母间隔,或kerning没有任何变化,因此没有换行或页面布局变化. 负值使扫描线变薄,正值使其变厚.

c2d418413d8d448b.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 阴影长度

e52377710cf0ab0d.original: Adjusts the font's shadow length from no shadow visible (0 %) to a maximum shadow applied (100%) relative to each family design.
e52377710cf0ab0d.translationZh: 将字体的阴影长度从无可见阴影(0%)调整为相对于每个家族设计的应用最大阴影(100%).

ce7737be65c9b28a.original: Adjust shapes from angular or blunt default shapes (0%) to become increasingly sharped forms (up to 100%).
ce7737be65c9b28a.translationZh: 从角或钝的默认形状(0%)调整形状,成为日益尖锐的形式(最高达到100%)。

5267000bd771cf96.original: Variable font axis: Size of Paint 1
5267000bd771cf96.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 绘画 1 的大小

aee0cb6bd1ae266a.original: Modifies the size of a paint element going from an initial size (0) to positive values that increase the size (100%) or negative values that shrink it down (-100%). Reducing the size can create transparency.
aee0cb6bd1ae266a.translationZh: 修改涂料元素的大小,从初始尺寸(0)变为正值,增加大小(100%)或负值将其缩小(-100%)。 缩小规模可以提高透明度。

09bca98ff8078844.original: Variable font axis: Size of Paint 2
09bca98ff8078844.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 绘画 2 的大小

64171831e25ada49.original: Modifies the size of a paint element going from an initial size (0) to positive values that increase the size (100%) or negative values that shrink it down (-100%). Reducing the size can create transparency. Paint 2 is in front of Paint 1.
64171831e25ada49.translationZh: 修改涂料元素的大小,从初始尺寸(0)变为正值,增加大小(100%)或负值将其缩小(-100%)。 缩小规模可以提高透明度。 画2在画1前面.

8152466fe0ea6307.original: Adjust the style from upright to slanted. Negative values produce right-leaning forms, also known to typographers as an 'oblique' style. Positive values produce left-leaning forms, also called a 'backslanted' or 'reverse oblique' style.
8152466fe0ea6307.translationZh: 将样式从直立调整为斜立。 负值产生右拾遗表,也被打字员称为"oblique"风格. 正值产生左拾遗形式,也称为"背斜的"或"反斜的"风格.

23e839195a30c1b3.original: Adjust letterforms to become more and more soft and rounded.
23e839195a30c1b3.translationZh: 调整字母格式,使其更加柔和和四舍五入。

ee502774c6fa77a8.original: Adjusts the overall letter spacing of a font. The range is a relative percentage change from the family's default spacing, so the default value is 0.
ee502774c6fa77a8.translationZh: 调整字体的整个字母间隔。 范围是家庭默认间隔的相对百分比变化,因此默认值为0.

c98be68938b07112.original: Expands and exaggerates details of a typeface to emphasize the personality. Understood in a percentage amount, it goes from a neutral state (0%) to a maximum level (100%).
c98be68938b07112.translationZh: 扩展和夸大了打字面的细节,以强调个性. 按百分比计算,它从中性状态(0%)到最高水平(100%)。

cc2f95b7c9667170.original: Adjust the style from lighter to bolder in typographic color, by varying stroke weights, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type. This typically changes overall width, and so may be used in conjunction with Width and Grade axes.
cc2f95b7c9667170.translationZh: 按不同中风重量、间距和克宁以及类型其他方面,将样式从打字颜色的轻度调整为粗度。 这一般会改变整体宽度,因此可以与Width和Grade轴结合使用.

e742477774e0cec7.original: Adjust the style from narrower to wider, by varying the proportions of counters, strokes, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type. This typically changes the typographic color in a subtle way, and so may be used in conjunction with Weight and Grade axes.
e742477774e0cec7.translationZh: 通过不同比例的计数器、中风、间距和克宁以及该类型其他方面,将样式从窄到宽。 这一般会以微妙的方式改变打字的颜色,因此可能与重量轴和等级轴结合使用.

a98cd8a93e2fc8e5.original: Toggle the substitution of wonky forms. 'Off' (0) maintains more conventional letterforms, while 'On' (1) maintains wonky letterforms, such as leaning stems in roman, or flagged ascenders in italic. These forms are also controlled by Optical Size.
a98cd8a93e2fc8e5.translationZh: 切换替换 winky 格式 。 'off' (0) 保持更常规的字母形式,而'On' (1) 则保持 wonky 字母形式,如斜向根部在罗马语中,或斜向升起者在斜体中. 这些形式也由光学大小控制.

7a3803e3cdc4c647.original: Variable font axis: Horizontal Element Alignment
7a3803e3cdc4c647.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 水平元素对齐

a4b56c08d9924e1f.original: Align glyph elements from their default position (0%), usually the baseline, to a rightmost (100%) or leftmost (-100%) position.
a4b56c08d9924e1f.translationZh: 从默认位置(0%),通常是基线,向最右边位置(100%)或最左边位置(-100%)对齐。

b6b434d39ccdeb70.original: A parametric axis for varying thick stroke weights, such as stems.
b6b434d39ccdeb70.translationZh: 用于不同厚的中风重量的参数轴,如茎.

8e8d2096634add4d.original: Variable font axis: Horizontal Position of Paint 1
8e8d2096634add4d.translationZh: 可变字体轴:绘画 1的水平位置

8ed7cf5f65882910.original: The position of the paint moves left and right. Negative values move to the left and positive values move to the right, in the X dimension. Paint 1 is behind Paint 2.
8ed7cf5f65882910.translationZh: 颜料的位置左右移动. 负值向左移动,正值向右移动,属于X维度. 绘画1在绘画2后面.

5814ec09d402c16e.original: Variable font axis: Horizontal Position of Paint 2
5814ec09d402c16e.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 绘画 2 的水平位置

8b19cd3fd5b7a17b.original: The position of the paint moves left and right. Negative values move to the left and positive values move to the right, in the X dimension. Paint 2 is in front of Paint 1.
8b19cd3fd5b7a17b.translationZh: 颜料的位置左右移动. 负值向左移动,正值向右移动,属于X维度. 画2在画1前面.

cd90bddc055874c3.original: Variable font axis: Rotation in X
cd90bddc055874c3.translationZh: 可变字体轴: X 中的旋转

06ca0334e579abc1.original: Glyphs rotate left and right, negative values to the left and positive values to the right, in the X dimension.
06ca0334e579abc1.translationZh: Glyphs在X维度中左右旋转,左侧负值和右侧正值.

aa1d58d5d4471895.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 反向宽度

06358c0257b7e9aa.original: A parametric axis for varying counter widths in the X dimension.
06358c0257b7e9aa.translationZh: X 维度中不同反宽的参数轴 。

6602fcf91258423f.original: Variable font axis: X transparent figures
6602fcf91258423f.translationZh: 可变字体轴: X 透明数字

e19547009aad74e9.original: Assigns a 'white' per mille value to each instance of the design space.
e19547009aad74e9.translationZh: 给设计空间的每个实例指定一个“ 白色” 值 。

20a3ea653b7432ee.original: Variable font axis: Vertical Element Alignment
20a3ea653b7432ee.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 垂直元素对齐

35b9afd7dc05370a.original: Align glyphs elements from their default position (0%), usually the baseline, to an upper (100%) or lower (-100%) position.
35b9afd7dc05370a.translationZh: 将glyphs元素从默认位置(0%),通常是基线,调整到上(100%)或下(-100%)的位置.

1c829cb8d78451c4.original: A parametric axis for varying thin stroke weights, such as bars and hairlines.
1c829cb8d78451c4.translationZh: 用于不同细中风重量的参数轴,如栏杆和发线.

5a802bba529c170c.original: Variable font axis: Vertical Position of Paint 1
5a802bba529c170c.translationZh: 可变字体轴:绘画 1的垂直位置

1196ed2b11aeec6e.original: The position of the paint moves up and down. Negative values move down and positive values move up. Paint 1 is behind Paint 2.
1196ed2b11aeec6e.translationZh: 颜料的位置上下移动. 负值向下移动,正值向上移动. 绘画1在绘画2后面.

8c452e2ddc7f4c54.original: Variable font axis: Vertical Position of Paint 2
8c452e2ddc7f4c54.translationZh: 可变字体轴:绘画 2 的垂直位置

73182a61344ee120.original: The position of the paint moves up and down. Negative values move down and positive values move up. Paint 2 is in front of Paint 1.
73182a61344ee120.translationZh: 颜料的位置上下移动. 负值向下移动,正值向上移动. 画2在画1前面.

4e4a25d75b22c59e.original: Variable font axis: Rotation in Y
4e4a25d75b22c59e.translationZh: 可变字体轴: Y 中的旋转

d352d16e280ca792.original: Glyphs rotate up and down, negative values tilt down and positive values tilt up, in the Y dimension.
d352d16e280ca792.translationZh: 胶片上下旋转,负值向下倾斜,正值向上倾斜,在Y维度中.

ca40352f2043ae73.translationZh: 可变字体轴: Ascender 高度

e6b0bd2e8be6d0d1.original: A parametric axis for varying the height of lowercase ascenders.
e6b0bd2e8be6d0d1.translationZh: 用于改变小写上升器高度的参数轴 。

f25e1598695eaf49.translationZh: 可变字体轴: Descender 深度

74858d54a6c360b2.original: A parametric axis for varying the depth of lowercase descenders.
74858d54a6c360b2.translationZh: 用于改变小写递减器深度的参数轴。

6120e0fcac16898d.original: A parametric axis for varying the height of figures.
6120e0fcac16898d.translationZh: 用于改变数字高度的参数轴 。

2f186ce9cd8b1527.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 小写高度

2c46d34e91c3860a.original: A parametric axis for varying the height of the lowercase.
2c46d34e91c3860a.translationZh: 用于改变小写高度的参数轴。

623f59dd80b4f741.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 大写高度

bb510614ed511336.original: A parametric axis for varying the heights of uppercase letterforms.
bb510614ed511336.translationZh: 用于改变大写字母格式高度的参数轴。

ec21d8ac0be0211d.translationZh: 可变字体轴: 垂直扩展

89025714cd217373.original: The axis extends glyphs in the Y dimension, such as the Cap Height, Ascender and Descender lengths. This is a relative axis, starting at 0% and going to the typeface's individual maximum extent at 100%.
89025714cd217373.translationZh: 轴在Y维度中延伸格律,如Cap Height,Ascender和Descender长度. 这是一个相对轴,从0%开始,到排字面的个人最大范围为100%.

355607c02bbafc29.original: Axis that shows in a metaphoric way the effect of time on a chosen topic.
355607c02bbafc29.translationZh: 以隐喻方式显示时间对选定主题的影响的轴心.

335b11cbe221b47e.original: Variable font axis: Rotation in Z
335b11cbe221b47e.translationZh: 可变字体轴: Z 的旋转

815669c7bcc1f81d.original: Glyphs rotate left and right, negative values to the left and positive values to the right, in the Z dimension.
815669c7bcc1f81d.translationZh: Glyphs在Z维度中左右旋转,左侧负值和右侧正值.
